    89→
    90→    await createSingleItemVariant(normalizedCtx, parentGenerationId);
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  const pairShotGenId = normalized.pairShotGenerationId;
    94→
    95→  // Check for existing generation at same position (always check for segment tasks)
    96→  if (finalChildOrder !== null && !isNaN(finalChildOrder)) {
    97→    const existingGenId = await findExistingGenerationAtPosition(
    98→      supabase, parentGenerationId, finalChildOrder, pairShotGenId
    99→    );
   100→
   101→    if (existingGenId) {
   102→      const variantViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   103→        taskParams: normalized.params,
   104→        parentGenerationId,
   105→      });
   106→
   107→      logger?.info("Adding segment as variant to existing generation", {
   108→        task_id: taskId,
   109→        existing_generation_id: existingGenId,
   110→        child_order: finalChildOrder,
   111→      });
   112→
   113→      const variantTypeForExisting = normalized.taskData.variant_type || VARIANT_TYPE_DEFAULT;
   114→
   115→      const variantResult = await createVariantOnParent(
   116→        supabase, existingGenId, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, normalized.taskData, taskId,
   117→        variantTypeForExisting,
   118→        {
   119→          tool_type: normalized.taskData.tool_type,
   120→          created_from: 'segment_variant_at_position',
   121→          segment_index: finalChildOrder,
   122→          pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenId
   123→        },
   124→        null,
   125→        false,
   126→        variantViewedAt
   127→      );
   128→
   129→      if (variantResult) return variantResult;
   130→      console.error(`[GenHandler] Failed to create variant, falling through to new generation`);
   131→    }
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  // Create the child generation
   135→  return createChildGenerationRecord(
   136→    normalizedCtx,
   137→    parentGenerationId,
   138→    finalChildOrder,
   139→    isSingleItem || false,
   140→    pairShotGenId,
   141→  );
   142→}
   143→
   144→// ===== SINGLE-ITEM VARIANT CREATION =====
   145→
   146→/**
   147→ * Create variant on parent for single-item cases
   148→ */
   149→export async function createSingleItemVariant(
   150→  ctx: HandlerContext,
   151→  parentGenerationId: string
   152→): Promise<unknown | null> {
   153→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, childOrder } = ctx;
   154→  const params = asRecord(taskData.params);
   155→
   156→  // Check if this is first variant on parent
   157→  const { count: existingVariantCount } = await supabase
   158→    .from('generation_variants')
   159→    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   160→    .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId);
   161→  const isFirstVariant = (existingVariantCount || 0) === 0;
   162→
   163→  const toolType = asString(params.tool_type) ?? asString(taskData.tool_type);
   164→
   165→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || VARIANT_TYPE_DEFAULT;
   166→
   167→  const result = await createVariantOnParent(
   168→    supabase, parentGenerationId, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, taskData, taskId,
   169→    variantType,
   170→    {
   171→      tool_type: toolType,
   172→      created_from: 'single_item_completion',
   173→      is_single_item: true,
   174→      child_order: childOrder ?? 0,
   175→    },
   176→    null,
   177→    isFirstVariant
   178→  );
   179→
   180→  return result;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Find existing generation at a position (for variant creation)
   185→ */
   186→export async function findExistingGenerationAtPosition(
   187→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   188→  parentGenerationId: string,
   189→  childOrder: number,
   190→  pairShotGenId?: string
   191→): Promise<string | null> {
   192→
   193→  // Strategy 1: Try to find by pair_shot_generation_id column
   194→  if (pairShotGenId) {
   195→    // Match by the FK column (source of truth with referential integrity)
   196→    const { data: matchByColumn, error: matchByColumnError } = await supabase
   197→      .from('generations')
   198→      .select('id')
   199→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   200→      .eq('is_child', true)
   201→      .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', pairShotGenId)
   202→      .maybeSingle();
   203→
   204→    if (!matchByColumnError && matchByColumn?.id) {
   205→      return matchByColumn.id;
   206→    }
   207→
   208→    // NOTE: We intentionally DON'T fall back to params JSONB here.
   209→    // Pre-migration generations have already been migrated to the column.
   210→    // Any generation with NULL column but non-NULL params is orphaned
   211→    // (FK cascade set column to NULL when shot_generation was deleted).
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Strategy 2: Fallback to child_order match
   215→  // IMPORTANT: Only use this fallback when NO pair_shot_generation_id was provided
   216→  // If pairShotGenId was provided but no match found, DON'T fall back to child_order
   217→  // because the existing child at that index may be for a different timeline layout
   218→  if (!pairShotGenId) {
   219→    const { data: matchByChildOrder, error: matchByChildOrderError } = await supabase
   220→      .from('generations')
   221→      .select('id')
   222→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   223→      .eq('is_child', true)
   224→      .eq('child_order', childOrder)
   225→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   226→      .limit(1)
   227→      .maybeSingle();
   228→
   229→    if (!matchByChildOrderError && matchByChildOrder?.id) {
   230→      return matchByChildOrder.id;
   231→    }
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  return null;
   235→}
   236→
   237→/**
   238→ * Create the child generation record and its initial variant
   239→ */
   240→export async function createChildGenerationRecord(
   241→  ctx: HandlerContext,
   242→  parentGenerationId: string,
   243→  childOrder: number | null,
   244→  isSingleItemCase: boolean,
   245→  pairShotGenerationId?: string | null | false
   246→): Promise<unknown> {
   247→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   248→  const params = asRecord(taskData.params);
   249→
   250→  const { shotId } = extractShotAndPosition(params);
   251→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'video';
   252→  const toolType = taskData.tool_type;
   253→  let generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   254→    params, toolType, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   255→  );
   256→
   257→  // Ensure pair_shot_generation_id is at top level of params (for slot matching)
   258→  if (pairShotGenerationId && !generationParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   259→    generationParams = { ...generationParams, pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId };
   260→  }
   261→
   262→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   263→
   264→  const generationName = asString(params.generation_name);
   265→
   266→  // Find based_on
   267→  const basedOnGenerationId = await resolveBasedOn(supabase, params);
   268→
   269→  logger?.info("Creating child generation record", {
   270→    task_id: taskId,
   271→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   272→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   273→    child_order: childOrder,
   274→    is_single_item: isSingleItemCase,
   275→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   276→    pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId || null,
   277→  });
   278→
   279→  // Verify pair_shot_generation_id still exists before inserting (FK constraint check)
   280→  // If the shot_generation was deleted between task creation and completion, set to NULL
   281→  let validatedPairShotGenId = pairShotGenerationId || null;
   282→  if (validatedPairShotGenId) {
   283→    let shotGenQuery = supabase
   284→      .from('shot_generations')
   285→      .select('id')
   286→      .eq('id', validatedPairShotGenId);
   287→
   288→    // Scope to current shot to avoid matching a generation in a different shot
   289→    if (shotId) {
   290→      shotGenQuery = shotGenQuery.eq('shot_id', shotId);
   291→    }
   292→
   293→    const { data: shotGenExists } = await shotGenQuery.maybeSingle();
   294→
   295→    if (!shotGenExists) {
   296→      validatedPairShotGenId = null;
   297→    }
   298→  }
   299→
   300→  const generationRecord: Record<string, unknown> = {
   301→    id: newGenerationId,
   302→    tasks: [taskId],
   303→    params: generationParams,
   304→    type: generationType,
   305→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   306→    name: generationName,
   307→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   308→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   309→    is_child: true,
   310→    child_order: childOrder,
   311→    // Store pair_shot_generation_id as proper column (not just in params)
   312→    // This enables FK constraint and ON DELETE SET NULL behavior
   313→    // Validated above to prevent FK violation if shot_generation was deleted
   314→    pair_shot_generation_id: validatedPairShotGenId,
   315→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   316→  };
   317→
   318→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   319→
   320→  // Build diagnostic snapshot for segment tasks without mixing it into write-path orchestration.
   321→  const isTravelSegmentTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT ||
   322→                               taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.INDIVIDUAL_TRAVEL_SEGMENT;
   323→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   324→
   325→  if (isTravelSegmentTask && childOrder !== null) {
   326→    try {
   327→      const segmentSnapshot = buildSegmentMasterStateSnapshot({
   328→        taskId,
   329→        generationId: newGeneration.id,
   330→        segmentIndex: childOrder,
   331→        parentGenerationId,
   332→        orchestratorDetails,
   333→        segmentParams: params,
   334→        shotId,
   335→      });
   336→      logger?.debug?.('Segment master state', segmentSnapshot);
   337→    } catch (logError) {
   338→      logger?.warn?.('Failed to build segment master state', {
   339→        taskId,
   340→        generationId: newGeneration.id,
   341→        segmentIndex: childOrder,
   342→        error: logError,
   343→      });
   344→    }
   345→  }
   346→
   347→  // Create "original" variant
   348→  let autoViewedAt: string | null = null;
   349→  let createdFrom = 'child_generation_original';
   350→
   351→  if (isSingleItemCase) {
   352→    autoViewedAt = new Date().toISOString();
   353→    createdFrom = 'single_segment_child_original';
   354→  } else {
   355→    autoViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   356→      taskParams: taskData.params,
   357→    });
   358→    if (autoViewedAt) {
   359→      createdFrom = 'single_segment_child_original';
   360→    }
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  await createVariant(
   364→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   365→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: createdFrom },
   366→    true, 'original', null, autoViewedAt
   367→  );
   368→
   369→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   370→
   371→  return newGeneration;
   372→}
   373→

   113→export async function checkOrchestratorCompletion(
   114→  params: CheckOrchestratorCompletionParams,

   116→  const {

   283→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)

   285→async function findSiblingSegments(

   299→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   300→    });
   301→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   302→      return runIdRows;
   303→    }
   304→  }
   305→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   306→    supabase,
   307→    taskType: segmentType,
   308→    projectId,
   309→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   310→    orchestratorTaskId,
   311→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   312→  });
   313→  return orchestratorRows;
   314→}
   315→/**
   316→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   317→ */
   318→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   319→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   320→  finalStepType: string,
   321→  projectId: string,
   322→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   323→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   324→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   325→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   326→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   327→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   328→      supabase,
   329→      taskType: finalStepType,
   330→      projectId,
   331→      select: "id, status",
   332→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   333→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   334→    });
   335→  }
   336→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   337→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   338→      supabase,
   339→      taskType: finalStepType,
   340→      projectId,
   341→      select: "id, status",
   342→      orchestratorTaskId,
   343→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   344→    });
   345→  }
   346→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   347→    return 'not_found';
   348→  }
   349→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   350→    return 'failed';
   351→  }
   352→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
   353→    return 'complete';
   354→  }
   355→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
   356→    return 'pending';
   357→  }
   358→  return 'unknown';
   359→}
   360→/**
   361→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   362→ */
   363→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   364→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   365→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   366→  failedSegments: number,
   367→  totalSegments: number,
   368→  errorMessage?: string,
   369→  logger?: {
   370→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   371→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   372→  },
   373→): Promise<void> {
   374→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   375→    .from("tasks")
   376→    .update({
   377→      status: TASK_STATUS.FAILED,
   378→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   379→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   380→    })
   381→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   382→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   383→    .select('id');
   384→  if (updateOrchError) {
   385→    throw new CompletionError({
   386→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   387→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   388→      recoverable: true,
   389→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   390→      metadata: {
   391→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   393→          ? updateOrchError.message
   394→          : String(updateOrchError),
   395→      },
   396→      cause: updateOrchError,
   397→    });
   398→  }
   399→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   400→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   401→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   402→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   403→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   404→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   405→    });
   406→  }
   407→}
   408→/**
   409→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   410→ */
   411→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   412→  params: {
   413→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   414→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   415→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   416→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   417→    publicUrl: string;
   418→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   419→    supabaseUrl: string;
   420→    serviceKey: string;
   421→    logger?: {
   422→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   423→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   424→    };
   425→  },
   426→): Promise<void> {
   427→  const {
   428→    supabase,
   429→    orchestratorTask,
   430→    orchestratorTaskId,
   431→    allSegments,
   432→    publicUrl,
   433→    isFinalStep,
   434→    supabaseUrl,
   435→    serviceKey,
   436→    logger,
   437→  } = params;
   438→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   439→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   440→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   441→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   442→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   443→      }
   444→    }
   445→  }
   446→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   447→    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
   448→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   449→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   450→  };
   451→  if (isFinalStep) {
   452→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   453→  }
   454→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   455→    .from("tasks")
   456→    .update(updateData)
   457→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   458→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   459→    .select('id');
   460→  if (updateOrchError) {
   461→    throw new CompletionError({
   462→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   463→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   464→      recoverable: true,
   465→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   466→      metadata: {
   467→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   469→          ? updateOrchError.message
   470→          : String(updateOrchError),
   471→      },
   472→      cause: updateOrchError,
   473→    });
   474→  }
   475→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   476→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   477→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   478→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   479→    });
   480→    return;
   481→  }
   482→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   483→    supabaseUrl,
   484→    serviceKey,
   485→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   486→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   487→  });
   488→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   489→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   490→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   491→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   492→    supabase,
   493→    orchestratorTaskId,
   494→    existingResultData,
   495→    billingOutcome,
   496→    billingDecision,
   497→    logger,
   498→  );
   499→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   500→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   501→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   502→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   503→      billing_result: billingResult,
   504→    });
   505→  }
   506→}
   507→

    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    59→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
    60→    
    61→    this.logBuffer.push({
    62→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    63→      source_type: 'edge_function',
    64→      source_id: this.functionName,
    65→      log_level: level,
    66→      message,
    67→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
    68→      metadata
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    73→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    74→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    78→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    79→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
    80→  }

    92→  const splitViewWrapperStyle: React.CSSProperties = isMobileSplitView ? {

    99→  const mainContent = (

   105→
   106→  return (

   111→        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-secondary/10 to-accent/5 opacity-40 dark:opacity-0 pointer-events-none"></div>
   112→

   121→
   122→        <TasksPane onOpenSettings={handleOpenSettings} />
   123→        <ToolsPane />
   124→        <GenerationsPane />
   125→
   126→        {/* Social Icons Footer */}
   127→        <div

   129→          style={footerStyle}
   130→        >
   131→          <SocialIcons />
   132→        </div>
   133→
   134→        <SettingsModal
   135→          isOpen={isSettingsModalOpen}
   136→          onOpenChange={setIsSettingsModalOpen}
   137→          initialTab={settingsInitialTab}
   138→          creditsTab={settingsCreditsTab}
   139→        />
   140→
   141→        {/* Onboarding Modal */}
   142→        <OnboardingModal

   146→

   151→          </React.Suspense>
   152→        </ChunkLoadErrorBoundary>

   311→// ===== HANDLER: STANDALONE GENERATION =====
   312→
   313→/**
   314→ * Creates an independent generation (for regular tasks)
   315→ * Used by: single_image, wan_2_2_i2v, image_inpaint, etc.
   316→ */
   317→export async function handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<unknown> {
   318→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   319→
   320→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   321→
   322→  // Validate shot exists
   323→  if (shotId) {
   324→    const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
   325→    if (uuidRegex.test(shotId)) {
   326→      await supabase.from('shots').select('id').eq('id', shotId).single();
   327→    }
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'image';
   331→  const generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   332→    taskData.params, taskData.tool_type, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   333→  );
   334→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   335→
   336→  const generationName = taskData.params?.generation_name ||
   337→    taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.generation_name ||
   338→    taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.generation_name;
   339→
   340→  // Find based_on
   341→  const basedOnGenerationId = await resolveBasedOn(supabase, taskData.params);
   342→
   343→  logger?.info("Creating standalone generation", {
   344→    task_id: taskId,
   345→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   346→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   347→    shot_id: shotId,
   348→    generation_type: generationType,
   349→  });
   350→
   351→  const generationRecord: Record<string, unknown> = {
   352→    id: newGenerationId,
   353→    tasks: [taskId],
   354→    params: generationParams,
   355→    type: generationType,
   356→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   357→    name: generationName,
   358→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   359→    parent_generation_id: null,
   360→    is_child: false,
   361→    child_order: null,
   362→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   363→  };
   364→
   365→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   366→
   367→  // Create "original" variant
   368→  await createVariant(
   369→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   370→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: 'generation_original' },
   371→    true, 'original', null, null
   372→  );
   373→
   374→  // Link to shot if applicable
   375→  if (shotId) {
   376→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, newGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   377→  }
   378→
   379→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   380→
   381→  return newGeneration;
   382→}

    29→function defaultErrorCode(status: number): string {
    30→  if (status === 401) return 'authentication_failed';
    31→  if (status === 403) return 'forbidden';
    32→  if (status === 404) return 'not_found';
    33→  if (status === 405) return 'method_not_allowed';
    34→  if (status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
    35→  if (status === 503) return 'service_unavailable';
    36→  if (status >= 500) return 'internal_server_error';
    37→  return 'request_failed';
    38→}

    46→    {
    47→      errorCode,
    48→      message,
    49→      recoverable: status >= 500 || status === 429,
    50→    },
    51→    status,
    52→  );
    53→}
    54→
    55→function asObjectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    56→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    57→    return {};
    58→  }
    59→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
    60→}

    62→/**
    63→ * Best-effort mark a task as Failed so the UI can update immediately.
    64→ * Swallows errors — callers still return their own HTTP error response.
    65→ */
    66→export async function markTaskFailed(
    67→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    68→  taskId: string,
    69→  errorMessage: string,
    70→): Promise<void> {
    71→  try {
    72→    await supabase.from("tasks").update({
    73→      status: "Failed",
    74→      error_message: errorMessage,
    75→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    76→    }).eq("id", taskId).in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
    77→  } catch {
    78→    // Best-effort — don't mask the original error
    79→  }
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function persistCompletionFollowUpIssues(
    83→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    84→  taskId: string,
    85→  existingResultData: unknown,
    86→  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
    87→): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
    88→  if (issues.length === 0) {
    89→    return { ok: true };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
    93→  const completionFollowUp = {
    94→    status: 'degraded',
    95→    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    96→    issues,
    97→  };
    98→
    99→  const { error } = await supabase

   101→    .update({
   102→      result_data: {

   104→        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
   105→      },
   106→    })
   107→    .eq('id', taskId);
   108→
   109→  if (error) {

   112→
   113→  return { ok: true };

   121→export async function fetchTaskContext(

1→interface BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput {
     2→  isMobile: boolean;
     3→  isFormOnlyMode: boolean;
     4→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
     5→  isPortraitMode: boolean;
     6→  shouldShowSidePanel: boolean;
     7→  isAnyVideoEditMode: boolean;
     8→  hasSegmentVideo: boolean;
     9→  showTaskDetails: boolean;
    10→  isSegmentSlotMode: boolean;
    11→  effectiveTasksPaneOpen: boolean;
    12→  isTasksPaneLocked: boolean;
    13→}
    14→
    15→interface VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    16→  shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim: boolean;
    17→  showPanel: boolean;
    18→  needsFullscreenLayout: boolean;
    19→  needsTasksPaneOffset: boolean;
    20→  panelVariant: 'desktop' | 'mobile';
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function buildVideoLightboxLayoutState(
    24→  input: BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput,
    25→): VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    26→  const shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim = input.shouldShowSidePanel
    27→    || ((!input.isPortraitMode && input.isTabletOrLarger) && input.isAnyVideoEditMode);
    28→
    29→  const showPanel = shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim
    30→    || ((input.showTaskDetails || input.isAnyVideoEditMode || (input.isSegmentSlotMode && input.hasSegmentVideo)) && input.isMobile);
    31→
    32→  const needsFullscreenLayout = input.isMobile
    33→    || input.isFormOnlyMode
    34→    || input.shouldShowSidePanel
    35→    || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;
    36→
    37→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
    38→    && (input.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || input.isTasksPaneLocked)
    39→    && !input.isPortraitMode
    40→    && input.isTabletOrLarger;
    41→
    42→  const panelVariant = (shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim && !input.isMobile)
    43→    ? 'desktop'
    44→    : 'mobile';
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim,
    48→    showPanel,
    49→    needsFullscreenLayout,
    50→    needsTasksPaneOffset,
    51→    panelVariant,
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→

   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);

   121→
   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);

   133→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   134→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   135→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   136→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   137→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   138→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   139→    );
   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt
   143→    return (
   144→      pickFirstString(
   145→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,
   148→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   157→  // cleared the global prompt.
   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   160→  return (

   165→      params.prompt,

   167→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],

   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)

   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→

   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;

   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];

   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {

   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}

   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));

   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );

   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);

   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }

   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );

   292→
   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';

    15→
    16→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    17→  batchSize?: number;
    18→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    19→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;

    26→  taskMappingError?: string;

    28→
    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

    52→// Helper component to wrap buttons in tooltips (desktop only)

   207→            >

   209→            </Button>
   210→          </TooltipButton>
   211→        );
   212→
   213→      case 'fourth':
   214→        if (!fourthButton) return null;
   215→        return (
   216→          <TooltipButton key="fourth" tooltip={fourthButton.tooltip} showTooltip={showTooltips} side={tooltipSide}>
   217→            <Button
   218→              variant="ghost"
   219→              size="icon"
   220→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(fourthButton.onClick)}
   221→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   222→              className={baseClass}
   223→              aria-label={fourthButton.ariaLabel}
   224→              data-tour={dataTourFourthButton}
   225→            >
   226→              {fourthButton.content || <Square className={iconSize} />}
   227→            </Button>
   228→          </TooltipButton>
   229→        );
   230→
   231→      case 'lock':
   232→        return (
   233→          <TooltipButton key="lock" tooltip="Lock pane open" showTooltip={showTooltips} side={tooltipSide}>
   234→            <Button
   235→              variant="ghost"
   236→              size="icon"
   237→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(() => toggleLock(true))}
   238→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   239→              className={baseClass}
   240→              aria-label="Lock pane"
   241→              data-tour={dataTourLock}
   242→            >

   244→            </Button>
   245→          </TooltipButton>
   246→        );
   247→
   248→      case 'unlock':
   249→        return (

   251→            <Button
   252→              variant="ghost"
   253→              size="icon"
   254→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(() => toggleLock(false))}
   255→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}

   257→              aria-label="Unlock pane"
   258→            >

   260→            </Button>
   261→          </TooltipButton>
   262→        );
   263→
   264→      case 'open':
   265→        return (

   267→            <Button
   268→              variant="ghost"
   269→              size="icon"
   270→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(handleOpen)}
   271→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   272→              className={baseClass}
   273→              aria-label={paneTooltip || "Open pane"}

   284→
   285→  // ==========================================================================
   286→  // RENDER
   287→  // ==========================================================================
   288→
   289→  // Hide on mobile when selection is active
   290→  if (!useDesktopBehavior && selectionActive) return null;
   291→
   292→  const buttons = getButtonsToShow();
   293→
   294→  // Nothing to show
   295→  if (buttons.length === 0) return null;
   296→
   297→  // Container styling
   298→  // TasksPane (right side) should appear above MediaLightbox on iPad/desktop
   299→  // but behind the lightbox on mobile phones for cleaner full-screen lightbox experience
   300→  const isTasksPane = side === 'right';
   301→  const isMobilePhone = isMobile && !isTablet;
   302→  const tasksPaneZIndex = isMobilePhone
   303→    ? UI_Z_LAYERS.TASKS_PANE_TAB_BEHIND_LIGHTBOX
   304→    : UI_Z_LAYERS.TASKS_PANE_TAB_ABOVE_LIGHTBOX;
   305→  const normalLockedZIndex = PANE_CONFIG.zIndex.CONTROL_LOCKED;
   306→  const normalUnlockedZIndex = PANE_CONFIG.zIndex.CONTROL_UNLOCKED;
   307→
   308→  const zIndexClass = isTasksPane
   309→    ? ''
   310→    : (isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked) ? normalLockedZIndex : normalUnlockedZIndex);
   311→
   312→  const bgOpacity = isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked) ? 'bg-zinc-800/90' : 'bg-zinc-800/80';
   313→  const transition = isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked)
   314→    ? PANE_CONFIG.transition.PROPERTIES.TRANSFORM_ONLY
   315→    : PANE_CONFIG.transition.PROPERTIES.TRANSFORM_OPACITY;
   316→
   317→  const positionClasses = (() => {
   318→    switch (side) {
   319→      case 'left': return 'left-0 flex-col';
   320→      case 'right': return 'right-0 flex-col';
   321→      case 'bottom': return 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-0 flex-row';
   322→      default: return '';
   323→    }
   324→  })();
   325→
   326→  // On mobile, left/right panes only show one button - make them taller for easier tapping
   327→  const isMobileSidePane = !useDesktopBehavior && !isBottom && buttons.length === 1;
   328→
   329→  // Add safe area margin for iOS home indicator on touch devices
   330→  // Only when the pane is NOT visible - when visible, the control sits on the pane, not at screen edge
   331→  const needsSafeAreaMargin = isMobile && isBottom && !isVisible;
   332→  const mobileStyle = needsSafeAreaMargin ? {
   333→    ...dynamicStyle,
   334→    marginBottom: safeAreaCalc.marginBottom(0.5),
   335→  } : dynamicStyle;
   336→
   337→  const content = (
   338→    <div
   339→      data-pane-control
   340→      data-tour={dataTour}
   341→      style={{
   342→        ...mobileStyle,
   343→        ...(isTasksPane ? { zIndex: tasksPaneZIndex } : {}),
   344→      }}
   345→      className={cn(
   346→        `fixed ${zIndexClass} flex items-center p-1 backdrop-blur-sm border border-zinc-700 rounded-md gap-1 duration-${PANE_CONFIG.timing.ANIMATION_DURATION} ${PANE_CONFIG.transition.EASING}`,
   347→        bgOpacity,
   348→        transition,
   349→        positionClasses,
   350→        'opacity-100 touch-none',
   351→        // Taller touch target for mobile side panes with single button
   352→        isMobileSidePane && 'min-h-[72px] justify-center'
   353→      )}
   354→      onMouseEnter={useDesktopBehavior && isOpen && !isLocked ? handlePaneEnter : undefined}
   355→      onMouseLeave={useDesktopBehavior && isOpen && !isLocked ? handlePaneLeave : undefined}
   356→      {...containerEventHandlers}
   357→    >
   358→      {buttons.map(renderButton)}
   359→    </div>
   360→  );
   361→
   362→  return content;
   363→};
   364→
   365→export { PaneControlTab };
   366→

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

    59→## Directory Structure
    60→
    61→| Path | Purpose | Key Files |
    62→|------|---------|-----------|
    63→| `/src/app` | App bootstrap & routing | `main.tsx` → `App.tsx` → `routes.tsx` → `Layout.tsx` |
    64→| `/src/pages` | Top-level pages | `HomePage`, `ShotsPage`, `ArtPage`, `SharePage`, `NotFoundPage`, payment pages |
    65→| `/src/tools` | Feature modules | Each tool: `pages/`, `components/`, `hooks/`, `settings.ts` |
    66→| `/src/shared` | Shared code | `components/ui/` (shadcn), `hooks/`, `contexts/`, `lib/` |
    67→| `/supabase/functions` | Edge Functions | Task processing, payments, AI integration |
    68→| `/supabase/migrations` | DB migrations | Schema changes (use `db push --linked`) |
    69→| Root | Build configs | `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `railway.toml` |

    71→---
    72→
    73→## Core Concepts
    74→
    75→### Tools
    76→Tools live in `/src/tools/{tool-name}/` following a consistent structure. See [adding_new_tool.md](docs/structure_detail/adding_new_tool.md).
    77→
    78→**Active tools:** Image Generation, Video Travel, Animate Characters, Edit Images, Edit Video, Join Clips, Training Data Helper
    79→
    80→### Shots & Generations
    81→- **Generations** = gallery items (images/videos produced by AI tasks)
    82→- **Shots** = containers that organize generations into a timeline
    83→- **`shot_generations`** = join table with position + metadata (pair prompts, timeline frame)
    84→- Data access: `useShotImages(shotId)` → see [data_fetching.md](docs/structure_detail/data_fetching.md)
    85→
    86→### Settings Resolution
    87→Priority: **shot → project → user → defaults**. See [settings_system.md](docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md).
    88→
    89→### Task System
    90→Async queue for AI workloads: client creates task → DB trigger → worker polls → Edge Function completes.
    91→See [task_worker_lifecycle.md](docs/structure_detail/task_worker_lifecycle.md).
    92→
    93→### Realtime
    94→Smart polling + Supabase realtime subscriptions. Connected = no polling; disconnected = 15s fallback.
    95→See [realtime_system.md](docs/structure_detail/realtime_system.md).
    96→

    98→
    99→## Key Utilities
   100→
   101→| System | Location | Purpose |
   102→|--------|----------|---------|
   103→| **queryKeys** | `lib/queryKeys.ts` | Central registry for all React Query cache keys |
   104→| **errors** | `lib/errors.ts` | Typed error classes (`NetworkError`, `AuthError`, `ValidationError`, etc.) |
   105→| **errorHandler** | `lib/errorHandler.ts` | Centralized `handleError()` with logging + toast |
   106→| **AppErrorBoundary** | `components/AppErrorBoundary.tsx` | App-level crash recovery UI |
   107→| **ModalContainer** | `components/ModalContainer.tsx` | Unified responsive modal with header/footer/scroll |
   108→| **ConfirmDialog** | `components/ConfirmDialog.tsx` | Promise-based confirmation dialogs with presets |
   109→| **settingsResolution** | `lib/settingsResolution.ts` | Resolve settings across scopes |
   110→| **settingsWriteQueue** | `lib/settingsWriteQueue.ts` | Global queue for settings writes (prevents network flooding) |
   111→| **debugConfig** | `lib/debugConfig.ts` | Runtime debug logging (`window.debugConfig`) |
   112→| **taskConfig** | `lib/taskConfig.ts` | Task visibility & display names |
   113→| **performanceUtils** | `lib/performanceUtils.ts` | Frame budget monitoring |
   114→
   115→Instrumentation lives in `src/integrations/supabase/instrumentation/` — see its [README](src/integrations/supabase/instrumentation/README.md).

   212→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {

   214→    stage: 'idle',
   215→    message: '',
   216→  });

   218→  /**
   219→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket

   221→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
   222→    const fileName = `${crypto.randomUUID()}-${file.name}`;
   223→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
   224→    const { error } = await supabase().storage
   225→      .from('temporary')
   226→      .upload(filePath, file, {
   227→        cacheControl: '3600',
   228→        upsert: false,
   229→      });
   230→
   231→    if (error) {
   232→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    return filePath;
   236→  };
   237→
   238→  /**

   240→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs.
   241→   */
   242→  const uploadToHuggingFace = async (
   243→    loraFiles: LoraFiles,
   244→    loraDetails: LoraDetails,
   245→    sampleVideos: File[] = [],
   246→    options: {
   247→      isPrivate?: boolean;
   248→      repoName?: string;
   249→    } = {}
   250→  ): Promise<UploadResult> => {
   251→    try {
   252→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase().auth.getUser();
   253→      if (!user) {
   254→        return operationFailure(new Error('Not authenticated'), {
   255→          errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_not_authenticated',
   256→          recoverable: false,
   257→          policy: 'fail_closed',
   258→        });
   259→      }
   260→
   261→      const storagePaths = await uploadLoraFilesToTempStorage({
   262→        loraFiles,
   263→        userId: user.id,
   264→        setUploadProgress,
   265→        uploadToTempStorage,
   266→      });
   267→
   268→      if (!storagePaths) {
   269→        return operationFailure(new Error('No LoRA file provided'), {
   270→          errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_missing_file',
   271→          recoverable: false,
   272→          policy: 'fail_closed',
   273→        });
   274→      }
   275→
   276→      const sampleVideoMeta = await uploadSampleVideosToTempStorage({
   277→        sampleVideos,
   278→        userId: user.id,
   279→        setUploadProgress,
   280→        uploadToTempStorage,
   281→      });
   282→
   283→      setUploadProgress({
   284→        stage: 'processing',
   285→        message: 'Uploading to HuggingFace...',
   286→        progress: 60,
   287→      });
   288→
   289→      const response = await invokeHuggingFaceUpload({
   290→        storagePaths,
   291→        loraDetails,
   292→        sampleVideoMeta,
   293→        options,
   294→      });
   295→
   296→      setUploadProgress({
   297→        stage: 'complete',
   298→        message: 'Upload complete!',
   299→        progress: 100,
   300→      });
   301→
   302→      return operationSuccess(mapUploadSuccess(response));
   303→    } catch (err) {
   304→      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
   305→      setUploadProgress({
   306→        stage: 'error',
   307→        message: errorMessage,
   308→      });
   309→      return operationFailure(err, {
   310→        errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_failed',
   311→        message: errorMessage,
   312→      });
   313→    }
   314→  };

   316→  const resetProgress = () => {

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}

   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {

   408→    },

    11→ *

1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}
    46→

1→/**
     2→ * LineageGifModal
     3→ *
     4→ * Modal component that displays the lineage chain as a grid of images
     5→ * (4 across, scrollable) with a Download GIF button at the bottom.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import React, { useState } from 'react';
     9→import { Download, Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
    10→import { Button } from '@/shared/components/ui/button';
    11→import { Progress } from '@/shared/components/ui/progress';
    12→import { useLineageChain } from '@/shared/hooks/variants/useLineageChain';
    13→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
    14→import { GIFEncoder, quantize, applyPalette } from 'gifenc';
    15→
    16→interface CreateGifProgress {
    17→  stage: 'loading' | 'encoding' | 'complete';
    18→  current: number;
    19→  total: number;
    20→  message: string;
    21→}
    22→
    23→function loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
    24→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    25→    const img = new Image();
    26→    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    27→    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image from blob'));
    28→    img.src = blobUrl;
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→async function createLineageGif(
    33→  imageUrls: string[],
    34→  options: { frameDelay?: number; width?: number } = {},
    35→  onProgress?: (progress: CreateGifProgress) => void
    36→): Promise<Blob> {
    37→  const { frameDelay = 800, width = 512 } = options;
    38→  if (imageUrls.length === 0) throw new Error('No images provided for GIF creation');
    39→
    40→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'loading', current: 0, total: imageUrls.length, message: 'Loading images...' });
    41→
    42→  const images: HTMLImageElement[] = [];
    43→  const blobUrls: string[] = [];
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < imageUrls.length; i++) {
    46→    try {
    47→      const response = await fetch(imageUrls[i]);
    48→      if (!response.ok) continue;
    49→      const blob = await response.blob();
    50→      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    51→      blobUrls.push(blobUrl);
    52→      const img = await loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl);
    53→      images.push(img);
    54→      onProgress?.({ stage: 'loading', current: i + 1, total: imageUrls.length, message: `Loading images ${i + 1}/${imageUrls.length}` });
    55→    } catch { /* Skip failed images */ }
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  if (images.length === 0) {
    59→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
    60→    throw new Error('No images could be loaded');
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const firstImage = images[0];
    64→  const aspectRatio = firstImage.width / firstImage.height;
    65→  const height = Math.round(width / aspectRatio);
    66→
    67→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    68→  canvas.width = width;
    69→  canvas.height = height;
    70→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    71→
    72→  if (!ctx) {
    73→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
    74→    throw new Error('Could not get canvas context');
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const gif = GIFEncoder();
    78→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'encoding', current: 0, total: images.length, message: 'Encoding frames...' });
    79→
    80→  for (let i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
    81→    const img = images[i];
    82→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    83→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    84→
    85→    const imgAspect = img.width / img.height;
    86→    const targetAspect = width / height;
    87→    let drawWidth: number, drawHeight: number, drawX: number, drawY: number;
    88→
    89→    if (imgAspect > targetAspect) {
    90→      drawWidth = width;
    91→      drawHeight = width / imgAspect;
    92→      drawX = 0;
    93→      drawY = (height - drawHeight) / 2;
    94→    } else {
    95→      drawHeight = height;
    96→      drawWidth = height * imgAspect;
    97→      drawX = (width - drawWidth) / 2;
    98→      drawY = 0;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    ctx.drawImage(img, drawX, drawY, drawWidth, drawHeight);
   102→    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
   103→    const rgbaPixels = new Uint8Array(imageData.data);
   104→    const palette = quantize(rgbaPixels, 256, { format: 'rgba4444' });
   105→    const indexedPixels = applyPalette(rgbaPixels, palette);
   106→    gif.writeFrame(indexedPixels, width, height, { palette, delay: frameDelay / 10 });
   107→    onProgress?.({ stage: 'encoding', current: i + 1, total: images.length, message: `Encoding frames ${i + 1}/${images.length}` });
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
   111→  gif.finish();
   112→  const gifBytes = gif.bytes();
   113→  const blob = new Blob([gifBytes], { type: 'image/gif' });
   114→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'complete', current: images.length, total: images.length, message: 'Complete!' });
   115→  return blob;
   116→}
   117→
   118→function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
   119→  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   120→  const a = document.createElement('a');
   121→  a.href = url;
   122→  a.download = filename;
   123→  document.body.appendChild(a);
   124→  a.click();
   125→  document.body.removeChild(a);
   126→  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   127→}

   131→interface LineageGifModalProps {
