   135→}
   136→
   137→type DownloadState =
   138→  | { status: 'idle' }
   139→  | { status: 'generating'; progress: CreateGifProgress }
   140→  | { status: 'error'; message: string };
   141→
   142→export const LineageGifModal: React.FC<LineageGifModalProps> = ({
   143→  open,
   144→  onClose,
   145→  variantId,
   146→}) => {
   147→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
   148→  const [downloadState, setDownloadState] = useState<DownloadState>({ status: 'idle' });
   149→
   150→  // Fetch the lineage chain
   151→  const { chain, isLoading: isChainLoading, hasLineage, error: chainError } = useLineageChain(
   152→    open ? variantId : null,
   153→    selectedProjectId ?? null,
   154→  );
   155→
   156→  const handleDownloadGif = async () => {
   157→    if (chain.length === 0) return;
   158→
   159→    setDownloadState({ status: 'generating', progress: { stage: 'loading', current: 0, total: chain.length, message: 'Starting...' } });
   160→
   161→    try {
   162→      const imageUrls = chain.map((item) => item.imageUrl);
   163→
   164→      const blob = await createLineageGif(imageUrls, { frameDelay: 800 }, (progress) => {
   165→        setDownloadState({ status: 'generating', progress });
   166→      });
   167→
   168→      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
   169→      downloadBlob(blob, `lineage-${timestamp}.gif`);
   170→      setDownloadState({ status: 'idle' });
   171→    } catch (err) {
   172→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'LineageGifModal', showToast: false });
   173→      setDownloadState({
   174→        status: 'error',
   175→        message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to generate GIF',
   176→      });
   177→    }
   178→  };
   179→
   180→  const renderContent = () => {
   181→    if (isChainLoading) {
   182→      return (
   183→        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-4">
   184→          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
   185→          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading lineage...</p>
   186→        </div>
   187→      );
   188→    }
   189→
   190→    if (chainError) {
   191→      return (
   192→        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-4">
   193→          <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-destructive" />
   194→          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">{chainError.message}</p>
   195→          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
   196→            Close
   197→          </Button>
   198→        </div>
   199→      );
   200→    }
   201→
   202→    if (!hasLineage || chain.length < 2) {
   203→      return (
   204→        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-4">
   205→          <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-destructive" />
   206→          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">No lineage found for this image</p>
   207→          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
   208→            Close
   209→          </Button>
   210→        </div>
   211→      );
   212→    }
   213→
   214→    const isGenerating = downloadState.status === 'generating';
   215→    const progress = isGenerating ? downloadState.progress : null;
   216→    const percentage = progress && progress.total > 0
   217→      ? Math.round((progress.current / progress.total) * 100)
   218→      : 0;
   219→
   220→    return (
   221→      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
   222→        {/* Image grid - 4 across, scrollable */}
   223→        <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
   224→          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
   225→            {chain.map((item, index) => (
   226→              <div

   229→              >

   232→                  alt={`Lineage ${index + 1}`}

   238→                  {index + 1}

   241→            ))}
   242→          </div>
   243→        </div>
   244→
   245→        {/* Info text */}
   246→        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center">
   247→          {chain.length} images · Oldest to newest (left to right, top to bottom)
   248→        </p>
   249→
   250→        {/* Download button with progress */}
   251→        {isGenerating ? (

   256→            </div>

   260→            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
   261→            Download GIF
   262→          </Button>

   264→
   265→        {/* Error message */}
   266→        {downloadState.status === 'error' && (

   268→        )}
   269→      </div>
   270→    );
   271→  };
   272→
   273→  return (

   277→      size="large"
   278→      title="Evolution"
   279→    >
   280→      {renderContent()}
   281→    </ModalContainer>
   282→  );
   283→};

    25→/**
    26→ * Sanitize task data before caching in shared_generations
    27→ * Removes potentially sensitive fields from params

    29→function sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(taskData: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    30→  if (!taskData) return null;
    31→  
    32→  const sanitized = { ...taskData };
    33→
    34→  const redactDeep = (value: unknown, depth: number = 0): unknown => {
    35→    if (depth > 6) return null;
    36→    if (value == null) return value;
    37→    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => redactDeep(v, depth + 1));
    38→    if (typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    39→
    40→    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    41→    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    42→      // Strip any obviously sensitive keys
    43→      if (/(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|service_role|authorization|stripe)/i.test(k)) {
    44→        continue;
    45→      }
    46→      out[k] = redactDeep(v, depth + 1);
    47→    }
    48→    return out;
    49→  };

    51→  // Remove or sanitize sensitive fields from params
    52→  if (sanitized.params) {

    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  // Remove fields that shouldn't be exposed

    62→function buildShareUrl(slug: string): string {
    63→  return `${window.location.origin}/share/${slug}`;

    66→const SHARE_COPIED_RESET_DELAY_MS = 2000;
    67→
    68→function markShareCopied(
    69→  setShareCopied: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>,

    75→async function copyToClipboardWithFallback(value: string): Promise<boolean> {
    76→  try {
    77→    if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    78→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    79→      return true;
    80→    }
    81→  } catch {
    82→    // Fall back to textarea copy path below.
    83→  }
    84→
    85→  try {
    86→    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    87→    textarea.value = value;
    88→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    89→    textarea.style.opacity = '0';
    90→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    91→    textarea.focus();
    92→    textarea.select();
    93→    const copied = document.execCommand('copy');
    94→    document.body.removeChild(textarea);
    95→    return copied;
    96→  } catch {
    97→    return false;
    98→  }
    99→}

   101→async function fetchExistingShareSlug(
   102→  generationId: string,
   103→  userId: string,
   104→): Promise<string | null> {
   105→  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   106→    .select('share_slug')
   107→    .eq('generation_id', generationId)
   108→    .eq('creator_id', userId)
   109→    .maybeSingle();
   110→
   111→  if (error && !isNotFoundError(error)) {
   112→    throw error;
   113→  }
   114→
   115→  return data?.share_slug ?? null;
   116→}
   117→
   118→interface ShareCachedDataResult {
   119→  generationData: Record<string, unknown>;
   120→  augmentedTaskData: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   121→}
   122→
   123→async function fetchShareCachedData(
   124→  generationId: string,
   125→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   126→  shotId?: string | null,
   127→): Promise<ShareCachedDataResult> {
   128→  const generationResult = await supabase().from('generations')
   129→    .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, type, params, created_at, name')
   130→    .eq('id', generationId)
   131→    .single();
   132→
   133→  if (generationResult.error || !generationResult.data) {
   134→    throw generationResult.error ?? new Error('Failed to load generation data');
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  let taskResultData: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
   138→  if (taskId) {
   139→    const { data } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   140→      .select('id, task_type, params, status, created_at')
   141→      .eq('id', taskId)
   142→      .single();
   143→    taskResultData = data as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  let augmentedTaskData: Record<string, unknown> | null = taskResultData;
   147→
   148→  if (shotId) {
   149→    try {
   150→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase().from('shots')
   151→        .select('id, name, settings')
   152→        .eq('id', shotId)
   153→        .single();
   154→
   155→      const { data: shotGenerations, error: genError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   156→        .select(`
   157→          timeline_frame,
   158→          generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(
   159→            id,
   160→            location,
   161→            thumbnail_url,
   162→            type
   163→          )
   164→        `)
   165→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   166→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   167→
   168→      if (!shotError && !genError && shotData && shotGenerations) {
   169→        const travelSettings = (shotData.settings as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.travel_between_images as Record<string, unknown> || {};
   170→        const generationMode = travelSettings.generationMode || 'batch';
   171→
   172→        const images = shotGenerations
   173→          .filter((sg) => sg.generation?.type === 'image' && sg.generation?.location)
   174→          .map((sg) => ({
   175→            url: sg.generation.location,
   176→            thumbnail_url: sg.generation.thumbnail_url,
   177→            timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   178→          }));
   179→
   180→        augmentedTaskData = {
   181→          ...taskResultData,
   182→          cached_shot_data: {
   183→            shot_id: shotId,
   184→            shot_name: shotData.name,
   185→            generation_mode: generationMode,
   186→            images,
   187→            settings: {
   188→              prompt: travelSettings.batchVideoPrompt || '',
   189→              negative_prompt: travelSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   190→              frames: travelSettings.batchVideoFrames || 38,
   191→              steps: travelSettings.batchVideoSteps || 6,
   192→              motion: travelSettings.amountOfMotion || 50,
   193→              enhance_prompt: travelSettings.enhancePrompt || false,
   194→              phase_config: travelSettings.phaseConfig || null,
   195→              context_frames: travelSettings.contextFrames || 0,
   196→            },
   197→          },
   198→        };
   199→      }
   200→    } catch {
   201→      // Keep share creation resilient when shot-cache enrichment fails.
   202→    }
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  return {
   206→    generationData: generationResult.data as Record<string, unknown>,
   207→    augmentedTaskData,
   208→  };
   209→}
   210→
   211→interface InsertShareWithRetryArgs {
   212→  generationId: string;
   213→  taskId: string | null | undefined;
   214→  shotId?: string | null;
   215→  userId: string;
   216→  generationData: Record<string, unknown>;
   217→  augmentedTaskData: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   218→  generateShareSlug: (length?: number) => string;
   219→}
   220→
   221→async function insertShareWithRetry({
   222→  generationId,
   223→  taskId,
   224→  shotId,
   225→  userId,
   226→  generationData,
   227→  augmentedTaskData,
   228→  generateShareSlug,
   229→}: InsertShareWithRetryArgs): Promise<string | null> {
   230→  const maxAttempts = 5;
   231→  let attempts = 0;
   232→
   233→  const { data: creatorRow } = await supabase().from('users')
   234→    .select('username, name, avatar_url')
   235→    .eq('id', userId)
   236→    .maybeSingle();
   237→
   238→  while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
   239→    const candidateSlug = generateShareSlug(10);
   240→    const creator = (creatorRow as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? null;
   241→    const normalizedTaskId = typeof taskId === 'string' && taskId.length > 0 ? taskId : null;
   242→    const sharedGenerationInsert = {
   243→      share_slug: candidateSlug,
   244→      ...(normalizedTaskId ? { task_id: normalizedTaskId } : {}),
   245→      generation_id: generationId,
   246→      creator_id: userId,
   247→      creator_username: asNullableString(creator?.username),
   248→      creator_name: asNullableString(creator?.name),
   249→      creator_avatar_url: asNullableString(creator?.avatar_url),
   250→      cached_generation_data: generationData,
   251→      cached_task_data: sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(augmentedTaskData),
   252→      shot_id: shotId || null,
   253→    };
   254→
   255→    const { data: newShare, error: insertError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   256→      .insert(sharedGenerationInsert)
   257→      .select('share_slug')
   258→      .single();
   259→
   260→    if (!insertError && newShare) {
   261→      return newShare.share_slug;
   262→    }
   263→
   264→    if (isUniqueViolationError(insertError)) {
   265→      attempts++;
   266→      continue;
   267→    }
   268→
   269→    if (insertError) {
   270→      throw insertError;
   271→    }
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  return null;
   275→}
   276→
   277→interface CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs {
   278→  slug: string;
   279→  successTitle: string;
   280→  successDescription: string;
   281→  fallbackTitle: string;
   282→  fallbackDescription: string;
   283→  setShareCopied: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
   284→}
   285→
   286→async function copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   287→  slug,
   288→  successTitle,
   289→  successDescription,
   290→  fallbackTitle,
   291→  fallbackDescription,
   292→  setShareCopied,
   293→}: CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs): Promise<void> {
   294→  const copied = await copyToClipboardWithFallback(buildShareUrl(slug));
   295→  if (copied) {
   296→    markShareCopied(setShareCopied);
   297→    toast({ title: successTitle, description: successDescription });
   298→    return;
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  toast({ title: fallbackTitle, description: fallbackDescription });
   302→}
   303→
   304→/**
   305→ * Hook to handle sharing of generations via unique slug
   306→ *
   307→ * @param generationId - The generation to share
   308→ * @param taskId - The task associated with the generation
   309→ * @param shotId - Optional shot ID for final videos (to fetch input images and settings)
   310→ */
   311→export function useShareGeneration(
   312→  generationId: string | undefined,
   313→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   314→  shotId?: string | null,
   315→  options?: UseShareGenerationOptions
   316→): UseShareGenerationResult {
   317→  const { initialShareSlug, onShareCreated } = options ?? {};
   318→  const [shareSlug, setShareSlug] = useState<string | null>(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   319→  const [isCreatingShare, setIsCreatingShare] = useState(false);
   320→  const [shareCopied, setShareCopied] = useState(false);
   321→  // Reset share state when shot/generation changes
   322→  useEffect(() => {
   323→    setShareSlug(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   324→    setShareCopied(false);
   325→  }, [generationId, shotId, initialShareSlug]);
   326→
   327→  // Generate a short, URL-friendly random string
   328→  const generateShareSlug = (length: number = 10): string => {
   329→    const chars = [REDACTED];
   330→    let result = '';
   331→    const randomValues = new Uint8Array(length);
   332→    crypto.getRandomValues(randomValues);
   333→    
   334→    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
   335→      result += chars[randomValues[i] % chars.length];
   336→    }
   337→    
   338→    return result;
   339→  };
   340→
   341→  const handleShare = useCallback(async (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
   342→    e.stopPropagation();
   343→    e.preventDefault();
   344→
   345→    if (!generationId) {
   346→      toast({
   347→        title: 'Cannot create share',
   348→        description: 'Generation information not available',
   349→        variant: 'destructive',
   350→      });
   351→      return;
   352→    }
   353→
   354→    if (shareSlug) {
   355→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   356→        slug: shareSlug,
   357→        successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   358→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   359→        fallbackTitle: 'Share ready',
   360→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   361→        setShareCopied,
   362→      });
   363→      return;
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    setIsCreatingShare(true);
   367→    try {
   368→      const { data: sessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   369→      const [REDACTED]?.access_token;
   370→      const userId = sessionData.session?.user.id;
   371→
   372→      if (!accessToken || !userId) {
   373→        toast({
   374→          title: 'Authentication required',
   375→          description: 'Please sign in to create share links',
   376→          variant: 'destructive',
   377→        });
   378→        return;
   379→      }
   380→
   381→      const existingSlug = await fetchExistingShareSlug(generationId, userId);
   382→      if (existingSlug) {
   383→        setShareSlug(existingSlug);
   384→        await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   385→          slug: existingSlug,
   386→          successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   387→          successDescription: 'Existing share link copied to clipboard',
   388→          fallbackTitle: 'Share found',
   389→          fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   390→          setShareCopied,
   391→        });
   392→        return;
   393→      }
   394→
   395→      const { generationData, augmentedTaskData } = await fetchShareCachedData(
   396→        generationId,
   397→        taskId,
   398→        shotId,
   399→      );
   400→
   401→      const newSlug = await insertShareWithRetry({
   402→        generationId,
   403→        taskId,
   404→        shotId,
   405→        userId,
   406→        generationData,
   407→        augmentedTaskData,
   408→        generateShareSlug,
   409→      });
   410→
   411→      if (!newSlug) {
   412→        toast({
   413→          title: 'Share failed',
   414→          description: 'Failed to generate unique link. Please try again.',
   415→          variant: 'destructive',
   416→        });
   417→        return;
   418→      }
   419→
   420→      setShareSlug(newSlug);
   421→      onShareCreated?.(generationId, newSlug);
   422→
   423→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   424→        slug: newSlug,
   425→        successTitle: 'Share created!',
   426→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   427→        fallbackTitle: 'Share created',
   428→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   429→        setShareCopied,
   430→      });
   431→    } catch (error) {
   432→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   433→        context: 'useShareGeneration',
   434→        toastTitle: 'Share failed',
   435→        logData: { message: 'Please try again' },
   436→      });
   437→    } finally {
   438→      setIsCreatingShare(false);
   439→    }
   440→  }, [generationId, onShareCreated, shareSlug, shotId, taskId]);
   441→
   442→  return {
   443→    handleShare,
   444→    isCreatingShare,
   445→    shareCopied,
   446→    shareSlug
   447→  };
   448→}

   122→
   123→async function fetchShareCachedData(
   124→  generationId: string,
   125→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   126→  shotId?: string | null,
   127→): Promise<ShareCachedDataResult> {
   128→  const generationResult = await supabase().from('generations')
   129→    .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, type, params, created_at, name')
   130→    .eq('id', generationId)
   131→    .single();
   132→
   133→  if (generationResult.error || !generationResult.data) {
   134→    throw generationResult.error ?? new Error('Failed to load generation data');
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  let taskResultData: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
   138→  if (taskId) {
   139→    const { data } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   140→      .select('id, task_type, params, status, created_at')
   141→      .eq('id', taskId)
   142→      .single();
   143→    taskResultData = data as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  let augmentedTaskData: Record<string, unknown> | null = taskResultData;
   147→
   148→  if (shotId) {

   150→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase().from('shots')
   151→        .select('id, name, settings')
   152→        .eq('id', shotId)
   153→        .single();
   154→
   155→      const { data: shotGenerations, error: genError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   156→        .select(`
   157→          timeline_frame,
   158→          generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(
   159→            id,
   160→            location,
   161→            thumbnail_url,
   162→            type
   163→          )
   164→        `)
   165→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   166→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   167→
   168→      if (!shotError && !genError && shotData && shotGenerations) {

   170→        const generationMode = travelSettings.generationMode || 'batch';
   171→

   174→          .map((sg) => ({

---

## Wontfix Investigation Results

I've thoroughly reviewed each file and assessed whether the wontfix claims hold up or could be improved. Here are my findings:

### 1. **useSharedLightboxState.ts (521 lines)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "mostly legitimate orchestration, trimming thin wrappers is low-value"

**Reality:** This file is 520 lines and contains 8 functions (7 internal, 1 export). The claim is **partially wrong**—there IS mechanical pass-through happening, but the bigger issue is that the internal functions are thin wrappers that each destructure their input, call 1-3 other hooks, and immediately bundle the results back up.

Breakdown:
- `useSharedVariantsState` (lines 42-114): Calls 3 hooks + one useRef + one useEffect + one useCallback. Lines 92-114 are just bundling results into an object.
- `useLightboxShotActions` (lines 119-189): Calls 3 hooks + some useMemo. Lines 180-189 bundle results.
- `useSharedMakeMainVariantState` (lines 192-236): Calls 1 hook, does 3 variable assignments for `can*` flags, then bundles (230-236).
- `useLightboxNavigationModel` (lines 315-351): Calls 3 hooks, creates 1 computed object (347-351).
- `useSharedButtonGroupState` (lines 354-441): Complex—creates useCallback and useMemo with ~2 lines of logic each, bundles results in huge object (396-441).
- `useInteractionState` (lines 239-310): Calls 6+ hooks, then bundles in one big object (280-310).
- `usePresentationState` (lines 443-496): Calls 3-4 hooks, bundles (479-496).

**The real problem:** These functions exist primarily to organize the return objects. They could be collapsed significantly by:
1. Moving the `return {}` bundling logic directly into the main hook's return statement
2. Extracting only the *computed* parts (e.g., the `can*` flags in `useSharedMakeMainVariantState`) into mini-helpers
3. Accepting that some multi-line return objects are OK if they're at the leaf level

**Recommendation:** Extract computed-value helpers (3-4 lines each), inline the rest. This reduces from 520 → ~250 lines with no loss of clarity. The wontfix oversimplifies the problem.

---

### 2. **useInlineEditState.ts (466 lines)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "well-structured with extracted sub-hooks, remaining mapping IS the hook's purpose"

**Reality:** The hook is 466 lines with 7 functions (6 internal, 1 export). The claim is **misleading**. Yes, sub-hooks are extracted, but the file has a **fundamental issue**: lines 244-321 (`buildInlineEditStateModels`) are a 77-line function that maps output from 4 hooks into 3 nested objects. This function is:
- Called once per render (line 427)
- Not memoized despite containing many destructured assignments
- A pure mapping (no side effects)
- Could trivially be removed by inlining its object shape

Lines 437-465 (the final return) are also pure bundling.

**The real problem:** The core export (`useInlineEditState`) is only ~65 lines of actual logic (402-436). The rest is infrastructure that could be streamlined:
- `buildInlineEditStateModels` is a pure transformer—should be a const object builder, not a function
- Many internal helpers (like `useInlineEditReposition`, `useInlineEditImg2Img`) are simple wrappers around single hooks
- The result type definition spans 75 lines (322-397) with heavy nesting

**Recommendation:** Flatten the return structure (don't nest so deeply), memoize or eliminate `buildInlineEditStateModels`, and remove wrapper functions that call a single hook and pass all args through unchanged. This reduces mechanical mapping without losing readability.

---

### 3. **useDeleteGeneration / useDeleteVariant (deleteGenerationScoped / deleteVariantScoped)** — VERDICT: WONTFIX

**Claim:** "2 branches with union type, splitting would duplicate error handling"

**Reality:** **This claim is correct.** The two functions are:
- `deleteGenerationScoped` (lines 276-308): validates generation scope, calls delete repo, checks for error + no-rows error
- `deleteVariantScoped` (lines 313-345): validates variant scope (which returns generationId), calls delete repo, checks for error + no-rows error

The error handling is *identical* in both (the `normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow` pattern with the same log structure). Extracting this into a shared `deleteScoped()` helper would require either:
1. A union type that accepts both scope types (add indirection without clarity)
2. Duplicating the error handling in two places (worse than now)
3. A closure that captures the error context (obscures the flow)

**Keeping them separate is correct.** The duplicate code is justified by the coupling to their respective validation functions.

---

### 4. **LightboxLayout.tsx (440 lines, 4 levels of prop drilling)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "4-level prop drilling is inherent to React composition"

**Reality:** **This is false.** The file uses a `model` object that bundles context access (line 37-81), then passes `model` through 6+ components. This actually *prevents* context usage. Looking at lines 12-18:

```tsx
useLightboxCoreSafe(),
useLightboxMediaSafe(),
useLightboxVariantsSafe(),
useLightboxNavigationSafe(),
useImageEditCanvasSafe(),
useVideoEditSafe(),
```

These are already context hooks (the `Safe` suffix indicates they use contexts). They're being called in `useLightboxLayoutModel`, bundled, and passed down as props instead of being called directly in each component that needs them.

**The real problem:** Components like `MediaContent`, `TopCenterOverlay`, `OverlayElements`, `CompactEditControls`, and `PanelLayoutView` are receiving `model: LightboxLayoutModel` as a single prop but only using 2-3 fields each. They could call the context hooks directly.

**Why it happened:** Likely done to avoid multiple context calls per render. But React Query and most context libraries batch this anyway, so the optimization is premature.

**Recommendation:** Remove the `useLightboxLayoutModel` bundling. Have each component call only the contexts it needs. The `model` pattern saves 1 function call depth but costs clarity and forces all prop drilling to go through one type.

---

### 5. **segmentSettingsMigration.ts (LoRA format coexistence)** — VERDICT: WONTFIX (mostly)

**Claim:** "formats converge naturally as users save"

**Reality:** **Partially true, but incomplete.** The file handles 4 LoRA formats on read:
1. Legacy `pair_loras` (object: `{ "path": strength }`)
2. Legacy `additional_loras` (object: `{ "path": strength }`)
3. New `loras` array (at params level)
4. New `loras` array (at orchestrator_details level)

On write (lines 286-297), it writes only the new format and deletes old fields on next save. This **does** converge formats automatically.

**However, there's a subtle risk:** If a user has `additional_loras` in their DB and they:
1. Open the form → reads via `normalizeLegacyLoraRecord` → displays correctly
2. Don't touch the lora field → `settings.loras` is undefined → write skips lora cleanup (line 331: `if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;`)

The legacy field persists indefinitely.

**Why it's not a blocker:** The fields are read-tolerant (coexistence is harmless) and will clean up when user actually edits loras. Over time, all dB rows will have loras updated. This is a reasonable gradual migration.

**Recommendation:** KEEP as-is. The gradual cleanup is safe. If you wanted to be stricter, you could add a comment explaining the lazy cleanup strategy, but no code change needed.

---

## Summary Table

| Item | Current | Verdict | Effort | Impact |
|------|---------|---------|--------|--------|
| 1. useSharedLightboxState (521 LOC) | Mostly wrappers | **FIX** | 2-3h | High clarity, -50% LOC |
| 2. useInlineEditState (466 LOC) | Mechanical mapping | **FIX** | 2h | Better structure, -30% LOC |
| 3. deleteGeneration/Variant | Justified duplication | **WONTFIX** | — | Duplication is acceptable |
| 4. LightboxLayout prop drilling | Avoidable via contexts | **FIX** | 1.5h | Much clearer component boundaries |
| 5. LoRA format coexistence | Lazy cleanup OK | **WONTFIX** | — | Gradual migration is sound |

Items 1, 2, and 4 are real improvements worth making. Items 3 and 5 are correctly marked as wontfix.

   313→// --- Presentation state (navigation, layout, effective media, button groups) ---
   314→
   315→function useLightboxNavigationModel(
   316→  core: SharedLightboxCoreProps,
   317→  navigation: SharedLightboxNavigationProps,
   318→) {
   319→  const { onClose, readOnly } = core;
   320→  const {
   321→    hasNext = false,
   322→    hasPrevious = false,
   323→    handleSlotNavNext,
   324→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   325→    swipeDisabled,
   326→    showNavigation,
   327→  } = navigation;
   328→  const { safeClose, activateClickShield } = useLightboxNavigation({
   329→    onNext: handleSlotNavNext,
   330→    onPrevious: handleSlotNavPrev,
   331→    onClose,
   332→  });
   333→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   334→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   335→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   336→    },
   337→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   338→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();
   339→    },
   340→    disabled: swipeDisabled || readOnly || !showNavigation,
   341→    hasNext,
   342→    hasPrevious,
   343→    threshold: 50,
   344→    velocityThreshold: 0.3,
   345→  });
   346→
   347→  return {
   348→    safeClose,
   349→    activateClickShield,
   350→    swipeNavigation,
   351→  };
   352→}

   354→function useSharedButtonGroupState(params: {
   355→  core: SharedLightboxCoreProps;
   356→  actions: SharedLightboxButtonGroupProps;
   357→  localStarred: boolean;
   358→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
   359→  toggleStarPending: boolean;
   360→  isAddingToReferences: boolean;

   362→  handleAddToReferences: () => Promise<void>;
   363→  handleAddToJoin: () => void;

   368→  const {
   369→    core,

   374→    isAddingToReferences,
   375→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   376→    handleAddToReferences,

   379→    addToJoinSuccess,
   380→    handleGoToJoin,
   381→  } = params;
   382→  const { media, onClose } = core;
   383→  const {
   384→    showDownload,

   391→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async () => {

   394→  }, [onDelete, media.id]);
   395→
   396→  return useMemo<LightboxButtonGroupProps>(() => ({
   397→    topRight: {

   399→      isDownloading,
   400→      onDelete,
   401→      handleDelete,
   402→      isDeleting,
   403→      onClose,
   404→    },
   405→    bottomLeft: {
   406→      isUpscaling,
   407→      handleUpscale,
   408→      localStarred,
   409→      handleToggleStar,
   410→      toggleStarPending,
   411→    },
   412→    bottomRight: {
   413→      isAddingToReferences,
   414→      addToReferencesSuccess,
   415→      handleAddToReferences,
   416→      handleAddToJoin,
   417→      isAddingToJoin,
   418→      addToJoinSuccess,
   419→      onGoToJoin: handleGoToJoin,
   420→    },
   421→  }), [
   422→    showDownload,
   423→    isDownloading,
   424→    onDelete,
   425→    handleDelete,
   426→    isDeleting,
   427→    onClose,
   428→    isUpscaling,
   429→    handleUpscale,
   430→    localStarred,
   431→    handleToggleStar,
   432→    toggleStarPending,
   433→    isAddingToReferences,
   434→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   435→    handleAddToReferences,
   436→    handleAddToJoin,
   437→    isAddingToJoin,
   438→    addToJoinSuccess,
   439→    handleGoToJoin,
   440→  ]);
   441→}
   442→
   443→function usePresentationState(
   444→  input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput,
   445→  variantsState: VariantsStateResult,
   446→  interactionState: InteractionState,
   447→) {
   448→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationModel(input.core, input.navigation);
   449→  const { effectiveVideoUrl, effectiveMediaUrl, effectiveImageDimensions } = useEffectiveMedia({
   450→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   451→    activeVariant: variantsState.activeVariant,
   452→    effectiveImageUrl: input.media.effectiveImageUrl,
   453→    imageDimensions: input.media.imageDimensions,
   454→    projectAspectRatio: input.media.projectAspectRatio,
   455→  });
   456→  const layout = useLayoutMode({
   457→    isMobile: input.core.isMobile,
   458→    showTaskDetails: input.layout.showTaskDetails ?? false,
   459→    isSpecialEditMode: input.layout.isSpecialEditMode,
   460→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   461→    isInpaintMode: input.layout.isInpaintMode ?? false,
   462→    isMagicEditMode: input.layout.isMagicEditMode ?? false,
   463→  });
   464→  const buttonGroupProps = useSharedButtonGroupState({
   465→    core: input.core,
   466→    actions: input.actions,
   467→    localStarred: interactionState.star.localStarred,
   468→    handleToggleStar: interactionState.star.handleToggleStar,
   469→    toggleStarPending: interactionState.star.toggleStarMutation.isPending,
   470→    isAddingToReferences: interactionState.references.isAddingToReferences,
   471→    addToReferencesSuccess: interactionState.references.addToReferencesSuccess,
   472→    handleAddToReferences: interactionState.references.handleAddToReferences,
   473→    handleAddToJoin: interactionState.references.handleAddToJoin,
   474→    isAddingToJoin: interactionState.references.isAddingToJoin,
   475→    addToJoinSuccess: interactionState.references.addToJoinSuccess,
   476→    handleGoToJoin: interactionState.references.handleGoToJoin,
   477→  });
   478→
   479→  return {
   480→    variants: variantsState.section,
   481→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: variantsState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   482→    navigation,
   483→    effectiveMedia: {
   484→      videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   485→      mediaUrl: effectiveMediaUrl,
   486→      imageDimensions: effectiveImageDimensions,
   487→    },
   488→    layout: {
   489→      isTabletOrLarger: layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   490→      isTouchLikeDevice: layout.isTouchLikeDevice,
   491→      shouldShowSidePanel: layout.shouldShowSidePanel,
   492→      isUnifiedEditMode: layout.isUnifiedEditMode,
   493→      isPortraitMode: layout.isPortraitMode,
   494→    },
   495→    buttonGroupProps,
   496→  };
   497→}
   498→
   499→// --- Main orchestrator ---
   500→
   501→export function useSharedLightboxState(input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn {
   502→  const variantsState = useSharedVariantsState(input.core);
   503→  const interactionState = useInteractionState(input, variantsState);
   504→  const presentationState = usePresentationState(input, variantsState, interactionState);
   505→
   506→  return {
   507→    variants: presentationState.variants,
   508→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: presentationState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   509→    navigation: presentationState.navigation,
   510→    star: interactionState.star,
   511→    references: interactionState.references,
   512→    lineage: interactionState.lineage,
   513→    shots: interactionState.shots,
   514→    sourceGeneration: interactionState.sourceGeneration,
   515→    makeMainVariant: interactionState.makeMainVariant,
   516→    effectiveMedia: presentationState.effectiveMedia,
   517→    layout: presentationState.layout,
   518→    buttonGroupProps: presentationState.buttonGroupProps,
   519→  };
   520→}

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration,
   417→  });
   418→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   419→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   420→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   421→  };
   422→  const {
   423→    inpaintingState,
   424→    transformState,
   425→    generationState,
   426→    imageEditValue,
   427→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   428→    env,
   429→    persistence,
   430→    inpainting,
   431→    magic,
   432→    reposition,
   433→    img2img,
   434→    starToggle,
   435→    handleDownload,
   436→  });
   437→  return {
   438→    media,
   439→    canvasEnvironment: {
   440→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   441→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   442→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   443→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   444→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   445→      effectiveImageUrl,
   446→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   447→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   448→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   449→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   450→    },
   451→    inpaintingState,
   452→    transformState,
   453→    generationState,
   454→    variants: {
   455→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   456→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   457→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   458→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   459→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   460→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,

   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}

   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Delete a generation with project-scoped verification.
   275→ */
   276→async function deleteGenerationScoped(input: ScopedGenerationInput): Promise<void> {
   277→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   278→    input.projectId,
   279→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.projectScope',
   280→  );
   281→
   282→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   283→    input.id,
   284→    projectId,
   285→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.scopeValidation',
   286→  );
   287→
   288→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   289→    id: input.id,
   290→    projectId,
   291→  });
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   295→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration',
   296→      showToast: false,
   297→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   298→    });
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   302→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   303→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.noRows',
   304→      showToast: false,
   305→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   306→    });
   307→  }
   308→}
   309→
   310→/**
   311→ * Delete a variant with project-scoped verification via its parent generation.
   312→ */
   313→async function deleteVariantScoped(input: ScopedVariantInput): Promise<void> {
   314→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   315→    input.projectId,
   316→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.projectScope',
   317→  );
   318→
   319→  const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   320→    input.id,
   321→    projectId,
   322→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.scopeValidation',
   323→  );
   324→
   325→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   326→    id: input.id,
   327→    generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   328→  });
   329→
   330→  if (error) {
   331→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   332→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant',
   333→      showToast: false,
   334→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→
   338→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   339→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   340→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.noRows',
   341→      showToast: false,
   342→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   343→    });
   344→  }
   345→}

   354→      });
   355→    },
   356→  });
   357→}

   373→}

   375→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {

   377→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   378→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   379→    },
   380→    onError: (error: Error) => {

   382→    },

   386→export function useCreateGeneration() {

   395→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   396→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   397→
   398→  return useMutation({
   399→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   400→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   401→    },
   402→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   403→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   404→        generationId: id,
   405→        starred,
   406→        shotId,
   407→      });
   408→    },
   409→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   410→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   411→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   412→    },
   413→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   414→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   415→      if (variables.shotId) {
   416→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   417→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   418→        });
   419→      }
   420→    },
   421→  });
   422→}

   235→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   236→
   237→function setTextOverride(
   238→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   239→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   240→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   241→  value: string | undefined
   242→): void {
   243→  if (value === undefined) return;
   244→  if (value === '') {
   245→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   246→    return;
   247→  }

   251→function setNullableOverride<K extends keyof SegmentOverrides>(
   252→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   253→  fieldsToClear: K[],
   254→  key: K,
   255→  value: SegmentOverrides[K] | null | undefined
   256→): void {
   257→  if (value === undefined) return;
   258→  if (value === null) {

   261→  }

   284→  }

   286→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) {

   288→      fieldsToClear.push('loras');
   289→    } else {

   291→        id: l.id,
   292→        name: l.name,

   310→}

   312→function clearFields(

   314→  fields: string[]
   315→): void {
   316→  fields.forEach((field) => {

   321→function cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(
   322→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   323→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   324→): void {
   325→  if (settings.prompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_prompt;
   326→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_negative_prompt;
   327→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined || settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {

   330→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_phase_config;
   331→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;
   332→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_random_seed;
   333→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_seed;
   334→  if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_selected_phase_preset_id;
   335→}

   337→function cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(
   338→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,

   340→): void {

   360→export function buildMetadataUpdate(

   372→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;

## Wontfix Investigation Results

I've thoroughly reviewed each file and assessed whether the wontfix claims hold up or could be improved. Here are my findings:

### 1. **useSharedLightboxState.ts (521 lines)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "mostly legitimate orchestration, trimming thin wrappers is low-value"

**Reality:** This file is 520 lines and contains 8 functions (7 internal, 1 export). The claim is **partially wrong**—there IS mechanical pass-through happening, but the bigger issue is that the internal functions are thin wrappers that each destructure their input, call 1-3 other hooks, and immediately bundle the results back up.

Breakdown:
- `useSharedVariantsState` (lines 42-114): Calls 3 hooks + one useRef + one useEffect + one useCallback. Lines 92-114 are just bundling results into an object.
- `useLightboxShotActions` (lines 119-189): Calls 3 hooks + some useMemo. Lines 180-189 bundle results.
- `useSharedMakeMainVariantState` (lines 192-236): Calls 1 hook, does 3 variable assignments for `can*` flags, then bundles (230-236).
- `useLightboxNavigationModel` (lines 315-351): Calls 3 hooks, creates 1 computed object (347-351).
- `useSharedButtonGroupState` (lines 354-441): Complex—creates useCallback and useMemo with ~2 lines of logic each, bundles results in huge object (396-441).
- `useInteractionState` (lines 239-310): Calls 6+ hooks, then bundles in one big object (280-310).
- `usePresentationState` (lines 443-496): Calls 3-4 hooks, bundles (479-496).

**The real problem:** These functions exist primarily to organize the return objects. They could be collapsed significantly by:
1. Moving the `return {}` bundling logic directly into the main hook's return statement
2. Extracting only the *computed* parts (e.g., the `can*` flags in `useSharedMakeMainVariantState`) into mini-helpers
3. Accepting that some multi-line return objects are OK if they're at the leaf level

**Recommendation:** Extract computed-value helpers (3-4 lines each), inline the rest. This reduces from 520 → ~250 lines with no loss of clarity. The wontfix oversimplifies the problem.

---

### 2. **useInlineEditState.ts (466 lines)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "well-structured with extracted sub-hooks, remaining mapping IS the hook's purpose"

**Reality:** The hook is 466 lines with 7 functions (6 internal, 1 export). The claim is **misleading**. Yes, sub-hooks are extracted, but the file has a **fundamental issue**: lines 244-321 (`buildInlineEditStateModels`) are a 77-line function that maps output from 4 hooks into 3 nested objects. This function is:
- Called once per render (line 427)
- Not memoized despite containing many destructured assignments
- A pure mapping (no side effects)
- Could trivially be removed by inlining its object shape

Lines 437-465 (the final return) are also pure bundling.

**The real problem:** The core export (`useInlineEditState`) is only ~65 lines of actual logic (402-436). The rest is infrastructure that could be streamlined:
- `buildInlineEditStateModels` is a pure transformer—should be a const object builder, not a function
- Many internal helpers (like `useInlineEditReposition`, `useInlineEditImg2Img`) are simple wrappers around single hooks
- The result type definition spans 75 lines (322-397) with heavy nesting

**Recommendation:** Flatten the return structure (don't nest so deeply), memoize or eliminate `buildInlineEditStateModels`, and remove wrapper functions that call a single hook and pass all args through unchanged. This reduces mechanical mapping without losing readability.

---

### 3. **useDeleteGeneration / useDeleteVariant (deleteGenerationScoped / deleteVariantScoped)** — VERDICT: WONTFIX

**Claim:** "2 branches with union type, splitting would duplicate error handling"

**Reality:** **This claim is correct.** The two functions are:
- `deleteGenerationScoped` (lines 276-308): validates generation scope, calls delete repo, checks for error + no-rows error
- `deleteVariantScoped` (lines 313-345): validates variant scope (which returns generationId), calls delete repo, checks for error + no-rows error

The error handling is *identical* in both (the `normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow` pattern with the same log structure). Extracting this into a shared `deleteScoped()` helper would require either:
1. A union type that accepts both scope types (add indirection without clarity)
2. Duplicating the error handling in two places (worse than now)
3. A closure that captures the error context (obscures the flow)

**Keeping them separate is correct.** The duplicate code is justified by the coupling to their respective validation functions.

---

### 4. **LightboxLayout.tsx (440 lines, 4 levels of prop drilling)** — VERDICT: FIX

**Claim:** "4-level prop drilling is inherent to React composition"

**Reality:** **This is false.** The file uses a `model` object that bundles context access (line 37-81), then passes `model` through 6+ components. This actually *prevents* context usage. Looking at lines 12-18:

```tsx
useLightboxCoreSafe(),
useLightboxMediaSafe(),
useLightboxVariantsSafe(),
useLightboxNavigationSafe(),
useImageEditCanvasSafe(),
useVideoEditSafe(),
```

These are already context hooks (the `Safe` suffix indicates they use contexts). They're being called in `useLightboxLayoutModel`, bundled, and passed down as props instead of being called directly in each component that needs them.

**The real problem:** Components like `MediaContent`, `TopCenterOverlay`, `OverlayElements`, `CompactEditControls`, and `PanelLayoutView` are receiving `model: LightboxLayoutModel` as a single prop but only using 2-3 fields each. They could call the context hooks directly.

**Why it happened:** Likely done to avoid multiple context calls per render. But React Query and most context libraries batch this anyway, so the optimization is premature.

**Recommendation:** Remove the `useLightboxLayoutModel` bundling. Have each component call only the contexts it needs. The `model` pattern saves 1 function call depth but costs clarity and forces all prop drilling to go through one type.

---

### 5. **segmentSettingsMigration.ts (LoRA format coexistence)** — VERDICT: WONTFIX (mostly)

**Claim:** "formats converge naturally as users save"

**Reality:** **Partially true, but incomplete.** The file handles 4 LoRA formats on read:
1. Legacy `pair_loras` (object: `{ "path": strength }`)
2. Legacy `additional_loras` (object: `{ "path": strength }`)
3. New `loras` array (at params level)
4. New `loras` array (at orchestrator_details level)

On write (lines 286-297), it writes only the new format and deletes old fields on next save. This **does** converge formats automatically.

**However, there's a subtle risk:** If a user has `additional_loras` in their DB and they:
1. Open the form → reads via `normalizeLegacyLoraRecord` → displays correctly
2. Don't touch the lora field → `settings.loras` is undefined → write skips lora cleanup (line 331: `if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;`)

The legacy field persists indefinitely.

**Why it's not a blocker:** The fields are read-tolerant (coexistence is harmless) and will clean up when user actually edits loras. Over time, all dB rows will have loras updated. This is a reasonable gradual migration.

**Recommendation:** KEEP as-is. The gradual cleanup is safe. If you wanted to be stricter, you could add a comment explaining the lazy cleanup strategy, but no code change needed.

---

## Summary Table

| Item | Current | Verdict | Effort | Impact |
|------|---------|---------|--------|--------|
| 1. useSharedLightboxState (521 LOC) | Mostly wrappers | **FIX** | 2-3h | High clarity, -50% LOC |
| 2. useInlineEditState (466 LOC) | Mechanical mapping | **FIX** | 2h | Better structure, -30% LOC |
| 3. deleteGeneration/Variant | Justified duplication | **WONTFIX** | — | Duplication is acceptable |
| 4. LightboxLayout prop drilling | Avoidable via contexts | **FIX** | 1.5h | Much clearer component boundaries |
| 5. LoRA format coexistence | Lazy cleanup OK | **WONTFIX** | — | Gradual migration is sound |

Items 1, 2, and 4 are real improvements worth making. Items 3 and 5 are correctly marked as wontfix.

   443→function usePresentationState(
   444→  input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput,
   445→  variantsState: VariantsStateResult,
   446→  interactionState: InteractionState,
   447→) {
   448→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationModel(input.core, input.navigation);
   449→  const { effectiveVideoUrl, effectiveMediaUrl, effectiveImageDimensions } = useEffectiveMedia({
   450→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,

   452→    effectiveImageUrl: input.media.effectiveImageUrl,
   453→    imageDimensions: input.media.imageDimensions,
   454→    projectAspectRatio: input.media.projectAspectRatio,
   455→  });
   456→  const layout = useLayoutMode({
   457→    isMobile: input.core.isMobile,
   458→    showTaskDetails: input.layout.showTaskDetails ?? false,
   459→    isSpecialEditMode: input.layout.isSpecialEditMode,
   460→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   461→    isInpaintMode: input.layout.isInpaintMode ?? false,
   462→    isMagicEditMode: input.layout.isMagicEditMode ?? false,
   463→  });
   464→  const buttonGroupProps = useSharedButtonGroupState({
   465→    core: input.core,
   466→    actions: input.actions,
   467→    localStarred: interactionState.star.localStarred,
   468→    handleToggleStar: interactionState.star.handleToggleStar,
   469→    toggleStarPending: interactionState.star.toggleStarMutation.isPending,
   470→    isAddingToReferences: interactionState.references.isAddingToReferences,
   471→    addToReferencesSuccess: interactionState.references.addToReferencesSuccess,
   472→    handleAddToReferences: interactionState.references.handleAddToReferences,
   473→    handleAddToJoin: interactionState.references.handleAddToJoin,
   474→    isAddingToJoin: interactionState.references.isAddingToJoin,
   475→    addToJoinSuccess: interactionState.references.addToJoinSuccess,
   476→    handleGoToJoin: interactionState.references.handleGoToJoin,
   477→  });
   478→
   479→  return {
   480→    variants: variantsState.section,
   481→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: variantsState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   482→    navigation,
   483→    effectiveMedia: {

   486→      imageDimensions: effectiveImageDimensions,

   499→// --- Main orchestrator ---
   500→
   501→export function useSharedLightboxState(input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn {
   502→  const variantsState = useSharedVariantsState(input.core);
   503→  const interactionState = useInteractionState(input, variantsState);
   504→  const presentationState = usePresentationState(input, variantsState, interactionState);
   505→
   506→  return {
   507→    variants: presentationState.variants,
   508→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: presentationState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   509→    navigation: presentationState.navigation,
   510→    star: interactionState.star,

   516→    effectiveMedia: presentationState.effectiveMedia,

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration,
   417→  });
   418→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   419→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   420→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   421→  };
   422→  const {
   423→    inpaintingState,
   424→    transformState,
   425→    generationState,
   426→    imageEditValue,
   427→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   428→    env,
   429→    persistence,
   430→    inpainting,
   431→    magic,
   432→    reposition,
   433→    img2img,
   434→    starToggle,
   435→    handleDownload,
   436→  });
   437→  return {
   438→    media,
   439→    canvasEnvironment: {
   440→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   441→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   442→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   443→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   444→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   445→      effectiveImageUrl,
   446→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   447→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   448→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   449→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   450→    },
   451→    inpaintingState,
   452→    transformState,
   453→    generationState,
   454→    variants: {
   455→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   456→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   457→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   458→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   459→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   460→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   461→    },
   462→    sourceGenerationData,
   463→    availableLoras,
   464→    imageEditValue,
   465→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   466→}

   190→      handleUnifiedGenerate: state.generationState.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   191→      handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: state.generationState.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   192→      handleGenerateReposition: state.generationState.handleGenerateReposition,
   193→      handleSaveAsVariant: state.generationState.handleSaveAsVariant,
   194→      handleGenerateImg2Img: state.generationState.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   195→      img2imgLoraManager: state.generationState.img2imgLoraManager,
   196→    },
   197→    availableLoras: state.availableLoras,
   198→    imageEditValue: state.imageEditValue,
   199→    variants: {
   200→      list: state.variants.variants,
   201→      activeVariantId: state.variants.activeVariant?.id || null,
   202→      isLoading: state.variants.isLoading,
   203→      setActiveVariantId: state.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   204→      setPrimaryVariant: state.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   205→      deleteVariant: state.variants.deleteVariant,
   206→    },
   207→    actions: {

   209→        state.inpaintingState.setIsInpaintMode(true);
   210→        state.inpaintingState.setEditMode('inpaint');
   211→      },
   212→      enterMagicEditMode: state.inpaintingState.handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   213→    },
   214→  };
   215→}
   216→
   217→function InlineEditSidebar({ variant, model, onClose }: InlineEditSidebarProps) {
   218→  const sidebarContent = model.isSpecialEditMode ? (
   219→    <EditModePanel
   220→      variant={variant === 'mobile' ? 'mobile' : 'desktop'}
   221→      hideInfoEditToggle={true}
   222→      simplifiedHeader={true}
   223→      currentMediaId={model.currentMediaId}
   224→      actions={{
   225→        handleUnifiedGenerate: model.generation.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   226→        handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: model.generation.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   227→        handleGenerateReposition: model.generation.handleGenerateReposition,
   228→        handleSaveAsVariant: model.generation.handleSaveAsVariant,
   229→        handleGenerateImg2Img: model.generation.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   230→      }}
   231→      lora={{
   232→        img2imgLoraManager: model.generation.img2imgLoraManager,
   233→        availableLoras: model.availableLoras,
   234→      }}
   235→      stateOverrides={{
   236→        coreState: { onClose },
   237→        imageEditState: model.imageEditValue,
   238→      }}
   239→    />
   240→  ) : (
   241→    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center gap-y-4">
   242→      <h3 className="text-xl font-medium">Image Editor</h3>
   243→      <p className="text-muted-foreground">Select an option to start editing</p>
   244→
   245→      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 w-full max-w-xs">
   246→        <Button onClick={() => {
   247→          model.actions.enterInpaintMode();
   248→        }} className="w-full">
   249→          Inpaint / Erase
   250→        </Button>
   251→
   252→        <Button onClick={model.actions.enterMagicEditMode} variant="secondary" className="w-full">
   253→          Magic Edit
   254→        </Button>
   255→      </div>
   256→    </div>
   257→  );
   258→
   259→  return (
   260→    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col min-h-0">
   261→      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto">
   262→        {sidebarContent}
   263→      </div>
   264→      <div
   265→        className={cn(
   266→          'border-t border-border bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 pt-3 pb-6',
   267→          variant === 'mobile' ? 'pb-8' : 'pb-6'
   268→        )}
   269→      >
   270→        <VariantSelector
   271→          variants={model.variants.list}
   272→          activeVariantId={model.variants.activeVariantId}
   273→          onVariantSelect={(variantId) => model.variants.setActiveVariantId(variantId)}
   274→          onMakePrimary={model.variants.setPrimaryVariant}
   275→          isLoading={model.variants.isLoading}
   276→          onDeleteVariant={model.variants.deleteVariant}
   277→        />
   278→      </div>
   279→    </div>
   280→  );
   281→}

   285→// ============================================================================

   287→export function InlineEditView({ media, onClose, onNavigateToGeneration }: InlineEditViewProps) {

   314→                onNavigateToGeneration={onNavigateToGeneration}

   316→            </div>

   319→    );

   322→  return (

   327→            style={{ width: '60%', height: '100%' }}
   328→          >
   329→            <InlineEditCanvas variant="desktop" model={canvasModel} media={media} />
   330→          </div>
   331→
   332→          <div
   333→            className={cn(
   334→              "bg-background border-l border-border overflow-y-auto relative z-[60] rounded-r-xl"
   335→            )}
   336→            style={{ width: '40%', height: '100%' }}
   337→          >

   340→              model={sidebarModel}

   342→              onNavigateToGeneration={onNavigateToGeneration}
   343→            />
   344→          </div>
   345→        </div>
   346→      </TooltipProvider>
   347→  );
   348→}

1→import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import type { UseMutationResult } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import { useToggleGenerationStar } from '@/domains/generation/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     4→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     5→import { getGenerationId } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
     6→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
     7→
     8→interface UseStarToggleProps {
     9→  media: GenerationRow;
    10→  starred?: boolean;
    11→  shotId?: string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseStarToggleReturn {
    15→  localStarred: boolean;
    16→  setLocalStarred: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
    17→  toggleStarMutation: UseMutationResult<void, Error, { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }>;
    18→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for managing star toggle state
    23→ * Maintains local state for immediate UI updates while syncing with server
    24→ */
    25→export const useStarToggle = ({ media, starred, shotId }: UseStarToggleProps): UseStarToggleReturn => {
    26→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    27→  const toggleStarMutation = useToggleGenerationStar();
    28→  
    29→  // Track when we last mutated to prevent stale prop syncing
    30→  const lastMutationTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
    31→  const prevMediaIdRef = useRef<string>(media.id);
    32→
    33→  // Local starred state to ensure UI reflects updates immediately even if parent data is stale
    34→  const initialStarred = useMemo(() => {
    35→    // Prefer explicit prop, fall back to media.starred if available
    36→    
    37→    if (typeof starred === 'boolean') {
    38→      return starred;
    39→    }
    40→    if (typeof media.starred === 'boolean') {
    41→      return media.starred;
    42→    }
    43→    return false;
    44→  }, [starred, media.starred]);
    45→
    46→  const [localStarred, setLocalStarred] = useState<boolean>(initialStarred);
    47→
    48→  // Keep local state in sync when parent updates (e.g., after query refetch or navigating to different image)
    49→  // BUT: Don't sync if we recently performed a mutation (prevents stale prop from resetting UI)
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    const mediaChanged = prevMediaIdRef.current !== media.id;
    52→    const timeSinceMutation = Date.now() - lastMutationTimeRef.current;
    53→    const recentlyMutated = timeSinceMutation < 2000; // 2 second grace period
    54→    const willSync = mediaChanged || !recentlyMutated;
    55→    
    56→    // Only sync if:
    57→    // 1. Media changed (navigated to different image), OR
    58→    // 2. Haven't recently mutated (prevents stale prop from overriding optimistic update)
    59→    if (willSync) {
    60→      setLocalStarred(initialStarred);
    61→    }
    62→    
    63→    prevMediaIdRef.current = media.id;
    64→  }, [initialStarred, media.id]);
    65→
    66→  // Handler that records mutation time to prevent stale prop syncing
    67→  const handleToggleStar = () => {
    68→    const newStarred = !localStarred;
    69→    
    70→    // Record mutation time BEFORE updating state
    71→    lastMutationTimeRef.current = Date.now();
    72→    
    73→    // Optimistically update UI
    74→    setLocalStarred(newStarred);
    75→    
    76→    // IMPORTANT: Use generation_id (actual generations.id) when available, falling back to id
    77→    // For ShotImageManager/Timeline images, id is shot_generations.id but generation_id is the actual generation ID
    78→    // For variants, generation_id is in metadata.generation_id (the parent generation)
    79→    const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media);
    80→    
    81→    // Trigger mutation
    82→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    83→      setLocalStarred((prev) => !prev);
    84→      return;
    85→    }
    86→    toggleStarMutation.mutate({
    87→      id: actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
    88→      starred: newStarred,
    89→      projectId: selectedProjectId,
    90→      shotId,
    91→    });
    92→  };
    93→
    94→  return {
    95→    localStarred,
    96→    setLocalStarred,
    97→    toggleStarMutation,
    98→    handleToggleStar,
    99→  };
   100→};
   101→

Clean. Here's a summary of what was done:

**Changes to `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/domains/media-lightbox/components/layouts/LightboxLayout.tsx`:**

1. **Removed `useLightboxLayoutModel`** -- the monolithic hook that bundled 6 context hook results + layout computations into a single `model` object, and removed the `LightboxLayoutModel` type.

2. **Replaced with `useLightboxLayoutComputed`** -- a small focused hook that only computes layout-derived values (`isSidePanelLayout`, `mediaDisplayVariant`, `topCenterClassName`, etc.) from props and `core.isMobile`. This is the only part that actually needed to be shared.

3. **Each component now calls context hooks directly for what it needs:**
   - `CompactEditControls` -- calls `useLightboxCoreSafe()` and `useImageEditCanvasSafe()` directly, takes zero props (was `{ model }`)
   - `TopCenterOverlay` -- calls `useLightboxCoreSafe()`, `useLightboxMediaSafe()`, `useLightboxVariantsSafe()` directly; receives only `className`, `adjacentSegments`, `segmentSlotMode` as props
   - `OverlayElements` -- calls its own context hooks directly; receives `topCenterClassName`, `showFloatingTools`, and `props` (the original layout props for button groups/workflow bar)
   - `MediaContent` -- calls context hooks directly; receives only `layout` (computed values) and the two tasks-pane props it needs
   - `PanelLayoutView` / `CenteredLayoutView` -- call their own context hooks + `useLightboxLayoutComputed`; receive only `props` (the original `LightboxLayoutProps`)
   - `LightboxLayout` (root) -- no longer calls any hooks; just renders the right layout view

4. **The `model` prop that was threaded through 4 levels is completely gone.** TypeScript passes with no errors.

    14→
    15→- Read `dimension_prompts` from `query.json` for dimensions with definitions and seed files.

     3→---
     4→name: desloppify
     5→description: >
     6→  Codebase health scanner and technical debt tracker. Use when the user asks
     7→  about code quality, technical debt, dead code, large files, god classes,
     8→  duplicate functions, code smells, naming issues, import cycles, or coupling
