    13→
    14→# Desloppify
    15→
    16→## 1. Your Job
    17→
    18→Maximise the **strict score** honestly. Your main cycle: **scan → plan → execute → rescan**. Follow the scan output's **INSTRUCTIONS FOR AGENTS** — don't substitute your own analysis.
    19→
    20→**Don't be lazy.** Do large refactors and small detailed fixes with equal energy. If it takes touching 20 files, touch 20 files. If it's a one-line change, make it. No task is too big or too small — fix things properly, not minimally.
    21→
    22→## 2. The Workflow
    23→
    24→Three phases, repeated as a cycle.
    25→
    26→### Phase 1: Scan and review — understand the codebase
    27→
    28→```bash
    29→desloppify scan --path .       # analyse the codebase
    30→desloppify status              # check scores — are we at target?
    31→```
    32→
    33→The scan will tell you if subjective dimensions need review. Follow its instructions. To trigger a review manually:
    34→```bash
    35→desloppify review --prepare    # then follow your runner's review workflow
    36→```
    37→
    38→### Phase 2: Plan — decide what to work on
    39→
    40→After reviews, triage stages and plan creation appear as queue items in `next`. Complete them in order:
    41→```bash
    42→desloppify next                                        # shows the next workflow step
    43→desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "themes and root causes..."
    44→desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report "comparison against completed work..."
    45→desloppify plan triage --stage organize --report "summary of priorities..."
    46→desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "execution plan..."
    47→```
    48→
    49→### Automated triage (subagent runners)
    50→
    51→For Codex: `desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner codex`
    52→For Claude: `desloppify plan triage --run-stages --runner claude` — then follow orchestrator instructions per stage
    53→
    54→Options: `--only-stages observe,reflect` (subset), `--dry-run` (prompts only), `--stage-timeout-seconds N` (per-stage).
    55→
    56→Then shape the queue. **The plan shapes everything `next` gives you** — don't skip this step.
    57→
    58→```bash
    59→desloppify plan                          # see the full ordered queue
    60→desloppify plan reorder <pat> top        # reorder — what unblocks the most?
    61→desloppify plan cluster create <name>    # group related issues to batch-fix
    62→desloppify plan focus <cluster>          # scope next to one cluster
    63→desloppify plan skip <pat>              # defer — hide from next
    64→```
    65→
    66→More plan commands:
    67→```bash
    68→desloppify plan reorder <cluster> top    # move all cluster members at once
    69→desloppify plan reorder <a> <b> top     # mix clusters + findings in one reorder
    70→desloppify plan reorder <pat> before -t X  # position relative to another item/cluster
    71→desloppify plan cluster reorder a,b top # reorder multiple clusters as one block
    72→desloppify plan resolve <pat>           # mark complete
    73→desloppify plan reopen <pat>             # reopen
    74→```
    75→
    76→### Phase 3: Execute — grind the queue to completion
    77→
    78→Trust the plan and execute. Don't rescan mid-queue — finish the queue first.
    79→
    80→**Branch first.** Create a dedicated branch for health work — never commit directly to main:
    81→```bash
    82→git checkout -b desloppify/code-health    # or desloppify/<focus-area>
    83→```
    84→
    85→**Set up commit tracking.** If you have a PR, link it for auto-updated descriptions:
    86→```bash
    87→desloppify config set commit_pr 42        # PR number for auto-updates
    88→```
    89→
    90→**The loop:**
    91→```
    92→1. desloppify next              ← what to fix next
    93→2. Fix the issue in code
    94→3. Resolve it (next shows you the exact command including required attestation)
    95→4. When you have a logical batch, commit:
    96→   git add <files> && git commit -m "desloppify: fix 3 deferred_import findings"
    97→5. Record the commit:
    98→   desloppify plan commit-log record      # moves findings uncommitted → committed, updates PR
    99→6. Push periodically:
   100→   git push -u origin desloppify/code-health
   101→7. Repeat until the queue is empty
   102→```
   103→
   104→Score may temporarily drop after fixes — cascade effects are normal, keep going.
   105→If `next` suggests an auto-fixer, run `desloppify autofix <fixer> --dry-run` to preview, then apply.
   106→
   107→**When the queue is clear, go back to Phase 1.** New issues will surface, cascades will have resolved, priorities will have shifted. This is the cycle.
   108→
   109→### Other useful commands
   110→
   111→```bash
   112→desloppify next --count 5                         # top 5 priorities
   113→desloppify next --cluster <name>                  # drill into a cluster
   114→desloppify show <pattern>                         # filter by file/detector/ID
   115→desloppify show --status open                     # all open findings
   116→desloppify plan skip --permanent "<id>" --note "reason" --attest "..." # accept debt
   117→desloppify exclude <path>                         # exclude a directory from scanning
   118→desloppify config show                            # show all config including excludes
   119→desloppify scan --path . --reset-subjective       # reset subjective baseline to 0
   120→```
   121→
   122→## 3. Reference
   123→
   124→### How scoring works
   125→
   126→Overall score = **40% mechanical** + **60% subjective**.
   127→
   128→- **Mechanical (40%)**: auto-detected issues — duplication, dead code, smells, unused imports, security. Fixed by changing code and rescanning.
   129→- **Subjective (60%)**: design quality review — naming, error handling, abstractions, clarity. Starts at **0%** until reviewed. The scan will prompt you when a review is needed.
   130→- **Strict score** is the north star: wontfix items count as open. The gap between overall and strict is your wontfix debt.
   131→- **Score types**: overall (lenient), strict (wontfix counts), objective (mechanical only), verified (confirmed fixes only).
   132→
   133→### Subjective reviews in detail
   134→
   135→- **Local runner (Codex)**: `desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` — automated end-to-end.
   136→- **Local runner (Claude)**: `desloppify review --prepare` → launch parallel subagents → `desloppify review --import merged.json` — see skill doc overlay for details.
   137→- **Cloud/external**: `desloppify review --external-start --external-runner claude` → follow session template → `--external-submit`.
   138→- **Manual path**: `desloppify review --prepare` → review per dimension → `desloppify review --import file.json`.
   139→- Import first, fix after — import creates tracked state entries for correlation.
   140→- Target-matching scores trigger auto-reset to prevent gaming.
   141→- Even moderate scores (60-80) dramatically improve overall health.
   142→- Stale dimensions auto-surface in `next` — just follow the queue.
   143→
   144→### Review output format
   145→
   146→Return machine-readable JSON for review imports. For `--external-submit`, include `session` from the generated template:
   147→
   148→```json
   149→{
   150→  "session": {
   151→    "id": "<session_id_from_template>",
   152→    "token": "<session_token_from_template>"
   153→  },
   154→  "assessments": {
   155→    "<dimension_from_query>": 0
   156→  },
   157→  "findings": [
   158→    {
   159→      "dimension": "<dimension_from_query>",
   160→      "identifier": "short_id",
   161→      "summary": "one-line defect summary",
   162→      "related_files": ["relative/path/to/file.py"],
   163→      "evidence": ["specific code observation"],
   164→      "suggestion": "concrete fix recommendation",
   165→      "confidence": "high|medium|low"
   166→    }
   167→  ]
   168→}
   169→```
   170→
   171→**Import rules:**
   172→- `findings` MUST match `query.system_prompt` exactly (including `related_files`, `evidence`, and `suggestion`). Use `"findings": []` when no defects found.
   173→- Import is fail-closed: invalid findings abort unless `--allow-partial` is passed.
   174→- Assessment scores are auto-applied from trusted internal or cloud session imports. Legacy `--attested-external` remains supported.
   175→
   176→**Import paths:**
   177→- Robust session flow (recommended): `desloppify review --external-start --external-runner claude` → use generated prompt/template → run printed `--external-submit` command.
   178→- Durable scored import (legacy): `desloppify review --import findings.json --attested-external --attest "I validated this review was completed without awareness of overall score and is unbiased."`
   179→- Findings-only fallback: `desloppify review --import findings.json`
   180→
   181→### Review integrity
   182→
   183→1. Do not use prior chat context, score history, or target-threshold anchoring.
   184→2. Score from evidence only; when mixed, score lower and explain uncertainty.
   185→3. Assess every requested dimension; never drop one. If evidence is weak, score lower.
   186→
   187→### Reviewer agent prompt
   188→
   189→Runners that support agent definitions (Cursor, Copilot, Gemini) can create a dedicated reviewer agent. Use this system prompt:
   190→
   191→```
   192→You are a code quality reviewer. You will be given a codebase path, a set of
   193→dimensions to score, and what each dimension means. Read the code, score each
   194→dimension 0-100 from evidence only, and return JSON in the required format.
   195→Do not anchor to target thresholds. When evidence is mixed, score lower and
   196→explain uncertainty.
   197→```
   198→
   199→See your editor's overlay section below for the agent config format.
   200→
   201→### Commit tracking & branch workflow
   202→
   203→Work on a dedicated branch named `desloppify/<description>` (e.g., `desloppify/code-health`, `desloppify/fix-smells`). Never push health work directly to main.
   204→
   205→```bash
   206→desloppify config set commit_pr 42              # link to your PR
   207→desloppify plan commit-log                      # see uncommitted + committed status
   208→desloppify plan commit-log record               # record HEAD commit, update PR description
   209→desloppify plan commit-log record --note "why"  # with rationale
   210→desloppify plan commit-log record --only "smells::*"  # record specific findings only
   211→desloppify plan commit-log history              # show commit records
   212→desloppify plan commit-log pr                   # preview PR body markdown
   213→desloppify config set commit_tracking_enabled false  # disable guidance
   214→```
   215→
   216→After resolving findings as `fixed`, the tool shows uncommitted work, committed history, and a suggested commit message. After committing externally, run `record` to move findings from uncommitted to committed and auto-update the linked PR description.
   217→
   218→### Key concepts
   219→
   220→- **Tiers**: T1 auto-fix → T2 quick manual → T3 judgment call → T4 major refactor.
   221→- **Auto-clusters**: related findings are auto-grouped in `next`. Drill in with `next --cluster <name>`.
   222→- **Zones**: production/script (scored), test/config/generated/vendor (not scored). Fix with `zone set`.
   223→- **Wontfix cost**: widens the lenient↔strict gap. Challenge past decisions when the gap grows.
   224→- Score can temporarily drop after fixes (cascade effects are normal).
   225→
   226→## 4. Escalate Tool Issues Upstream
   227→
   228→When desloppify itself appears wrong or inconsistent:
   229→
   230→1. Capture a minimal repro (`command`, `path`, `expected`, `actual`).
   231→2. Open a GitHub issue in `peteromallet/desloppify`.
   232→3. If you can fix it safely, open a PR linked to that issue.
   233→4. If unsure whether it is tool bug vs user workflow, issue first, PR second.
   234→

1. The **system_prompt** (16K chars) — scoring philosophy, process, output format

3. A list of **seed files** to start reading (from `investigation_batches`)
4. The **blind packet** (no score targets to avoid anchoring)

The agent reads the code, scores 0-100, returns JSON with `assessments` and `findings`.

The meta task is: launch 20 agents (one per dimension), collect their JSON outputs, merge into one file, then `desloppify review --import merged.json`.

    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {

1→import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { useDeleteGeneration } from '@/domains/generation/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→
     5→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
     6→  pendingDeleteId: string | null;
     7→  deletingId: string | null;
     8→  isPending: boolean;
     9→  requestDelete: (id: string) => void;
    10→  cancelDelete: () => void;
    11→  confirmDelete: () => Promise<void>;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions {
    15→  projectId: string | null | undefined;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteGenerationAction({
    19→  projectId,
    20→}: UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions): UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
    21→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    22→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    23→  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    24→
    25→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    26→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  const cancelDelete = useCallback(() => {
    30→    setPendingDeleteId(null);
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const confirmDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    if (!pendingDeleteId || !projectId) {
    35→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    36→      return;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const targetId = pendingDeleteId;
    40→    setDeletingId(targetId);
    41→    try {
    42→      await deleteGenerationMutation.mutateAsync({ id: targetId, projectId });
    43→      setPendingDeleteId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    44→    } catch (error) {
    45→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    46→        context: 'useDeleteGenerationAction.confirmDelete',
    47→        toastTitle: 'Delete failed',
    48→      });
    49→      // Keep the dialog open so users can retry or cancel after a failed delete.
    50→    } finally {
    51→      setDeletingId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    52→    }
    53→  }, [deleteGenerationMutation, pendingDeleteId, projectId]);
    54→
    55→  return {
    56→    pendingDeleteId,
    57→    deletingId,
    58→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    59→    requestDelete,
    60→    cancelDelete,
    61→    confirmDelete,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→

1→/**
     2→ * LightboxShell - Dialog/Overlay container for MediaLightbox
     3→ *
     4→ * Encapsulates all the complex event handling for the lightbox modal:
     5→ * - Dialog root/portal/overlay
     6→ * - Pointer/touch/click event handling with z-index awareness

     8→ * - Accessibility elements
     9→ *

    11→ * which is visible above the lightbox at z-[100001]. The overlay adjusts its size
    12→ * to account for the pane when it's open or locked.
    13→ *
    14→ * This allows the main MediaLightbox to focus on content orchestration.
    15→ */
    16→
    17→import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
    18→import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui-components/react/dialog";
    19→import { cn } from '@/shared/components/ui/contracts/cn';
    20→import { useLightboxShellInteractionHandlers } from '@/domains/media-lightbox/hooks/useLightboxShellInteractionHandlers';
    21→import { useLightboxViewportLock } from '@/domains/media-lightbox/hooks/useLightboxViewportLock';
    22→import { useLightboxPaneLayout } from '@/domains/media-lightbox/hooks/useLightboxPaneLayout';
    23→import type { OverlayViewportConstraints } from '@/shared/lib/layout/overlayViewportConstraints';
    24→import { UI_Z_LAYERS } from '@/shared/lib/uiLayers';
    25→
    26→interface LightboxShellProps {
    27→  children: React.ReactNode;
    28→  onClose: () => void;
    29→
    30→  // Edit mode
    31→  /** Canvas/brush edit overlay is active (inpaint, annotate, reposition, text).
    32→   *  Used to allow canvas touch events to pass through. */
    33→  hasCanvasOverlay: boolean;
    34→  /** Reposition (move) mode — the only edit mode that blocks background click-to-close
    35→   *  (because dragging could cause accidental closes). */
    36→  isRepositionMode: boolean;
    37→
    38→  // Responsive
    39→  isMobile: boolean;
    40→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
    41→
    42→  // Layout constraints from the layout subsystem.
    43→  overlayViewport: OverlayViewportConstraints;
    44→
    45→  // Ref for content
    46→  contentRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
    47→
    48→  // Accessibility
    49→  accessibilityTitle: string;
    50→  accessibilityDescription: string;
    51→}
    52→
    53→export const LightboxShell: React.FC<LightboxShellProps> = ({
    54→  children,
    55→  onClose,
    56→  hasCanvasOverlay,
    57→  isRepositionMode,
    58→  isMobile,
    59→  isTabletOrLarger,
    60→  overlayViewport,
    61→  contentRef,
    62→  accessibilityTitle,
    63→  accessibilityDescription,
    64→}) => {
    65→  const isActuallyModal = isMobile && !isTabletOrLarger;
    66→  useLightboxViewportLock({ isActuallyModal });
    67→
    68→  const {
    69→    handleOverlayPointerDown,
    70→    handleOverlayPointerUp,
    71→    handleOverlayClick,
    72→    handleBgPointerDownCapture,
    73→    handleBgClickCapture,
    74→    handleContentPointerDown,
    75→    handleContentClick,
    76→    handleTouchEvent,
    77→    handleTouchCancel,
    78→  } = useLightboxShellInteractionHandlers({
    79→    hasCanvasOverlay,
    80→    isRepositionMode,
    81→    isMobile,
    82→    onClose,
    83→  });
    84→
    85→  // Focus the content element on mount
    86→  useEffect(() => {
    87→    contentRef.current?.focus();
    88→  }, [contentRef]);
    89→
    90→  const { overlayStyle, contentStyle } = useLightboxPaneLayout({
    91→    overlayViewport,
    92→  });
    93→
    94→  return (
    95→    <DialogPrimitive.Root
    96→      open={true}
    97→      modal={isActuallyModal}
    98→      disablePointerDismissal
    99→      onOpenChange={(_open, eventDetails) => {
   100→        // Prevent Base UI from updating internal state (which corrupts controlled open={true})

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

    14→interface UseMediaGalleryHandlersArgs {

    35→}
    36→
    37→function useShotNavigationHandlers({
    38→  allShots,
    39→  simplifiedShotOptions,
    40→  navigateToShot,
    41→  closeLightbox,
    42→  reportError,
    43→}: UseShotNavigationHandlersArgs) {
    44→  const handleNavigateToShot = useCallback((shot: NavigableShot) => {
    45→    try {
    46→      navigateToShot(shot);
    47→      closeLightbox();
    48→    } catch (error) {
    49→      reportError(error, {
    50→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleNavigateToShot',
    51→        showToast: false,
    52→        logData: { shotId: shot.id },
    53→      });
    54→    }
    55→  }, [navigateToShot, closeLightbox, reportError]);
    56→
    57→  const handleVisitShotFromNotifier = useCallback((shotId: string) => {
    58→    const shot = simplifiedShotOptions.find((option) => option.id === shotId);
    59→    if (!shot) {
    60→      reportError(new Error('Shot option not found for notifier navigation'), {
    61→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleVisitShotFromNotifier',
    62→        showToast: false,
    63→        logData: { shotId, scope: 'simplifiedShotOptions' },
    64→      });
    65→      return;
    66→    }
    67→
    68→    const fullShot = allShots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotId);
    69→    if (!fullShot) {
    70→      reportError(new Error('Shot entity not found for notifier navigation'), {
    71→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleVisitShotFromNotifier',
    72→        showToast: false,
    73→        logData: { shotId, scope: 'allShots' },
    74→      });
    75→      return;
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    try {
    79→      navigateToShot(fullShot);
    80→    } catch (error) {
    81→      reportError(error, {
    82→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleVisitShotFromNotifier',
    83→        showToast: false,
    84→        logData: { shotId },
    85→      });
    86→    }
    87→  }, [simplifiedShotOptions, allShots, navigateToShot, reportError]);
    88→
    89→  return {
    90→    handleNavigateToShot,
    91→    handleVisitShotFromNotifier,
    92→  };
    93→}
    94→

   101→function useShotFilterHandlers({

   103→  onSwitchToAssociatedShot,
   104→  setShotFilter,
   105→}: UseShotFilterHandlersArgs) {
   106→  const handleSwitchToAssociatedShot = useCallback(() => {
   107→    if (formAssociatedShotId && onSwitchToAssociatedShot) {
   108→      onSwitchToAssociatedShot(formAssociatedShotId);
   109→    }
   110→  }, [formAssociatedShotId, onSwitchToAssociatedShot]);
   111→
   112→  const handleShowAllShots = useCallback(() => {
   113→    setShotFilter('all');
   114→  }, [setShotFilter]);
   115→
   116→  return {
   117→    handleSwitchToAssociatedShot,
   118→    handleShowAllShots,
   119→  };
   120→}
   121→

   126→  setActiveLightboxMedia: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => void;
   127→  reportError: (error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions) => void;
   128→}
   129→
   130→function useTaskDetailsHandler({
   131→  activeLightboxMedia,
   132→  setSelectedImageForDetails,
   133→  setShowTaskDetailsModal,
   134→  setActiveLightboxMedia,
   135→  reportError,
   136→}: UseTaskDetailsHandlerArgs) {

   138→    if (!activeLightboxMedia) {

   141→        showToast: false,

   149→  }, [

   175→    if (reportErrorProp) {

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '../types';
     3→
     4→interface UseMobileInteractionsProps {
     5→  isMobile: boolean;
     6→  setMobileActiveImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
     7→  mobilePopoverOpenImageId: string | null;
     8→  setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
     9→  onOpenLightbox: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata) => void;
    10→}
    11→
    12→interface UseMobileInteractionsReturn {
    13→  handleMobileTap: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→export const useMobileInteractions = ({
    17→  isMobile,
    18→  setMobileActiveImageId,
    19→  mobilePopoverOpenImageId,
    20→  setMobilePopoverOpenImageId,
    21→  onOpenLightbox,
    22→}: UseMobileInteractionsProps): UseMobileInteractionsReturn => {
    23→  const lastTouchTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
    24→  const lastTappedImageIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    25→  const doubleTapTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    26→  
    27→  // Handle mobile double-tap detection
    28→  // Using 400ms window for snappier, more reliable double-tap detection
    29→  const DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_MS = 400;
    30→  const MIN_TAP_INTERVAL_MS = 50; // Minimum time between taps to filter out accidental multi-touch
    31→  
    32→  const handleMobileTap = useCallback((image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata) => {
    33→    const currentTime = Date.now();
    34→    const timeSinceLastTap = currentTime - lastTouchTimeRef.current;
    35→    const lastTappedImageId = lastTappedImageIdRef.current;
    36→    const isSameImage = lastTappedImageId === image.id;
    37→    
    38→    if (timeSinceLastTap < DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_MS && timeSinceLastTap > MIN_TAP_INTERVAL_MS && lastTouchTimeRef.current > 0 && isSameImage) {
    39→      // This is a double-tap on the same image, clear any pending timeout and open lightbox
    40→      if (doubleTapTimeoutRef.current) {
    41→        clearTimeout(doubleTapTimeoutRef.current);
    42→        doubleTapTimeoutRef.current = null;
    43→      }
    44→      onOpenLightbox(image);
    45→      // Reset tap tracking to prevent triple-tap issues
    46→      lastTouchTimeRef.current = 0;
    47→      lastTappedImageIdRef.current = null;
    48→    } else {
    49→      // This is a single tap or tap on different image, set a timeout to handle it if no second tap comes
    50→      if (doubleTapTimeoutRef.current) {
    51→        clearTimeout(doubleTapTimeoutRef.current);
    52→      }
    53→      doubleTapTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    54→        // Single tap (mobile): reveal action controls for this image
    55→        // Close any existing popover if tapping a different image
    56→        if (mobilePopoverOpenImageId && mobilePopoverOpenImageId !== image.id) {
    57→          setMobilePopoverOpenImageId(null);
    58→        }
    59→        setMobileActiveImageId(image.id);
    60→        doubleTapTimeoutRef.current = null;
    61→      }, DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_MS);
    62→      
    63→      // Update the last tapped image and time
    64→      lastTappedImageIdRef.current = image.id;
    65→      lastTouchTimeRef.current = currentTime;
    66→    }
    67→  }, [onOpenLightbox, mobilePopoverOpenImageId, setMobilePopoverOpenImageId, setMobileActiveImageId]);
    68→
    69→  // Close mobile popover on scroll or when clicking outside
    70→  useEffect(() => {
    71→    if (!isMobile || !mobilePopoverOpenImageId) return;
    72→
    73→    const handleScroll = () => {
    74→      setMobilePopoverOpenImageId(null);
    75→    };
    76→
    77→    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    78→      // Close if clicking outside any popover content
    79→      const target = event.target as Element;
    80→      if (!target.closest('[data-popup]')) {
    81→        setMobilePopoverOpenImageId(null);
    82→      }

    22→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
    23→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
    24→}

    43→    scale: toFiniteNumber(record.scale, DEFAULT_TRANSFORM.scale),

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

     4→import type { AutoTopupState } from '../types';
     5→
     6→interface UseAutoTopupStateProps {
     7→  initialPurchaseAmount: number;
     8→}
     9→
    10→interface UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
    11→  // State
    12→  purchaseAmount: number;
    13→  localAutoTopupEnabled: boolean;
    14→  localAutoTopupThreshold: number;
    15→  autoTopupState: AutoTopupState;
    16→  isUpdatingAutoTopup: boolean;
    17→
    18→  // Handlers

    20→  handleAutoTopupToggle: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    21→  handleAutoTopupThresholdChange: (threshold: number) => void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
    25→  const {
    26→    preferences: autoTopupPreferences,
    27→    updatePreferences: updateAutoTopup,
    28→    isUpdatingPreferences: isUpdatingAutoTopup,
    29→  } = useAutoTopup();
    30→
    31→  const [purchaseAmount, setPurchaseAmount] = useState(initialPurchaseAmount);
    32→  const [localAutoTopupEnabled, setLocalAutoTopupEnabled] = useState(true);
    33→  const [localAutoTopupThreshold, setLocalAutoTopupThreshold] = useState(10);
    34→  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);
    35→
    36→  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
    37→  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    38→
    39→  // Initialize from server preferences
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
    42→      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
    43→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);
    44→
    45→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
    46→        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
    47→      }
    48→
    49→      setHasInitialized(true);
    50→    }
    51→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);
    52→
    53→  // Auto-update threshold for new users when purchase amount changes
    54→  useEffect(() => {
    55→    if (hasInitialized && autoTopupPreferences && autoTopupPreferences.threshold === 10 && purchaseAmount !== 50) {
    56→      const defaultThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(purchaseAmount / 5));
    57→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(defaultThreshold);
    58→    }
    59→  }, [purchaseAmount, hasInitialized, autoTopupPreferences]);
    60→
    61→  // Cleanup debounce timer on unmount
    62→  useEffect(() => {
    63→    return () => {
    64→      if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
    65→        clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
    66→      }
    67→    };
    68→  }, []);
    69→
    70→  // Computed auto-top-up state
    71→  const autoTopupState = useMemo((): AutoTopupState => {
    72→    if (!autoTopupPreferences) return 'loading';
    73→
    74→    const { setupCompleted } = autoTopupPreferences;
    75→    const enabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    76→
    77→    if (enabled && setupCompleted) return 'active';
    78→    if (!enabled && setupCompleted) return 'setup-but-disabled';
    79→    if (enabled && !setupCompleted) return 'enabled-but-not-setup';
    80→    return 'not-setup';
    81→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, localAutoTopupEnabled]);
    82→
    83→  const handleAutoTopupToggle = (enabled: boolean) => {
    84→    const previousEnabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    85→    setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(enabled);
    86→
    87→    const saveData = {
    88→      enabled,
    89→      amount: purchaseAmount,
    90→      threshold: localAutoTopupThreshold,
    91→    };
    92→    updateAutoTopup(saveData, {
    93→      onError: (error) => {
    94→        setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(previousEnabled);
    95→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    96→          context: 'useAutoTopupState',
    97→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update auto top-up',
    98→        });
    99→      },
   100→    });
   101→  };
   102→
   103→  const handleAutoTopupThresholdChange = (threshold: number) => {
   104→    setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(threshold);
   105→
   106→    // Debounce the save
   107→    if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
   108→      clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
   109→    }
   110→    thresholdDebounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   111→      updateAutoTopup({
   112→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   113→        amount: purchaseAmount,
   114→        threshold,
   115→      }, {
   116→        onError: (error) => {
   117→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   118→            context: 'useAutoTopupState',
   119→            toastTitle: 'Failed to update auto top-up',
   120→          });
   121→        },
   122→      });
   123→    }, 500);
   124→  };
   125→
   126→  const handlePurchaseAmountChange = (amount: number) => {
   127→    const previousAmount = purchaseAmount;
   128→    const previousThreshold = localAutoTopupThreshold;
   129→    setPurchaseAmount(amount);
   130→
   131→    if (localAutoTopupEnabled) {
   132→      const newThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(amount / 5));
   133→
   134→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(newThreshold);
   135→
   136→      updateAutoTopup({
   137→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   138→        amount: amount,
   139→        threshold: newThreshold,
   140→      }, {
   141→        onError: (error) => {
   142→          setPurchaseAmount(previousAmount);
   143→          setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(previousThreshold);
   144→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   145→            context: 'useAutoTopupState',
   146→            toastTitle: 'Failed to update auto top-up',
   147→          });
   148→        },
   149→      });
   150→    }
   151→  };
   152→
   153→  return {
   154→    purchaseAmount,
   155→    localAutoTopupEnabled,
   156→    localAutoTopupThreshold,
   157→    autoTopupState,
   158→    isUpdatingAutoTopup,

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

   165→async function invokeHuggingFaceUpload(input: {
   166→  storagePaths: TempStoragePaths;
   167→  loraDetails: LoraDetails;
   168→  sampleVideoMeta: SampleVideoMeta[];
   169→  options: { isPrivate?: boolean; repoName?: string };
   170→}): Promise<HuggingFaceUploadResponse> {
   171→  const formData = new FormData();
   172→  formData.append('loraStoragePaths', JSON.stringify(input.storagePaths));
   173→  formData.append('loraDetails', JSON.stringify(input.loraDetails));
   174→  formData.append('sampleVideos', JSON.stringify(input.sampleVideoMeta));
   175→
   176→  if (input.options.isPrivate !== undefined) {
   177→    formData.append('isPrivate', String(input.options.isPrivate));
   178→  }
   179→  if (input.options.repoName) {
   180→    formData.append('repoName', input.options.repoName);
   181→  }
   182→
   183→  const { data, error } = await supabase().functions.invoke('huggingface-upload', {
   184→    body: formData,
   185→  });
   186→
   187→  if (error) {
   188→    throw new Error(error.message || 'Edge function error');
   189→  }
   190→
   191→  if (!data?.success) {
   192→    throw new Error(data?.error || 'Upload failed');
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  return data;
   196→}

   209→/**
   210→ * Hook to handle uploading LoRA files to HuggingFace via our Edge Function
   211→ */
   212→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {
   213→  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<UploadProgress>({
   214→    stage: 'idle',
   215→    message: '',
   216→  });
   217→
   218→  /**
   219→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket
   220→   */
   221→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
   222→    const fileName = `${crypto.randomUUID()}-${file.name}`;
   223→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
   224→    const { error } = await supabase().storage
   225→      .from('temporary')
   226→      .upload(filePath, file, {
   227→        cacheControl: '3600',
   228→        upsert: false,
   229→      });
   230→
   231→    if (error) {
   232→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    return filePath;
   236→  };
   237→
   238→  /**
   239→   * Upload LoRA file(s) and optionally sample videos to HuggingFace.
   240→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs.
   241→   */
   242→  const uploadToHuggingFace = async (
   243→    loraFiles: LoraFiles,
   244→    loraDetails: LoraDetails,
   245→    sampleVideos: File[] = [],
   246→    options: {
   247→      isPrivate?: boolean;
   248→      repoName?: string;
   249→    } = {}
   250→  ): Promise<UploadResult> => {
   251→    try {
   252→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase().auth.getUser();
   253→      if (!user) {
   254→        return operationFailure(new Error('Not authenticated'), {
   255→          errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_not_authenticated',
   256→          recoverable: false,
   257→          policy: 'fail_closed',
   258→        });
   259→      }
   260→
   261→      const storagePaths = await uploadLoraFilesToTempStorage({
   262→        loraFiles,
   263→        userId: user.id,
   264→        setUploadProgress,
   265→        uploadToTempStorage,
   266→      });
   267→
   268→      if (!storagePaths) {
   269→        return operationFailure(new Error('No LoRA file provided'), {
   270→          errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_missing_file',
   271→          recoverable: false,
   272→          policy: 'fail_closed',
   273→        });
   274→      }
   275→
   276→      const sampleVideoMeta = await uploadSampleVideosToTempStorage({
   277→        sampleVideos,
   278→        userId: user.id,
   279→        setUploadProgress,
   280→        uploadToTempStorage,
   281→      });
   282→
   283→      setUploadProgress({
   284→        stage: 'processing',
   285→        message: 'Uploading to HuggingFace...',
   286→        progress: 60,
   287→      });
   288→
   289→      const response = await invokeHuggingFaceUpload({
   290→        storagePaths,
   291→        loraDetails,
   292→        sampleVideoMeta,
   293→        options,
   294→      });
   295→
   296→      setUploadProgress({
   297→        stage: 'complete',
   298→        message: 'Upload complete!',
   299→        progress: 100,
   300→      });
   301→
   302→      return operationSuccess(mapUploadSuccess(response));
   303→    } catch (err) {
   304→      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
   305→      setUploadProgress({
   306→        stage: 'error',
   307→        message: errorMessage,
   308→      });
   309→      return operationFailure(err, {
   310→        errorCode: 'huggingface_upload_failed',
   311→        message: errorMessage,
   312→      });
   313→    }
   314→  };
   315→
   316→  const resetProgress = () => {
   317→    setUploadProgress({ stage: 'idle', message: '' });
   318→  };
   319→
   320→  return {
   321→    uploadToHuggingFace,
   322→    uploadProgress,
   323→    resetProgress,
   324→    isUploading: uploadStages().includes(uploadProgress.stage),
   325→  };
   326→}

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useGetTask } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { deriveInputImages } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→interface UseGenerationDetailsOptions {
     8→  taskId?: string;
     9→  task?: Task;
    10→  inputImages?: string[];
    11→  projectId?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    15→  task: Task | undefined;
    16→  inputImages: string[];
    17→  isLoading: boolean;
    18→  isError: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for fetching and preparing task data for GenerationDetails
    23→ *
    24→ * Handles:
    25→ * - Fetching task data by ID if provided
    26→ * - Using directly provided task if available
    27→ * - Deriving input images from task params
    28→ */
    29→export function useGenerationDetails({
    30→  taskId,
    31→  task: taskProp,
    32→  inputImages: inputImagesProp,
    33→  projectId,
    34→}: UseGenerationDetailsOptions): UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    35→  // Fetch task data if taskId is provided and no task prop
    36→  const { data: fetchedTask, isLoading, isError } = useGetTask(taskId || '', projectId);
    37→
    38→  // Use provided task or fetched task
    39→  const task = taskProp || fetchedTask;
    40→
    41→  // Derive input images from task if not explicitly provided
    42→  const inputImages = useMemo(() => {
    43→    if (inputImagesProp && inputImagesProp.length > 0) {
    44→      return inputImagesProp;
    45→    }
    46→    if (!task?.params) return [];
    47→    // Parse params if needed
    48→    let params: Record<string, unknown>;
    49→    try {
    50→      params = typeof task.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(task.params) : task.params;
    51→    } catch (error) {
    52→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    53→        context: 'useGenerationDetails.parseTaskParams',
    54→        showToast: false,
    55→        logData: { taskId: task?.id, hasStringParams: typeof task?.params === 'string' },
    56→      });
    57→      return [];
    58→    }
    59→    return deriveInputImages(params);
    60→  }, [inputImagesProp, task]);
    61→
    62→  return {
    63→    task,
    64→    inputImages,
    65→    isLoading: taskId ? isLoading && !taskProp : false,
    66→    isError: taskId ? isError && !taskProp : false,
    67→  };
    68→}
    69→

    30→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    31→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    32→    return projectId;
    33→  }
    34→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    35→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    36→    return selectedProjectId;
    37→  }
    38→  return null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    43→ */
    44→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  generationIds: string[],
    47→  projectId: string | null,
    48→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    49→) {
    50→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    51→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    52→  const {
    53→    batchSize = 5,
    54→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    55→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    56→  } = options;
    57→
    58→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    59→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    60→
    61→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    62→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    63→
    64→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    65→
    66→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    67→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    68→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    69→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    70→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    71→        cacheEntry,
    72→      );
    73→
    74→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    75→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    76→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    77→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    78→          showToast: false,
    79→        });
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    83→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    84→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    85→          queryFn: async () => {
    86→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    87→              .from('tasks')
    88→              .select('*')
    89→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    90→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    91→              .single();
    92→
    93→            if (error) throw error;
    94→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    95→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    96→            }
    97→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    98→          },
    99→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   100→        }));
   101→      }
   102→    });
   103→
   104→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   105→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   109→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→}
   113→
   114→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   115→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   116→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   117→  projectId: string | null,
   118→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   119→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   120→
   121→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   122→    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
   123→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   124→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   125→    );
   126→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   127→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   128→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   129→      : null;
   130→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   131→
   132→    return {
   133→      ...generation,
   134→      taskId,
   135→      taskData,
   136→      taskMappingStatus,
   137→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   138→    };
   139→  });
   140→}

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

   139→function drawStar(
   140→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   141→  star: Star,
   142→  pulseOpacity: number,
   143→  isClaudeStar: boolean

   151→    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(255, 146, 115, ${pulseOpacity * 0.6})`);

   153→

   155→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   156→    ctx.fill();

   159→    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   160→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   161→    ctx.fill();

   166→  ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);

   170→function updateAndDrawStars(

   185→    star.x = star.baseX - parallaxX * depth;
   186→    star.y = star.baseY - parallaxY * depth;

   197→function calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(startTime: number, now: number): number {
   198→  const timeSinceStart = now - startTime;
   199→  if (timeSinceStart < WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) {
   200→    return 0;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return Math.min(1, (timeSinceStart - WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) / WANDERING_FADE_DURATION_MS);

   206→function updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   207→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   208→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   209→  groups: WanderingGroup[],
   210→  now: number,
   211→  time: number,
   212→  masterOpacity: number
   213→): void {
   214→  for (const group of groups) {
   215→    group.vx += (group.targetVx - group.vx) * 0.01;
   216→    group.vy += (group.targetVy - group.vy) * 0.01;
   217→
   218→    group.cx = wrapPosition(group.cx + group.vx, canvas.width, 100);
   219→    group.cy = wrapPosition(group.cy + group.vy, canvas.height, 100);
   220→
   221→    if (now > group.nextDirectionChange) {
   222→      group.targetVx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   223→      group.targetVy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   224→      group.nextDirectionChange =
   225→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    group.opacity += (group.targetOpacity - group.opacity) * group.fadeSpeed * 16;
   229→
   230→    if (now > group.nextFadeChange) {
   231→      group.targetOpacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.05 : 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25;
   232→      group.nextFadeChange = now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    for (const particle of group.particles) {
   236→      const particleX = group.cx + particle.offsetX;
   237→      const particleY = group.cy + particle.offsetY;
   238→
   239→      if (
   240→        particleX < -50 ||
   241→        particleX > canvas.width + 50 ||
   242→        particleY < -50 ||
   243→        particleY > canvas.height + 50
   244→      ) {
   245→        continue;
   246→      }
   247→
   248→      const twinkle = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.001 + particle.phase) * 0.2;
   249→      const particleOpacity = group.opacity * twinkle * masterOpacity;
   250→
   251→      ctx.beginPath();
   252→      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${particleOpacity})`;
   253→      ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   254→      ctx.fill();
   255→    }
   256→  }
   257→}

   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};
   371→

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

     2→
     3→interface TrailPoint {
     4→  x: number;
     5→  y: number;
     6→  opacity: number;
     7→  id: number;
     8→}
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Title text with a gold spotlight effect that follows the mouse cursor,
    12→ * leaving a fading trail of gold behind.
    13→ */
    14→export const GoldSpotlight: React.FC = () => {
    15→  const [titleHover, setTitleHover] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, active: false });
    16→  const [goldTrail, setGoldTrail] = useState<TrailPoint[]>([]);
    17→  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    18→  const trailIdRef = useRef(0);
    19→
    20→  // Handle mouse move over title for gold spotlight effect with trailing fade
    21→  const handleTitleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    22→    if (!titleRef.current) return;
    23→    const rect = titleRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    24→    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    25→    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    26→
    27→    setTitleHover({ x, y, active: true });
    28→
    29→    // Add a trail point
    30→    const newId = trailIdRef.current++;
    31→    setGoldTrail(prev => [...prev, { x, y, opacity: 1, id: newId }]); // Points only removed when fully faded
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const handleTitleMouseLeave = () => {
    35→    setTitleHover(prev => ({ ...prev, active: false }));
    36→  };
    37→
    38→  // Fade out trail points over time
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (goldTrail.length === 0) return;
    41→
    42→    const interval = setInterval(() => {
    43→      setGoldTrail(prev =>
    44→        prev
    45→          .map(point => ({ ...point, opacity: point.opacity - 0.008 }))
    46→          .filter(point => point.opacity > 0)
    47→      );
    48→    }, 50);
    49→
    50→    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    51→  }, [goldTrail.length]);  
    52→
    53→  return (
    54→    <div
    55→      ref={titleRef}
    56→      className="relative inline-block cursor-default"
    57→      onMouseMove={handleTitleMouseMove}
    58→      onMouseLeave={handleTitleMouseLeave}
    59→    >
    60→      {/* Base text */}
    61→      <h1 className="text-8xl md:text-[10rem] text-[#ecede3] mb-0 leading-tight select-none">
    62→        Reigh
    63→      </h1>
    64→      {/* Gold trail - fading spots where cursor has been */}
    65→      {goldTrail.map(point => (
    66→        <h1
    67→          key={point.id}
    68→          className="absolute inset-0 text-8xl md:text-[10rem] mb-0 leading-tight select-none pointer-events-none text-amber-400"
    69→          style={{
    70→            opacity: point.opacity,
    71→            filter: 'blur(0.4px)',
    72→            maskImage: `radial-gradient(circle 80px at ${point.x}px ${point.y}px, black 0%, black 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 70%, transparent 100%)`,
    73→            WebkitMaskImage: `radial-gradient(circle 80px at ${point.x}px ${point.y}px, black 0%, black 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 70%, transparent 100%)`,
    74→          }}
    75→          aria-hidden="true"
    76→        >
    77→          Reigh
    78→        </h1>
    79→      ))}
    80→      {/* Current cursor spotlight - solid gold */}
    81→      <h1
    82→        className="absolute inset-0 text-8xl md:text-[10rem] mb-0 leading-tight select-none pointer-events-none text-amber-400"
    83→        style={{
    84→          opacity: titleHover.active ? 1 : 0,
    85→          filter: 'blur(0.4px)',
    86→          maskImage: `radial-gradient(circle 90px at ${titleHover.x}px ${titleHover.y}px, black 0%, black 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 70%, transparent 100%)`,
    87→          WebkitMaskImage: `radial-gradient(circle 90px at ${titleHover.x}px ${titleHover.y}px, black 0%, black 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 70%, transparent 100%)`,
    88→          transition: 'opacity 0.15s ease-out'
    89→        }}
    90→        aria-hidden="true"
    91→      >
    92→        Reigh
    93→      </h1>
    94→    </div>
    95→  );
    96→};
    97→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

     2→import { installVisuals } from './visuals';
     3→
     4→interface InstallScenarioInput {
     5→  installMethod: InstallMethod;

    10→}
    11→
    12→function getInstallModalTitle({
    13→  platform,
    14→  browser,
    15→  isAppInstalled,
    16→}: Pick<InstallScenarioInput, 'platform' | 'browser' | 'isAppInstalled'>): string {
    17→  if (isAppInstalled) {
    18→    return 'Reigh is already installed!';
    19→  }
    20→  if (platform === 'ios') {
    21→    return 'Add Reigh to home screen';
    22→  }
    23→  if (platform === 'mac' && browser === 'safari') {
    24→    return 'Add Reigh to your dock';
    25→  }
    26→  return 'Install Reigh';
    27→}
    28→
    29→type InstallVisual = (typeof installVisuals)[keyof typeof installVisuals];
    30→
    31→interface InstallVisualRule {
    32→  matches: (input: InstallScenarioInput) => boolean;
    33→  Visual: InstallVisual;
    34→}
    35→
    36→const installVisualRules: InstallVisualRule[] = [
    37→  {
    38→    matches: ({ isAppInstalled, deviceType }) => Boolean(isAppInstalled && (deviceType === 'phone' || deviceType === 'tablet')),
    39→    Visual: installVisuals.mobileHomeIcon,

    47→    Visual: installVisuals.safariFileMenu,
    48→  },
    49→  {
    50→    matches: ({ installMethod, deviceType, browser }) => (
    51→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    52→      && deviceType === 'tablet'
    53→      && browser === 'chrome'
    54→    ),
    55→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadChromeShare,
    56→  },
    57→  {

    61→      && browser === 'edge'

    63→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadEdgeShare,

    69→    ),
    70→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadSafariShare,

    72→  {
    73→    matches: ({ installMethod, browser }) => (

    77→    Visual: installVisuals.chromeIosShare,

    79→  {
    80→    matches: ({ installMethod, browser }) => (
    81→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    82→      && browser === 'edge'
    83→    ),
    84→    Visual: installVisuals.edgeIosShare,
    85→  },
    86→  {
    87→    matches: ({ installMethod }) => installMethod === 'safari-home-screen',
    88→    Visual: installVisuals.safariShare,
    89→  },
    90→  {
    91→    matches: ({ platform }) => platform === 'android',
    92→    Visual: installVisuals.androidInstallPrompt,
    93→  },
    94→  {
    95→    matches: ({ browser }) => browser === 'chrome',
    96→    Visual: installVisuals.chromeInstall,
    97→  },
    98→  {
    99→    matches: ({ browser }) => browser === 'edge',
   100→    Visual: installVisuals.edgeAppAvailable,
   101→  },
   102→];
   103→
   104→function resolveInstallVisual(input: InstallScenarioInput): InstallVisual | null {
   105→  for (const rule of installVisualRules) {
   106→    if (rule.matches(input)) {
   107→      return rule.Visual;
   108→    }
   109→  }
   110→  return null;
   111→}
   112→
   113→interface InstallScenarioPresentation {
   114→  title: string;
   115→  Visual: InstallVisual | null;
   116→}
   117→
   118→export function resolveInstallScenarioPresentation(
   119→  input: InstallScenarioInput,
   120→): InstallScenarioPresentation {
   121→  const title = getInstallModalTitle(input);
   122→  const Visual = resolveInstallVisual(input);
   123→  return {
   124→    title,
   125→    Visual,
   126→  };
   127→}

    23→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {

    27→  taskMappingError?: string;

    29→
    30→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    31→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    32→    return projectId;
    33→  }
    34→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    35→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    36→    return selectedProjectId;
    37→  }
    38→  return null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    43→ */
    44→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  generationIds: string[],
    47→  projectId: string | null,
    48→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    49→) {
    50→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    51→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    52→  const {
    53→    batchSize = 5,
    54→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    55→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    56→  } = options;
    57→
    58→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    59→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    60→
    61→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    62→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    63→
    64→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    65→
    66→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    67→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    68→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    69→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    70→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    71→        cacheEntry,
    72→      );
    73→
    74→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    75→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    76→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    77→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    78→          showToast: false,
    79→        });
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    83→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    84→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    85→          queryFn: async () => {
    86→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    87→              .from('tasks')
    88→              .select('*')
    89→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    90→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    91→              .single();
    92→
    93→            if (error) throw error;
    94→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    95→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    96→            }
    97→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    98→          },
    99→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   100→        }));
   101→      }
   102→    });
   103→
   104→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   105→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   109→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→}
   113→
   114→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   115→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   116→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   117→  projectId: string | null,
   118→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   119→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   120→
   121→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   122→    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
   123→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   124→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   125→    );
   126→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   127→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   128→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   129→      : null;
   130→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   131→
   132→    return {
   133→      ...generation,
   134→      taskId,
   135→      taskData,
   136→      taskMappingStatus,
   137→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   138→    };
   139→  });
   140→}

   343→    effectiveSettings,

   346→    buildParams,

   348→  };
