```
    49→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    50→    return {
    51→      variantSourceTaskId: getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(variantParams),
    52→      variantHasOrchestratorDetails: hasOrchestratorDetails(variantParams),
    53→    };
    54→  }, [activeVariant?.params]);
    55→
    56→  // Fetch the variant's source task when it differs from taskDetailsData
    57→  // Skip fetch if variant already has orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join variants)
    58→  // NOTE: Uses ['tasks', 'single', taskId] query key to share cache with usePrefetchTaskData
    59→  const { data: variantSourceTask, isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask } = useQuery({
    60→    [REDACTED](variantSourceTaskId ?? '', projectId ?? null),
    61→    queryFn: async () => {
    62→      if (!variantSourceTaskId || !projectId) return null;
    63→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    64→        .select('*')
    65→        .eq('id', variantSourceTaskId)
    66→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    67→        .single();
    68→      if (error) {
    69→        console.error('[VariantTaskDetails] Error fetching source task:', error);
    70→        return null;
    71→      }
    72→      return data;
    73→    },
    74→    // Don't fetch if: no task ID, already have matching taskDetailsData, or variant has orchestrator_details
    75→    enabled: !!variantSourceTaskId
    76→      && !!projectId
    77→      && variantSourceTaskId !== taskDetailsData?.taskId
    78→      && !variantHasOrchestratorDetails,
    79→    staleTime: Infinity, // Task data is immutable - cache forever (matches prefetch)
    80→  });
    81→
    82→  // For variants, show the variant's source task params instead of the original task
    83→  // But ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so the Apply button shows
    84→  const adjustedTaskDetailsData = useMemo(() => {
    85→    // Check if we're viewing a variant that was created by a task (has source_task_id in params)
    86→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    87→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (
    88→      variantParams.source_task_id ||
    89→      variantParams.created_from ||
    90→      (activeVariant.variant_type && activeVariant.variant_type !== VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL)
    91→    );
    92→
    93→    if (isTaskCreatedVariant && variantParams) {
    94→      // Check if taskDetailsData already has the correct task (e.g., when opened from TasksPane)
    95→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
    96→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
    97→
    98→      // Determine the best source of task params:
    99→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   100→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params
   101→      // 3. Fall back to variant params (may be incomplete)
   102→      // IMPORTANT: Use variant_type for display (e.g., 'clip_join'), NOT tool_type
   103→      // tool_type is the tool that launched the task (e.g., 'travel-between-images'),
   104→      // which is different from what kind of variant this is
   105→      let effectiveParams = variantParams;
   106→      const effectiveTaskType = activeVariant.variant_type || 'variant';
   107→
   108→      if (hasMatchingTaskData) {
   109→        effectiveParams = (taskDetailsData.task?.params ?? variantParams) as Record<string, unknown>;
   110→      } else if (!variantParams.orchestrator_details && variantSourceTask?.params) {
   111→        // Only use fetched task params if variant doesn't already have orchestrator_details
   112→        // clip_join variants store orchestrator_details directly, so we don't want to overwrite
   113→        try {
   114→          effectiveParams = typeof variantSourceTask.params === 'string'
   115→            ? JSON.parse(variantSourceTask.params)
   116→            : variantSourceTask.params;
   117→        } catch {
   118→          // Keep variantParams as fallback on parse failure
   119→        }
   120→      }
   121→      // Otherwise keep variantParams which may already have orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join)
   122→
   123→      // Extract input images using shared utility
   124→      // This handles segment tasks (only segment images) vs full timeline tasks
   125→      const variantInputImages = deriveInputImages(effectiveParams);
   126→
   127→      return {
   128→        task: {
   129→          id: activeVariant.id,
   130→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   131→          params: effectiveParams,
   132→          status: 'Complete' as Task['status'],
   133→          createdAt: activeVariant.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   134→          projectId: '',
   135→        } as Task,
   136→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   137→        error: null,
   138→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   139→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   140→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   141→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   142→      };
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   146→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   147→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   148→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   149→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   150→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);
   151→
   152→    // Only override to loading if:
   153→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   154→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   155→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   156→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||
   157→      (isLoadingVariants && !activeVariant && taskDetailsData?.isLoading);
   158→
   159→    if (shouldShowLoading) {
   160→      return taskDetailsData ? { ...taskDetailsData, isLoading: true } : taskDetailsData;
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   164→    return taskDetailsData;
   165→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   166→
   167→  return {
   168→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   169→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   170→  };
   171→}
```

```
1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→
```

```
     2→ * useAdjustedTaskDetails - Fetches variant source task and computes adjusted task details
     3→ *
     4→ * For variants created by tasks, shows the variant's source task params
     5→ * instead of the original generation's task. Preserves onApplySettingsFromTask.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     9→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

    11→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    12→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    13→import {

    15→  hasOrchestratorDetails,

    17→import { deriveInputImages } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
    18→import type { TaskDetailsData } from '../types';
    19→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
    20→
    21→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps {
    22→  projectId?: string | null;

    25→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;

    33→}
    34→
    35→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    36→  adjustedTaskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    37→  isLoadingVariantTask: boolean;
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({
    41→  projectId,
    42→  activeVariant,
    43→  taskDetailsData,
    44→  isLoadingVariants,
    45→  initialVariantId,
    46→}: UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps): UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    47→  // Extract source_task_id and check if variant already has orchestrator_details
    48→  const { variantSourceTaskId, variantHasOrchestratorDetails } = useMemo(() => {
    49→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    50→    return {
    51→      variantSourceTaskId: getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(variantParams),
    52→      variantHasOrchestratorDetails: hasOrchestratorDetails(variantParams),
    53→    };
    54→  }, [activeVariant?.params]);
    55→
    56→  // Fetch the variant's source task when it differs from taskDetailsData
    57→  // Skip fetch if variant already has orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join variants)
    58→  // NOTE: Uses ['tasks', 'single', taskId] query key to share cache with usePrefetchTaskData
    59→  const { data: variantSourceTask, isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask } = useQuery({
    60→    [REDACTED](variantSourceTaskId ?? '', projectId ?? null),
    61→    queryFn: async () => {
    62→      if (!variantSourceTaskId || !projectId) return null;
    63→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    64→        .select('*')
    65→        .eq('id', variantSourceTaskId)
    66→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    67→        .single();
    68→      if (error) {
    69→        console.error('[VariantTaskDetails] Error fetching source task:', error);
    70→        return null;
    71→      }
    72→      return data;
    73→    },
    74→    // Don't fetch if: no task ID, already have matching taskDetailsData, or variant has orchestrator_details
    75→    enabled: !!variantSourceTaskId
    76→      && !!projectId
    77→      && variantSourceTaskId !== taskDetailsData?.taskId
    78→      && !variantHasOrchestratorDetails,
    79→    staleTime: Infinity, // Task data is immutable - cache forever (matches prefetch)
    80→  });
    81→
    82→  // For variants, show the variant's source task params instead of the original task
    83→  // But ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so the Apply button shows
    84→  const adjustedTaskDetailsData = useMemo(() => {
    85→    // Check if we're viewing a variant that was created by a task (has source_task_id in params)
    86→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    87→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (
    88→      variantParams.source_task_id ||
    89→      variantParams.created_from ||
    90→      (activeVariant.variant_type && activeVariant.variant_type !== VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL)
    91→    );
    92→
    93→    if (isTaskCreatedVariant && variantParams) {
    94→      // Check if taskDetailsData already has the correct task (e.g., when opened from TasksPane)
    95→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
    96→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
    97→
    98→      // Determine the best source of task params:
    99→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   100→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params
   101→      // 3. Fall back to variant params (may be incomplete)
   102→      // IMPORTANT: Use variant_type for display (e.g., 'clip_join'), NOT tool_type
   103→      // tool_type is the tool that launched the task (e.g., 'travel-between-images'),
   104→      // which is different from what kind of variant this is
   105→      let effectiveParams = variantParams;
   106→      const effectiveTaskType = activeVariant.variant_type || 'variant';
   107→
   108→      if (hasMatchingTaskData) {
   109→        effectiveParams = (taskDetailsData.task?.params ?? variantParams) as Record<string, unknown>;
   110→      } else if (!variantParams.orchestrator_details && variantSourceTask?.params) {
   111→        // Only use fetched task params if variant doesn't already have orchestrator_details
   112→        // clip_join variants store orchestrator_details directly, so we don't want to overwrite
   113→        try {
   114→          effectiveParams = typeof variantSourceTask.params === 'string'
   115→            ? JSON.parse(variantSourceTask.params)
   116→            : variantSourceTask.params;
   117→        } catch {
   118→          // Keep variantParams as fallback on parse failure
   119→        }
   120→      }
   121→      // Otherwise keep variantParams which may already have orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join)
   122→
   123→      // Extract input images using shared utility
   124→      // This handles segment tasks (only segment images) vs full timeline tasks
   125→      const variantInputImages = deriveInputImages(effectiveParams);
   126→
   127→      return {
   128→        task: {
   129→          id: activeVariant.id,
   130→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   131→          params: effectiveParams,
   132→          status: 'Complete' as Task['status'],
   133→          createdAt: activeVariant.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   134→          projectId: '',
   135→        } as Task,
   136→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   137→        error: null,
   138→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   139→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   140→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   141→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   142→      };
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   146→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   147→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   148→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   149→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   150→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);

   152→    // Only override to loading if:
   153→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   154→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   155→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   156→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||

   158→

   161→    }
   162→
   163→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   164→    return taskDetailsData;
   165→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   166→
   167→  return {
   168→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   169→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   170→  };
   171→}
```

```
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}

   276→async function deleteGenerationScoped(input: ScopedGenerationInput): Promise<void> {
   277→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(

   310→/**

   313→async function deleteVariantScoped(input: ScopedVariantInput): Promise<void> {
   314→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(

   316→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.projectScope',

   319→  const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
```

```
    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
```

```
    11→
    12→/** App-facing themed button contract. */

    14→  BASE_BUTTON_CLASSNAME,

    19→        ...APP_BUTTON_VARIANTS,

    30→  },
    31→);
    32→
    33→interface ButtonProps
    34→  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    35→    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
    36→  asChild?: boolean;
    37→}
    38→
    39→const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
    40→  ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    41→    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button";
    42→    return (
    43→      <Comp

    47→      />
    48→    );
    49→  },
    50→);
    51→Button.displayName = "Button";
    52→
    53→export { Button, buttonVariants };
```

```
     2→import type { Json } from '@/integrations/supabase/jsonTypes';
     3→
     4→export function rpcCopyOnboardingTemplate(targetProjectId: string, targetShotId: string) {
     5→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('copy_onboarding_template', {
     6→    target_project_id: targetProjectId,
     7→    target_shot_id: targetShotId,
     8→  });
     9→}
    10→
    11→export function deleteProjectByIdForUser(projectId: string, userId: string) {
    12→  return getSupabaseClient().from('projects')
    13→    .delete()
    14→    .eq('id', projectId)
    15→    .eq('user_id', userId);
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function insertDefaultShotForProject(
    19→  projectId: string,
    20→  name: string,
    21→  settings: Record<string, Json | undefined>,
    22→) {
    23→  return getSupabaseClient().from('shots')
    24→    .insert({
    25→      name,

    27→      settings,
    28→    })
    29→    .select('id')
    30→    .single();
    31→}

    35→    .select('id')

    37→    .single();
    38→}
```

```
    50→        return 'Processing...';
    51→      default:
    52→        return hasExistingContent
    53→          ? 'Voice input to create/edit prompt'
    54→          : 'Voice input to create prompt';
    55→    }
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  return hasExistingContent
    59→    ? 'Type instructions to create/edit prompt'
    60→    : 'Type instructions to create prompt';
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function getButtonStyles({
    64→  mode,
    65→  voiceState,
    66→  textState,
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useEffectiveMedia - Computes effective URLs and dimensions for media display
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles:
     5→ * - effectiveVideoUrl: Video URL respecting active variant
     6→ * - effectiveMediaUrl: Image URL respecting active variant
     7→ * - effectiveImageDimensions: Guaranteed dimensions with fallbacks
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useMemo } from 'react';
    11→import { ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION } from '@/shared/lib/media/aspectRatios';
    12→
    13→interface UseEffectiveMediaProps {
    14→  isVideo: boolean;
    15→  activeVariant: {
    16→    id?: string | null;
    17→    location?: string | null;
    18→    thumbnail_url?: string | null;
    19→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    20→  } | null;
    21→  effectiveImageUrl: string | undefined;
    22→  imageDimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null;
    23→  projectAspectRatio: string | undefined;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    27→  effectiveVideoUrl: string | undefined;
    28→  effectiveMediaUrl: string | undefined;
    29→  effectiveImageDimensions: { width: number; height: number };
    30→}
    31→
    32→export function useEffectiveMedia({
    33→  isVideo,
    34→  activeVariant,
    35→  effectiveImageUrl,
    36→  imageDimensions,
    37→  projectAspectRatio,
    38→}: UseEffectiveMediaProps): UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    39→  // Get the effective video URL (active variant or current media)
    40→  const effectiveVideoUrl = useMemo(() => {
    41→    if (isVideo && activeVariant) {
    42→      return activeVariant.location ?? undefined;
    43→    }
    44→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    45→  }, [isVideo, activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    46→
    47→  // For images, use the active variant's location when a variant is explicitly selected
    48→  const effectiveMediaUrl = useMemo(() => {
    49→
    50→    // If an active variant is set (any variant, including primary), use its location
    51→    if (activeVariant && activeVariant.location) {
    52→      return activeVariant.location;
    53→    }
    54→    // Otherwise use the standard effective image URL
    55→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    56→  }, [activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    57→
    58→  // Compute effective dimensions that are GUARANTEED to have a value
    59→  // This is computed synchronously during render, so there's no flicker
    60→  // Priority: extracted/loaded dimensions > project aspect ratio > 16:9 default
    61→  const effectiveImageDimensions = useMemo(() => {
    62→    // Use actual dimensions if we have them
    63→    if (imageDimensions) {
    64→      return imageDimensions;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    // Fallback to project aspect ratio
    68→    if (projectAspectRatio) {
    69→      const resolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[projectAspectRatio];
    70→      if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {
    71→        const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
    72→        if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && w > 0 && h > 0) {
    73→          return { width: w, height: h };
    74→        }
    75→      }
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    // Absolute last resort: 16:9 default
    79→    return { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    80→  }, [imageDimensions, projectAspectRatio]);
    81→
    82→  return {
    83→    effectiveVideoUrl,
    84→    effectiveMediaUrl,
    85→    effectiveImageDimensions,
    86→  };
    87→}
    88→
```

```
   262→  defaultNumFrames: number,
   263→): Promise<string> {
   264→  const { data: enhanceResult, error: enhanceError } = await supabase().functions.invoke('ai-prompt', {
   265→    body: {
   266→      task: 'enhance_segment_prompt',
   267→      prompt: promptToEnhance,
   268→      temperature: 0.7,
   269→      numFrames: runtime.effectiveSettings.numFrames || defaultNumFrames,
   270→    },
   271→  });
   272→
   273→  if (enhanceError) {
   274→    runtime.reportNonFatalError?.('enhance_prompt', enhanceError);
   275→    normalizeAndPresentError(enhanceError, {
   276→      context: `${runtime.errorContext}.enhancePrompt`,
   277→      showToast: false,
   278→    });
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  return enhanceResult?.enhanced_prompt?.trim() || promptToEnhance;
   282→}
   283→
   284→async function submitEnhancedSegmentTask(
   285→  runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime,
   286→  promptToEnhance: string,
   287→  defaultNumFrames: number,
   288→): Promise<string> {
   289→  await maybeSaveSettings(runtime);
   290→
   291→  const enhancedPromptResult = await enhanceSegmentPrompt(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   292→  const originalPrompt = runtime.effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   293→  const originalPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, originalPrompt);
   294→  const enhancedPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, enhancedPromptResult);
   295→
   296→  await saveEnhancedPromptMetadata(
   297→    runtime,
   298→    runtime.task,
   299→    runtime.queryClient,
   300→    enhancedPromptResult,
   301→    promptToEnhance,
   302→    originalPrompt,
   303→  );
   304→
   305→  const taskParams = runtime.buildParams(originalPromptWithAffixes, enhancedPromptWithAffixes);
   306→  return createTaskOrThrow(taskParams);
   307→}
   308→
   309→/**
   310→ * Submit a segment task, handling both enhanced and standard prompt paths.
   311→ * Uses the task placeholder runner for lifecycle management.
   312→ * Returns immediately — task creation runs in the background (fire-and-forget).
   313→ */
   314→export function submitSegmentTask(input: SubmitSegmentTaskInput): void {
   315→  const {
   316→    taskLabel,
   317→    errorContext,
   318→    getSettings,
   319→    saveSettings,
   320→    shouldSaveSettings,
   321→    shouldEnhance,
   322→    enhancedPrompt,
   323→    defaultNumFrames,
   324→    images,
   325→    task,
   326→    run,
   327→    queryClient,
   328→    onGenerateStarted,
   329→    onNonFatalError,
   330→  } = input;
   331→
   332→  const effectiveSettings = getSettings();
   333→  const promptToEnhance = enhancedPrompt?.trim() || effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   334→  const buildParams = buildSubmitParamsBuilder(effectiveSettings, task, images);
   335→
   336→  // Notify parent for optimistic UI
   337→  onGenerateStarted?.();
   338→
   339→  const runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime = {
   340→    errorContext,
   341→    shouldSaveSettings,
   342→    saveSettings,
   343→    effectiveSettings,
   344→    task,
   345→    queryClient,
   346→    buildParams,
   347→    reportNonFatalError: onNonFatalError,
   348→  };
   349→
   350→  // Fire and forget — run() handles add/resolve/refetch/remove/error lifecycle
   351→  void run({
   352→    taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   353→    label: taskLabel,
   354→    context: errorContext,
   355→    toastTitle: 'Failed to create task',
   356→    create: async () => {
   357→      if (shouldEnhance && promptToEnhance) {
   358→        return submitEnhancedSegmentTask(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   359→      }
   360→      return submitStandardSegmentTask(runtime);
   361→    },
   362→  });
   363→}
```

```
    13→export function useIsMobile() {

    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return false;

    21→/** App-facing tablet signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    22→export function useIsTablet() {
    23→  const detected = useIsTabletSignal();
    24→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    25→    return false;
    26→  }
    27→  return detected ?? (window.innerWidth >= 768 && window.innerWidth < 1024);
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** App-facing touch capability signal with runtime fallback for browser environments. */
    31→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
    32→  const detected = useIsTouchDeviceSignal();
    33→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    34→    return false;
    35→  }
    36→  if (detected !== undefined) {
    37→    return detected;
    38→  }
    39→  return 'ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
    40→}
```

```
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}

   336→    ...(mapping?.queryError ? { queryError: mapping.queryError } : {}),
   337→  };
   338→}
```

```
    22→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !('items' in data)) {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→  const candidate = data as { items?: unknown };
    26→  return Array.isArray(candidate.items);
    27→}

    32→): Promise<GenerationStarOptimisticContext> {
    33→  await Promise.all([
    34→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    35→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    36→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    37→  ]);
    38→
    39→  const previousGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    40→  const previousShotsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    41→  const previousAllShotGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    42→
    43→  const generationsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    44→  generationsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    45→    if (!isUnifiedGenerationListData(data)) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    previousGenerationsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    50→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, {
    51→      ...data,
    52→      items: data.items.map((generation) => (
    53→        generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    54→      )),
    55→    });
    56→  });
    57→
    58→  const shotsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    59→  shotsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    60→    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
    61→      return;
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    previousShotsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    65→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, (data as Shot[]).map((shot) => {
    66→      if (!shot.images) {
    67→        return shot;
    68→      }
    69→      return {
    70→        ...shot,
    71→        images: shot.images.map((image) => (
    72→          image.id === input.generationId ? { ...image, starred: input.starred } : image
    73→        )),
    74→      };
    75→    }));
    76→  });

    86→          generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    87→        )),
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,
     5→ * ensuring consistent behavior across TasksPane, MediaLightbox, and other components.
     6→ */
     7→import { buildTaskPayloadSnapshot } from './tasks/taskPayloadSnapshot';
     8→import { createTravelPayloadReader, type TravelPayloadSource } from './tasks/travelPayloadReader';
     9→import {
    10→  asRecord,
    11→  asString,
    12→  asStringArray,
    13→  firstString as pickFirstString,
    14→} from './jsonNarrowing';
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    18→ */
    19→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    20→  if (!params) return {};
    21→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    22→    try {
    23→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    24→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    25→    } catch {
    26→      return {};
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Derive input images from task params
    34→ *
    35→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    36→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    37→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    38→ *
    39→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    40→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    41→ */
    42→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    43→  const params = parsedParams;
    44→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    45→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    46→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    47→      return travelImages;
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    52→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    53→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    54→
    55→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    56→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    57→
    58→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    59→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    60→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    61→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    62→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    63→    }
    64→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    65→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    66→      const urls: string[] = [];
    67→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    68→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    69→      return urls;
    70→    }
    71→    // Fallback to top-level (which should be segment-specific for segment tasks)
    72→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    73→      return params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    74→    }
    75→    return [];
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  // For non-segment tasks, collect from all locations
    79→  const urls: string[] = [];
    80→
    81→  // Image edit task paths
    82→  if (typeof params?.image_url === 'string') urls.push(params.image_url);
    83→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    84→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    85→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    86→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    87→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    89→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    90→
    91→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    92→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    93→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    94→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    95→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    96→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    97→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));
   101→}
   102→
   103→/**
   104→ * Extract prompt from task params
   105→ *
   106→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   107→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   108→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   109→ *
   110→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   111→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   112→ *
   113→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   114→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   115→ */
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   123→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   124→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   125→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   126→
   127→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   128→
   129→  // For segment tasks, try to get enhanced prompt first
   130→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   131→    // Check for enhanced prompt - can be singular field or in expanded array
   132→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   133→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   134→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   135→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   136→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   137→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   138→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   139→    );
   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt
   143→    return (
   144→      pickFirstString(
   145→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,
   148→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   157→  // cleared the global prompt.
   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   160→  return (
   161→    pickFirstString(
   162→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   163→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   164→      params.base_prompt,
   165→      params.prompt,
   166→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   167→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   169→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   170→    ) ?? null
   171→  );
   172→}
   173→
   174→/**
   175→ * Check if a task type is an image edit task
   176→ */
   177→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   178→  const IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES = [
   179→    'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   180→    'image_inpaint',
   181→    'qwen_image_edit',
   182→    'magic_edit',
   183→    'kontext_image_edit',
   184→    'flux_image_edit',
   185→    'annotated_image_edit',
   186→  ];
   187→  return IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES.includes(taskType || '');
   188→}
   189→
   190→/**
   191→ * Check if a task type is a video enhancement task
   192→ */
   193→export function isVideoEnhanceTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   194→  return taskType === 'video_enhance';
   195→}
   196→
   197→/**
   198→ * Check if a task type is an image enhancement/upscale task
   199→ */
   200→export function isImageEnhanceTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   201→  return taskType === 'image-upscale';
   202→}
   203→
   204→/**
   205→ * LoRA info extracted from task params
   206→ */
   207→interface LoraInfo {
   208→  url: string;
   209→  strength: number;
   210→  displayName: string;
   211→}
   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   215→ */
   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→
   221→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',

   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',

   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );

   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }

   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }

   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),

   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {

   338→      'rawParams',

   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(

   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Task ID resolution helpers
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes the logic for extracting task IDs from variant params,
     5→ * handling legacy field names consistently.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
     9→const CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    10→  ['source_task_id'],
    11→  ['orchestration_contract', 'orchestrator_task_id'],
    12→];
    13→const LEGACY_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    14→  ['orchestrator_task_id'],
    15→  ['task_id'],
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→function readStringPath(
    19→  value: unknown,
    20→  path: readonly string[],
    21→): string | null {
    22→  let current: unknown = value;
    23→  for (const segment of path) {
    24→    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || Array.isArray(current)) {
    25→      return null;
    26→    }
    27→    current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[segment];
    28→  }
    29→  return typeof current === 'string' && current.length > 0 ? current : null;
    30→}
    31→
    32→function resolveTaskIdFromPaths(
    33→  value: unknown,
    34→  paths: readonly (readonly string[])[],
    35→): string | null {
    36→  return paths
    37→    .map((path) => readStringPath(value, path))
    38→    .find((candidate): candidate is string => Boolean(candidate)) ?? null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→function asValidUuid(value: string | null): string | null {
    42→  if (!value) {
    43→    return null;
    44→  }
    45→  return UUID_REGEX.test(value) ? value : null;
    46→}
    47→
    48→/**
    49→ * Extract the source task ID from variant params.
    50→ *
    51→ * Variants can have their source task ID stored under different field names
    52→ * due to historical evolution of the param structure:
    53→ * - `source_task_id` - Current standard (preferred)
    54→ * - `orchestration_contract.orchestrator_task_id` - Canonical orchestrator contract
    55→ *
    56→ * @param params - Variant params object (typically from variant.params)
    57→ * @returns Valid UUID task ID, or null if not found/invalid
    58→ */
    59→export function getSourceTaskId(
    60→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
    61→): string | null {
    62→  return asValidUuid(resolveTaskIdFromPaths(params, CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS));
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Legacy-compatible source task ID extraction.
    67→ * This helper is only for migration paths that still need to read old keys.
    68→ */
    69→export function getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(
    70→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    71→): string | null {
    72→  const canonicalTaskId = getSourceTaskId(params);
    73→  if (canonicalTaskId) {
    74→    return canonicalTaskId;
    75→  }
    76→  return asValidUuid(resolveTaskIdFromPaths(params, LEGACY_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS));
    77→}
    78→
    79→/**
    80→ * Check if params contain orchestrator details.
    81→ * Used to determine if variant already has full task context.
    82→ */
    83→export function hasOrchestratorDetails(
    84→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
    85→): boolean {
    86→  return !!params?.orchestrator_details;
    87→}
```

```
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
```

```
1→import * as React from 'react';
     2→
     3→const Slot = React.forwardRef<HTMLElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>(
     4→  ({ children, ...props }, forwardedRef) => {
     5→    if (!React.isValidElement(children)) {
     6→      return null;
     7→    }
     8→
     9→    const child = children as React.ReactElement<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    10→      ref?: React.Ref<HTMLElement>;
    11→    };
    12→
    13→    return React.cloneElement(child, {
    14→      ...mergeProps(props, child.props),
    15→      ref: forwardedRef ? composeRefs(forwardedRef, child.ref) : child.ref,
    16→    } as Record<string, unknown>);
    17→  }
    18→);
    19→
    20→Slot.displayName = 'Slot';
    21→
    22→function mergeProps(
    23→  slotProps: Record<string, unknown>,
    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
    25→): Record<string, unknown> {
    26→  const overrideProps: Record<string, unknown> = { ...childProps };
    27→
    28→  for (const propName in childProps) {
    29→    const slotPropValue = slotProps[propName];
    30→    const childPropValue = childProps[propName];
    31→
    32→    const isHandler = /^on[A-Z]/.test(propName);
    33→    if (isHandler) {
    34→      if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function' && typeof childPropValue === 'function') {
    35→        overrideProps[propName] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    36→          (childPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    37→          (slotPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    38→        };
    39→      } else if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function') {
    40→        overrideProps[propName] = slotPropValue;
    41→      }
    42→    } else if (propName === 'style') {
    43→      const slotStyle = typeof slotPropValue === 'object' && slotPropValue ? slotPropValue : {};
    44→      const childStyle = typeof childPropValue === 'object' && childPropValue ? childPropValue : {};
    45→      overrideProps[propName] = { ...slotStyle, ...childStyle };
    46→    } else if (propName === 'className') {
    47→      overrideProps[propName] = [slotPropValue, childPropValue].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return { ...slotProps, ...overrideProps };
    52→}
    53→
    54→function composeRefs<T>(...refs: (React.Ref<T> | undefined | null)[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
    55→  return (node) => {
    56→    refs.forEach((ref) => {
    57→      if (typeof ref === 'function') {
    58→        ref(node);
    59→      } else if (ref != null) {
    60→        (ref as React.MutableRefObject<T | null>).current = node;
    61→      }
    62→    });
    63→  };
    64→}
    65→
    66→export { Slot };
    67→
```

```
     5→function getShotsProjectPrefix(projectId: string): readonly QueryKey {

     9→function getShotListQueries(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId: string) {

    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * @param onlyExisting - If true, only update caches that already exist.
    17→ *                       If false (default), will create cache entries if needed.
    18→ */
    19→export function updateAllShotsCaches(
    20→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    21→  projectId: string,
    22→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    23→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
    24→): void {
    25→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    26→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    27→    if (!onlyExisting) {
    28→      queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(
    29→        queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0),
    30→        (old) => updater(old)
    31→      );
    32→    }
    33→    return;
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key, existing]) => {
    37→    if (onlyExisting && existing === undefined) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(key, (old) => updater(old));
    41→  });
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function rollbackShotsCaches(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  projectId: string,
    47→  previous: Shot[] | undefined
    48→): void {
    49→  if (!previous) return;
    50→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    51→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    52→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), previous);
    53→    return;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key]) => {
```

```
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→
```

```
1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  events?: EventType[];
     7→  enabled?: boolean;
     8→  delay?: number;
     9→  capture?: boolean;
    10→}
    11→
    12→/** Listen for outside clicks and invoke `callback` when they occur. Example: `const ref = useClickOutside(() => setOpen(false));` */
    13→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    14→  callback: () => void,
    15→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    16→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    17→): RefObject<T> {
    18→  const {
    19→    events = ['mousedown'],
    20→    enabled = true,
    21→    delay = 0,
    22→    capture = false,
    23→  } = options;
    24→
    25→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    26→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    27→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    31→  }, [callback]);
    32→
    33→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    34→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    35→      callbackRef.current();
    36→    }
    37→  }, [ref]);
    38→
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (!enabled) return;
    41→
    42→    const subscribe = () => {
    43→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    44→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    45→      });
    46→    };
    47→
    48→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    49→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    50→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    51→      });
    52→    };
    53→
    54→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    55→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    56→
    57→    return () => {
    58→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    59→      unsubscribe();
    60→    };
    61→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    62→
    63→  return ref;
    64→}
    65→
```

```
    53→    batchSize = 5,
    54→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    55→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    56→  } = options;
    57→
    58→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    59→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    60→
    61→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    62→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    63→
    64→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    65→
    66→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    67→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    68→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    69→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    70→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    71→        cacheEntry,
    72→      );
    73→
    74→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    75→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    76→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    77→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    78→          showToast: false,
    79→        });
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    83→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    84→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    85→          queryFn: async () => {
    86→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    87→              .from('tasks')
    88→              .select('*')
    89→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    90→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    91→              .single();
    92→
    93→            if (error) throw error;
    94→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    95→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    96→            }
    97→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    98→          },
    99→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   100→        }));
   101→      }
   102→    });
   103→
   104→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   105→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   109→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→}
   113→
   114→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   115→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   116→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   117→  projectId: string | null,
   118→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   119→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   120→
   121→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   122→    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
   123→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   124→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   125→    );
   126→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   127→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   128→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   129→      : null;
   130→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   131→
   132→    return {
   133→      ...generation,
   134→      taskId,
   135→      taskData,
   136→      taskMappingStatus,
   137→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   138→    };
   139→  });
   140→}
```

```
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);

   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,

   324→    });
   325→  }
```

```
1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→export const useStableSkeletonVisibility = (
     4→  isLoading: boolean,
     5→  hideDelay: number = 120
     6→): boolean => {
     7→  const [showStableSkeleton, setShowStableSkeleton] = useState<boolean>(false);
     8→  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
     9→  const lastLoadingStateRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    10→  
    11→  useEffect(() => {
    12→    if (isLoading !== lastLoadingStateRef.current) {
    13→      lastLoadingStateRef.current = isLoading;
    14→      
    15→      if (isLoading) {
    16→        if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    17→          window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    18→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    19→        }
    20→        setShowStableSkeleton(true);
    21→      } else {
    22→        hideTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
    23→          setShowStableSkeleton(false);
    24→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    25→        }, hideDelay);
    26→      }
    27→    }
    28→    
    29→    return () => {
    30→      if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    31→        window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    32→        hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    33→      }
    34→    };
    35→  }, [isLoading, hideDelay]);
    36→
    37→  return showStableSkeleton;
    38→};
    39→
```

```
    86→          cause: { selectedProjectId: input.selectedProjectId },
```

```
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {

    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
```

```
1→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→export function useTemporaryVisibility(duration = 2000) {
     4→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
     5→  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
     6→
     7→  const clearPendingTimeout = useCallback(() => {
     8→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
     9→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    10→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    11→    }
    12→  }, []);
    13→
    14→  const show = useCallback(() => {
    15→    setIsVisible(true);
    16→    clearPendingTimeout();
    17→    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    18→      setIsVisible(false);
    19→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    20→    }, duration);
    21→  }, [duration, clearPendingTimeout]);
    22→
    23→  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    24→    setIsVisible(false);
    25→    clearPendingTimeout();
    26→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    27→
    28→  useEffect(() => {
    29→    return () => clearPendingTimeout();
    30→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    31→
    32→  return { isVisible, show, hide };
    33→}
    34→
```

```
    21→function isUnifiedGenerationListData(data: unknown): data is UnifiedGenerationListData {
    22→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !('items' in data)) {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→  const candidate = data as { items?: unknown };
    26→  return Array.isArray(candidate.items);
    27→}
```
