    33→  await Promise.all([
    34→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    35→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    36→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    37→  ]);
    38→
    39→  const previousGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    40→  const previousShotsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    41→  const previousAllShotGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    42→
    43→  const generationsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    44→  generationsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    45→    if (!isUnifiedGenerationListData(data)) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    previousGenerationsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    50→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, {
    51→      ...data,
    52→      items: data.items.map((generation) => (
    53→        generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    54→      )),
    55→    });
    56→  });
    57→
    58→  const shotsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    59→  shotsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    60→    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
    61→      return;
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    previousShotsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    65→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, (data as Shot[]).map((shot) => {
    66→      if (!shot.images) {
    67→        return shot;

    69→      return {
    70→        ...shot,
    71→        images: shot.images.map((image) => (
    72→          image.id === input.generationId ? { ...image, starred: input.starred } : image
    73→        )),
    74→      };
    75→    }));
    76→  });

    82→      previousAllShotGenerationsQueries.set(shotQueryKey, previousShotData);
    83→      queryClient.setQueryData(
    84→        shotQueryKey,
    85→        (previousShotData as GenerationRow[]).map((generation) => (
    86→          generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    87→        )),
    88→      );
    89→    }
    90→  }

    92→  return {

    94→    previousShotsQueries,

    96→  };
    97→}

    99→export function rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(

     2→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import { getErrorMessage } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     5→
     6→export type TextProcessingState = 'idle' | 'open' | 'processing' | 'success';
     7→
     8→interface UseAIInputTextPopoverParams {
     9→  context?: string;
    10→  example?: string;
    11→  existingValue?: string;
    12→  onResult: (result: { transcription: string; prompt?: string }) => void;
    13→  onError?: (error: string) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→interface UseAIInputTextPopoverReturn {
    17→  textState: TextProcessingState;
    18→  inputValue: string;
    19→  setInputValue: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
    20→  isPopoverOpen: boolean;
    21→  setIsPopoverOpen: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
    22→  inputRef: React.RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement>;
    23→  handlePopoverOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
    24→  handleTextSubmit: () => Promise<void>;
    25→  handleKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => void;
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function useAIInputTextPopover({
    29→  context,
    30→  example,
    31→  existingValue = '',
    32→  onResult,
    33→  onError,
    34→}: UseAIInputTextPopoverParams): UseAIInputTextPopoverReturn {
    35→  const [textState, setTextState] = React.useState<TextProcessingState>('idle');
    36→  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = React.useState('');
    37→  const [isPopoverOpen, setIsPopoverOpen] = React.useState(false);
    38→  const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
    39→
    40→  React.useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (isPopoverOpen && inputRef.current) {
    42→      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    43→    }
    44→  }, [isPopoverOpen]);
    45→
    46→  const handlePopoverOpenChange = React.useCallback((open: boolean) => {
    47→    if (textState === 'processing') return;
    48→    setIsPopoverOpen(open);
    49→    if (open) {
    50→      setTextState('open');
    51→      setInputValue('');
    52→    } else {
    53→      setTextState('idle');
    54→    }
    55→  }, [textState]);
    56→
    57→  const handleTextSubmit = React.useCallback(async () => {
    58→    if (!inputValue.trim() || textState === 'processing') return;
    59→
    60→    setTextState('processing');
    61→
    62→    try {
    63→      const { data, error } = await supabase().functions.invoke('ai-voice-prompt', {
    64→        body: {
    65→          textInstructions: inputValue.trim(),
    66→          task: 'transcribe_and_write',
    67→          context: context || '',
    68→          example: example || '',
    69→          existingValue: existingValue || '',
    70→        },
    71→      });
    72→
    73→      if (error) {
    74→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'AIInputButton', showToast: false });
    75→        onError?.(error.message || 'Failed to process instructions');
    76→        setTextState('open');
    77→        return;
    78→      }
    79→
    80→      if (data?.error) {
    81→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(data.error), { context: 'AIInputButton', showToast: false });
    82→        onError?.(data.error);
    83→        setTextState('open');
    84→        return;
    85→      }
    86→
    87→      onResult?.({
    88→        transcription: data.transcription,
    89→        prompt: data.prompt,
    90→      });
    91→
    92→      setTextState('success');
    93→
    94→      setTimeout(() => {
    95→        setIsPopoverOpen(false);
    96→        setTextState('idle');
    97→        setInputValue('');
    98→      }, 500);
    99→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   100→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'AIInputButton', showToast: false });
   101→      onError?.(getErrorMessage(err) || 'Failed to process instructions');
   102→      setTextState('open');
   103→    }
   104→  }, [context, example, existingValue, inputValue, onError, onResult, textState]);
   105→
   106→  const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
   107→    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
   108→      e.preventDefault();
   109→      void handleTextSubmit();
   110→    }
   111→    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
   112→      setIsPopoverOpen(false);
   113→    }
   114→  }, [handleTextSubmit]);
   115→
   116→  return {
   117→    textState,
   118→    inputValue,
   119→    setInputValue,
   120→    isPopoverOpen,
   121→    setIsPopoverOpen,
   122→    inputRef,
   123→    handlePopoverOpenChange,
   124→    handleTextSubmit,
   125→    handleKeyDown,
   126→  };
   127→}
   128→

    97→    const particles = Array.from({ length: particleCount }, () => {
    98→      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    99→      const distance = Math.random() * spreadRadius;
   100→
   101→      return {
   102→        offsetX: Math.cos(angle) * distance,
   103→        offsetY: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
   104→        size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.5,
   105→        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
   106→      };
   107→    });
   108→
   109→    const speed = 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.6;
   110→
   111→    groups.push({
   112→      cx: Math.random() * width,
   113→      cy: Math.random() * height,
   114→      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   115→      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   116→      targetVx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   117→      targetVy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   118→      speed,
   119→      particles,
   120→      opacity: Math.random() * 0.3,
   121→      targetOpacity: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25,
   122→      fadeSpeed: 0.0005 + Math.random() * 0.001,
   123→      nextDirectionChange:
   124→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS,
   125→      nextFadeChange: now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS,
   126→    });
   127→  }
   128→
   129→  return groups;
   130→}
   131→
   132→function initializeStars(width: number, height: number): Star[] {
   133→  const starCount = Math.floor((width * height) / STAR_AREA_PER_STAR);
   134→  const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => createRegularStar(width, height));
   135→  stars.push(createClaudeStar(width, height));
   136→  return stars;
   137→}
   138→
   139→function drawStar(
   140→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   141→  star: Star,
   142→  pulseOpacity: number,
   143→  isClaudeStar: boolean
   144→): void {
   145→  ctx.beginPath();
   146→
   147→  if (isClaudeStar) {
   148→    const glowSize = star.size + Math.sin(performance.now() * star.twinkleSpeed) * 0.5;
   149→    const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(star.x, star.y, 0, star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3);
   150→    gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`);
   151→    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(255, 146, 115, ${pulseOpacity * 0.6})`);
   152→    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 166, 135, 0)');
   153→
   154→    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
   155→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   156→    ctx.fill();
   157→
   158→    ctx.beginPath();
   159→    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   160→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   161→    ctx.fill();
   162→    return;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   166→  ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   167→  ctx.fill();
   168→}
   169→
   170→function updateAndDrawStars(
   171→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   172→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   173→  stars: Star[],
   174→  parallaxX: number,
   175→  parallaxY: number,
   176→  time: number
   177→): void {
   178→  stars.forEach((star, index) => {
   179→    const isClaudeStar = index === stars.length - 1;
   180→
   181→    star.baseX = wrapPosition(star.baseX + star.vx, canvas.width, 50);
   182→    star.baseY = wrapPosition(star.baseY + star.vy, canvas.height, 50);
   183→
   184→    const depth = star.size * 0.5;
   185→    star.x = star.baseX - parallaxX * depth;
   186→    star.y = star.baseY - parallaxY * depth;
   187→
   188→    const pulseOpacity = Math.max(
   189→      0,
   190→      Math.min(1, star.opacity + Math.sin(time * star.twinkleSpeed + star.twinklePhase) * 0.3)
   191→    );
   192→
   193→    drawStar(ctx, star, pulseOpacity, isClaudeStar);
   194→  });
   195→}
   196→
   197→function calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(startTime: number, now: number): number {
   198→  const timeSinceStart = now - startTime;
   199→  if (timeSinceStart < WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) {
   200→    return 0;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return Math.min(1, (timeSinceStart - WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) / WANDERING_FADE_DURATION_MS);
   204→}
   205→
   206→function updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   207→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   208→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   209→  groups: WanderingGroup[],
   210→  now: number,
   211→  time: number,
   212→  masterOpacity: number
   213→): void {
   214→  for (const group of groups) {
   215→    group.vx += (group.targetVx - group.vx) * 0.01;
   216→    group.vy += (group.targetVy - group.vy) * 0.01;
   217→
   218→    group.cx = wrapPosition(group.cx + group.vx, canvas.width, 100);
   219→    group.cy = wrapPosition(group.cy + group.vy, canvas.height, 100);
   220→
   221→    if (now > group.nextDirectionChange) {
   222→      group.targetVx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   223→      group.targetVy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   224→      group.nextDirectionChange =
   225→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    group.opacity += (group.targetOpacity - group.opacity) * group.fadeSpeed * 16;
   229→
   230→    if (now > group.nextFadeChange) {
   231→      group.targetOpacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.05 : 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25;
   232→      group.nextFadeChange = now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    for (const particle of group.particles) {
   236→      const particleX = group.cx + particle.offsetX;
   237→      const particleY = group.cy + particle.offsetY;
   238→
   239→      if (
   240→        particleX < -50 ||
   241→        particleX > canvas.width + 50 ||
   242→        particleY < -50 ||
   243→        particleY > canvas.height + 50
   244→      ) {
   245→        continue;
   246→      }
   247→
   248→      const twinkle = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.001 + particle.phase) * 0.2;
   249→      const particleOpacity = group.opacity * twinkle * masterOpacity;
   250→
   251→      ctx.beginPath();
   252→      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${particleOpacity})`;
   253→      ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   254→      ctx.fill();
   255→    }
   256→  }
   257→}
   258→
   259→function useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement>): void {
   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};
   371→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically

     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:

    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation

    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}

   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→

    10→import type React from 'react';

    18→export const InlineSegmentVideo: React.FC<InlineSegmentVideoProps> = ({
    19→  slot,

    24→  leftPercent,
    25→  widthPercent,

   100→      }}
   101→    />
   102→  );
   103→};

1→/**

     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Base application error with additional context

    11→export class AppError extends Error {

    13→  public readonly showToast: boolean;

    24→      cause?: Error;
    25→    }
    26→  ) {
    27→    super(message);
    28→    this.name = 'AppError';
    29→    this.showToast = options?.showToast ?? true;
    30→    this.context = options?.context;
    31→    this.cause = options?.cause;

    34→
    35→/**

    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';

    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {
    68→      message = 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });

   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {

   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {

   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→

   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();

   204→    err.name === 'AbortError' ||
   205→    message.includes('network') ||

   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||

   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (
   226→    message.includes('required') ||
   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   235→}

1→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     2→
     3→// --- Timeline write logging ---
     4→
     5→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';
     6→
     7→interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {
     8→  shotId: string;
     9→  operation: string;
    10→  waitMs: number;
    11→  durationMs: number;
    12→  queueDepth: number;
    13→  requestId: number;
    14→  blockedByOperation?: string | null;
    15→  blockedByDurationMs?: number | null;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export type TimelineWriteEventHandler = (phase: TimelineWritePhase, meta: TimelineWriteEventMeta) => void;
    19→
    20→interface TimelineWriteLoggerOptions {
    21→  logPrefix: string;
    22→  log?: (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => void;
    23→}
    24→
    25→function shortTimelineId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    26→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.
    31→ * Keeps queue observability structure consistent across timeline hooks.
    32→ */
    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    39→      operation: meta.operation,
    40→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    41→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    42→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    43→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    44→    };
    45→
    46→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    47→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→// --- Timeline write timeout ---
    55→
    56→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    57→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    58→
    59→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    60→  timeoutMs?: number;
    61→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    62→  upstreamSignal?: AbortSignal;
    63→}
    64→
    65→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    66→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    67→
    68→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    69→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    70→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    71→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    72→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→}
    76→
    77→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    78→  return (
    79→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    80→    || (
    81→      typeof error === 'object'
    82→      && error !== null
    83→      && 'code' in error
    84→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    85→    )
    86→  );
    87→}
    88→
    89→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    90→  operation: string,
    91→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    92→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    93→): Promise<T> {
    94→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    95→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    96→  const controller = new AbortController();
    97→  let timedOut = false;
    98→  let abortedByUpstream = false;
    99→
   100→  const upstreamSignal = options?.upstreamSignal;
   101→  const handleUpstreamAbort = () => {
   102→    abortedByUpstream = true;
   103→    controller.abort();
   104→  };
   105→  if (upstreamSignal) {
   106→    if (upstreamSignal.aborted) {
   107→      handleUpstreamAbort();
   108→    } else {
   109→      upstreamSignal.addEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort, { once: true });
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   114→    timedOut = true;
   115→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   116→      operation,
   117→      timeoutMs,
   118→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   119→    });
   120→    controller.abort();
   121→  }, timeoutMs);
   122→
   123→  try {
   124→    return await task(controller.signal);
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    if (timedOut || (abortedByUpstream && controller.signal.aborted) || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   127→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   128→    }
   129→    throw error;
   130→  } finally {
   131→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   132→    if (upstreamSignal) {
   133→      upstreamSignal.removeEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort);
   134→    }
   135→  }
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Serialized timeline write queue ---
   139→
   140→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   141→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   142→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   143→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   144→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   145→
   146→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   147→  timeoutMs?: number;
   148→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   149→    shotId: string;
   150→    operation: string;
   151→    timeoutMs: number;
   152→    pendingMs: number;
   153→    requestId: number;
   154→  }) => void;
   155→}
   156→
   157→/**
   158→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   159→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   160→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   161→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   162→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   163→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   164→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   165→ */
   166→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   167→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   172→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   173→ */
   174→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   175→  shotId: string,
   176→  operation: string,
   177→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
   178→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   179→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   180→): Promise<T> {
   181→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   182→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   183→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   184→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   185→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   186→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   187→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   188→
   189→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   190→    shotId,
   191→    operation,
   192→    waitMs: 0,
   193→    durationMs: 0,
   194→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   195→    requestId,
   196→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   197→    blockedByDurationMs,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   201→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   202→    releaseTail = resolve;
   203→  });
   204→
   205→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   206→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   207→
   208→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   209→
   210→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   211→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   212→    requestId,
   213→    operation,
   214→    startedAt,
   215→  });
   216→  onEvent?.('start', {
   217→    shotId,
   218→    operation,
   219→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   220→    durationMs: 0,
   221→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   222→    requestId,
   223→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   224→    blockedByDurationMs,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   229→    return await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   230→      operation,
   231→      task,
   232→      {
   233→        timeoutMs,
   234→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs }) => {
   235→          options?.onTimeout?.({
   236→            shotId,
   237→            operation,
   238→            timeoutMs,
   239→            pendingMs,
   240→            requestId,
   241→          });
   242→        },
   243→      },
   244→    );
   245→  } finally {
   246→    releaseTail();
   247→
   248→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   249→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   250→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   251→    } else {
   252→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   256→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   257→    }
   258→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   259→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   260→    }
   261→
   262→    onEvent?.('end', {
   263→      shotId,
   264→      operation,
   265→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   266→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   267→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   268→      requestId,
   269→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   270→      blockedByDurationMs,
   271→    });
   272→  }
   273→}
   274→

1→import type { QueryClient, QueryKey } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→import { Shot, GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     3→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
     4→
     5→function getShotsProjectPrefix(projectId: string): readonly QueryKey {
     6→  return [...queryKeys.shots.all, projectId] as const;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getShotListQueries(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId: string) {
    10→  return queryClient.getQueriesData<Shot[]>({
    11→    [REDACTED](projectId),
    12→  });
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * @param onlyExisting - If true, only update caches that already exist.
    17→ *                       If false (default), will create cache entries if needed.
    18→ */
    19→export function updateAllShotsCaches(
    20→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    21→  projectId: string,
    22→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    23→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
    24→): void {
    25→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    26→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    27→    if (!onlyExisting) {
    28→      queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(
    29→        queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0),
    30→        (old) => updater(old)
    31→      );
    32→    }
    33→    return;
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key, existing]) => {
    37→    if (onlyExisting && existing === undefined) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(key, (old) => updater(old));
    41→  });
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function rollbackShotsCaches(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  projectId: string,
    47→  previous: Shot[] | undefined
    48→): void {
    49→  if (!previous) return;
    50→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    51→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    52→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), previous);
    53→    return;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key]) => {
    57→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, previous);
    58→  });
    59→}
    60→
    61→export async function cancelShotsQueries(
    62→  queryClient: QueryClient,

    67→
    68→export function findShotsCache(
    69→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    70→  projectId: string
    71→): Shot[] | undefined {

    75→      return data;
    76→    }
    77→  }
    78→  for (const [, data] of cachedQueries) {
    79→    if (data !== undefined) {
    80→      return data;
    81→    }
    82→  }
    83→  return undefined;
    84→}

1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).
     6→ *
     7→ * Note: Lineage is tracked at the variant level via params.source_variant_id,
     8→ * not at the generation level via based_on.
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    14→import { generationQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/generations';
    15→import {
    16→  resolveVariantProjectScope,
    17→  type VariantProjectScopeStatus,
    18→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    19→
    20→interface LineageItem {
    21→  id: string;
    22→  imageUrl: string;
    23→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    24→  createdAt: string;
    25→  type: 'variant';
    26→  variantType: string | null;
    27→}
    28→
    29→interface LineageChainResult {
    30→  chain: LineageItem[];
    31→  isLoading: boolean;
    32→  hasLineage: boolean;
    33→  error: LineageScopeError | null;
    34→}
    35→
    36→interface VariantRecord {
    37→  id: string;
    38→  generation_id: string;
    39→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    40→  location: string;
    41→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    42→  created_at: string;
    43→  variant_type: string | null;
    44→}
    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

   176→ * Get authenticated user ID without acquiring navigator.locks.

   178→ * Resolution order (all synchronous / lock-free):

   231→type AbortableQuery<T> = {
   232→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;
   233→};
   234→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
   235→  if (!signal) {
   236→    return query;
   237→  }
   238→  const abortable = query as AbortableQuery<T>;
   239→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   240→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   241→  }
   242→  return query;
   243→}
   244→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
   245→  if (!signal) {
   246→    return promise;
   247→  }
   248→  throwIfAborted(signal);

   250→    const onAbort = () => {

   256→    const cleanup = () => {

   258→    };

   260→    promise.then(
   261→      (value) => {
   262→        cleanup();
   263→        resolve(value);
   264→      },
   265→      (error) => {
   266→        cleanup();
   267→        reject(error);
   268→      },
   269→    );
   270→  });
   271→}
   272→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   273→function fetchAllScopes(
   274→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   275→  userId: string,
   276→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   277→  signal?: AbortSignal,

   279→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(

   281→      .from('users')
   282→      .select('settings')
   283→      .eq('id', userId)
   284→      .maybeSingle(),
   285→    signal,
   286→  );
   287→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   288→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   289→        supabaseClient
   290→          .from('projects')
   291→          .select('settings')
   292→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   293→          .maybeSingle(),
   294→        signal,
   295→      )
   296→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   297→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   298→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   299→        supabaseClient
   300→          .from('shots')
   301→          .select('settings')
   302→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   303→          .maybeSingle(),

   306→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });

   313→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   314→function extractAndMergeSettings(

   325→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   326→    );
   327→  }
   328→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   329→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   330→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   331→      `Failed to load project settings: ${getErrorMessage(projectResult.error)}`,
   332→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   333→    );
   334→  }
   335→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   336→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   337→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   338→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${getErrorMessage(shotResult.error)}`,
   339→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   340→    );
   341→  }
   342→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   343→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   344→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   345→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   346→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   347→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   348→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};

   350→  const merged = deepMerge(

   352→    defaultSettings,
   353→    userSettings,
   354→    projectSettings,
   355→    shotSettings
   356→  );

   359→/**
   360→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   361→ *
   362→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   363→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.

   367→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(

   370→  signal?: AbortSignal

   373→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);

   376→        recoverable: true,
   377→      }));
   378→    }

   380→    if (!user) {
   381→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required'));
   382→    }

   384→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({
   385→      toolId,
   386→      projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null,
   387→      shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null,
   388→      userId,
   389→    });
   390→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   391→    if (existingPromise) {
   392→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   393→      return operationSuccess(value);
   394→    }
   395→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   396→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   397→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   398→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   399→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, userId, ctx, signal);
   400→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   401→      const { data: { user: latestUser } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   402→      if (!latestUser || latestUser.id !== userId) {

   404→          recoverable: true,
   405→          metadata: { expectedUserId: userId, latestUserId: latestUser?.id ?? null },

   407→      }

   409→    })();
   410→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   411→    promise.finally(() => {
   412→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   413→    }).catch(() => {});

   417→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   418→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   419→    }
   420→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   421→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   422→        recoverable: true,
   423→        cause: error,
   424→      }));
   425→    }
   426→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);

   429→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   430→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   431→    };
   432→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   433→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   434→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   435→        showToast: false,

   440→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   441→        {
   442→          recoverable: true,
   443→          cause: error,
   444→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   445→        },
   446→      ));
   447→    }
   448→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   449→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   450→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   451→        'network',
   452→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   453→        {
   454→          recoverable: true,
   455→          cause: error,
   456→          metadata: contextInfo,
   457→        },
   458→      ));
   459→    }
   460→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   461→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   462→  }
   463→}
   464→/**
   465→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   466→ *
   467→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   468→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   469→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   470→ */
   471→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   472→  toolId: string,
   473→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   474→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   475→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   476→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   477→  if (!result.ok) {
   478→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   479→  }
   480→  return result.value;
   481→}

    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {

    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });

    49→        },

    51→    }

    37→  constructor(config: Partial<RealtimeConfig> = {}) {

    47→  async connect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {

    49→      return true;
    50→    }
    51→    if (this.state.projectId && this.state.projectId !== projectId) {

    89→  onStatusChange(callback: ConnectionStatusCallback): () => void {
    90→    this.statusCallbacks.add(callback);
    91→    callback(this.getState());
    92→    return () => this.statusCallbacks.delete(callback);

    97→  onEvent(callback: RawEventCallback): () => void {

   104→  reset(): void {

   121→  private startConnect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {

   142→  private async doConnect(projectId: string, connectSequence: number): Promise<boolean> {

   177→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {

   297→  private emitEvent(
   298→    table: DatabaseTable,
   299→    eventType: DatabaseEventType,
   300→    newRecord: unknown,
   301→    oldRecord: unknown
   302→  ): void {
   303→    const event: RawDatabaseEvent = {

   307→      old: oldRecord as Partial<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
   308→      receivedAt: Date.now(),
   309→    };
   310→    this.eventCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   311→      try {
   312→        callback(event);
   313→      } catch (error) {
   314→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.eventCallback', showToast: false });
   315→      }
   316→    });

   318→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   319→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   323→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   324→    if (isExhausted) {
   325→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Max reconnect attempts reached'), {
   326→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   327→        showToast: false,
   328→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   329→      });
   330→      this.setState({
   331→        status: 'failed',
   332→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   333→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   334→        nextRetryAt: null,
   335→      });
   336→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   337→    } else {
   338→      const delay = Math.min(
   339→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   340→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   341→      );
   342→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   343→      console.warn(
   344→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   345→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   346→      );
   347→      this.setState({
   348→        status: 'reconnecting',
   349→        error: reason,
   350→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   351→        nextRetryAt,
   352→      });
   353→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   354→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   355→    }
   356→  }
   357→  private scheduleReconnect(projectId: string, delay: number, failedConnectSequence: number): void {

   367→        } catch {
   368→        }
   369→        this.channel = null;
   370→      }
   371→      await this.startConnect(projectId);
   372→    }, delay);
   373→  }

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';

    30→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    31→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    32→    return projectId;
    33→  }
    34→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    35→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    36→    return selectedProjectId;
    37→  }
    38→  return null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    43→ */
    44→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  generationIds: string[],
    47→  projectId: string | null,
    48→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    49→) {
    50→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    51→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    52→  const {
    53→    batchSize = 5,
    54→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    55→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    56→  } = options;
    57→
    58→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    59→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    60→
    61→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    62→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    63→
    64→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    65→
    66→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    67→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    68→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    69→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    70→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    71→        cacheEntry,
    72→      );
    73→
    74→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    75→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    76→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    77→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    78→          showToast: false,
    79→        });
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    83→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    84→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    85→          queryFn: async () => {
    86→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    87→              .from('tasks')
    88→              .select('*')
    89→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    90→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    91→              .single();
    92→
    93→            if (error) throw error;
    94→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    95→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    96→            }
    97→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    98→          },
    99→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   100→        }));
   101→      }
   102→    });
   103→
   104→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   105→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   109→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→}
   113→
   114→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   115→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   116→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   117→  projectId: string | null,
   118→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   119→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   120→
   121→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   122→    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
   123→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   124→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   125→    );
   126→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   127→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   128→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   129→      : null;
   130→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   131→
   132→    return {
   133→      ...generation,
   134→      taskId,
   135→      taskData,
   136→      taskMappingStatus,
   137→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   138→    };
   139→  });
   140→}

1→/** Shared storage path helpers for edge functions. */
     2→export function generateUniqueFilename(extension: string): string {
     3→  const timestamp = Date.now();
     4→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
     5→  return `${timestamp}-${randomStr}.${extension}`;
     6→}
     7→
     8→export function generateThumbnailFilename(): string {
     9→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    10→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    11→  return `thumb_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.jpg`;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function getFileExtension(
    15→  filename: string,
    16→  mimeType?: string,
    17→  defaultExt: string = 'bin'
    18→): string {
    19→  const cleanName = filename
    20→    .split('?')[0]
    21→    .split('#')[0]
    22→    .split('/')
    23→    .pop() ?? filename;
    24→  const dotIndex = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
    25→  if (dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < cleanName.length - 1) {
    26→    return cleanName.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    27→  }
    28→  
    29→  if (mimeType) {
    30→    const mimeExt = mimeType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0]?.replace('jpeg', 'jpg');
    31→    if (mimeExt) return mimeExt;
    32→  }
    33→  
    34→  return defaultExt;
    35→}

     9→const POSTGREST_NO_ROWS_CODE = 'PGRST116';
    10→
    11→function isNoRowsPostgrestError(error: unknown): boolean {
    12→  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
    13→    return false;
    14→  }
    15→  const candidate = error as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    16→  if (candidate.code === POSTGREST_NO_ROWS_CODE) {
    17→    return true;
    18→  }
    19→  return typeof candidate.message === 'string' && /0 rows/i.test(candidate.message);
    20→}
