   200→      generationId: null,
   201→      projectId: data.project_id ?? null,
   202→      status: 'missing_generation',
   203→    };
   204→  }
   205→
   206→  if (expectedProjectId && data.project_id && data.project_id !== expectedProjectId) {
   207→    return {
   208→      variantId,
   209→      generationId: data.generation_id,
   210→      projectId: data.project_id,
   211→      status: 'scope_mismatch',
   212→    };
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  const generationScope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(
   216→    data.generation_id,
   217→    expectedProjectId,
   218→    supabaseRegistry,
   219→  );
   220→
   221→  if (generationScope.status !== 'ok') {
   222→    return {
   223→      variantId,
   224→      generationId: data.generation_id,
   225→      projectId: generationScope.projectId,
   226→      status: generationScope.status,
   227→      queryError: generationScope.queryError,
   228→    };
   229→  }
   230→
   231→  return {
   232→    variantId,
   233→    generationId: data.generation_id,
   234→    projectId: generationScope.projectId,
   235→    status: 'ok',
   236→  };
   237→}
   238→
   239→export async function getPrimaryTaskIdForGeneration(
   240→  generationId: string,
   241→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   242→): Promise<GenerationTaskMapping> {
   243→  const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations([generationId], options);
   244→  return mappings.get(generationId) ?? {
   245→    generationId,
   246→    taskId: null,
   247→    status: 'missing_generation',
   248→  };
   249→}
   250→
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}
   329→
   330→export function toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(
   331→  mapping: GenerationTaskMapping | undefined,
   332→): GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry {
   333→  return {
   334→    taskId: mapping?.taskId ?? null,
   335→    status: mapping?.status ?? 'not_loaded',
   336→    ...(mapping?.queryError ? { queryError: mapping.queryError } : {}),
   337→  };
   338→}
   339→

   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;
   266→}

1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→/**
     3→ * System Logger for Edge Functions
     4→ *
     5→ * Logs to both console (for immediate visibility) AND system_logs table (for persistence/querying).
     6→ * Uses a buffer pattern to batch database writes for efficiency.
     7→ *
     8→ * Usage:
     9→ *   const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'my-function-name');
    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    59→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
    60→    
    61→    this.logBuffer.push({
    62→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    63→      source_type: 'edge_function',
    64→      source_id: this.functionName,
    65→      log_level: level,
    66→      message,
    67→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
    68→      metadata
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    73→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    74→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    78→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    79→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    83→    console.warn(`${this.logPrefix} ⚠️ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    84→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    88→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} ❌ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    89→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    93→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} 🔥 CRITICAL: ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    94→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  /**
    98→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
    99→   * Call this before returning your response!
   100→   */
   101→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   102→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   103→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    try {
   107→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   108→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   109→
   110→      if (error) {
   111→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   112→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   113→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   117→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   118→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   119→      
   120→      console.log(`${this.logPrefix} Flushed ${bufferSize} logs to database`);
   121→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   122→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   123→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   124→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   125→    }
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  /**
   129→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   130→   */
   131→  getBufferSize(): number {
   132→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   133→  }
   134→}
   135→

     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  events?: EventType[];
     7→  enabled?: boolean;
     8→  delay?: number;
     9→  capture?: boolean;
    10→}
    11→
    12→/** Listen for outside clicks and invoke `callback` when they occur. Example: `const ref = useClickOutside(() => setOpen(false));` */
    13→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    14→  callback: () => void,
    15→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    16→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    17→): RefObject<T> {
    18→  const {
    19→    events = ['mousedown'],
    20→    enabled = true,
    21→    delay = 0,
    22→    capture = false,
    23→  } = options;
    24→
    25→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    26→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    27→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    31→  }, [callback]);
    32→
    33→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    34→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    35→      callbackRef.current();
    36→    }
    37→  }, [ref]);
    38→
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (!enabled) return;
    41→
    42→    const subscribe = () => {
    43→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    44→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    45→      });
    46→    };
    47→
    48→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    49→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    50→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    51→      });
    52→    };
    53→
    54→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    55→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    56→
    57→    return () => {
    58→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    59→      unsubscribe();
    60→    };
    61→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    62→
    63→  return ref;
    64→}
    65→

   165→        const _temperature = Number(body.temperature ?? 0.7);
   166→
   167→        if (!prompt.trim()) {
   168→          return jsonResponse({ error: "prompt is required" }, 400);
   169→        }
   170→
   171→        const openaiApiKey = getOpenAIApiKey();
   172→
   173→        const systemMsg = ENHANCE_SEGMENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT;
   174→        const userMsg = buildEnhanceSegmentUserPrompt(prompt);
   175→
   176→        try {
   177→          const response = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", {
   178→            method: "POST",
   179→            headers: {
   180→              "Authorization": `Bearer ${openaiApiKey}`,
   181→              "Content-Type": "application/json",
   182→            },
   183→            body: JSON.stringify({
   184→              model: "gpt-5-mini",
   185→              messages: [
   186→                { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   187→                { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   188→              ],
   189→              max_completion_tokens: 16000,
   190→            }),
   191→          });
   192→
   193→          if (!response.ok) {
   194→            const errorText = await response.text();
   195→            console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI API error:`, response.status, errorText);
   196→            return jsonResponse({ error: "OpenAI API error", details: errorText }, response.status);
   197→          }
   198→
   199→          const data = await response.json();
   200→
   201→          const enhancedPrompt = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || prompt;
   202→
   203→          return jsonResponse({
   204→            enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   205→            usage: data.usage,
   206→          });
   207→        } catch (fetchError: unknown) {
   208→          const message = toErrorMessage(fetchError);
   209→          console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI fetch error:`, message);
   210→          return jsonResponse({ error: "Failed to call OpenAI API", details: message }, 500);
   211→        }
   212→      }
   213→      default:
   214→        return jsonResponse({ error: `Unknown task: ${task}` }, 400);
   215→    }
   216→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   217→    const message = toErrorMessage(err);
   218→    console.error(`[ai-prompt] Error handling task ${task}:`, message);
   219→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: message }, 500);
   220→  }
   221→});

    10→export function useOperationTracking(): UseOperationTrackingResult {

    12→  const [isDraggingInTimeline, setIsDraggingInTimeline] = useState(false);

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter, extractOrchestratorRefFromParams } from './orchestratorReference.ts';
    13→import { readEdgeErrorCode } from './edgeRequest.ts';
    14→import {
    15→  operationFailure,
    16→  operationSuccess,

    19→
    20→interface TaskQueryResponse {
    21→  data: unknown[] | null;
    22→  error: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface TaskQueryBuilder extends PromiseLike<TaskQueryResponse> {
    26→  eq(column: string, value: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    27→  or(filter: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskQueryClient {
    31→  from(table: string): {
    32→    select(columns: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→// ===== Constants =====
    37→
    38→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    39→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    40→
    41→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    45→ *
    46→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    47→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    48→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    49→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    50→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    51→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    52→ *
    53→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    54→ */
    55→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: unknown): string | null {
    56→  const contractOrReferencePath = extractOrchestratorRefFromParams(params);
    57→  if (contractOrReferencePath) {
    58→    return contractOrReferencePath;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    62→
    63→  const p = params as Record<string, unknown>;
    64→  const details = p.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    65→  const originalParams = p.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    66→  const originalDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    67→
    68→  return (
    69→    (p.orchestrator_task_id_ref as string) ||
    70→    (details?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    71→    (originalDetails?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    72→    (p.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    73→    null
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    79→ *
    80→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    81→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    82→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    83→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    84→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    85→ *
    86→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    87→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    88→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    89→ */
    90→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: unknown, taskId: string): string | null {
    91→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    92→  if (!ref) return null;
    93→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    94→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    95→  return ref;
    96→}
    97→
    98→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
   102→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
   103→ *
   104→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
   105→ *
   106→ * Usage:
   107→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
   108→ */
   109→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   110→  return [
   111→    buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   112→    buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   113→  ].join(',');
   114→}
   115→
   116→export function buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   117→  return buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter(orchestratorTaskId);
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   121→  return [
   122→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   123→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   124→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   125→  ].join(',');
   126→}
   127→
   128→export interface CompletedSubTaskRow {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_started_at: string | null;
   131→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
   132→  status: string;
   133→}
   134→
   135→export type SubTaskLookupStage = 'canonical' | 'legacy';
   136→
   137→export class SubTaskLookupError extends Error {
   138→  readonly code = 'subtask_lookup_failed';
   139→  readonly stage: SubTaskLookupStage;
   140→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   141→
   142→  constructor(stage: SubTaskLookupStage, cause: unknown) {
   143→    super(`[Billing] Failed to query ${stage} sub-task references`);
   144→    this.name = 'SubTaskLookupError';
   145→    this.stage = stage;
   146→    this.cause = cause;
   147→  }
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function lookupCompletedSubTasksForOrchestrator(
   151→  supabaseAdmin: TaskQueryClient,
   152→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   153→): Promise<CompletedSubTaskRow[]> {
   154→  const canonicalResult = await supabaseAdmin
   155→    .from('tasks')
   156→    .select(`
   157→      id,
   158→      generation_started_at,
   159→      generation_processed_at,
   160→      status
   161→    `)
   162→    .or(buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   163→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   164→
   165→  if (canonicalResult.error) {
   166→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('canonical', canonicalResult.error);
   167→  }
   168→
   169→  const canonicalTasks = (canonicalResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   170→  if (canonicalTasks.length > 0) {
   171→    return canonicalTasks;
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const legacyResult = await supabaseAdmin
   175→    .from('tasks')
   176→    .select(`
   177→      id,
   178→      generation_started_at,
   179→      generation_processed_at,
   180→      status
   181→    `)
   182→    .or(buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   183→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   184→
   185→  if (legacyResult.error) {
   186→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('legacy', legacyResult.error);
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  const legacyTasks = (legacyResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   190→  if (legacyTasks.length > 0) {
   191→    return legacyTasks;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  return [];
   195→}
   196→
   197→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
   201→ *
   202→ * Returns an explicit outcome so callers can branch on billing success/failure.
   203→ *
   204→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
   205→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
   206→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
   207→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
   208→ */
   209→export interface CostCalculationTriggerValue {
   210→  status: number | null;
   211→  skipped?: boolean;
   212→  cost?: number;
   213→}
   214→
   215→export type CostCalculationTriggerResult = OperationResult<CostCalculationTriggerValue>;
   216→
   217→function isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   218→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
   219→}
   220→
   221→function parseJsonRecord(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   222→  if (!text.trim()) {
   223→    return null;
   224→  }
   225→  try {
   226→    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
   227→    return isObjectRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;
   228→  } catch {
   229→    return null;
   230→  }
   231→}
   232→
   233→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
   234→  params: {
   235→    supabaseUrl: string;
   236→    serviceKey: string;
   237→    taskId: string;
   238→    logTag?: string;
   239→  },
   240→): Promise<CostCalculationTriggerResult> {
   241→  const {
   242→    supabaseUrl,
   243→    serviceKey,
   244→    taskId,
   245→    logTag = 'CostCalc',
   246→  } = params;
   247→  try {
   248→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   249→      method: "POST",
   250→      headers: {
   251→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   252→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   253→      },
   254→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   255→    });
   256→
   257→    if (costResp.ok) {
   258→      const bodyText = await costResp.text();
   259→      const costData = parseJsonRecord(bodyText);
   260→      if (!costData) {
   261→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`), {
   262→          policy: 'degrade',
   263→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   264→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`,
   265→          recoverable: true,
   266→          cause: { status: costResp.status },
   267→        });
   268→      }
   269→
   270→      const costErrorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(costData);
   271→      if (costErrorCode) {
   272→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`), {
   273→          policy: 'degrade',
   274→          errorCode: costErrorCode,
   275→          message: typeof costData.message === 'string'
   276→            ? costData.message
   277→            : `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`,
   278→          recoverable: true,
   279→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   280→        });
   281→      }
   282→
   283→      const skipped = costData.skipped === true;
   284→      const successFlag = costData.success;
   285→      if (!skipped && successFlag !== true) {
   286→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`), {
   287→          policy: 'degrade',
   288→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   289→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`,
   290→          recoverable: true,
   291→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   292→        });
   293→      }
   294→
   295→      const costValue = costData.cost;
   296→      if (!skipped && (typeof costValue !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(costValue))) {
   297→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`), {
   298→          policy: 'degrade',
   299→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   300→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`,
   301→          recoverable: true,
   302→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   303→        });
   304→      }
   305→
   306→      return operationSuccess(
   307→        {
   308→          status: costResp.status,
   309→          skipped,
   310→          cost: typeof costValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(costValue)
   311→            ? costValue
   312→            : undefined,
   313→        },
   314→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
   315→      );
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   319→    const errPayload = parseJsonRecord(errTxt);
   320→    const errorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(errPayload) ?? 'cost_calculation_failed';
   321→    const message = typeof errPayload?.message === 'string'
   322→      ? errPayload.message
   323→      : (errTxt || 'Cost calculation failed');
   324→    return operationFailure(new Error(message), {
   325→      policy: 'degrade',
   326→      errorCode,
   327→      message,
   328→      recoverable: costResp.status >= 500,
   329→      cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: errPayload ?? errTxt },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (costErr) {
   332→    const message = costErr instanceof Error ? costErr.message : String(costErr);
   333→    return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] ${message}`), {
   334→      policy: 'degrade',
   335→      errorCode: 'cost_calculation_request_error',
   336→      message: `[${logTag}] ${message}`,
   337→      recoverable: true,
   338→      cause: costErr,
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→}
   342→

1→import { type OperationResult, type OperationFailure, operationFailure, operationSuccess } from './edgeOperation.ts';
     2→import { createClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
     3→import { SystemLogger } from './systemLogger.ts';
     4→
     5→declare const Deno: { env: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined } };
     6→
     7→// --- Edge runtime initialization ---
     8→
     9→export interface EdgeRuntime {

    17→
    18→export function initEdgeRuntime(
    19→  functionName: string,
    20→  missingEnvLogPrefix: string,
    21→  options?: InitEdgeRuntimeOptions,
    22→): OperationResult<EdgeRuntime> {
    23→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
    24→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL');
    25→
    26→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
    27→    return operationFailure(new Error('Server configuration error'), {
    28→      policy: 'fail_closed',
    29→      errorCode: 'server_configuration_error',
    30→      message: 'Server configuration error',
    31→      recoverable: false,
    32→      cause: { missingEnvLogPrefix },
    33→    });
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  const supabaseAdmin = options?.clientOptions
    37→    ? createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, options.clientOptions)
    38→    : createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    39→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, functionName);
    40→
    41→  return operationSuccess({ supabaseAdmin, logger }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    42→}
    43→
    44→export async function ensureRequestMethod(
    45→  req: Request,
    46→  method: string,
    47→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    48→): Promise<OperationResult<void>> {
    49→  if (req.method === method) {
    50→    return operationSuccess(undefined, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  logger?.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
    54→  if (logger) {
    55→    await logger.flush();
    56→  }
    57→  return operationFailure(new Error('Method not allowed'), {
    58→    policy: 'fail_closed',
    59→    errorCode: 'method_not_allowed',
    60→    message: 'Method not allowed',
    61→    recoverable: false,
    62→    cause: { method: req.method, allow: method },
    63→  });
    64→}
    65→
    66→// --- JSON body parsing ---
    67→
    68→function isJsonObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    69→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
    70→}
    71→
    72→function coerceLooseObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    73→  return isJsonObject(value) ? value : {};
    74→}
    75→
    76→export interface ParseJsonBodyOptions {
    77→  mode?: 'strict' | 'loose';
    78→  message?: string;
    79→  nonObjectMessage?: string;
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function parseJsonBody(
    83→  req: Request,
    84→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    85→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
    86→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    87→  const mode = options?.mode ?? 'strict';
    88→  const message = options?.message ?? 'Invalid JSON body';
    89→  const nonObjectMessage = options?.nonObjectMessage ?? 'JSON body must be an object';
    90→
    91→  try {
    92→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    93→    if (!bodyText) {
    94→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const parsed = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    98→    if (isJsonObject(parsed)) {
    99→      return operationSuccess(parsed, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   103→      logger?.debug('Non-object JSON body provided, using empty object defaults');
   104→      return operationSuccess(coerceLooseObject(parsed), { policy: 'fail_open' });
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    logger?.error(nonObjectMessage);
   108→    if (logger) {
   109→      await logger.flush();
   110→    }
   111→    return operationFailure(new Error(nonObjectMessage), {
   112→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   113→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body_shape',
   114→      message: nonObjectMessage,
   115→      recoverable: false,
   116→      cause: parsed,
   117→    });
   118→  } catch (error) {
   119→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   120→      logger?.debug('No valid JSON body provided, using defaults');
   121→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   122→    }
   123→    logger?.error(message);
   124→    if (logger) {
   125→      await logger.flush();
   126→    }
   127→    return operationFailure(error, {
   128→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   129→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body',
   130→      message,
   131→      recoverable: false,
   132→      cause: error,
   133→    });
   134→  }
   135→}
   136→
   137→export async function parseJsonBodyStrict(
   138→  req: Request,
   139→  logger?: SystemLogger,
   140→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
   141→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
   142→  return parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   143→    mode: 'strict',
   144→    message: options?.message,
   145→    nonObjectMessage: options?.nonObjectMessage,
   146→  });
   147→}
   148→
   149→// --- Error code reading ---
   150→
   151→export function readEdgeErrorCode(payload: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
   152→  if (!payload) {
   153→    return null;
   154→  }
   155→  if (typeof payload.errorCode === 'string' && payload.errorCode.trim().length > 0) {
   156→    return payload.errorCode;
   157→  }
   158→  if (typeof payload.error === 'string' && payload.error.trim().length > 0) {
   159→    return payload.error;
   160→  }
   161→  return null;
   162→}
   163→
   164→// --- Error response helpers ---
   165→
   166→interface EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput {
   167→  errorCode: string;
   168→  message: string;
   169→  recoverable: boolean;
   170→  retryAfter?: number;
   171→}
   172→
   173→export function edgeErrorResponse(
   174→  input: EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput,
   175→  status: number,
   176→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   177→): Response {
   178→  return new Response(
   179→    JSON.stringify({
   180→      error: input.errorCode,
   181→      errorCode: input.errorCode,
   182→      message: input.message,
   183→      recoverable: input.recoverable,
   184→      ...(input.retryAfter !== undefined ? { retryAfter: input.retryAfter } : {}),
   185→    }),
   186→    {
   187→      status,
   188→      headers: {
   189→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   190→        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
   191→        ...(extraHeaders ?? {}),
   192→      },
   193→    },
   194→  );
   195→}
   196→
   197→export function operationFailureResponse(
   198→  failure: OperationFailure,
   199→  status = 500,
   200→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   201→): Response {
   202→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   203→    {
   204→      errorCode: failure.errorCode,
   205→      message: failure.message,
   206→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   207→    },
   208→    status,
   209→    extraHeaders,
   210→  );
   211→}
   212→
   213→export function parseJsonFailureResponse(
   214→  failure: OperationFailure,
   215→  status = 400,
   216→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   217→): Response {
   218→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   219→    {
   220→      errorCode: failure.errorCode,
   221→      message: failure.message,
   222→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   223→    },
   224→    status,
   225→    extraHeaders,
   226→  );
   227→}
   228→
   229→export function requestMethodFailureResponse(
   230→  failure: OperationFailure,
   231→  method: string,
   232→): Response {
   233→  return parseJsonFailureResponse(failure, 405, { Allow: method });
   234→}
   235→

    56→/**
    57→ * Check rate limit for a request

   100→      message,

   106→function parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data: unknown): RateLimitRpcPayload | null {
   107→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
   108→    return null;
   109→  }
   110→  const record = data as Record<string, unknown>;
   111→  if (typeof record.allowed !== 'boolean') {
   112→    return null;
   113→  }
   114→  if (typeof record.count !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(record.count) || record.count < 0) {
   115→    return null;
   116→  }
   117→  if (typeof record.reset_at !== 'string') {
   118→    return null;
   119→  }
   120→  const resetAt = new Date(record.reset_at);
   121→  if (Number.isNaN(resetAt.getTime())) {
   122→    return null;
   123→  }
   124→  return {
   125→    allowed: record.allowed,
   126→    count: Math.trunc(record.count),
   127→    reset_at: record.reset_at,
   128→  };
   129→}
   130→
   131→export async function checkRateLimit(
   132→  input: CheckRateLimitInput,
   133→): Promise<OperationResult<RateLimitResult>> {
   134→  const {
   135→    supabaseAdmin,
   136→    functionName,
   137→    identifier,
   138→    config,
   139→    logPrefix = "[RATE-LIMIT]",
   140→  } = input;
   141→  const now = new Date();
   142→  const key = `${functionName}:${identifier}`;
   143→  
   144→  try {
   145→    // Use upsert with atomic increment via RPC function
   146→    // This handles race conditions properly
   147→    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc('check_rate_limit', {
   148→      p_key: key,
   149→      p_window_seconds: config.windowSeconds,
   150→      p_max_requests: config.maxRequests
   151→    });
   152→    
   153→    if (error) {
   154→      const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}"`;
   155→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   156→        now,
   157→        config,
   158→        'rpc_error',
   159→        message,
   160→        error,
   161→      );
   162→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, error);
   163→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const result = parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data);
   167→    if (!result) {
   168→      const message = `${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}"`;
   169→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   170→        now,
   171→        config,
   172→        'invalid_rpc_payload',
   173→        message,
   174→        data,
   175→      );
   176→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, data);
   177→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    const resetAt = new Date(result.reset_at);
   181→    const remaining = Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - result.count);
   182→    
   183→    if (!result.allowed) {
   184→      const retryAfter = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((resetAt.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 1000));
   185→      return operationSuccess({
   186→        allowed: false,
   187→        remaining: 0,
   188→        resetAt,
   189→        retryAfter,
   190→      }, {
   191→        policy: 'fail_closed',
   192→      });
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    return operationSuccess(
   196→      {
   197→        allowed: true,
   198→        remaining,
   199→        resetAt,
   200→      },
   201→      { policy: 'best_effort' },
   202→    );
   203→  } catch (err) {
   204→    const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit runtime error for key "${key}"`;
   205→    const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   206→      now,
   207→      config,
   208→      'runtime_error',
   209→      message,
   210→      err,
   211→    );
   212→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Rate limit error for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, err);
   213→    return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   214→  }
   215→}
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Create rate limit headers for response
   219→ */
   220→function rateLimitHeaders(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Record<string, string> {
   221→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
   222→    'X-RateLimit-Limit': config.maxRequests.toString(),
   223→    'X-RateLimit-Remaining': result.remaining.toString(),
   224→    'X-RateLimit-Reset': Math.floor(result.resetAt.getTime() / 1000).toString(),
   225→  };
   226→  
   227→  if (result.retryAfter) {
   228→    headers['Retry-After'] = result.retryAfter.toString();
   229→  }
   230→  
   231→  return headers;
   232→}
   233→
   234→/**
   235→ * Create a 429 Too Many Requests response
   236→ */
   237→export function rateLimitResponse(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Response {
   238→  const retryAfterSuffix = typeof result.retryAfter === 'number' && result.retryAfter > 0
   239→    ? ` Please wait ${result.retryAfter} seconds before retrying.`
   240→    : ' Please retry shortly.';
   241→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   242→    {
   243→      errorCode: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
   244→      message: `Rate limit exceeded.${retryAfterSuffix}`,
   245→      recoverable: true,
   246→      retryAfter: result.retryAfter,
   247→    },
   248→    429,
   249→    rateLimitHeaders(result, config),
   250→  );
   251→}

   254→  const now = new Date();
   255→  return {
   256→    allowed: false,
   257→    remaining: 0,

   259→    retryAfter: config.windowSeconds,
   260→  };
   261→}

   263→function extractDeniedResultFromFailure(
   264→  failure: OperationFailure,
   265→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   266→): RateLimitResult {
   267→  const decision = (failure.cause as { decision?: unknown } | undefined)?.decision;
   268→  if (decision && typeof decision === 'object' && !Array.isArray(decision)) {
   269→    const record = decision as Partial<RateLimitResult>;
   270→    if (
   271→      record.allowed === false
   272→      && record.resetAt instanceof Date
   273→      && typeof record.remaining === 'number'
   274→    ) {
   275→      return {
   276→        allowed: false,
   277→        remaining: record.remaining,
   278→        resetAt: record.resetAt,

   281→    }

   284→}
   285→
   286→export function isRateLimitExceededFailure(result: OperationResult<RateLimitResult>): boolean {
   287→  if (result.ok) {
   288→    return result.value.allowed === false;
   289→  }
   290→  return result.errorCode === 'rate_limit_exceeded';
   291→}
   292→
   293→export function rateLimitFailureResponse(
   294→  result: OperationFailure | DeniedRateLimitResult,
   295→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   296→): Response {
   297→  if ('allowed' in result) {
   298→    return rateLimitResponse(result, config);
   299→  }
   300→  return rateLimitResponse(extractDeniedResultFromFailure(result, config), config);
   301→}
   302→
   303→interface RateLimitLogger {
   304→  warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   305→  error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   306→  flush: () => Promise<void>;
   307→}
   308→
   309→interface EnforceRateLimitInput {
   310→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseAdminClient;
   311→  functionName: string;
   312→  userId: string;
   313→  config: RateLimitConfig;
   314→  logger: RateLimitLogger;
   315→  logPrefix: string;
   316→  responses?: {
   317→    serviceUnavailable?: () => Response;
   318→  };
   319→}
   320→
   321→/**
   322→ * Full rate-limit enforcement: check → error response → fail_open logging.
   323→ * Returns a Response to short-circuit (exceeded or service error), or null to proceed.
   324→ *
   325→ * @param serviceUnavailableResponse Optional factory for 503 responses.
   326→ *   Defaults to a generic 503 edge error.
   327→ */
   328→export async function enforceRateLimit(
   329→  input: EnforceRateLimitInput,
   330→): Promise<Response | null> {
   331→  const {
   332→    supabaseAdmin,
   333→    functionName,
   334→    userId,
   335→    config,
   336→    logger,
   337→    logPrefix,
   338→    responses,
   339→  } = input;
   340→  const result = await checkRateLimit({
   341→    supabaseAdmin,
   342→    functionName,
   343→    identifier: userId,
   344→    config,
   345→    logPrefix,
   346→  });
   347→
   348→  // Rate limit exceeded — works for both ok (fail_closed) and !ok paths
   349→  if (isRateLimitExceededFailure(result)) {
   350→    logger.warn('Rate limit exceeded', { user_id: userId });
   351→    await logger.flush();
   352→    if (result.ok) {
   353→      return rateLimitResponse(result.value, config);
   354→    }
   355→    return rateLimitFailureResponse(result, config);
   356→  }
   357→
   358→  // Operation failure that's not rate-limit-exceeded
   359→  if (!result.ok) {
   360→    logger.error('Rate limit check failed', {
   361→      user_id: userId,
   362→      error_code: result.errorCode,
   363→      message: result.message,
   364→    });
   365→    await logger.flush();
   366→    return responses?.serviceUnavailable
   367→      ? responses.serviceUnavailable()
   368→      : edgeErrorResponse(
   369→          { errorCode: 'rate_limit_service_unavailable', message: 'Rate limit service unavailable', recoverable: true },
   370→          503,
   371→        );
   372→  }
   373→
   374→  // Success but degraded (fail_open) — proceed with warning
   375→  if (result.policy === 'fail_open') {
   376→    logger.warn('Rate limit check degraded; allowing request', {
   377→      user_id: userId,
   378→      reason: result.value.degraded?.reason,
   379→      message: result.value.degraded?.message,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return null;
   384→}

    86→  existingResultData: unknown,
    87→  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
    88→): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
    89→  if (issues.length === 0) {
    90→    return { ok: true };
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
    94→  const completionFollowUp = {
    95→    status: 'degraded',
    96→    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    97→    issues,
    98→  };
    99→
   100→  const { error } = await supabase
   101→    .from('tasks')
   102→    .update({
   103→      result_data: {
   104→        ...baseResultData,
   105→        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
   106→      },
   107→    })
   108→    .eq('id', taskId);
   109→
   110→  if (error) {
   111→    return { ok: false, error };
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  return { ok: true };
   115→}
   116→
   117→/**
   118→ * Fetch task context with all required fields for the completion flow.
   119→ * Uses a single query with FK join (tasks.task_type -> task_types.name).
   120→ * Returns null if task not found or on error.
   121→ */
   122→export async function fetchTaskContext(
   123→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   124→  taskId: string,
   125→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   126→): Promise<TaskContext | null> {
   127→  const { data: task, error } = await supabase
   128→    .from("tasks")
   129→    .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params, result_data, task_types!tasks_task_type_fkey(tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type)`)
   130→    .eq("id", taskId)
   131→    .single();
   132→
   133→  if (error || !task) {
   134→    logger?.error('Failed to fetch task context', {
   135→      task_id: taskId,
   136→      fetch_error: toErrorMessage(error),
   137→    });
   138→    return null;
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  const taskTypeInfo = task.task_types || {};
   142→
   143→  return {
   144→    id: task.id,
   145→    task_type: task.task_type,
   146→    project_id: task.project_id,
   147→    params: task.params || {},
   148→    result_data: task.result_data,
   149→    tool_type: taskTypeInfo.tool_type || 'unknown',
   150→    category: taskTypeInfo.category || 'unknown',
   151→    content_type: taskTypeInfo.content_type || 'image',
   152→    variant_type: taskTypeInfo.variant_type || null,
   153→  };
   154→}
   155→

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

1→export function getStoredPromptCount(effectiveShotId: string): number {
     2→  try {
     3→    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
     4→      const shotSpecificKey = `ig:lastPromptCount:${effectiveShotId}`;
     5→      const stored =
     6→        window.sessionStorage.getItem(shotSpecificKey) ||
     7→        window.sessionStorage.getItem('ig:lastPromptCount');
     8→
     9→      const parsed = stored ? Number.parseInt(stored, 10) : 1;
    10→      return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 1;
    11→    }
    12→  } catch {
    13→    // Ignore sessionStorage errors.
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  return 1;
    17→}

   118→async function updateGenerationLocation(

   274→ * Delete a generation with project-scoped verification.
   275→ */
   276→async function deleteGenerationScoped(input: ScopedGenerationInput): Promise<void> {
   277→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   278→    input.projectId,
   279→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.projectScope',
   280→  );
   281→
   282→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   283→    input.id,
   284→    projectId,
   285→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.scopeValidation',
   286→  );
   287→
   288→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   289→    id: input.id,
   290→    projectId,
   291→  });
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   295→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration',
   296→      showToast: false,
   297→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   298→    });
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   302→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   303→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.noRows',
   304→      showToast: false,
   305→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   306→    });
   307→  }
   308→}
   309→
   310→/**
   311→ * Delete a variant with project-scoped verification via its parent generation.
   312→ */
   313→async function deleteVariantScoped(input: ScopedVariantInput): Promise<void> {
   314→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   315→    input.projectId,
   316→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.projectScope',
   317→  );
   318→
   319→  const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   320→    input.id,
   321→    projectId,
   322→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.scopeValidation',
   323→  );
   324→
   325→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   326→    id: input.id,
   327→    generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   328→  });
   329→
   330→  if (error) {
   331→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   332→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant',
   333→      showToast: false,
   334→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→
   338→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   339→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   340→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.noRows',
   341→      showToast: false,
   342→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   343→    });
   344→  }
   345→}

     2→export function generateUniqueFilename(extension: string): string {
     3→  const timestamp = Date.now();
     4→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
     5→  return `${timestamp}-${randomStr}.${extension}`;
     6→}

     8→export function generateThumbnailFilename(): string {

    10→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    11→  return `thumb_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.jpg`;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function getFileExtension(
    15→  filename: string,
    16→  mimeType?: string,
    17→  defaultExt: string = 'bin'
    18→): string {
    19→  const cleanName = filename
    20→    .split('?')[0]
    21→    .split('#')[0]
    22→    .split('/')
    23→    .pop() ?? filename;
    24→  const dotIndex = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
    25→  if (dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < cleanName.length - 1) {
    26→    return cleanName.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    27→  }
    28→  
    29→  if (mimeType) {
    30→    const mimeExt = mimeType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0]?.replace('jpeg', 'jpg');
    31→    if (mimeExt) return mimeExt;
    32→  }
    33→  
    34→  return defaultExt;
    35→}

1→import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
     2→import { normalizeAndLogError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorReporting';
     3→import type { Database } from '@/integrations/supabase/databasePublicTypes';
     4→import {
     5→  getSupabasePublishableKey,
     6→  getSupabaseUrl,
     7→} from '@/integrations/supabase/config/env';
     8→import { fetchWithTimeout } from './fetchWithTimeout';
     9→import { readAccessTokenFromStorage } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseSession';
    10→
    11→const REALTIME_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000;
    12→const REALTIME_MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 10_000;
    13→
    14→export function createSupabaseClient() {
    15→  try {
    16→    // Cache the access token to avoid navigator.locks contention.
    17→    // Every supabase.rpc()/from() call normally goes through fetchWithAuth →
    18→    // _getAccessToken() → GoTrueClient.getSession() → _acquireLock(-1) →
    19→    // navigator.locks (exclusive). When the lock is held by a concurrent token
    20→    // refresh, ALL data requests queue indefinitely — blocking timeline drag RPCs
    21→    // for 8+ seconds even when the DB responds in 60ms.
    22→    //
    23→    // Fix: replace PostgrestClient.fetch (a public property, read dynamically on
    24→    // every from()/rpc() call) with a version that injects the cached token
    25→    // directly, bypassing getSession/navigator.locks entirely for data requests.
    26→    // Auth operations (supabase.auth.*) are unaffected.
    27→    let cachedToken: string | null = readAccessTokenFromStorage();
    28→
    29→    const url = getSupabaseUrl();
    30→    const [REDACTED]();
    31→
    32→    const client = createClient<Database>(url, key, {
    33→      auth: {
    34→        autoRefreshToken: true,
    35→        persistSession: true,
    36→        detectSessionInUrl: true,
    37→      },
    38→      realtime: {
    39→        params: { eventsPerSecond: 10 },
    40→        heartbeatIntervalMs: REALTIME_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS,
    41→        reconnectAfterMs: (tries: number) => Math.min(tries * 1000, REALTIME_MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS),
    42→      },
    43→      global: {
    44→        fetch: fetchWithTimeout,
    45→      },
    46→      db: { schema: 'public' },
    47→    });
    48→
    49→    // Replace PostgrestClient.fetch to use the cached token.
    50→    // PostgrestClient reads this.fetch on each from()/rpc() call, so the
    51→    // replacement takes effect immediately without recreating any clients.
    52→    const dataFetch = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    53→      const headers = new Headers(init.headers ?? {});
    54→      if (!headers.has('apikey')) headers.set('apikey', key);
    55→      if (!headers.has('Authorization')) {
    56→        headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${cachedToken ?? key}`);
    57→      }
    58→      return fetchWithTimeout(input as Parameters<typeof fetchWithTimeout>[0], { ...init, headers });
    59→    };
    60→    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    61→    (client as unknown as { rest: { fetch: typeof dataFetch } }).rest.fetch = dataFetch;
    62→
    63→    // Keep the cached token in sync with auth state changes.
    64→    client.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
    65→      cachedToken = session?.access_token ?? null;
    66→    });
    67→
    68→    return client;
    69→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    70→    normalizeAndLogError(error, { context: 'SupabaseClient' });
    71→    throw error;
    72→  }
    73→}

1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→/**
     3→ * System Logger for Edge Functions
     4→ *
     5→ * Logs to both console (for immediate visibility) AND system_logs table (for persistence/querying).
     6→ * Uses a buffer pattern to batch database writes for efficiency.
     7→ *
     8→ * Usage:
     9→ *   const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'my-function-name');
    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    59→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
    60→    
    61→    this.logBuffer.push({
    62→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    63→      source_type: 'edge_function',
    64→      source_id: this.functionName,
    65→      log_level: level,
    66→      message,
    67→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
    68→      metadata
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    73→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    74→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    78→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    79→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    83→    console.warn(`${this.logPrefix} ⚠️ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    84→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    88→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} ❌ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    89→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    93→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} 🔥 CRITICAL: ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    94→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  /**
    98→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
    99→   * Call this before returning your response!
   100→   */
   101→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   102→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   103→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    try {
   107→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   108→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   109→
   110→      if (error) {
   111→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   112→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   113→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   117→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   118→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   119→      
   120→      console.log(`${this.logPrefix} Flushed ${bufferSize} logs to database`);
   121→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   122→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   123→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   124→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   125→    }
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  /**
   129→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   130→   */
   131→  getBufferSize(): number {
   132→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   133→  }
   134→}
   135→

   131→export function useInlineEditState(

   134→): InlineEditStateResult {
   135→  // --- Environment ---

   162→  const activeVariant = variants.activeVariant;

1→import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
     2→import { abbreviateRelativeTime, formatRelativeDuration } from '@/shared/lib/timeFormatting';
     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseRelativeTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseRelativeTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    44→    date,
    45→    preset: 'task',
    46→  });
    47→}

    19→export const CreateProjectModal: React.FC<CreateProjectModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onOpenChange, initialName }) => {
    20→  const [projectName, setProjectName] = useState(initialName || '');
    21→  const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState<string>('16:9');
    22→  const { addNewProject, isCreatingProject, projects, selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    23→  const navigate = useNavigate();
    24→
    25→  // Get current project to use its aspect ratio as default
    26→  const currentProject = projects.find(p => p.id === selectedProjectId);
    27→  
    28→  // Update default aspect ratio when modal opens or current project changes
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    if (isOpen && currentProject?.aspectRatio) {
    31→      setAspectRatio(currentProject.aspectRatio);
    32→    }
    33→  }, [isOpen, currentProject?.aspectRatio]);
    34→  
    35→  // Set initial name when modal opens with one provided, or reset when closing
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (isOpen) {
    38→      // When opening, set to initialName if provided, otherwise reset
    39→      setProjectName(initialName || '');
    40→    }
    41→  }, [isOpen, initialName]);
    42→
    43→  const handleCreateProject = async () => {
    44→    let finalProjectName = projectName.trim();
    45→    // If user didn't enter a name, pick a random dummy name that's not already used
    46→    if (!finalProjectName) {
    47→      const existingNamesLower = projects.map(p => p.name.toLowerCase());
    48→
    49→      // Try up to dummy names list length times to find a unique one
    50→      const maxTries = 10;
    51→      let tries = 0;
    52→      let candidateName = '';
    53→      while (tries < maxTries) {
    54→        candidateName = getRandomDummyName();
    55→        if (!existingNamesLower.includes(candidateName.toLowerCase())) {
    56→          break;
    57→        }
    58→        tries++;
    59→      }
    60→
    61→      // As a fallback, append a random number to guarantee uniqueness
    62→      if (existingNamesLower.includes(candidateName.toLowerCase())) {
    63→        candidateName = `${candidateName} ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
    64→      }
    65→
    66→      finalProjectName = candidateName;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    if (!aspectRatio) {
    70→      toast.error("Please select an aspect ratio.");
    71→      return;
    72→    }
    73→    try {
    74→      const newProject = await addNewProject({ name: finalProjectName, aspectRatio: aspectRatio });
    75→      if (newProject) {
    76→  
    77→        setProjectName('');
    78→        setAspectRatio(currentProject?.aspectRatio || '16:9');
    79→        onOpenChange(false);
    80→        navigate('/tools');
    81→      }
    82→    } catch (error) {
    83→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'CreateProjectModal', toastTitle: 'An error occurred while creating the project' });
    84→    }
    85→  };
    86→
    87→  return (
    88→    <ModalContainer
    89→      open={isOpen}
    90→      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
    91→      size="medium"
    92→      title="Create New Project"
    93→      footer={
    94→        <ModalFooterButtons
    95→          onCancel={() => onOpenChange(false)}
    96→          onConfirm={handleCreateProject}
    97→          confirmText={isCreatingProject ? "Creating..." : "Create Project"}
    98→          isLoading={isCreatingProject}
    99→          disabled={!aspectRatio}
   100→        />
   101→      }
   102→    >
   103→      <div className="grid gap-4 py-3">
   104→        <div className="space-y-1.5">
   105→          <Label htmlFor="project-name">
   106→            Name:
   107→          </Label>
   108→          <Input
   109→            id="project-name"
   110→            value={projectName}
   111→            onChange={(e) => setProjectName(e.target.value)}
   112→            className="w-full"
   113→            disabled={isCreatingProject}
   114→            maxLength={30}
   115→            placeholder="Enter project name..."
   116→          />
   117→        </div>
   118→        <div className="space-y-1.5">
   119→          <Label htmlFor="aspect-ratio">

   133→};

    66→    identifier: auth.userId,
    67→    config: RATE_LIMITS.expensive,
    68→    logPrefix: '[AI-PROMPT]',
    69→  });
    70→  if (!rateLimitResult.ok) {
    71→    if (isRateLimitExceededFailure(rateLimitResult)) {
    72→      return rateLimitFailureResponse(rateLimitResult, RATE_LIMITS.expensive);
    73→    }
    74→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Rate limit service unavailable' }, 503);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const task = body.task as string | undefined;
    78→  if (!task) return jsonResponse({ error: "task is required" }, 400);
    79→
    80→  try {
    81→    switch (task) {
    82→      case "generate_prompts": {
    83→        const groq = getGroqClient();
    84→        const overallPromptText = String(body.overallPromptText ?? "");
    85→        const rulesToRememberText = String(body.rulesToRememberText ?? "");
    86→        const numberToGenerate = Number(body.numberToGenerate ?? 3);
    87→        const existingPrompts = Array.isArray(body.existingPrompts) ? body.existingPrompts as unknown[] : [];
    88→        const temperature = Number(body.temperature ?? 0.8);
    89→
    90→        const { systemMsg, userMsg } = buildGeneratePromptsMessages({
    91→          overallPromptText,
    92→          rulesToRememberText,
    93→          numberToGenerate,
    94→          existingPrompts,
    95→        });
    96→
    97→        const resp = await groq.chat.completions.create({
    98→          model: "moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct",
    99→          messages: [
   100→            { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   101→            { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   102→          ],
   103→          temperature: temperature,
   104→          max_tokens: 4096,
   105→          top_p: 1,
   106→        });
   107→        const outputText = resp.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || "";
   108→        const prompts = outputText.split("\n").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
   109→        
   110→        // Validate we got the expected number of prompts
   111→        if (prompts.length !== numberToGenerate) {
   112→          // If we got too many, take the first N
   113→          if (prompts.length > numberToGenerate) {
   114→            prompts.splice(numberToGenerate);
   115→          }
   116→          // If we got too few, we'll just return what we have rather than failing
   117→        }
   118→        
   119→        return jsonResponse({ prompts, usage: resp.usage });
   120→      }
   121→      case "edit_prompt": {
   122→        const groq = getGroqClient();
   123→        const originalPromptText = String(body.originalPromptText ?? "");
   124→        const editInstructions = String(body.editInstructions ?? "");
   125→        if (!originalPromptText || !editInstructions) return jsonResponse({ error: "originalPromptText and editInstructions required" }, 400);
   126→        const { systemMsg, userMsg } = buildEditPromptMessages({
   127→          originalPromptText,
   128→          editInstructions,
   129→        });
   130→        const resp = await groq.chat.completions.create({
   131→          model: "moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct",
   132→          messages: [
   133→            { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   134→            { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   135→          ],
   136→          temperature: 0.7,
   137→          max_tokens: 2048,
   138→          top_p: 1,
   139→        });
   140→        const newText = resp.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || originalPromptText;
   141→        return jsonResponse({ success: true, newText, usage: resp.usage });
   142→      }
   143→      case "generate_summary": {
   144→        const groq = getGroqClient();
   145→        const promptText = String(body.promptText ?? "");
   146→        if (!promptText) return jsonResponse({ error: "promptText required" }, 400);
   147→        const resp = await groq.chat.completions.create({
   148→          model: "moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct",
   149→          messages: [{ role: "user", content: `Create a brief summary of this image prompt in 10 words or less. Output only the summary text with no additional formatting or quotation marks:
   150→
   151→"${promptText}"
   152→
   153→Summary:` }],
   154→          temperature: 1.0,
   155→          max_tokens: 50,
   156→          top_p: 1,
   157→        });
   158→        const summary = resp.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || null;
   159→        return jsonResponse({ summary, usage: resp.usage });
   160→      }
   161→      case "enhance_segment_prompt": {
   162→        // Enhance a single segment prompt using OpenAI GPT-5 Mini
   163→        // Uses motion-focused prompt template for video transitions
   164→        const prompt = String(body.prompt ?? "");
   165→        const _temperature = Number(body.temperature ?? 0.7);
   166→
   167→        if (!prompt.trim()) {
   168→          return jsonResponse({ error: "prompt is required" }, 400);
   169→        }
   170→
   171→        const openaiApiKey = getOpenAIApiKey();
   172→
   173→        const systemMsg = ENHANCE_SEGMENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT;
   174→        const userMsg = buildEnhanceSegmentUserPrompt(prompt);
   175→
   176→        try {
   177→          const response = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", {
   178→            method: "POST",
   179→            headers: {
   180→              "Authorization": `Bearer ${openaiApiKey}`,
   181→              "Content-Type": "application/json",
   182→            },
   183→            body: JSON.stringify({
   184→              model: "gpt-5-mini",
   185→              messages: [
   186→                { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   187→                { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   188→              ],
   189→              max_completion_tokens: 16000,
   190→            }),
   191→          });
   192→
   193→          if (!response.ok) {
   194→            const errorText = await response.text();
   195→            console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI API error:`, response.status, errorText);
   196→            return jsonResponse({ error: "OpenAI API error", details: errorText }, response.status);
   197→          }
   198→
   199→          const data = await response.json();
   200→
   201→          const enhancedPrompt = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || prompt;
   202→
   203→          return jsonResponse({
   204→            enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   205→            usage: data.usage,
   206→          });
   207→        } catch (fetchError: unknown) {
   208→          const message = toErrorMessage(fetchError);
   209→          console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI fetch error:`, message);
   210→          return jsonResponse({ error: "Failed to call OpenAI API", details: message }, 500);
   211→        }
   212→      }
   213→      default:
   214→        return jsonResponse({ error: `Unknown task: ${task}` }, 400);
   215→    }
   216→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   217→    const message = toErrorMessage(err);
   218→    console.error(`[ai-prompt] Error handling task ${task}:`, message);
   219→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: message }, 500);
   220→  }
   221→});
