1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→import { asRecord, asString, firstString } from '@/shared/lib/jsonNarrowing';
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}

   168→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;

   171→/**
   172→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)

   174→export interface RawShotGeneration {

   182→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;

   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Options for transformation customization
   187→ */
   188→interface TransformOptions {

   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;

   198→  verbose?: boolean;

   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→}
    16→
    17→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    18→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    19→  return getSupabaseClient()
    20→    .from(tableName)
    21→    .select('settings')
    22→    .eq('id', id)
    23→    .single();
    24→}
    25→
    26→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    27→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    28→  id: string,
    29→  toolId: string,
    30→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    31→) {
    32→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    33→    p_table_name: tableName,
    34→    p_id: id,
    35→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    36→    p_settings: settings,
    37→  });
    38→}

1→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     2→
     3→// --- Timeline write logging ---
     4→
     5→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';
     6→
     7→interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {
     8→  shotId: string;
     9→  operation: string;
    10→  waitMs: number;
    11→  durationMs: number;
    12→  queueDepth: number;
    13→  requestId: number;
    14→  blockedByOperation?: string | null;
    15→  blockedByDurationMs?: number | null;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export type TimelineWriteEventHandler = (phase: TimelineWritePhase, meta: TimelineWriteEventMeta) => void;
    19→
    20→interface TimelineWriteLoggerOptions {
    21→  logPrefix: string;
    22→  log?: (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => void;
    23→}
    24→
    25→function shortTimelineId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    26→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.
    31→ * Keeps queue observability structure consistent across timeline hooks.
    32→ */
    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    39→      operation: meta.operation,
    40→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    41→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    42→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    43→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    44→    };
    45→
    46→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    47→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→// --- Timeline write timeout ---
    55→
    56→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    57→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    58→
    59→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    60→  timeoutMs?: number;
    61→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    62→  upstreamSignal?: AbortSignal;
    63→}
    64→
    65→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    66→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    67→
    68→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    69→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    70→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    71→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    72→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→}
    76→
    77→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    78→  return (
    79→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    80→    || (
    81→      typeof error === 'object'
    82→      && error !== null
    83→      && 'code' in error
    84→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    85→    )
    86→  );
    87→}
    88→
    89→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    90→  operation: string,
    91→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    92→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    93→): Promise<T> {
    94→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    95→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    96→  const controller = new AbortController();
    97→  let timedOut = false;
    98→  let abortedByUpstream = false;
    99→
   100→  const upstreamSignal = options?.upstreamSignal;
   101→  const handleUpstreamAbort = () => {
   102→    abortedByUpstream = true;
   103→    controller.abort();
   104→  };
   105→  if (upstreamSignal) {
   106→    if (upstreamSignal.aborted) {
   107→      handleUpstreamAbort();
   108→    } else {
   109→      upstreamSignal.addEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort, { once: true });
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   114→    timedOut = true;
   115→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   116→      operation,
   117→      timeoutMs,
   118→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   119→    });
   120→    controller.abort();
   121→  }, timeoutMs);
   122→
   123→  try {
   124→    return await task(controller.signal);
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    if (timedOut || (abortedByUpstream && controller.signal.aborted) || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   127→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   128→    }
   129→    throw error;
   130→  } finally {
   131→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   132→    if (upstreamSignal) {
   133→      upstreamSignal.removeEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort);
   134→    }
   135→  }
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Serialized timeline write queue ---
   139→
   140→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   141→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   142→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   143→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   144→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   145→
   146→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   147→  timeoutMs?: number;
   148→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   149→    shotId: string;
   150→    operation: string;
   151→    timeoutMs: number;
   152→    pendingMs: number;
   153→    requestId: number;
   154→  }) => void;
   155→}
   156→
   157→/**
   158→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   159→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   160→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   161→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   162→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   163→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   164→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   165→ */
   166→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   167→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   172→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   173→ */
   174→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   175→  shotId: string,
   176→  operation: string,
   177→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
   178→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   179→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   180→): Promise<T> {
   181→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   182→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   183→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   184→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   185→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   186→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   187→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   188→
   189→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   190→    shotId,
   191→    operation,
   192→    waitMs: 0,
   193→    durationMs: 0,
   194→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   195→    requestId,
   196→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   197→    blockedByDurationMs,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   201→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   202→    releaseTail = resolve;
   203→  });
   204→
   205→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   206→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   207→
   208→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   209→
   210→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   211→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   212→    requestId,
   213→    operation,
   214→    startedAt,
   215→  });
   216→  onEvent?.('start', {
   217→    shotId,
   218→    operation,
   219→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   220→    durationMs: 0,
   221→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   222→    requestId,
   223→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   224→    blockedByDurationMs,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   229→    return await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   230→      operation,
   231→      task,
   232→      {
   233→        timeoutMs,
   234→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs }) => {
   235→          options?.onTimeout?.({
   236→            shotId,
   237→            operation,
   238→            timeoutMs,
   239→            pendingMs,
   240→            requestId,
   241→          });
   242→        },
   243→      },
   244→    );
   245→  } finally {
   246→    releaseTail();
   247→
   248→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   249→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   250→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   251→    } else {
   252→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   256→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   257→    }
   258→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   259→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   260→    }
   261→
   262→    onEvent?.('end', {
   263→      shotId,
   264→      operation,
   265→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   266→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   267→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   268→      requestId,
   269→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   270→      blockedByDurationMs,
   271→    });
   272→  }
   273→}
   274→

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

   231→type AbortableQuery<T> = {

   266→        cleanup();

   268→      },

   270→  });

   272→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */

   274→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,

   289→        supabaseClient
   290→          .from('projects')
   291→          .select('settings')
   292→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   293→          .maybeSingle(),
   294→        signal,

   296→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });

   343→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;

   346→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};

   353→    userSettings,

   355→    shotSettings

   359→/**
   360→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.

   362→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.

   365→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper

   367→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   368→  toolId: string,

   380→    if (!user) {

   384→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({
   385→      toolId,
   386→      projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null,
   387→      shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null,
   388→      userId,

   391→    if (existingPromise) {
   392→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   393→      return operationSuccess(value);

   395→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   396→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   397→      throwIfAborted(signal);

   399→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, userId, ctx, signal);
   400→      throwIfAborted(signal);

   412→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   413→    }).catch(() => {});

   443→          cause: error,
   444→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   445→        },
   446→      ));
   447→    }
   448→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   449→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   450→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   451→        'network',
   452→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   453→        {
   454→          recoverable: true,
   455→          cause: error,
   456→          metadata: contextInfo,
   457→        },
   458→      ));
   459→    }
   460→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   461→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   462→  }

   464→/**
   465→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   466→ *
   467→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   468→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   469→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   470→ */
   471→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   472→  toolId: string,
   473→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,

     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}

    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

     9→function isRetryableNetworkError(err: unknown): boolean {

    11→  const status = (err instanceof Object && 'status' in err) ? (err as { status: unknown }).status : undefined;

    19→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
    20→    message.includes('not found') ||
    21→    message.includes('quota') ||
    22→    status === 401 ||
    23→    status === 403 ||
    24→    status === 404;
    25→
    26→  return isNetworkError && !isServerError;

   297→  private emitEvent(

   315→      }

   318→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   319→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   323→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   324→    if (isExhausted) {
   325→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Max reconnect attempts reached'), {
   326→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   327→        showToast: false,
   328→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   329→      });
   330→      this.setState({
   331→        status: 'failed',
   332→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   333→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   334→        nextRetryAt: null,
   335→      });
   336→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   337→    } else {
   338→      const delay = Math.min(
   339→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   340→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   341→      );
   342→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   343→      console.warn(
   344→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   345→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   346→      );
   347→      this.setState({
   348→        status: 'reconnecting',
   349→        error: reason,
   350→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   351→        nextRetryAt,
   352→      });
   353→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   354→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   355→    }

   357→  private scheduleReconnect(projectId: string, delay: number, failedConnectSequence: number): void {

   367→        } catch {
   368→        }
   369→        this.channel = null;
   370→      }
   371→      await this.startConnect(projectId);
   372→    }, delay);
   373→  }

1→export function getStoredPromptCount(effectiveShotId: string): number {
     2→  try {
     3→    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
     4→      const shotSpecificKey = `ig:lastPromptCount:${effectiveShotId}`;
     5→      const stored =
     6→        window.sessionStorage.getItem(shotSpecificKey) ||
     7→        window.sessionStorage.getItem('ig:lastPromptCount');
     8→
     9→      const parsed = stored ? Number.parseInt(stored, 10) : 1;
    10→      return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 1;
    11→    }
    12→  } catch {
    13→    // Ignore sessionStorage errors.
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  return 1;
    17→}
    18→

    56→function ensureProjectScope(projectId: string | undefined, context: string): string {

    67→async function verifyGenerationScope(generationId: string, projectId: string, context: string): Promise<void> {
    68→  const scope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(generationId, projectId);

    71→  }

    83→      },

   114→/**
   115→ * Update generation location using direct Supabase call.
   116→ * @internal Used by useUpdateGenerationLocation hook.

   118→async function updateGenerationLocation(
   119→  params: ScopedGenerationInput & { location: string; thumbUrl?: string },
   120→): Promise<void> {
   121→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   122→    params.projectId,
   123→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.projectScope',
   124→  );
   125→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   126→    params.id,
   127→    projectId,
   128→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.scopeValidation',
   129→  );
   130→
   131→  const updateData: { location: string; thumbnail_url?: string } = { location: params.location };
   132→
   133→  // If thumbUrl is provided, update it as well (important for flipped images)
   134→  if (params.thumbUrl) {
   135→    updateData.thumbnail_url = params.thumbUrl;
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationLocationByScope({
   139→    id: params.id,
   140→    projectId,
   141→    location: updateData.location,
   142→    thumbnailUrl: updateData.thumbnail_url,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  if (error) {
   146→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   147→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation',
   148→      showToast: false,
   149→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   150→    });
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   154→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope'), {
   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}

   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}

   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Delete a generation with project-scoped verification.
   275→ */
   276→async function deleteGenerationScoped(input: ScopedGenerationInput): Promise<void> {
   277→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   278→    input.projectId,
   279→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.projectScope',
   280→  );
   281→
   282→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   283→    input.id,
   284→    projectId,
   285→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.scopeValidation',
   286→  );
   287→
   288→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   289→    id: input.id,
   290→    projectId,
   291→  });
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   295→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration',
   296→      showToast: false,
   297→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   298→    });
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   302→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   303→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.noRows',
   304→      showToast: false,
   305→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   306→    });
   307→  }
   308→}
   309→
   310→/**
   311→ * Delete a variant with project-scoped verification via its parent generation.

   313→async function deleteVariantScoped(input: ScopedVariantInput): Promise<void> {
   314→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(

   338→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {

   347→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   348→  return useMutation({
   349→    mutationFn: deleteGenerationScoped,
   350→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   351→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   352→        context: 'useDeleteGeneration',
   353→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete generation',
   354→      });
   355→    },
   356→  });
   357→}
   358→
   359→/**
   360→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   361→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   362→ */
   363→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: deleteVariantScoped,
   366→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   367→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   368→        context: 'useDeleteVariant',
   369→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete variant',
   370→      });
   371→    },
   372→  });
   373→}
   374→
   375→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   376→  return useMutation({
   377→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   378→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   379→    },
   380→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   381→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   382→    },
   383→  });
   384→}
   385→
   386→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   387→  return useMutation({
   388→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   389→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   390→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   391→    },
   392→  });
   393→}
   394→
   395→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   396→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   397→
   398→  return useMutation({
   399→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   400→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   401→    },
   402→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   403→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   404→        generationId: id,
   405→        starred,
   406→        shotId,
   407→      });
   408→    },
   409→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   410→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   411→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   412→    },
   413→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   414→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   415→      if (variables.shotId) {
   416→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   417→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   418→        });
   419→      }
   420→    },
   421→  });
   422→}

   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Delete a generation with project-scoped verification.
   275→ */
   276→async function deleteGenerationScoped(input: ScopedGenerationInput): Promise<void> {
   277→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   278→    input.projectId,
   279→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.projectScope',
   280→  );
   281→
   282→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   283→    input.id,
   284→    projectId,
   285→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.scopeValidation',
   286→  );
   287→
   288→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   289→    id: input.id,
   290→    projectId,
   291→  });
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   295→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration',
   296→      showToast: false,
   297→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   298→    });
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   302→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   303→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteGeneration.noRows',
   304→      showToast: false,
   305→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId },
   306→    });
   307→  }
   308→}
   309→
   310→/**
   311→ * Delete a variant with project-scoped verification via its parent generation.
   312→ */
   313→async function deleteVariantScoped(input: ScopedVariantInput): Promise<void> {
   314→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   315→    input.projectId,
   316→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.projectScope',
   317→  );
   318→
   319→  const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   320→    input.id,
   321→    projectId,
   322→    'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.scopeValidation',
   323→  );
   324→
   325→  const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   326→    id: input.id,
   327→    generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   328→  });
   329→
   330→  if (error) {
   331→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   332→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant',
   333→      showToast: false,
   334→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→
   338→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   339→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   340→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.deleteVariant.noRows',
   341→      showToast: false,
   342→      logData: { id: input.id, projectId, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   343→    });
   344→  }
   345→}
   346→
   347→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   348→  return useMutation({
   349→    mutationFn: deleteGenerationScoped,
   350→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   351→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   352→        context: 'useDeleteGeneration',
   353→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete generation',
   354→      });
   355→    },
   356→  });
   357→}
   358→
   359→/**
   360→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   361→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   362→ */
   363→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: deleteVariantScoped,
   366→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   367→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   368→        context: 'useDeleteVariant',
   369→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete variant',
   370→      });
   371→    },
   372→  });
   373→}
   374→
   375→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   376→  return useMutation({
   377→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   378→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   379→    },
   380→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   381→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   382→    },
   383→  });
   384→}
   385→
   386→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   387→  return useMutation({

   391→    },
   392→  });
   393→}
   394→
   395→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   396→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   397→
   398→  return useMutation({
   399→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   400→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   401→    },
   402→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   403→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   404→        generationId: id,
   405→        starred,
   406→        shotId,
   407→      });
   408→    },
   409→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   410→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   411→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   412→    },
   413→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {

   417→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   418→        });
   419→      }
   420→    },
   421→  });

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { getSupabaseClientResult } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { runAuthSupabaseOperation } from './auth/runAuthSupabaseOperation';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→  type OperationResult,
     9→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
    10→
    11→type OAuthIntentCacheResult = OperationResult<{ cached: boolean }>;
    12→
    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {
    14→  try {
    15→    localStorage.setItem('oauthInProgress', 'true');
    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    17→  } catch (error) {
    18→    return operationFailure(error, {
    19→      policy: 'degrade',
    20→      recoverable: true,
    21→      errorCode: 'oauth_intent_cache_failed',
    22→      message: 'Unable to cache OAuth intent in local storage.',
    23→      cause: error,
    24→    });
    25→  }
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function useDiscordSignIn() {
    29→  return useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    31→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    32→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    33→        policy: 'degrade',
    34→        recoverable: true,
    35→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    36→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized yet.',
    37→      });
    38→    }
    39→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    40→    const intentCacheResult = cacheOAuthIntentFlag();
    41→    if (!intentCacheResult.ok) {
    42→      normalizeAndPresentError(intentCacheResult.error, {
    43→        context: 'useDiscordSignIn.cacheOauthIntent',
    44→        showToast: false,
    45→        logData: {
    46→          errorCode: intentCacheResult.errorCode,
    47→          policy: intentCacheResult.policy,
    48→          recoverable: intentCacheResult.recoverable,
    49→        },
    50→      });
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    const oauthStartResult = await runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    54→      context: 'useDiscordSignIn.startOAuth',
    55→      errorCode: 'discord_oauth_start_failed',
    56→      showToast: true,
    57→      toastTitle: 'Failed to start Discord sign-in. Please try again.',
    58→      run: async () => {
    59→        const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    60→          provider: 'discord',
    61→          options: {
    62→            redirectTo: window.location.origin,
    63→          },
    64→        });
    65→
    66→        if (error) {
    67→          throw error;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        return { started: true as const };
    71→      },
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    if (!oauthStartResult.ok) {
    75→      return oauthStartResult;
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    return operationSuccess(
    79→      {
    80→        ...oauthStartResult.value,
    81→        oauthIntentCached: intentCacheResult.ok,
    82→      },
    83→      {
    84→        policy: intentCacheResult.ok ? oauthStartResult.policy : 'degrade',
    85→      },
    86→    );
    87→  }, []);
    88→}
    89→

     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {
    64→        policy: 'best_effort',
    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

    21→
    22→function hasEntries(record: UnknownRecord): boolean {
    23→  return Object.keys(record).length > 0;
    24→}
    25→
    26→function toNonEmptyRecord(value: unknown): UnknownRecord | undefined {
    27→  const record = asRecord(value);
    28→  if (!record || !hasEntries(record)) {
    29→    return undefined;
    30→  }
    31→  return record;
    32→}
    33→
    34→function pickRecordWithFallback(
    35→  primary: unknown,
    36→  fallback: unknown,
    37→): UnknownRecord {
    38→  return toNonEmptyRecord(primary)
    39→    ?? toNonEmptyRecord(fallback)
    40→    ?? {};
    41→}

    43→export function buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(rawParams: unknown): TaskPayloadSnapshot {
    44→  const params = toRecordOrEmpty(rawParams);

    50→  const orchestratorDetails = pickRecordWithFallback(

    56→    rawParams: params,

1→import type { TaskPayloadSnapshot } from './taskPayloadSnapshot';
     2→import { buildTaskPayloadSnapshot } from './taskPayloadSnapshot';
     3→import {
     4→  asBoolean,
     5→  asNumber,

    12→
    13→export type TravelPayloadSource =
    14→  | 'taskViewContract'
    15→  | 'individualSegmentParams'
    16→  | 'familyContract'
    17→  | 'orchestratorDetails'
    18→  | 'fullOrchestratorPayload'
    19→  | 'rawParams';
    20→
    21→const DEFAULT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
    22→  'taskViewContract',
    23→  'individualSegmentParams',
    24→  'familyContract',
    25→  'orchestratorDetails',
    26→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
    27→  'rawParams',
    28→];
    29→
    30→function getSourceRecord(snapshot: TaskPayloadSnapshot, source: TravelPayloadSource): UnknownRecord {
    31→  switch (source) {
    32→    case 'taskViewContract':
    33→      return snapshot.taskViewContract;
    34→    case 'individualSegmentParams':
    35→      return snapshot.individualSegmentParams;
    36→    case 'familyContract': {
    37→      const readContract = asRecord(snapshot.familyContract.read_contract);
    38→      return readContract ?? snapshot.familyContract;
    39→    }
    40→    case 'rawParams':
    41→      return snapshot.rawParams;
    42→    case 'orchestratorDetails':
    43→      return snapshot.orchestratorDetails;
    44→    case 'fullOrchestratorPayload':
    45→      return snapshot.fullOrchestratorPayload;
    46→    default:
    47→      return {};
    48→  }
    49→}
    50→
    51→function pickValue(
    52→  snapshot: TaskPayloadSnapshot,
    53→  key: string,
    54→  order: TravelPayloadSource[] = DEFAULT_SOURCE_ORDER,
    55→): unknown {
    56→  for (const source of order) {
    57→    const record = getSourceRecord(snapshot, source);
    58→    if (record[key] !== undefined) {
    59→      return record[key];
    60→    }
    61→  }
    62→  return undefined;
    63→}
    64→
    65→export function createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot: TaskPayloadSnapshot) {
    66→  const read = (key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): unknown =>
    67→    pickValue(snapshot, key, order);
    68→
    69→  return {
    70→    read,
    71→    pickString(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): string | undefined {
    72→      return asString(read(key, order));
    73→    },
    74→    pickNumber(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): number | undefined {
    75→      return asNumber(read(key, order));
    76→    },
    77→    pickBoolean(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): boolean | undefined {
    78→      return asBoolean(read(key, order));
    79→    },
    80→    pickRecord(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): UnknownRecord | undefined {
    81→      return asRecord(read(key, order));
    82→    },
    83→    pickStringArray(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): string[] | undefined {
    84→      return asStringArray(read(key, order));
    85→    },
    86→    pickNumberArray(key: string, order?: TravelPayloadSource[]): number[] | undefined {
    87→      return asNumberArray(read(key, order));
    88→    },
    89→  };
    90→}
    91→
    92→export function resolveTravelPairShotGenerationId(
    93→  rawParams: unknown,
    94→  directPairShotGenerationId?: unknown,
    95→): string | undefined {
    96→  const direct = asString(directPairShotGenerationId);
    97→  if (direct) {
    98→    return direct;
    99→  }
   100→
   101→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(rawParams);
   102→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);

   104→    'individualSegmentParams',
   105→    'rawParams',
   106→    'orchestratorDetails',
   107→  ]);
   108→}

    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {

    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,

    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }

     3→import type { PromptEntry } from '../../types';
     4→import type { PromptRoutingResult } from './types';
     5→import { isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt, toShortPrompt } from '../../lib/promptUtils';
     6→
     7→interface PromptHandlersInput {
     8→  prompts: PromptEntry[];
     9→  setPrompts: PromptRoutingResult['setPrompts'];
    10→  markAsInteracted: () => void;
    11→  generatePromptId: () => string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function usePromptHandlers(input: PromptHandlersInput) {
    15→  const { prompts, setPrompts, markAsInteracted, generatePromptId } = input;
    16→
    17→  const handleAddPrompt = useCallback(() => {
    18→    markAsInteracted();
    19→    const newPrompt = {
    20→      id: generatePromptId(),
    21→      fullPrompt: '',
    22→      shortPrompt: `Prompt ${prompts.length + 1}`,
    23→    };
    24→
    25→    setPrompts((prev) => [...prev, newPrompt]);
    26→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, prompts.length, setPrompts]);
    27→
    28→  const handleUpdatePrompt = useCallback(
    29→    (id: string, field: 'fullPrompt' | 'shortPrompt', value: string) => {
    30→      markAsInteracted();
    31→
    32→      setPrompts((prev) =>
    33→        prev.map((prompt) => {
    34→          if (prompt.id !== id) {
    35→            return prompt;
    36→          }
    37→
    38→          const updatedPrompt = { ...prompt, [field]: value };
    39→          if (
    40→            field === 'fullPrompt' &&
    41→            isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt(updatedPrompt.shortPrompt, prompt.fullPrompt)
    42→          ) {
    43→            updatedPrompt.shortPrompt = toShortPrompt(value);
    44→          }
    45→
    46→          return updatedPrompt;
    47→        })
    48→      );
    49→    },
    50→    [markAsInteracted, setPrompts]
    51→  );
    52→
    53→  const handleRemovePrompt = useCallback(
    54→    (id: string) => {
    55→      markAsInteracted();
    56→
    57→      if (prompts.length <= 1) {
    58→        toast.error('Cannot remove the last prompt.');
    59→        return;
    60→      }
    61→
    62→      setPrompts((prev) => prev.filter((prompt) => prompt.id !== id));
    63→    },
    64→    [markAsInteracted, prompts.length, setPrompts]
    65→  );
    66→
    67→  const handleDeleteAllPrompts = useCallback(() => {
    68→    markAsInteracted();
    69→    setPrompts([{ id: generatePromptId(), fullPrompt: '', shortPrompt: 'Prompt 1' }]);
    70→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]);
    71→
    72→  const handleSavePromptsFromModal = useCallback(
    73→    (updatedPrompts: PromptEntry[]) => {
    74→      markAsInteracted();
    75→
    76→      const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    77→      const sanitizedPrompts = updatedPrompts.map((prompt) => {
    78→        let id = prompt.id && !seenIds.has(prompt.id) ? prompt.id : '';
    79→        if (!id) {
    80→          id = generatePromptId();
    81→        }
    82→
    83→        seenIds.add(id);
    84→
    85→        return {
    86→          ...prompt,
    87→          id,
    88→          shortPrompt: prompt.shortPrompt || toShortPrompt(prompt.fullPrompt),
    89→        };
    90→      });
    91→
    92→      setPrompts(sanitizedPrompts);
    93→    },
    94→    [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]
    95→  );
    96→
    97→  return {
    98→    handleAddPrompt,
    99→    handleUpdatePrompt,
   100→    handleRemovePrompt,
   101→    handleDeleteAllPrompts,
   102→    handleSavePromptsFromModal,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→

    11→
    12→interface ModeSelectorItem {

    19→interface ModeSelectorProps {

    24→
    25→export const ModeSelector: React.FC<ModeSelectorProps> = ({
    26→  items,

    33→
    34→  // Calculate minimum width needed for text mode
    35→  // Each button needs: icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width + padding (24px horizontal)
    36→  // Plus gaps between buttons
    37→  const checkIfTextFits = useCallback(() => {
    38→    const container = containerRef.current;
    39→    const measureDiv = measureRef.current;
    40→    if (!container || !measureDiv) return;
    41→
    42→    // Get the available width (container width minus padding and gaps)
    43→    const containerWidth = container.clientWidth;
    44→    const padding = 8; // p-1 = 4px each side
    45→    const gaps = (items.length - 1) * 4; // gap-1 = 4px between items
    46→    const availableWidth = containerWidth - padding - gaps;
    47→
    48→    // Measure the hidden text spans to get required width
    49→    const spans = measureDiv.querySelectorAll('span');
    50→    let totalRequiredWidth = 0;
    51→
    52→    spans.forEach((span) => {
    53→      // Each button needs: padding (24px) + icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width
    54→      const textWidth = span.scrollWidth;
    55→      const buttonWidth = 24 + 14 + 6 + textWidth;
    56→      totalRequiredWidth += buttonWidth;
    57→    });
    58→
    59→    // If we need more width than available, show icons only
    60→    const needsIconsOnly = totalRequiredWidth > availableWidth;
    61→    setShowIconsOnly(needsIconsOnly);

    73→      checkIfTextFits();

    79→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    80→    };
    81→  }, [checkIfTextFits]);
    82→
    83→  return (

    85→      {/* Hidden measurement div - always renders text to measure */}

    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {

    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceMetrics;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;
    77→}
    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);
    81→  if (!task) {
    82→    return {
    83→      ok: false,
    84→      failure: {
    85→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
    86→        message: "Task payload is not an object",
    87→        details: { received_type: typeof value },
    88→      },
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const id = asString(task.id);
    93→  const taskType = asString(task.task_type);
    94→  const projectId = asString(task.project_id);
    95→  if (!id || !taskType || !projectId) {
    96→    return {
    97→      ok: false,
    98→      failure: {
    99→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   100→        message: "Task payload missing required fields: id, task_type, or project_id",
   101→        details: {
   102→          has_id: !!id,
   103→          has_task_type: !!taskType,
   104→          has_project_id: !!projectId,
   105→        },
   106→      },
   107→    };
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  const projectsRaw = task.projects;
   111→  const projectRecord = asObjectRecord(projectsRaw)
   112→    ?? (Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? asObjectRecord(projectsRaw[0]) : null);
   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);
   114→  if (!userId) {
   115→    return {
   116→      ok: false,
   117→      failure: {
   118→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   119→        message: "Task payload missing projects.user_id",
   120→        details: {
   121→          projects_type: Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? "array" : typeof projectsRaw,
   122→          has_projects_user_id: false,
   123→        },
   124→      },
   125→    };
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const params = parseTaskCostParams(task.params);
   129→  const status = asString(task.status) ?? "unknown";
   130→
   131→  // Extract task_types FK join (PostgREST returns object or null)
   132→  let taskTypeConfig: TaskTypeConfig | null = null;
   133→  const ttRaw = asObjectRecord(task.task_types);
   134→  if (ttRaw) {
   135→    const ttId = asString(ttRaw.id);
   136→    const billingType = asString(ttRaw.billing_type);
   137→    if (ttId && billingType) {
   138→      taskTypeConfig = {
   139→        id: ttId,
   140→        billing_type: billingType,
   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },
   160→      task_type_config: taskTypeConfig,
   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   165→// Helper for standard JSON responses with CORS headers
   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {
   167→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {

   169→    headers: {

   193→
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceMetrics {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→}
   208→
   209→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   210→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   211→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   212→}
   213→
   214→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   215→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   216→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: TaskCostParams): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   217→  let totalCost = 0;
   218→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   219→
   220→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   221→  const result = taskParams.result ?? (taskParams as VideoEnhanceMetrics);
   222→
   223→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   224→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   225→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   226→    totalCost += filmCost;
   227→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   228→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   229→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   230→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   235→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   236→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   237→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   238→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   239→    breakdown.upscale = {
   240→      output_width: result.output_width,
   241→      output_height: result.output_height,
   242→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   243→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   244→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   245→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   246→    };
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return {
   250→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   251→    breakdown,
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→interface CostFactors {
   256→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   257→  frameCount?: number;
   258→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   259→}
   260→
   261→interface TaskCostParams {
   262→  resolution?: string;
   263→  frame_count?: number;
   264→  model_type?: string;
   265→  result?: VideoEnhanceMetrics;
   266→  [key: string]: unknown;
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   270→export function calculateTaskCost(
   271→  taskType: string,
   272→  billingType: string,
   273→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   274→  unitCost: number,
   275→  durationSeconds: number,
   276→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   277→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   278→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   279→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   280→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   281→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   282→  }
   283→
   284→  let totalCost;
   285→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   286→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   287→  } else {
   288→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   289→  }
   290→
   291→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   292→  if (costFactors) {
   293→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   294→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   295→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   296→    }
   297→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   298→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   299→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   300→      } else {
   301→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   302→      }
   303→    }
   304→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   305→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   306→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   307→    }
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   311→}
   312→
