   242→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(() => toggleLock(true))}
   243→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   244→              className={baseClass}
   245→              aria-label="Lock pane"
   246→              data-tour={dataTourLock}
   247→            >
   248→              <LockIcon className={iconSize} />
   249→            </Button>
   250→          </TooltipButton>
   251→        );
   252→
   253→      case 'unlock':
   254→        return (
   255→          <TooltipButton key="unlock" tooltip="Unlock pane" showTooltip={showTooltips} side={tooltipSide}>
   256→            <Button
   257→              variant="ghost"
   258→              size="icon"
   259→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(() => toggleLock(false))}
   260→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   261→              className={baseClass}
   262→              aria-label="Unlock pane"
   263→            >
   264→              <UnlockIcon className={iconSize} />
   265→            </Button>
   266→          </TooltipButton>
   267→        );
   268→
   269→      case 'open':
   270→        return (
   271→          <TooltipButton key="open" tooltip={paneTooltip} showTooltip={showTooltips} side={tooltipSide}>
   272→            <Button
   273→              variant="ghost"
   274→              size="icon"
   275→              onPointerUp={handleButtonClick(handleOpen)}
   276→              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
   277→              className={baseClass}
   278→              aria-label={paneTooltip || "Open pane"}

   285→      default:

   287→    }
   288→  };
   289→
   290→  // ==========================================================================
   291→  // RENDER
   292→  // ==========================================================================
   293→
   294→  // Hide on mobile when selection is active
   295→  if (!useDesktopBehavior && selectionActive) return null;
   296→
   297→  const buttons = getButtonsToShow();
   298→
   299→  // Nothing to show
   300→  if (buttons.length === 0) return null;
   301→
   302→  // Container styling
   303→  // TasksPane (right side) should appear above MediaLightbox on iPad/desktop
   304→  // but behind the lightbox on mobile phones for cleaner full-screen lightbox experience
   305→  const isTasksPane = side === 'right';
   306→  const isMobilePhone = isMobile && !isTablet;
   307→  const tasksPaneZIndex = isMobilePhone
   308→    ? UI_Z_LAYERS.TASKS_PANE_TAB_BEHIND_LIGHTBOX
   309→    : UI_Z_LAYERS.TASKS_PANE_TAB_ABOVE_LIGHTBOX;
   310→  const normalLockedZIndex = PANE_CONFIG.zIndex.CONTROL_LOCKED;
   311→  const normalUnlockedZIndex = PANE_CONFIG.zIndex.CONTROL_UNLOCKED;
   312→
   313→  const zIndexClass = isTasksPane
   314→    ? ''
   315→    : (isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked) ? normalLockedZIndex : normalUnlockedZIndex);
   316→
   317→  const bgOpacity = isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked) ? 'bg-zinc-800/90' : 'bg-zinc-800/80';
   318→  const transition = isLocked || (isOpen && !isLocked)
   319→    ? PANE_CONFIG.transition.PROPERTIES.TRANSFORM_ONLY
   320→    : PANE_CONFIG.transition.PROPERTIES.TRANSFORM_OPACITY;
   321→
   322→  const positionClasses = (() => {
   323→    switch (side) {
   324→      case 'left': return 'left-0 flex-col';
   325→      case 'right': return 'right-0 flex-col';
   326→      case 'bottom': return 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-0 flex-row';
   327→      default: return '';
   328→    }
   329→  })();
   330→
   331→  // On mobile, left/right panes only show one button - make them taller for easier tapping
   332→  const isMobileSidePane = !useDesktopBehavior && !isBottom && buttons.length === 1;
   333→
   334→  // Add safe area margin for iOS home indicator on touch devices
   335→  // Only when the pane is NOT visible - when visible, the control sits on the pane, not at screen edge
   336→  const needsSafeAreaMargin = isMobile && isBottom && !isVisible;
   337→  const mobileStyle = needsSafeAreaMargin ? {
   338→    ...dynamicStyle,
   339→    marginBottom: safeAreaCalc.marginBottom(0.5),
   340→  } : dynamicStyle;
   341→
   342→  const content = (
   343→    <div
   344→      data-pane-control
   345→      data-tour={dataTour}
   346→      style={{
   347→        ...mobileStyle,
   348→        ...(isTasksPane ? { zIndex: tasksPaneZIndex } : {}),
   349→      }}
   350→      className={cn(
   351→        `fixed ${zIndexClass} flex items-center p-1 backdrop-blur-sm border border-zinc-700 rounded-md gap-1 duration-${PANE_CONFIG.timing.ANIMATION_DURATION} ${PANE_CONFIG.transition.EASING}`,
   352→        bgOpacity,
   353→        transition,
   354→        positionClasses,
   355→        'opacity-100 touch-none',
   356→        // Taller touch target for mobile side panes with single button
   357→        isMobileSidePane && 'min-h-[72px] justify-center'
   358→      )}
   359→      onMouseEnter={useDesktopBehavior && isOpen && !isLocked ? handlePaneEnter : undefined}
   360→      onMouseLeave={useDesktopBehavior && isOpen && !isLocked ? handlePaneLeave : undefined}
   361→      {...containerEventHandlers}
   362→    >
   363→      {buttons.map(renderButton)}
   364→    </div>
   365→  );
   366→
   367→  return content;
   368→};
   369→
   370→export { PaneControlTab };
   371→

   227→/**
   228→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   229→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   230→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   231→ */
   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;
   266→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls

     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter, extractOrchestratorRefFromParams } from './orchestratorReference.ts';
    13→import { readEdgeErrorCode } from './edgeRequest.ts';
    14→import {
    15→  operationFailure,
    16→  operationSuccess,

    18→} from './edgeOperation.ts';
    19→
    20→interface TaskQueryResponse {
    21→  data: unknown[] | null;
    22→  error: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface TaskQueryBuilder extends PromiseLike<TaskQueryResponse> {
    26→  eq(column: string, value: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    27→  or(filter: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskQueryClient {
    31→  from(table: string): {
    32→    select(columns: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→// ===== Constants =====
    37→
    38→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    39→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    40→
    41→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    45→ *
    46→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    47→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    48→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    49→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    50→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    51→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    52→ *
    53→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    54→ */
    55→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: unknown): string | null {
    56→  const contractOrReferencePath = extractOrchestratorRefFromParams(params);
    57→  if (contractOrReferencePath) {
    58→    return contractOrReferencePath;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    62→
    63→  const p = params as Record<string, unknown>;
    64→  const details = p.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    65→  const originalParams = p.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    66→  const originalDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    67→
    68→  return (
    69→    (p.orchestrator_task_id_ref as string) ||
    70→    (details?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    71→    (originalDetails?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    72→    (p.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    73→    null
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    79→ *
    80→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    81→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    82→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    83→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    84→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    85→ *
    86→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    87→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    88→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    89→ */
    90→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: unknown, taskId: string): string | null {
    91→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    92→  if (!ref) return null;
    93→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    94→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    95→  return ref;
    96→}
    97→
    98→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
   102→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
   103→ *
   104→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
   105→ *
   106→ * Usage:
   107→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
   108→ */
   109→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   110→  return [
   111→    buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   112→    buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   113→  ].join(',');
   114→}
   115→
   116→export function buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   117→  return buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter(orchestratorTaskId);
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   121→  return [
   122→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   123→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   124→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   125→  ].join(',');
   126→}
   127→
   128→export interface CompletedSubTaskRow {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_started_at: string | null;
   131→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
   132→  status: string;
   133→}
   134→
   135→export type SubTaskLookupStage = 'canonical' | 'legacy';
   136→
   137→export class SubTaskLookupError extends Error {
   138→  readonly code = 'subtask_lookup_failed';
   139→  readonly stage: SubTaskLookupStage;
   140→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   141→
   142→  constructor(stage: SubTaskLookupStage, cause: unknown) {
   143→    super(`[Billing] Failed to query ${stage} sub-task references`);
   144→    this.name = 'SubTaskLookupError';
   145→    this.stage = stage;
   146→    this.cause = cause;
   147→  }
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function lookupCompletedSubTasksForOrchestrator(
   151→  supabaseAdmin: TaskQueryClient,
   152→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   153→): Promise<CompletedSubTaskRow[]> {
   154→  const canonicalResult = await supabaseAdmin
   155→    .from('tasks')
   156→    .select(`
   157→      id,
   158→      generation_started_at,
   159→      generation_processed_at,
   160→      status
   161→    `)
   162→    .or(buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   163→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   164→
   165→  if (canonicalResult.error) {
   166→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('canonical', canonicalResult.error);
   167→  }
   168→
   169→  const canonicalTasks = (canonicalResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   170→  if (canonicalTasks.length > 0) {
   171→    return canonicalTasks;
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const legacyResult = await supabaseAdmin
   175→    .from('tasks')
   176→    .select(`
   177→      id,
   178→      generation_started_at,
   179→      generation_processed_at,
   180→      status
   181→    `)
   182→    .or(buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   183→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   184→
   185→  if (legacyResult.error) {
   186→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('legacy', legacyResult.error);
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  const legacyTasks = (legacyResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   190→  if (legacyTasks.length > 0) {
   191→    return legacyTasks;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  return [];
   195→}
   196→
   197→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
   201→ *
   202→ * Returns an explicit outcome so callers can branch on billing success/failure.
   203→ *
   204→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
   205→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
   206→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
   207→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
   208→ */
   209→export interface CostCalculationTriggerValue {
   210→  status: number | null;
   211→  skipped?: boolean;
   212→  cost?: number;
   213→}
   214→
   215→export type CostCalculationTriggerResult = OperationResult<CostCalculationTriggerValue>;
   216→
   217→function isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   218→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
   219→}
   220→
   221→function parseJsonRecord(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   222→  if (!text.trim()) {
   223→    return null;
   224→  }
   225→  try {
   226→    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
   227→    return isObjectRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;
   228→  } catch {
   229→    return null;
   230→  }
   231→}
   232→
   233→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
   234→  params: {
   235→    supabaseUrl: string;
   236→    serviceKey: string;
   237→    taskId: string;
   238→    logTag?: string;
   239→  },
   240→): Promise<CostCalculationTriggerResult> {
   241→  const {
   242→    supabaseUrl,
   243→    serviceKey,
   244→    taskId,
   245→    logTag = 'CostCalc',
   246→  } = params;
   247→  try {
   248→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   249→      method: "POST",
   250→      headers: {
   251→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   252→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   253→      },
   254→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   255→    });
   256→
   257→    if (costResp.ok) {
   258→      const bodyText = await costResp.text();
   259→      const costData = parseJsonRecord(bodyText);
   260→      if (!costData) {
   261→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`), {
   262→          policy: 'degrade',
   263→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   264→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`,
   265→          recoverable: true,
   266→          cause: { status: costResp.status },
   267→        });
   268→      }
   269→
   270→      const costErrorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(costData);
   271→      if (costErrorCode) {
   272→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`), {
   273→          policy: 'degrade',
   274→          errorCode: costErrorCode,
   275→          message: typeof costData.message === 'string'
   276→            ? costData.message
   277→            : `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`,
   278→          recoverable: true,
   279→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   280→        });
   281→      }
   282→
   283→      const skipped = costData.skipped === true;
   284→      const successFlag = costData.success;
   285→      if (!skipped && successFlag !== true) {
   286→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`), {
   287→          policy: 'degrade',
   288→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   289→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`,
   290→          recoverable: true,
   291→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   292→        });
   293→      }
   294→
   295→      const costValue = costData.cost;
   296→      if (!skipped && (typeof costValue !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(costValue))) {
   297→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`), {
   298→          policy: 'degrade',
   299→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   300→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`,
   301→          recoverable: true,
   302→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   303→        });
   304→      }
   305→
   306→      return operationSuccess(
   307→        {
   308→          status: costResp.status,
   309→          skipped,
   310→          cost: typeof costValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(costValue)
   311→            ? costValue
   312→            : undefined,
   313→        },
   314→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
   315→      );
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   319→    const errPayload = parseJsonRecord(errTxt);
   320→    const errorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(errPayload) ?? 'cost_calculation_failed';
   321→    const message = typeof errPayload?.message === 'string'
   322→      ? errPayload.message
   323→      : (errTxt || 'Cost calculation failed');
   324→    return operationFailure(new Error(message), {
   325→      policy: 'degrade',
   326→      errorCode,
   327→      message,
   328→      recoverable: costResp.status >= 500,
   329→      cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: errPayload ?? errTxt },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (costErr) {
   332→    const message = costErr instanceof Error ? costErr.message : String(costErr);
   333→    return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] ${message}`), {
   334→      policy: 'degrade',
   335→      errorCode: 'cost_calculation_request_error',
   336→      message: `[${logTag}] ${message}`,
   337→      recoverable: true,
   338→      cause: costErr,
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→}
   342→

     6→interface NavigationArrowsProps {
     7→  // Visibility - optional, uses context if not provided

    23→/**
    24→ * NavigationArrows Component
    25→ *
    26→ * Left and right navigation arrows for the lightbox.
    27→ * Supports desktop (larger buttons) and mobile (smaller buttons) variants.
    28→ *
    29→ * Can be used in two modes:
    30→ * 1. Props mode: Pass all props explicitly (legacy usage)
    31→ * 2. Context mode: Uses LightboxStateContext via hooks (preferred)
    32→ *
    33→ * When props are not provided, falls back to context values.
    34→ */
    35→export const NavigationArrows: React.FC<NavigationArrowsProps> = ({
    36→  showNavigation: showNavigationProp,

    38→  onPrevious: onPreviousProp,

    56→  }
    57→

    59→  const buttonSize = isDesktop ? 'h-10 w-10 sm:h-12 sm:w-12' : 'h-12 w-12';
    60→  const iconSize = isDesktop ? 'h-6 w-6 sm:h-8 sm:w-8' : 'h-6 w-6';
    61→  const leftPosition = isDesktop ? 'left-4' : 'left-2';
    62→  const rightPosition = isDesktop ? 'right-4' : 'right-2';
    63→
    64→  return (
    65→    <>
    66→      {/* Left Arrow */}
    67→      {onPrevious && hasPrevious && (
    68→        <Button
    69→          variant="secondary"
    70→          size="lg"
    71→          onClick={onPrevious}
    72→          className={`bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70 text-white z-[80] ${buttonSize} absolute ${leftPosition} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`}

    76→      )}

    83→          onClick={onNext}
    84→          className={`bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70 text-white z-[80] ${buttonSize} absolute ${rightPosition} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`}
    85→        >
    86→          <ChevronRight className={iconSize} />
    87→        </Button>
    88→      )}
    89→    </>
    90→  );
    91→};

     2→import { createClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
     3→import { SystemLogger } from './systemLogger.ts';
     4→
     5→declare const Deno: { env: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined } };

     7→// --- Edge runtime initialization ---
     8→
     9→export interface EdgeRuntime {
    10→  supabaseAdmin: ReturnType<typeof createClient>;

    13→
    14→export interface InitEdgeRuntimeOptions {

    17→
    18→export function initEdgeRuntime(
    19→  functionName: string,
    20→  missingEnvLogPrefix: string,
    21→  options?: InitEdgeRuntimeOptions,
    22→): OperationResult<EdgeRuntime> {
    23→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
    24→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL');
    25→
    26→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {

    32→      cause: { missingEnvLogPrefix },
    33→    });
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  const supabaseAdmin = options?.clientOptions
    37→    ? createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, options.clientOptions)
    38→    : createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    39→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, functionName);

    44→export async function ensureRequestMethod(
    45→  req: Request,
    46→  method: string,
    47→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    48→): Promise<OperationResult<void>> {
    49→  if (req.method === method) {
    50→    return operationSuccess(undefined, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  logger?.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
    54→  if (logger) {
    55→    await logger.flush();

    57→  return operationFailure(new Error('Method not allowed'), {
    58→    policy: 'fail_closed',

    60→    message: 'Method not allowed',
    61→    recoverable: false,
    62→    cause: { method: req.method, allow: method },
    63→  });
    64→}

    66→// --- JSON body parsing ---
    67→
    68→function isJsonObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    69→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
    70→}
    71→
    72→function coerceLooseObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    73→  return isJsonObject(value) ? value : {};
    74→}
    75→
    76→export interface ParseJsonBodyOptions {
    77→  mode?: 'strict' | 'loose';
    78→  message?: string;
    79→  nonObjectMessage?: string;
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function parseJsonBody(
    83→  req: Request,
    84→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    85→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
    86→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    87→  const mode = options?.mode ?? 'strict';
    88→  const message = options?.message ?? 'Invalid JSON body';
    89→  const nonObjectMessage = options?.nonObjectMessage ?? 'JSON body must be an object';
    90→
    91→  try {
    92→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    93→    if (!bodyText) {
    94→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const parsed = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    98→    if (isJsonObject(parsed)) {
    99→      return operationSuccess(parsed, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   103→      logger?.debug('Non-object JSON body provided, using empty object defaults');
   104→      return operationSuccess(coerceLooseObject(parsed), { policy: 'fail_open' });
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    logger?.error(nonObjectMessage);
   108→    if (logger) {
   109→      await logger.flush();
   110→    }
   111→    return operationFailure(new Error(nonObjectMessage), {
   112→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   113→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body_shape',
   114→      message: nonObjectMessage,
   115→      recoverable: false,
   116→      cause: parsed,
   117→    });
   118→  } catch (error) {
   119→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   120→      logger?.debug('No valid JSON body provided, using defaults');
   121→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   122→    }
   123→    logger?.error(message);
   124→    if (logger) {
   125→      await logger.flush();
   126→    }
   127→    return operationFailure(error, {
   128→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   129→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body',
   130→      message,
   131→      recoverable: false,
   132→      cause: error,
   133→    });
   134→  }
   135→}
   136→
   137→export async function parseJsonBodyStrict(
   138→  req: Request,
   139→  logger?: SystemLogger,
   140→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
   141→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
   142→  return parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   143→    mode: 'strict',
   144→    message: options?.message,
   145→    nonObjectMessage: options?.nonObjectMessage,
   146→  });
   147→}
   148→
   149→// --- Error code reading ---
   150→
   151→export function readEdgeErrorCode(payload: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
   152→  if (!payload) {
   153→    return null;
   154→  }
   155→  if (typeof payload.errorCode === 'string' && payload.errorCode.trim().length > 0) {
   156→    return payload.errorCode;
   157→  }
   158→  if (typeof payload.error === 'string' && payload.error.trim().length > 0) {
   159→    return payload.error;
   160→  }
   161→  return null;
   162→}
   163→
   164→// --- Error response helpers ---
   165→
   166→interface EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput {
   167→  errorCode: string;
   168→  message: string;
   169→  recoverable: boolean;
   170→  retryAfter?: number;
   171→}
   172→
   173→export function edgeErrorResponse(
   174→  input: EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput,
   175→  status: number,
   176→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   177→): Response {
   178→  return new Response(
   179→    JSON.stringify({
   180→      error: input.errorCode,
   181→      errorCode: input.errorCode,
   182→      message: input.message,
   183→      recoverable: input.recoverable,
   184→      ...(input.retryAfter !== undefined ? { retryAfter: input.retryAfter } : {}),
   185→    }),
   186→    {
   187→      status,
   188→      headers: {
   189→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   190→        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
   191→        ...(extraHeaders ?? {}),
   192→      },
   193→    },
   194→  );
   195→}
   196→
   197→export function operationFailureResponse(
   198→  failure: OperationFailure,
   199→  status = 500,
   200→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   201→): Response {
   202→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   203→    {
   204→      errorCode: failure.errorCode,
   205→      message: failure.message,
   206→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   207→    },
   208→    status,
   209→    extraHeaders,
   210→  );
   211→}
   212→
   213→export function parseJsonFailureResponse(
   214→  failure: OperationFailure,
   215→  status = 400,

   217→): Response {

   221→      message: failure.message,
   222→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   223→    },

   225→    extraHeaders,
   226→  );
   227→}

    24→  remaining: number;
    25→  resetAt: Date;
    26→  retryAfter?: number; // seconds until reset
    27→  degraded?: {
    28→    reason: RateLimitFailureReason;
    29→    message: string;
    30→    cause?: unknown;
    31→  };
    32→}
    33→
    34→type DeniedRateLimitResult = Omit<RateLimitResult, 'allowed'> & { allowed: false };
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Default rate limit configs for different function types
    38→ */
    39→export const RATE_LIMITS = {
    40→  // Unauthenticated/webhook endpoints - stricter
    41→  webhook: { maxRequests: 100, windowSeconds: 60 },
    42→  
    43→  // Authenticated user actions - moderate  
    44→  userAction: { maxRequests: 60, windowSeconds: 60 },
    45→  
    46→  // Expensive operations (AI, payments)
    47→  expensive: { maxRequests: 30, windowSeconds: 60 },
    48→  
    49→  // Task creation - lenient (users create many tasks in bursts)
    50→  taskCreation: { maxRequests: 120, windowSeconds: 60 },
    51→  
    52→  // Read operations - lenient
    53→  read: { maxRequests: 120, windowSeconds: 60 },
    54→};
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Check rate limit for a request
    58→ * Uses database-backed sliding window counter
    59→ * 
    60→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client
    61→ * @param functionName - Name of the function being rate limited
    62→ * @param identifier - User ID or IP address
    63→ * @param config - Rate limit configuration
    64→ * @param logPrefix - Optional log prefix
    65→ * @returns Rate limit check result
    66→ */
    67→interface SupabaseAdminClient {
    68→  rpc: (fn: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: unknown }>;
    69→}
    70→
    71→interface RateLimitRpcPayload {
    72→  allowed: boolean;
    73→  count: number;
    74→  reset_at: string;
    75→}
    76→
    77→type RateLimitFailureReason = 'rpc_error' | 'runtime_error' | 'invalid_rpc_payload';
    78→
    79→interface CheckRateLimitInput {
    80→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseAdminClient;
    81→  functionName: string;
    82→  identifier: string;
    83→  config: RateLimitConfig;
    84→  logPrefix?: string;
    85→}
    86→
    87→function failOpenRateLimit(
    88→  now: Date,
    89→  config: RateLimitConfig,
    90→  reason: RateLimitFailureReason,
    91→  message: string,
    92→  cause: unknown,
    93→): RateLimitResult {
    94→  return {
    95→    allowed: true,
    96→    remaining: config.maxRequests,
    97→    resetAt: new Date(now.getTime() + config.windowSeconds * 1000),
    98→    degraded: {
    99→      reason,
   100→      message,
   101→      cause,
   102→    },
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→
   106→function parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data: unknown): RateLimitRpcPayload | null {
   107→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
   108→    return null;
   109→  }
   110→  const record = data as Record<string, unknown>;
   111→  if (typeof record.allowed !== 'boolean') {
   112→    return null;
   113→  }
   114→  if (typeof record.count !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(record.count) || record.count < 0) {
   115→    return null;
   116→  }
   117→  if (typeof record.reset_at !== 'string') {
   118→    return null;
   119→  }
   120→  const resetAt = new Date(record.reset_at);
   121→  if (Number.isNaN(resetAt.getTime())) {
   122→    return null;
   123→  }
   124→  return {
   125→    allowed: record.allowed,
   126→    count: Math.trunc(record.count),
   127→    reset_at: record.reset_at,
   128→  };
   129→}
   130→
   131→export async function checkRateLimit(
   132→  input: CheckRateLimitInput,
   133→): Promise<OperationResult<RateLimitResult>> {
   134→  const {
   135→    supabaseAdmin,
   136→    functionName,
   137→    identifier,
   138→    config,
   139→    logPrefix = "[RATE-LIMIT]",
   140→  } = input;
   141→  const now = new Date();
   142→  const key = `${functionName}:${identifier}`;
   143→  
   144→  try {
   145→    // Use upsert with atomic increment via RPC function
   146→    // This handles race conditions properly
   147→    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc('check_rate_limit', {
   148→      p_key: key,
   149→      p_window_seconds: config.windowSeconds,
   150→      p_max_requests: config.maxRequests
   151→    });
   152→    
   153→    if (error) {
   154→      const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}"`;
   155→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   156→        now,
   157→        config,
   158→        'rpc_error',
   159→        message,
   160→        error,
   161→      );
   162→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, error);
   163→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const result = parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data);
   167→    if (!result) {
   168→      const message = `${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}"`;
   169→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   170→        now,
   171→        config,
   172→        'invalid_rpc_payload',
   173→        message,
   174→        data,
   175→      );
   176→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, data);
   177→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    const resetAt = new Date(result.reset_at);
   181→    const remaining = Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - result.count);
   182→    
   183→    if (!result.allowed) {
   184→      const retryAfter = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((resetAt.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 1000));
   185→      return operationSuccess({
   186→        allowed: false,
   187→        remaining: 0,
   188→        resetAt,
   189→        retryAfter,
   190→      }, {
   191→        policy: 'fail_closed',
   192→      });
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    return operationSuccess(
   196→      {
   197→        allowed: true,
   198→        remaining,
   199→        resetAt,
   200→      },
   201→      { policy: 'best_effort' },
   202→    );
   203→  } catch (err) {
   204→    const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit runtime error for key "${key}"`;
   205→    const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   206→      now,
   207→      config,
   208→      'runtime_error',
   209→      message,
   210→      err,
   211→    );
   212→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Rate limit error for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, err);
   213→    return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   214→  }
   215→}
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Create rate limit headers for response
   219→ */
   220→function rateLimitHeaders(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Record<string, string> {
   221→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
   222→    'X-RateLimit-Limit': config.maxRequests.toString(),
   223→    'X-RateLimit-Remaining': result.remaining.toString(),
   224→    'X-RateLimit-Reset': Math.floor(result.resetAt.getTime() / 1000).toString(),
   225→  };
   226→  
   227→  if (result.retryAfter) {
   228→    headers['Retry-After'] = result.retryAfter.toString();
   229→  }
   230→  
   231→  return headers;
   232→}
   233→
   234→/**
   235→ * Create a 429 Too Many Requests response
   236→ */
   237→export function rateLimitResponse(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Response {
   238→  const retryAfterSuffix = typeof result.retryAfter === 'number' && result.retryAfter > 0
   239→    ? ` Please wait ${result.retryAfter} seconds before retrying.`
   240→    : ' Please retry shortly.';
   241→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   242→    {
   243→      errorCode: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
   244→      message: `Rate limit exceeded.${retryAfterSuffix}`,
   245→      recoverable: true,
   246→      retryAfter: result.retryAfter,
   247→    },
   248→    429,
   249→    rateLimitHeaders(result, config),
   250→  );
   251→}
   252→
   253→function fallbackDeniedResult(config: RateLimitConfig): RateLimitResult {
   254→  const now = new Date();
   255→  return {
   256→    allowed: false,
   257→    remaining: 0,
   258→    resetAt: new Date(now.getTime() + config.windowSeconds * 1000),
   259→    retryAfter: config.windowSeconds,
   260→  };
   261→}
   262→
   263→function extractDeniedResultFromFailure(
   264→  failure: OperationFailure,
   265→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   266→): RateLimitResult {
   267→  const decision = (failure.cause as { decision?: unknown } | undefined)?.decision;
   268→  if (decision && typeof decision === 'object' && !Array.isArray(decision)) {
   269→    const record = decision as Partial<RateLimitResult>;
   270→    if (
   271→      record.allowed === false
   272→      && record.resetAt instanceof Date
   273→      && typeof record.remaining === 'number'
   274→    ) {
   275→      return {
   276→        allowed: false,
   277→        remaining: record.remaining,
   278→        resetAt: record.resetAt,
   279→        retryAfter: record.retryAfter,
   280→      };
   281→    }
   282→  }
   283→  return fallbackDeniedResult(config);
   284→}
   285→
   286→export function isRateLimitExceededFailure(result: OperationResult<RateLimitResult>): boolean {
   287→  if (result.ok) {
   288→    return result.value.allowed === false;
   289→  }
   290→  return result.errorCode === 'rate_limit_exceeded';
   291→}
   292→
   293→export function rateLimitFailureResponse(
   294→  result: OperationFailure | DeniedRateLimitResult,
   295→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   296→): Response {
   297→  if ('allowed' in result) {
   298→    return rateLimitResponse(result, config);
   299→  }
   300→  return rateLimitResponse(extractDeniedResultFromFailure(result, config), config);
   301→}
   302→
   303→interface RateLimitLogger {
   304→  warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   305→  error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   306→  flush: () => Promise<void>;
   307→}
   308→
   309→interface EnforceRateLimitInput {
   310→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseAdminClient;
   311→  functionName: string;
   312→  userId: string;
   313→  config: RateLimitConfig;
   314→  logger: RateLimitLogger;
   315→  logPrefix: string;
   316→  responses?: {
   317→    serviceUnavailable?: () => Response;
   318→  };
   319→}
   320→
   321→/**
   322→ * Full rate-limit enforcement: check → error response → fail_open logging.
   323→ * Returns a Response to short-circuit (exceeded or service error), or null to proceed.
   324→ *
   325→ * @param serviceUnavailableResponse Optional factory for 503 responses.
   326→ *   Defaults to a generic 503 edge error.
   327→ */
   328→export async function enforceRateLimit(
   329→  input: EnforceRateLimitInput,
   330→): Promise<Response | null> {
   331→  const {
   332→    supabaseAdmin,
   333→    functionName,
   334→    userId,
   335→    config,
   336→    logger,
   337→    logPrefix,
   338→    responses,
   339→  } = input;
   340→  const result = await checkRateLimit({
   341→    supabaseAdmin,
   342→    functionName,
   343→    identifier: userId,
   344→    config,
   345→    logPrefix,
   346→  });
   347→
   348→  // Rate limit exceeded — works for both ok (fail_closed) and !ok paths
   349→  if (isRateLimitExceededFailure(result)) {
   350→    logger.warn('Rate limit exceeded', { user_id: userId });
   351→    await logger.flush();
   352→    if (result.ok) {
   353→      return rateLimitResponse(result.value, config);
   354→    }
   355→    return rateLimitFailureResponse(result, config);
   356→  }
   357→
   358→  // Operation failure that's not rate-limit-exceeded
   359→  if (!result.ok) {
   360→    logger.error('Rate limit check failed', {
   361→      user_id: userId,
   362→      error_code: result.errorCode,
   363→      message: result.message,
   364→    });
   365→    await logger.flush();
   366→    return responses?.serviceUnavailable
   367→      ? responses.serviceUnavailable()
   368→      : edgeErrorResponse(
   369→          { errorCode: 'rate_limit_service_unavailable', message: 'Rate limit service unavailable', recoverable: true },
   370→          503,
   371→        );
   372→  }
   373→
   374→  // Success but degraded (fail_open) — proceed with warning
   375→  if (result.policy === 'fail_open') {
   376→    logger.warn('Rate limit check degraded; allowing request', {
   377→      user_id: userId,
   378→      reason: result.value.degraded?.reason,
   379→      message: result.value.degraded?.message,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return null;
   384→}
   385→

    94→  const completionFollowUp = {

    99→

   122→export async function fetchTaskContext(

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;

    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';

    33→    textarea.select();

    37→  } finally {

   122→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(

     9→function requireEnv(name: string): string {

    18→  const value = import.meta.env[name] as string | undefined;

1→/** @publicContract Supabase browser runtime entrypoint. */
     2→
     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,
     5→  getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult,
     6→  initializeSupabaseClientRuntime,
     7→  normalizeSupabaseError,
     8→} from '@/integrations/supabase/runtime/supabaseRuntime';
     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

1→/**
     2→ * useEffectiveMedia - Computes effective URLs and dimensions for media display
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles:
     5→ * - effectiveVideoUrl: Video URL respecting active variant
     6→ * - effectiveMediaUrl: Image URL respecting active variant
     7→ * - effectiveImageDimensions: Guaranteed dimensions with fallbacks
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useMemo } from 'react';
    11→import { ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION } from '@/shared/lib/media/aspectRatios';
    12→
    13→interface UseEffectiveMediaProps {
    14→  isVideo: boolean;
    15→  activeVariant: {
    16→    id?: string | null;
    17→    location?: string | null;
    18→    thumbnail_url?: string | null;
    19→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    20→  } | null;
    21→  effectiveImageUrl: string | undefined;
    22→  imageDimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null;
    23→  projectAspectRatio: string | undefined;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    27→  effectiveVideoUrl: string | undefined;
    28→  effectiveMediaUrl: string | undefined;
    29→  effectiveImageDimensions: { width: number; height: number };
    30→}
    31→
    32→export function useEffectiveMedia({
    33→  isVideo,
    34→  activeVariant,
    35→  effectiveImageUrl,
    36→  imageDimensions,
    37→  projectAspectRatio,
    38→}: UseEffectiveMediaProps): UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    39→  // Get the effective video URL (active variant or current media)
    40→  const effectiveVideoUrl = useMemo(() => {
    41→    if (isVideo && activeVariant) {
    42→      return activeVariant.location ?? undefined;
    43→    }
    44→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    45→  }, [isVideo, activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    46→
    47→  // For images, use the active variant's location when a variant is explicitly selected
    48→  const effectiveMediaUrl = useMemo(() => {
    49→
    50→    // If an active variant is set (any variant, including primary), use its location
    51→    if (activeVariant && activeVariant.location) {
    52→      return activeVariant.location;
    53→    }
    54→    // Otherwise use the standard effective image URL
    55→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    56→  }, [activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    57→
    58→  // Compute effective dimensions that are GUARANTEED to have a value
    59→  // This is computed synchronously during render, so there's no flicker
    60→  // Priority: extracted/loaded dimensions > project aspect ratio > 16:9 default
    61→  const effectiveImageDimensions = useMemo(() => {
    62→    // Use actual dimensions if we have them
    63→    if (imageDimensions) {
    64→      return imageDimensions;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    // Fallback to project aspect ratio
    68→    if (projectAspectRatio) {
    69→      const resolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[projectAspectRatio];
    70→      if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {
    71→        const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
    72→        if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && w > 0 && h > 0) {
    73→          return { width: w, height: h };
    74→        }
    75→      }
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    // Absolute last resort: 16:9 default
    79→    return { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    80→  }, [imageDimensions, projectAspectRatio]);
    81→
    82→  return {
    83→    effectiveVideoUrl,
    84→    effectiveMediaUrl,
    85→    effectiveImageDimensions,
    86→  };
    87→}
    88→

    30→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    31→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    32→    return projectId;
    33→  }
    34→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    35→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    36→    return selectedProjectId;
    37→  }
    38→  return null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    43→ */
    44→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  generationIds: string[],
    47→  projectId: string | null,
    48→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    49→) {
    50→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    51→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    52→  const {
    53→    batchSize = 5,
    54→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    55→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    56→  } = options;
    57→
    58→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    59→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    60→
    61→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    62→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    63→
    64→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    65→
    66→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    67→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    68→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    69→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    70→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    71→        cacheEntry,
    72→      );
    73→
    74→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    75→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    76→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    77→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    78→          showToast: false,
    79→        });
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    83→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    84→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    85→          queryFn: async () => {
    86→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    87→              .from('tasks')
    88→              .select('*')
    89→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    90→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    91→              .single();
    92→
    93→            if (error) throw error;
    94→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    95→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    96→            }
    97→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    98→          },
    99→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   100→        }));
   101→      }
   102→    });
   103→
   104→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   105→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   109→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→}
   113→
   114→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   115→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   116→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   117→  projectId: string | null,
   118→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   119→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   120→
   121→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   122→    const generationId = getGenerationId(generation);
   123→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   124→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   125→    );
   126→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   127→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   128→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   129→      : null;
   130→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   131→
   132→    return {
   133→      ...generation,
   134→      taskId,
   135→      taskData,
   136→      taskMappingStatus,
   137→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   138→    };
   139→  });
   140→}

    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {

    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',

    31→    }

    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,

    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );

    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {

    69→    } finally {

    71→    }

    73→}

    11→type OAuthIntentCacheResult = OperationResult<{ cached: boolean }>;
    12→
    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {
    14→  try {
    15→    localStorage.setItem('oauthInProgress', 'true');
    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    17→  } catch (error) {
    18→    return operationFailure(error, {
    19→      policy: 'degrade',
    20→      recoverable: true,
    21→      errorCode: 'oauth_intent_cache_failed',
    22→      message: 'Unable to cache OAuth intent in local storage.',
    23→      cause: error,
    24→    });
    25→  }
    26→}

    28→export function useDiscordSignIn() {
    29→  return useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    31→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    32→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    33→        policy: 'degrade',
    34→        recoverable: true,
    35→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    36→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized yet.',
    37→      });
    38→    }
    39→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    40→    const intentCacheResult = cacheOAuthIntentFlag();
    41→    if (!intentCacheResult.ok) {
    42→      normalizeAndPresentError(intentCacheResult.error, {
    43→        context: 'useDiscordSignIn.cacheOauthIntent',
    44→        showToast: false,
    45→        logData: {
    46→          errorCode: intentCacheResult.errorCode,
    47→          policy: intentCacheResult.policy,
    48→          recoverable: intentCacheResult.recoverable,
    49→        },
    50→      });
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    const oauthStartResult = await runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    54→      context: 'useDiscordSignIn.startOAuth',
    55→      errorCode: 'discord_oauth_start_failed',
    56→      showToast: true,
    57→      toastTitle: 'Failed to start Discord sign-in. Please try again.',

     5→import {

     9→import {

    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {

    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

    40→function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {

    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {
    45→  const record = asObjectRecord(value) ?? {};
    46→  const parsed: TaskCostParams = {};
    47→
    48→  const resolution = asString(record.resolution);
    49→  if (resolution) {
    50→    parsed.resolution = resolution;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const frameCount = asNumber(record.frame_count);
    54→  if (frameCount !== undefined) {
    55→    parsed.frame_count = frameCount;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceMetrics;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;

    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {

   193→
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceMetrics {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→}
   208→
   209→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   210→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   211→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   212→}
   213→
   214→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   215→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   216→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: TaskCostParams): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   217→  let totalCost = 0;
   218→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   219→
   220→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   221→  const result = taskParams.result ?? (taskParams as VideoEnhanceMetrics);
   222→
   223→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   224→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   225→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   226→    totalCost += filmCost;
   227→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   228→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   229→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   230→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   235→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   236→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   237→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   238→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   239→    breakdown.upscale = {
   240→      output_width: result.output_width,
   241→      output_height: result.output_height,
   242→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   243→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   244→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   245→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   246→    };
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return {
   250→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   251→    breakdown,
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→interface CostFactors {
   256→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   257→  frameCount?: number;
   258→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   259→}
   260→
   261→interface TaskCostParams {
   262→  resolution?: string;
   263→  frame_count?: number;
   264→  model_type?: string;
   265→  result?: VideoEnhanceMetrics;
   266→  [key: string]: unknown;
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   270→export function calculateTaskCost(
   271→  taskType: string,
   272→  billingType: string,
   273→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   274→  unitCost: number,
   275→  durationSeconds: number,
   276→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   277→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   278→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   279→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   280→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   281→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   282→  }
   283→
   284→  let totalCost;
   285→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   286→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   287→  } else {
   288→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   289→  }
   290→
   291→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   292→  if (costFactors) {
   293→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   294→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   295→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   296→    }
   297→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   298→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   299→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   300→      } else {
   301→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   302→      }
   303→    }
   304→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   305→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   306→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   307→    }
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   311→}
   312→

    67→function useSegmentController(
    68→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {

    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {

    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);

    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(
   107→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.shotId || null : null,
   108→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.projectId || null : null
   109→  );

   111→  const segmentLightbox = useSegmentLightboxState(segmentSlots, props.onPairClick);

   113→  return {

   119→}

   121→function useSegmentLightboxState(
   122→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
   123→  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
   124→): SegmentLightboxState {
   125→  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
   126→
   127→  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
   128→    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
   129→    if (onPairClick && slot) {
   130→      onPairClick(slot.index);
   131→      return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
   135→  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
   136→
   137→  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
   138→  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
   139→    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
   140→    : null;
   141→
   142→  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
   143→    () =>
   144→      segmentSlots
   145→        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
   146→        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
   147→    [segmentSlots]
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
   151→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   152→      return;
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   156→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   157→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[nextPos]);
   158→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   159→
   160→  const handleSegmentLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
   161→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   162→      return;
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   166→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + segmentChildSlotIndices.length) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   167→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[prevPos]);
   168→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   169→
   170→  const closeSegmentLightbox = useCallback(() => {
   171→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(null);
   172→  }, []);
   173→
   174→  return {

   176→    currentSegmentSlot,
   177→    currentSegmentMedia,
   178→    segmentChildSlotIndices,
   179→    handleSegmentClick,
   180→    handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   181→    handleSegmentLightboxPrev,

   183→  };

    82→

   101→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   102→  value: unknown,
   103→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   104→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   105→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   106→    : {};
   107→
   108→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   109→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   110→  );
   111→
   112→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   113→    ? record.structure_videos
   114→    : [];
   115→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   116→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   117→  );
   118→
   119→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   120→}
   121→
   122→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   123→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   124→  options?: {
   125→    context?: string;
   126→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   127→  },
   128→): boolean {
   129→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   130→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   131→    return false;
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   135→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   136→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   137→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   138→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   139→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   140→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   141→  });
   142→}

   145→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   146→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   147→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.

   149→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   150→  value: unknown,
   151→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   152→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   153→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   154→  if (!settings) {

   166→  );
   167→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   168→
   169→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   170→    ? settings.structure_videos
   171→    : null;
   172→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   173→    return rawStructureVideos
   174→      .map((entry) => {
   175→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   176→        if (!record) {
   177→          return null;
   178→        }
   179→
   180→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   181→        if (!path) {
   182→          return null;
   183→        }
   184→
   185→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   186→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);

     2→import { EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS } from '@/domains/lora/lib/loraUtils';
     3→
     4→export type LoraMode = 'none' | 'in-scene' | 'next-scene' | 'custom';
     5→
     6→interface UseEditModeLorasReturn {
     7→  // Mode selection for automatic LoRAs
     8→  loraMode: LoraMode;
     9→  setLoraMode: (mode: LoraMode) => void;
    10→  
    11→  // Custom URL support
    12→  customLoraUrl: string;
    13→  setCustomLoraUrl: (url: string) => void;

    15→  // The computed LoRAs based on mode

    19→  isInSceneBoostEnabled: boolean;
    20→  setIsInSceneBoostEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Hook to manage LoRA mode state for image editing operations
    25→ * Supports: In-Scene, Next Scene, Custom, or None
    26→ * Used by both inpainting and magic edit modes
    27→ */
    28→export const useEditModeLoras = (): UseEditModeLorasReturn => {
    29→  const [loraMode, setLoraMode] = useState<LoraMode>('none'); // Default to no preset LoRA
    30→  const [customLoraUrl, setCustomLoraUrl] = useState<string>('');
    31→
    32→  // Legacy boolean support - map to new lora mode
    33→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = loraMode !== 'none';
    34→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
    35→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
    36→  };
    37→
    38→  // Build loras array based on selected mode
    39→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {
    40→    switch (loraMode) {
    41→      case 'in-scene':
    42→        return [{
    43→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['in-scene'],
    44→          strength: 1.0
    45→        }];
    46→      case 'next-scene':
    47→        return [{
    48→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['next-scene'],
    49→          strength: 1.0
    50→        }];
    51→      case 'custom':
    52→        // Only return custom lora if URL is provided
    53→        return customLoraUrl.trim() ? [{
    54→          url: customLoraUrl.trim(),
    55→          strength: 1.0
    56→        }] : undefined;
    57→      case 'none':
    58→      default:
    59→        return undefined;
    60→    }
    61→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
    62→
    63→  return {
    64→    // Mode selection
    65→    loraMode,
    66→    setLoraMode,
    67→    // Custom URL
    68→    customLoraUrl,

     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseRelativeTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseRelativeTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,

    39→  });

   301→function PanelLayoutView({ props }: { props: LightboxLayoutProps }) {
   302→  const core = useLightboxCoreSafe();
   303→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationSafe();

   305→  const layout = useLightboxLayoutComputed(props);
   306→
   307→  const isDesktopPanel = layout.isSidePanelLayout;
   308→  const showAnnotationControls = imageEdit.isSpecialEditMode && imageEdit.editMode === 'annotate';
   309→
   310→  return (
   311→    <div
   312→      data-lightbox-bg
   313→      className={cn('w-full h-full bg-black/90', isDesktopPanel ? 'flex' : 'flex flex-col')}
   314→      onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
   315→    >
   316→      <div
   317→        data-lightbox-bg
   318→        className={cn('flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden', isDesktopPanel ? 'flex-1 touch-none' : 'flex-none touch-none z-10')}
   319→        style={isDesktopPanel
   320→          ? { width: '60%' }
   321→          : {
   322→              height: '50%',
   323→              transform: navigation.swipeNavigation.isSwiping
   324→                ? `translateX(${navigation.swipeNavigation.swipeOffset}px)`
   325→                : undefined,
   326→              transition: navigation.swipeNavigation.isSwiping ? 'none' : 'transform 0.2s ease-out',

   338→            hasNext={navigation.hasNext}
   339→            variant="desktop"

   348→        {showAnnotationControls && (

   350→            selectedShapeId={imageEdit.selectedShapeId}

   354→            onToggleFreeForm={imageEdit.handleToggleFreeForm}
   355→            onDeleteSelected={imageEdit.handleDeleteSelected}
   356→            positionStrategy="fixed"
   357→            freeFormActiveClassName="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
   358→            freeFormInactiveClassName="bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   359→            deleteButtonClassName="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white"
   360→          />
   361→        )}
   362→        <OverlayElements props={props} topCenterClassName={layout.topCenterClassName} showFloatingTools={true} />
   363→
   364→        {!isDesktopPanel && (
   365→          <NavigationArrows
   366→            showNavigation={navigation.showNavigation}
   367→            readOnly={core.readOnly}
   368→            onPrevious={navigation.handleSlotNavPrev}
   369→            onNext={navigation.handleSlotNavNext}
   370→            hasPrevious={navigation.hasPrevious}
   371→            hasNext={navigation.hasNext}
   372→            variant="mobile"

   377→      <div
   378→        data-task-details-panel
   379→        className={cn('bg-background overflow-hidden relative z-[60] overscroll-none', isDesktopPanel ? 'border-l border-border h-full' : 'border-t border-border overflow-y-auto')}
   380→        style={isDesktopPanel ? { width: '40%' } : { height: '50%' }}
   381→      >
   382→        {props.controlsPanelContent}
   383→      </div>
   384→    </div>
   385→  );
   386→}

   388→function CenteredLayoutView({ props }: { props: LightboxLayoutProps }) {

   395→

   398→      data-lightbox-bg
   399→      className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 md:gap-6 px-3 py-4 sm:px-4 sm:py-6 md:px-6 md:py-8 w-full h-full touch-none"
   400→      onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}

   416→        }}
   417→        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
   418→        {...navigation.swipeNavigation.swipeHandlers}
   419→      >
   420→        <MediaContent
   421→          layout={layout}
   422→          effectiveTasksPaneOpen={props.effectiveTasksPaneOpen}
   423→          effectiveTasksPaneWidth={props.effectiveTasksPaneWidth}
   424→        />
   425→        {showAnnotationControls && (
   426→          <AnnotationFloatingControls
   427→            selectedShapeId={imageEdit.selectedShapeId}

   436→            deleteButtonClassName="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white"

   439→        <OverlayElements

   441→          topCenterClassName="absolute top-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2"
   442→          showFloatingTools={false}
   443→        />
   444→        <CompactEditControls />
   445→
   446→        <NavigationArrows
