   448→          readOnly={core.readOnly}
   449→          onPrevious={navigation.handleSlotNavPrev}
   450→          onNext={navigation.handleSlotNavNext}
   451→          hasPrevious={navigation.hasPrevious}
   452→          hasNext={navigation.hasNext}
   453→          variant="mobile"
   454→        />
   455→      </div>
   456→
   457→    </div>
   458→  );
   459→}
   460→
   461→export const LightboxLayout: React.FC<LightboxLayoutProps> = (props) => {
   462→  return props.showPanel
   463→    ? <PanelLayoutView props={props} />
   464→    : <CenteredLayoutView props={props} />;
   465→};

    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;

    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {

    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,

    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
    25→): Record<string, unknown> {
    26→  const overrideProps: Record<string, unknown> = { ...childProps };
    27→
    28→  for (const propName in childProps) {
    29→    const slotPropValue = slotProps[propName];
    30→    const childPropValue = childProps[propName];
    31→
    32→    const isHandler = /^on[A-Z]/.test(propName);
    33→    if (isHandler) {
    34→      if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function' && typeof childPropValue === 'function') {
    35→        overrideProps[propName] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    36→          (childPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    37→          (slotPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    38→        };
    39→      } else if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function') {
    40→        overrideProps[propName] = slotPropValue;
    41→      }
    42→    } else if (propName === 'style') {
    43→      const slotStyle = typeof slotPropValue === 'object' && slotPropValue ? slotPropValue : {};
    44→      const childStyle = typeof childPropValue === 'object' && childPropValue ? childPropValue : {};
    45→      overrideProps[propName] = { ...slotStyle, ...childStyle };
    46→    } else if (propName === 'className') {
    47→      overrideProps[propName] = [slotPropValue, childPropValue].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return { ...slotProps, ...overrideProps };
    52→}
    53→
    54→function composeRefs<T>(...refs: (React.Ref<T> | undefined | null)[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
    55→  return (node) => {
    56→    refs.forEach((ref) => {
    57→      if (typeof ref === 'function') {
    58→        ref(node);
    59→      } else if (ref != null) {
    60→        (ref as React.MutableRefObject<T | null>).current = node;
    61→      }
    62→    });
    63→  };
    64→}
    65→
    66→export { Slot };
    67→

    66→
    67→function useSegmentController(
    68→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {
    73→      return undefined;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    const orderedImages = currentImages.filter(
    77→      (image) => isPositioned(image) && !isVideoGeneration(image)
    78→    );
    79→    if (orderedImages.length === 0) {
    80→      return undefined;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const positions = new Map<string, number>();
    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {
    86→        positions.set(image.id, index);
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);
    91→
    92→  const shouldFetchSegments = props.generationMode !== 'timeline' &&
    93→    (!props.segmentSlots || (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0));
    94→
    95→  const hookResult = useSegmentOutputsForShot(
    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(
   107→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.shotId || null : null,
   108→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.projectId || null : null
   109→  );
   110→
   111→  const segmentLightbox = useSegmentLightboxState(segmentSlots, props.onPairClick);
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    segmentSlots,
   115→    selectedParentId,
   116→    hasPendingTask,
   117→    segmentLightbox,
   118→  };
   119→}
   120→
   121→function useSegmentLightboxState(
   122→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
   123→  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
   124→): SegmentLightboxState {
   125→  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
   126→
   127→  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
   128→    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
   129→    if (onPairClick && slot) {
   130→      onPairClick(slot.index);
   131→      return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
   135→  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
   136→
   137→  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
   138→  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
   139→    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
   140→    : null;
   141→
   142→  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
   143→    () =>
   144→      segmentSlots
   145→        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
   146→        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
   147→    [segmentSlots]
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
   151→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   152→      return;
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   156→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   157→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[nextPos]);
   158→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   159→
   160→  const handleSegmentLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
   161→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   162→      return;
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   166→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + segmentChildSlotIndices.length) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   167→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[prevPos]);
   168→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   169→
   170→  const closeSegmentLightbox = useCallback(() => {
   171→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(null);
   172→  }, []);
   173→
   174→  return {
   175→    segmentLightboxIndex,
   176→    currentSegmentSlot,
   177→    currentSegmentMedia,
   178→    segmentChildSlotIndices,
   179→    handleSegmentClick,
   180→    handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   181→    handleSegmentLightboxPrev,
   182→    closeSegmentLightbox,
   183→  };
   184→}
   185→
   186→function useShotImageManagerContainerState(
   187→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
   188→  isMobile: boolean
   189→): ShotImageManagerContainerState {
   190→  const optimistic = useOptimisticOrder({ images: props.images });
   191→  const setLightboxIndexRef = useRef<(index: number) => void>(() => {});
   192→
   193→  const externalGens = useExternalGenerations({
   194→    selectedShotId: props.selectedShotId,
   195→    optimisticOrder: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   196→    images: props.images,
   197→    setLightboxIndexRef,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  const [lightboxSelectedShotId, setLightboxSelectedShotId] = useState<string | undefined>(props.selectedShotId);
   201→
   202→  const selection = useSelection({
   203→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   204→    isMobile,
   205→    generationMode: props.generationMode,
   206→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   207→  });
   208→
   209→  const lightbox = useLightbox({
   210→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   211→    externalGenerations: externalGens.externalGenerations,
   212→    tempDerivedGenerations: externalGens.tempDerivedGenerations,
   213→    derivedNavContext: externalGens.derivedNavContext,
   214→    handleOpenExternalGeneration: externalGens.handleOpenExternalGeneration,
   215→  });
   216→  const segments = useSegmentController(props, lightbox.currentImages);
   217→
   218→  useEffect(() => {
   219→    setLightboxIndexRef.current = lightbox.setLightboxIndex;
   220→  }, [lightbox.setLightboxIndex]);
   221→
   222→  const dragAndDrop = useDragAndDrop({
   223→    images: lightbox.currentImages,
   224→    selectedIds: selection.selectedIds,
   225→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   226→    isMobile,
   227→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   228→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   229→    setOptimisticOrder: optimistic.setOptimisticOrder,
   230→    setIsOptimisticUpdate: optimistic.setIsOptimisticUpdate,
   231→    setReconciliationId: optimistic.setReconciliationId,
   232→    onDragStateChange: props.onDragStateChange,
   233→  });
   234→
   235→  const batchOps = useBatchOperations({
   236→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   237→    onImageDelete: props.onImageDelete,
   238→    onBatchImageDelete: props.onBatchImageDelete,
   239→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   240→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   241→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   242→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   243→  });
   244→
   245→  const mobileGestures = useMobileGestures({
   246→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   247→    mobileSelectedIds: selection.mobileSelectedIds,
   248→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   249→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   250→    setLightboxIndex: lightbox.setLightboxIndex,
   251→  });
   252→
   253→  const getFramePosition = useMemo(
   254→    () => (index: number) =>
   255→      getFramePositionForIndex(
   256→        index,
   257→        lightbox.currentImages,
   258→        props.batchVideoFrames || DEFAULT_BATCH_VIDEO_FRAMES
   259→      ),
   260→    [lightbox.currentImages, props.batchVideoFrames]
   261→  );
   262→
   263→  const selectionOrder: SelectionOrderController = {
   264→    optimistic,
   265→    selection,
   266→    dragAndDrop,
   267→    batchOps,
   268→    mobileGestures,
   269→    getFramePosition,
   270→  };
   271→
   272→  const navigation: NavigationController = {
   273→    lightbox,
   274→    externalGens,
   275→    shotSelector: {
   276→      lightboxSelectedShotId,
   277→      setLightboxSelectedShotId,
   278→    },
   279→  };
   280→
   281→  return {
   282→    selectionOrder,
   283→    navigation,
   284→    segments,
   285→  };
   286→}
   287→
   288→function SegmentLightboxModal({
   289→  segmentLightbox,
   290→  selectedParentId,
   291→  shotId,
   292→  readOnly,
   293→}: {
   294→  segmentLightbox: SegmentLightboxState;

    95→
    96→  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    97→    const touch = e.touches[0];
    98→    touchStartRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
    99→  };
   100→
   101→  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   102→    if (!onMobileTap || !touchStartRef.current) return;
   103→
   104→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   105→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartRef.current.x);
   106→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartRef.current.y);
   107→
   108→    // Only trigger tap if movement is minimal (< 10px in any direction)
   109→    // This prevents accidental selection during scrolling
   110→    if (deltaX < 10 && deltaY < 10) {
   111→      e.preventDefault();
   112→      onMobileTap();
   113→    }
   114→
   115→    touchStartRef.current = null;
   116→  };
   117→
   118→  const style = {
   119→    transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
   120→    transition,
   121→    opacity: isDragging ? 0.5 : 1,
   122→    touchAction: isDragDisabled ? 'auto' : 'none',
   123→    ...aspectRatioStyle, // Apply aspect ratio to maintain consistent dimensions
   124→  };
   125→
   126→  const handleDeleteClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   127→    e.preventDefault();
   128→    e.stopPropagation();
   129→    e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation();
   130→    // Use id (shot_generations.id) - unique per entry
   131→    onDelete(image.id);
   132→  };
   133→
   134→  const handleDuplicateClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   135→    e.preventDefault();
   136→    e.stopPropagation();
   137→    e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation();
   138→    if (onDuplicate && timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   139→      // Use id (shot_generations.id) - unique per entry
   140→      onDuplicate(image.id, timeline_frame);
   141→    }
   142→  };
   143→
   144→  const finalClassName = cn(
   145→    "group relative border rounded-lg overflow-hidden cursor-pointer bg-card hover:ring-2 hover:ring-primary/50 transition-colors",
   146→    isSelected && "ring-4 ring-orange-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background bg-orange-500/15 border-orange-500",
   147→    isDragDisabled && "cursor-default"
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  return (
   151→    <div
   152→      ref={setNodeRef}
   153→      style={style}
   154→      className={finalClassName}
   155→      data-selected={isSelected}
   156→      data-image-id={image.id?.substring(0, 8)}
   157→      {...(!isDragDisabled ? attributes : {})}
   158→      onClick={(e) => {
   159→        // Check if the click originated from a button or its children
   160→        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   161→        const isButtonClick = target.closest('button') !== null;
   162→
   163→        // Don't trigger onClick if the click came from a button
   164→        if (!isButtonClick) {
   165→          onClick?.(e);
   166→        }
   167→      }}
   168→      onPointerDown={(e) => {
   169→        // Check if the pointer down originated from a button or its children
   170→        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   171→        const isButtonClick = target.closest('button') !== null;
   172→
   173→        // Don't trigger onPointerDown if the click came from a button
   174→        if (!isButtonClick) {
   175→          onPointerDown?.(e);
   176→        }
   177→      }}
   178→      onDoubleClick={isMobile ? undefined : onDoubleClick}
   179→    >
   180→      {/* Progressive image display */}
   181→      <img
   182→        ref={progressiveRef}
   183→        src={shouldLoad ? displayImageUrl : '/placeholder.svg'}
   184→        alt={`Generated image ${Math.floor((timeline_frame ?? 0) / 50) + 1}`}
   185→        className={cn(
   186→          "w-full h-full object-cover transition-all duration-200",
   187→          // Progressive loading visual states
   188→          isThumbShowing && "opacity-95",
   189→          isFullLoaded && "opacity-100"
   190→        )}
   191→        onTouchStart={isMobile ? handleTouchStart : undefined}
   192→        onTouchEnd={isMobile ? handleTouchEnd : undefined}
   193→        loading="lazy"
   194→        draggable={false}
   195→        {...(!isDragDisabled ? listeners : {})}
   196→        onError={(e) => {
   197→          // Fallback to original URL if display URL fails
   198→          const target = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
   199→          if (target.src !== fallbackImageUrl) {
   200→            target.src = fallbackImageUrl;
   201→          }
   202→        }}
   203→      />
   204→
   205→      {/* Time overlay - bottom (showing position-based time in seconds) */}
   206→      {(displayTimeSeconds !== undefined || timeline_frame !== undefined) && (
   207→        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-black/60 text-white text-[10px] leading-none text-center py-0.5 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap overflow-hidden">
   208→          <span className="inline-block">
   209→            {displayTimeSeconds !== undefined
   210→              ? `${displayTimeSeconds.toFixed(2)}s`
   211→              : framesToSeconds(timeline_frame!)}
   212→          </span>
   213→        </div>

   215→
   216→      {(!isMobile || !isDragDisabled) && (

   218→          {/* Variant Count + NEW badge - bottom, above time */}
   219→          <VariantBadge

   226→            onMarkAllViewed={handleMarkAllVariantsViewed}

   230→          <div className="absolute top-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10">
   231→            {onDuplicate && timeline_frame !== undefined && (

     3→
     4→interface UseMediaGalleryDebugToolsOptions {

    12→export function useMediaGalleryDebugTools(options: UseMediaGalleryDebugToolsOptions): void {
    13→  const {
    14→    currentToolType,
    15→    filtersMediaType,
    16→    defaultFiltersMediaType,
    17→    imagesLength,
    18→    isMobile,
    19→  } = options;

    22→
    23→  useEffect(() => {
    24→    if (!import.meta.env.DEV) {
    25→      return;
    26→    }
    27→
    28→    const mediaType = filtersMediaType ?? defaultFiltersMediaType ?? 'all';
    29→    const isVideoGallery = currentToolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES && mediaType === 'video';
    30→    if (!isVideoGallery) {
    31→      return;
    32→    }
    33→
    34→    if (videoGalleryDebugRef.current.lastImagesLength !== imagesLength) {
    35→      videoGalleryDebugRef.current.lastImagesLength = imagesLength;
    36→    }
    37→  }, [currentToolType, defaultFiltersMediaType, filtersMediaType, imagesLength]);
    38→
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    window.debugMobile = () => {
    45→      const freshIsMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;

    48→        hookReportedMobile: isMobile,
    49→        windowWidth: window.innerWidth,
    50→        windowHeight: window.innerHeight,
    51→        touchSupported: 'ontouchstart' in window,
    52→      };
    53→    };
    54→
    55→    return () => {
    56→      delete window.debugMobile;
    57→    };
    58→  }, [isMobile]);
    59→}

1→/**
     2→ * DataFreshnessManager - Single source of truth for data freshness and polling decisions
     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
    12→
    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
    14→type RealtimeStatus = 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    15→type PollingInterval = number | false; // false = no polling
    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {
    19→  return JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    20→}
    21→
    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(
    23→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }
    49→  return now - lastEvent < freshnessThreshold;
    50→}
    51→
    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(
    53→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    54→  now: number,
    55→  parseQueryKey: (rawKey: string) => unknown,
    56→): Array<{ query: unknown; ageMs: number; ageSec: number }> {
    57→  return Array.from(lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => ({
    58→    query: parseQueryKey(key),
    59→    ageMs: now - time,
    60→    ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000),
    61→  }));
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface DataFreshnessState {
    65→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    66→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    67→  lastStatusChange: number;
    68→  /** Track consecutive fetch failures per query for circuit breaker */
    69→  fetchFailures: Map<string, { count: number; lastFailure: number }>;
    70→}
    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→
    90→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    91→    try {
    92→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);
    93→    } catch {
    94→      return rawKey;
    95→    }
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {
   108→      return; // Don't update state or notify subscribers for duplicates
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Actual status transition - update state
   112→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
   113→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
   114→
   115→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
   116→    this.notifySubscribers();
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  /**
   120→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
   121→   */
   122→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   123→    const now = Date.now();
   124→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, affectedQueries, now);
   125→
   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
   127→    this.notifySubscribers();
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */
   134→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
   142→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }
   146→
   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   173→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   174→
   175→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   176→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   177→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   178→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→
   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();

   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {

   136→    enabled: allProjects ? !!allProjectIds?.length : !!effectiveProjectId,

   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceMetrics {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→}
   208→
   209→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   210→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   211→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   212→}
   213→
   214→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   215→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   216→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: TaskCostParams): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   217→  let totalCost = 0;
   218→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   219→
   220→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   221→  const result = taskParams.result ?? (taskParams as VideoEnhanceMetrics);
   222→
   223→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   224→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   225→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   226→    totalCost += filmCost;
   227→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   228→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   229→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   230→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   235→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   236→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   237→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   238→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   239→    breakdown.upscale = {
   240→      output_width: result.output_width,
   241→      output_height: result.output_height,
   242→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   243→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   244→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   245→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   246→    };
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return {
   250→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   251→    breakdown,
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→interface CostFactors {
   256→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   257→  frameCount?: number;
   258→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   259→}
   260→
   261→interface TaskCostParams {
   262→  resolution?: string;
   263→  frame_count?: number;
   264→  model_type?: string;
   265→  result?: VideoEnhanceMetrics;
   266→  [key: string]: unknown;
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   270→export function calculateTaskCost(
   271→  taskType: string,
   272→  billingType: string,
   273→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   274→  unitCost: number,
   275→  durationSeconds: number,
   276→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   277→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   278→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   279→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   280→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   281→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   282→  }
   283→
   284→  let totalCost;
   285→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   286→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   287→  } else {
   288→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   289→  }
   290→
   291→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   292→  if (costFactors) {
   293→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   294→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   295→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   296→    }
   297→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   298→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   299→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   300→      } else {
   301→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   302→      }
   303→    }
   304→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   305→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   306→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   307→    }
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   311→}
   312→

     2→import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {
    64→        policy: 'best_effort',
    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {
    64→        policy: 'best_effort',
    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }

   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },
   160→      task_type_config: taskTypeConfig,
   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {
   167→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {

   179→  errorCode: string,

   190→    },
   191→  );
   192→}

   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceMetrics {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→}
   208→
   209→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   210→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   211→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   212→}
   213→
   214→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   215→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   216→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: TaskCostParams): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   217→  let totalCost = 0;
   218→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   219→
   220→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   221→  const result = taskParams.result ?? (taskParams as VideoEnhanceMetrics);
   222→
   223→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   224→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   225→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   226→    totalCost += filmCost;
   227→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   228→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   229→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   230→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   235→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   236→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   237→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   238→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   239→    breakdown.upscale = {
   240→      output_width: result.output_width,
   241→      output_height: result.output_height,
   242→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   243→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   244→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   245→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   246→    };
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return {
   250→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   251→    breakdown,
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→interface CostFactors {
   256→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   257→  frameCount?: number;
   258→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   259→}
   260→
   261→interface TaskCostParams {
   262→  resolution?: string;
   263→  frame_count?: number;
   264→  model_type?: string;
   265→  result?: VideoEnhanceMetrics;
   266→  [key: string]: unknown;
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   270→export function calculateTaskCost(
   271→  taskType: string,
   272→  billingType: string,
   273→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   274→  unitCost: number,
   275→  durationSeconds: number,
   276→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   277→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   278→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   279→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   280→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   281→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   282→  }
   283→
   284→  let totalCost;
   285→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   286→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   287→  } else {
   288→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   289→  }
   290→
   291→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   292→  if (costFactors) {
   293→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   294→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   295→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   296→    }
   297→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   298→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   299→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   300→      } else {
   301→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   302→      }
   303→    }
   304→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   305→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   306→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   307→    }
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   311→}

     2→ * PreloadingService - Unified coordinator for all image preloading

     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:

    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {

    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;

    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();

    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {

    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→

   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  /**
   152→   * Pause all preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open).
   153→   */
   154→  pause(): void {
   155→    if (this.state.isPaused) return;
   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();
   240→
   241→// Expose for debugging in browser console (dev only)
   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   243→  (window as unknown as { __PRELOADING_SERVICE__: PreloadingService }).__PRELOADING_SERVICE__ =
   244→    preloadingService;
   245→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,

    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    18→ */
    19→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    20→  if (!params) return {};
    21→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    22→    try {
    23→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    24→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    25→    } catch {
    26→      return {};
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    30→}

    32→/**

    34→ *
    35→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    36→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    37→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    38→ *
    39→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    40→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    41→ */
    42→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    43→  const params = parsedParams;
    44→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    45→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    46→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    47→      return travelImages;
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    52→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    53→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    54→
    55→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    56→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    57→
    58→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    59→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    60→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    61→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    62→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    63→    }
    64→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    65→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    66→      const urls: string[] = [];
    67→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    68→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    69→      return urls;
    70→    }

    72→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {

    85→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    86→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    87→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    89→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    90→
    91→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    92→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {

    94→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    95→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    96→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    97→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    98→  }
    99→

   103→/**
   104→ * Extract prompt from task params
   105→ *
   106→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   107→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   108→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt

   110→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,

   112→ *
   113→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object

   115→ */
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   120→  }

   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);

   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt

   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,

   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly

   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);

   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],

   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}
   375→

    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;

    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

   224→  }

   230→      'mode',
   231→    );
   232→  }

   234→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   235→      "video_edit.source_video_url is required when video_edit config is provided",
   236→      'video_edit',
   237→    );
   238→  }
   239→  if (params.mode !== 'video_edit' && videoEdit) {
   240→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",
   242→      'mode',

   244→  }

   246→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   247→      "clip_source.kind must be clips when mode is multi_clip",
   248→      'mode',
   249→    );
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'
   253→    ? 'video_edit_join'
   254→    : 'multi_clip_join';
   255→
   256→  return {

   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,

   288→    })),

   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,

   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,

   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },

   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {

   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),

   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });

   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {

   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {

   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,

   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
