    27→  task_type_config: TaskTypeConfig | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskParseFailure {
    31→  errorCode: "task_shape_invalid";
    32→  message: string;
    33→  details: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→type TaskParseResult =
    37→  | { ok: true; task: TaskWithProject }
    38→  | { ok: false; failure: TaskParseFailure };
    39→
    40→function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    41→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {
    45→  const record = asObjectRecord(value) ?? {};
    46→  const parsed: TaskCostParams = {};
    47→
    48→  const resolution = asString(record.resolution);
    49→  if (resolution) {
    50→    parsed.resolution = resolution;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const frameCount = asNumber(record.frame_count);
    54→  if (frameCount !== undefined) {
    55→    parsed.frame_count = frameCount;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceMetrics;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;
    77→}
    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);
    81→  if (!task) {
    82→    return {
    83→      ok: false,
    84→      failure: {
    85→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
    86→        message: "Task payload is not an object",
    87→        details: { received_type: typeof value },
    88→      },
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const id = asString(task.id);
    93→  const taskType = asString(task.task_type);
    94→  const projectId = asString(task.project_id);
    95→  if (!id || !taskType || !projectId) {
    96→    return {
    97→      ok: false,
    98→      failure: {
    99→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   100→        message: "Task payload missing required fields: id, task_type, or project_id",
   101→        details: {
   102→          has_id: !!id,
   103→          has_task_type: !!taskType,
   104→          has_project_id: !!projectId,
   105→        },
   106→      },
   107→    };
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  const projectsRaw = task.projects;
   111→  const projectRecord = asObjectRecord(projectsRaw)
   112→    ?? (Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? asObjectRecord(projectsRaw[0]) : null);
   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);
   114→  if (!userId) {
   115→    return {
   116→      ok: false,
   117→      failure: {
   118→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   119→        message: "Task payload missing projects.user_id",
   120→        details: {
   121→          projects_type: Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? "array" : typeof projectsRaw,
   122→          has_projects_user_id: false,
   123→        },
   124→      },
   125→    };
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const params = parseTaskCostParams(task.params);
   129→  const status = asString(task.status) ?? "unknown";
   130→
   131→  // Extract task_types FK join (PostgREST returns object or null)
   132→  let taskTypeConfig: TaskTypeConfig | null = null;
   133→  const ttRaw = asObjectRecord(task.task_types);
   134→  if (ttRaw) {
   135→    const ttId = asString(ttRaw.id);
   136→    const billingType = asString(ttRaw.billing_type);
   137→    if (ttId && billingType) {
   138→      taskTypeConfig = {
   139→        id: ttId,
   140→        billing_type: billingType,
   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },
   160→      task_type_config: taskTypeConfig,
   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   165→// Helper for standard JSON responses with CORS headers
   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {

   190→    },

   193→
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceMetrics {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→}
   208→
   209→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   210→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   211→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   212→}
   213→
   214→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   215→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   216→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: TaskCostParams): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   217→  let totalCost = 0;
   218→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   219→
   220→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   221→  const result = taskParams.result ?? (taskParams as VideoEnhanceMetrics);
   222→
   223→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   224→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   225→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   226→    totalCost += filmCost;
   227→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   228→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   229→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   230→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   235→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   236→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   237→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   238→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   239→    breakdown.upscale = {
   240→      output_width: result.output_width,
   241→      output_height: result.output_height,
   242→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   243→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   244→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   245→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   246→    };
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return {
   250→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   251→    breakdown,
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→interface CostFactors {
   256→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   257→  frameCount?: number;
   258→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   259→}
   260→
   261→interface TaskCostParams {
   262→  resolution?: string;
   263→  frame_count?: number;
   264→  model_type?: string;
   265→  result?: VideoEnhanceMetrics;
   266→  [key: string]: unknown;
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   270→export function calculateTaskCost(
   271→  taskType: string,
   272→  billingType: string,
   273→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   274→  unitCost: number,
   275→  durationSeconds: number,
   276→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   277→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   278→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   279→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   280→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   281→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   282→  }
   283→
   284→  let totalCost;
   285→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   286→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   287→  } else {
   288→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   289→  }
   290→
   291→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   292→  if (costFactors) {
   293→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   294→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   295→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   296→    }
   297→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   298→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   299→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   300→      } else {
   301→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   302→      }
   303→    }
   304→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   305→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   306→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   307→    }
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   311→}
   312→

   177→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   178→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   179→        requestParams.project_id,
   180→        requestParams.resolution,
   181→      );
   182→
   183→      const taskParams = buildMagicEditTaskParams(requestParams, finalResolution);

   187→        taskType: "qwen_image_edit",

   191→  });

   194→/**
   195→ * Creates multiple magic edit tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   196→ * Used by MediaLightbox unified edit mode for creating multiple variations
   197→ * 
   198→ * @param params - Batch magic edit parameters
   199→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   200→ */
   201→export async function createBatchMagicEditTasks(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   202→
   203→  try {
   204→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   205→      batchParams: params,
   206→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchMagicEditParams,
   207→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<MagicEditTaskParams[]> => {
   208→        const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   209→          batchParams.project_id,
   210→          batchParams.resolution,
   211→        );
   212→
   213→        return Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   214→          const seedBase = resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: batchParams.seed, field: 'seed' });
   215→          const seed = seedBase + index;

   219→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   220→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   221→            negative_prompt: batchParams.negative_prompt,
   222→            resolution: finalResolution,

   225→            shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   226→            output_format: batchParams.output_format,
   227→            enable_sync_mode: batchParams.enable_sync_mode,

   230→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,

   234→            create_as_generation: batchParams.create_as_generation,
   235→            hires_fix: batchParams.hires_fix,
   236→            qwen_edit_model: batchParams.qwen_edit_model,
   237→          } as MagicEditTaskParams;
   238→        });
   239→      },
   240→      createSingleTask: createMagicEditTask,
   241→      operationName: 'createBatchMagicEditTasks',

   244→  } catch (error) {

   246→  }
   247→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→import { asRecord, asString, firstString } from '@/shared/lib/jsonNarrowing';
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}
   125→
   126→/**
   127→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   128→ */
   129→export interface RawVariant {
   130→  id: string;
   131→  generation_id: string;
   132→  location: string;
   133→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   134→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   135→  variant_type?: string | null;
   136→  name?: string | null;
   137→  created_at: string;
   138→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   139→  is_primary?: boolean;
   140→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   145→ */
   146→export interface RawGeneration {
   147→  id: string;
   148→  location: string;
   149→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   150→  type?: string | null;
   151→  created_at: string;
   152→  updated_at?: string | null;
   153→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   154→  starred?: boolean | null;
   155→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   156→  based_on?: string | null;
   157→  name?: string | null;
   158→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   159→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   160→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   161→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   162→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   163→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   164→  child_order?: number | null;
   165→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   166→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   167→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   168→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   173→ */
   174→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   175→  id: string;
   176→  shot_id: string;
   177→  generation_id: string;
   178→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   179→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   180→  created_at?: string;
   181→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Options for transformation customization
   187→ */
   188→interface TransformOptions {
   189→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   191→  /** Timeline frame position */
   192→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   193→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   194→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   195→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   196→  shotId?: string;
   197→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   198→  verbose?: boolean;
   199→}
   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}

    16→/**

    19→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {

    32→/**

    36→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    37→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    38→ *
    39→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object

    42→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {

    54→
    55→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)

    61→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    62→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    63→    }

    68→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);

    72→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {

   103→/**
   104→ * Extract prompt from task params
   105→ *
   106→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   107→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   108→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   109→ *
   110→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   111→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   112→ *
   113→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   114→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   115→ */
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   123→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   124→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   125→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   126→
   127→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   128→
   129→  // For segment tasks, try to get enhanced prompt first
   130→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   131→    // Check for enhanced prompt - can be singular field or in expanded array
   132→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   133→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   134→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   135→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   136→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   137→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   138→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   139→    );
   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt
   143→    return (
   144→      pickFirstString(
   145→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,
   148→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   157→  // cleared the global prompt.
   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   160→  return (
   161→    pickFirstString(
   162→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   163→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   164→      params.base_prompt,
   165→      params.prompt,
   166→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   167→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   169→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   170→    ) ?? null
   171→  );
   172→}

   177→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {

   190→/**

   194→  return taskType === 'video_enhance';

   197→/**

   204→/**
   205→ * LoRA info extracted from task params

   209→  strength: number;
   210→  displayName: string;

   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   215→ */
   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→
   221→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}

     3→export interface OperationFailure {

     5→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;

     7→  error: Error;
     8→  errorCode: string;
     9→  message: string;

    11→}
    12→
    13→export interface OperationSuccess<T = void> {
    14→  ok: true;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  recoverable: false;
    17→  value: T;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T = void> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    23→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    27→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    28→  recoverable?: boolean;
    29→  errorCode?: string;
    30→  message?: string;
    31→  cause?: unknown;
    32→}
    33→
    34→export function operationSuccess<T>(
    35→  value: T,
    36→  options?: OperationSuccessOptions,
    37→): OperationSuccess<T> {
    38→  return {
    39→    ok: true,
    40→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    41→    recoverable: false,
    42→    value,
    43→  };
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function operationFailure(
    47→  error: unknown,
    48→  options?: OperationFailureOptions,
    49→): OperationFailure {
    50→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error
    51→    ? error
    52→    : new Error(options?.message ?? String(error));
    53→
    54→  return {
    55→    ok: false,
    56→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    57→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    58→    error: normalizedError,
    59→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    60→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    61→    cause: options?.cause,
    62→  };
    63→}

   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

   154→  for (const key of PER_JOIN_OVERRIDE_KEYS) {

   220→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   221→      "per_join_settings length cannot exceed the number of joins",
   222→      'per_join_settings'
   223→    );
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  const videoEdit = params.video_edit;
   227→  if (params.mode === 'video_edit' && !videoEdit) {
   228→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   229→      "video_edit config is required when mode is video_edit",
   230→      'mode',
   231→    );
   232→  }
   233→  if (videoEdit && !videoEdit.source_video_url) {
   234→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   235→      "video_edit.source_video_url is required when video_edit config is provided",
   236→      'video_edit',
   237→    );
   238→  }
   239→  if (params.mode !== 'video_edit' && videoEdit) {
   240→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",
   242→      'mode',
   243→    );
   244→  }
   245→  if (params.mode === 'multi_clip' && clipSource.kind !== 'clips') {
   246→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   247→      "clip_source.kind must be clips when mode is multi_clip",
   248→      'mode',
   249→    );
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'
   253→    ? 'video_edit_join'
   254→    : 'multi_clip_join';
   255→
   256→  return {
   257→    clipSequence,
   258→    clipSourceKind: clipSource.kind,
   259→    joinMode,
   260→    videoEdit,
   261→  };
   262→}
   263→
   264→/**
   265→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for join clips
   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)
   281→  const phaseConfig = params.phase_config || buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(params.loras || []);
   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   285→    clip_list: clipSequence.map(clip => ({
   286→      url: clip.url,
   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);
   326→
   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {
   328→    orchestratorDetails.loop_first_clip = true;
   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

   323→      username: input.addForm.created_by_is_you ? undefined : input.addForm.created_by_username,
   324→    },
   325→    huggingface_url: input.isMultiStageModel ? undefined : input.finalHuggingfaceUrl,

   337→      ? { low_noise_url: input.finalLowNoiseUrl.trim() }
   338→      : {}),

   341→
   342→function isButtonDisabled(args: UseLoraSubmissionArgs): boolean {
   343→  const { isSubmitting, isUploading, addForm, uploadMode, isEditMode, hasHfToken, isMultiStageModel, loraFiles } = args;
   344→  if (isSubmitting || isUploading) {
   345→    return true;
   346→  }
   347→
   348→  if (uploadMode === 'file' && !isEditMode && !hasHfToken) {
   349→    return true;
   350→  }
   351→
   352→  const mode = getSubmissionMode(uploadMode, isMultiStageModel, isEditMode);
   353→  return getValidationError(addForm, loraFiles, mode) !== null;
   354→}
   355→
   356→export function useLoraSubmission(args: UseLoraSubmissionArgs) {
   357→  const handleAddLoraFromForm = async () => {
   358→    const mode = getSubmissionMode(args.uploadMode, args.isMultiStageModel, args.isEditMode);
   359→    const validationError = getValidationError(args.addForm, args.loraFiles, mode);
   360→    if (validationError) {
   361→      toast.error(validationError);
   362→      return;
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    args.setIsSubmitting(true);
   366→
   367→    try {
   368→      const initialUrls: SubmissionUrls = {
   369→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: args.addForm.huggingface_url,
   370→        finalHighNoiseUrl: args.addForm.high_noise_url,
   371→        finalLowNoiseUrl: args.addForm.low_noise_url,
   372→      };
   373→
   374→      const resolvedUrls = await uploadToHuggingFaceIfNeeded(mode, {
   375→        addForm: args.addForm,
   376→        userName: args.userName,
   377→        loraFiles: args.loraFiles,
   378→        sampleFiles: args.sampleFiles,
   379→        uploadToHuggingFace: args.uploadToHuggingFace,
   380→        urls: initialUrls,
   381→      });
   382→
   383→      const uploadedSamples = await uploadSampleFiles(args.sampleFiles);
   384→      const { finalSamples, finalImages } = buildFinalSamplesAndImages({
   385→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   386→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   387→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   388→        uploadedSamples,
   389→      });
   390→
   391→      const mainGeneration = resolveMainGeneration({
   392→        uploadedSamples,
   393→        mainGenerationIndex: args.mainGenerationIndex,
   394→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   395→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   396→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   397→        finalSamples,
   398→      });
   399→
   400→      const uniqueFilename = resolveUniqueFilename({
   401→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   402→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   403→        addForm: args.addForm,
   404→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   405→        existingFilenames: args.getExistingFilenames(),
   406→      });
   407→
   408→      const loraMetadata = buildLoraMetadata({
   409→        addForm: args.addForm,
   410→        userName: args.userName,
   411→        uniqueFilename,
   412→        isMultiStageModel: args.isMultiStageModel,
   413→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   414→        finalHighNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHighNoiseUrl,
   415→        finalLowNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalLowNoiseUrl,
   416→        finalSamples,
   417→        finalImages,
   418→        mainGeneration,
   419→      });
   420→
   421→      if (args.isEditMode && args.editingLora) {
   422→        await args.updateResource.mutateAsync({
   423→          id: args.editingLora.id,
   424→          type: 'lora',
   425→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   426→        });
   427→        args.onClearEdit();
   428→      } else {
   429→        await args.createResource.mutateAsync({
   430→          type: 'lora',
   431→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   432→        });
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      args.resetForm();
   436→      args.onSwitchToBrowse();
   437→    } catch (error) {
   438→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   439→        context: 'MyLorasTab',
   440→        toastTitle: `Failed to ${args.isEditMode ? 'update' : 'add'} LoRA`,
   441→      });
   442→    } finally {
   443→      args.setIsSubmitting(false);
   444→    }
   445→  };
   446→
   447→  return {
   448→    handleAddLoraFromForm,
   449→    isButtonDisabled: () => isButtonDisabled(args),
   450→  };
   451→}

     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };

    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     2→import { deriveInputImages, parseTaskParams } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
     3→
     4→interface NormalizedTaskDetailsPayload {
     5→  parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>;
     6→  orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown>;
     7→  orchestratorPayload: Record<string, unknown>;
     8→  inputImages: string[];
     9→}
    10→
    11→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    12→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    13→    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
    14→    : null;
    15→}
    16→
    17→function asString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    18→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    19→}
    20→
    21→function cleanUrl(url: string): string {
    22→  return url.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    23→}
    24→
    25→export function normalizeTaskDetailsPayload(
    26→  task: Task | null | undefined,
    27→): NormalizedTaskDetailsPayload {
    28→  const parsedParams = parseTaskParams(task?.params);
    29→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(parsedParams.orchestrator_details) ?? {};
    30→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(parsedParams.full_orchestrator_payload) ?? {};
    31→  const inputImages = deriveInputImages(parsedParams).map(cleanUrl);
    32→
    33→  return {
    34→    parsedParams,
    35→    orchestratorDetails,
    36→    orchestratorPayload,
    37→    inputImages,
    38→  };
    39→}
    40→
    41→export function pickTaskDetailsString(
    42→  normalized: NormalizedTaskDetailsPayload,
    43→  key: string,
    44→): string | undefined {
    45→  return asString(normalized.parsedParams[key])
    46→    ?? asString(normalized.orchestratorDetails[key])
    47→    ?? asString(normalized.orchestratorPayload[key]);

    25→  const activateClickShield = useCallback(() => {

    48→      shield.addEventListener('touchstart', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    49→      shield.addEventListener('touchend', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);

    59→  const safeClose = useCallback(() => {

   171→/**

   182→export function buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload(
   183→  params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput,
   184→  finalResolution: string,
   185→  taskId: string,
   186→  runId: string,
   187→  parentGenerationId?: string,
   188→): Record<string, unknown> {
   189→  assertNoImplicitLegacyStructureFields(params);

   195→  const basePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.base_prompts, numSegments);
   196→  const negativePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.negative_prompts, numSegments) || Array(numSegments).fill("");

   199→  // If enhance_prompt is true, we must provide an array (even if empty strings) for the backend to populate
   200→  const enhancedPromptsExpanded = params.enhanced_prompts
   201→    ? expandArrayToCount(params.enhanced_prompts, numSegments)
   202→    : (params.enhance_prompt ? Array(numSegments).fill("") : undefined);
   203→
   204→  const segmentFramesExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.segment_frames, numSegments);
   205→  const frameOverlapExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.frame_overlap, numSegments);

   207→  // Extract steps parameter - only needed if NOT in Advanced Mode
   208→  // In Advanced Mode, steps come from steps_per_phase in phase_config
   209→  let stepsValue = params.steps;

   211→    if (stepsValue === undefined && params.params_json_str) {
   212→      const parsedParams = toRecordOrEmpty(safeParseJson(params.params_json_str, {}));
   213→      const parsedSteps = asNumber(parsedParams.steps);
   214→      if (parsedSteps !== undefined) {
   215→        stepsValue = parsedSteps;
   216→      }

    68→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {

    74→    }
    75→
    76→    const orderedImages = currentImages.filter(
    77→      (image) => isPositioned(image) && !isVideoGeneration(image)

    79→    if (orderedImages.length === 0) {
    80→      return undefined;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const positions = new Map<string, number>();
    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {
    86→        positions.set(image.id, index);
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);
    91→
    92→  const shouldFetchSegments = props.generationMode !== 'timeline' &&

    94→

    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(

   227→
   228→async function insertShareWithRetry({
   229→  generationId,
   230→  taskId,
   231→  shotId,
   232→  userId,
   233→  generationData,
   234→  augmentedTaskData,
   235→  generateShareSlug,
   236→}: InsertShareWithRetryArgs): Promise<string | null> {
   237→  const maxAttempts = 5;
   238→  let attempts = 0;
   239→
   240→  const { data: creatorRow } = await supabase().from('users')
   241→    .select('username, name, avatar_url')
   242→    .eq('id', userId)
   243→    .maybeSingle();
   244→
   245→  while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
   246→    const candidateSlug = generateShareSlug(10);
   247→    const creator = creatorRow ?? null;
   248→    const normalizedTaskId = typeof taskId === 'string' && taskId.length > 0 ? taskId : null;
   249→    const sharedGenerationInsert = {
   250→      share_slug: candidateSlug,
   251→      ...(normalizedTaskId ? { task_id: normalizedTaskId } : {}),
   252→      generation_id: generationId,
   253→      creator_id: userId,
   254→      creator_username: creator?.username ?? null,
   255→      creator_name: creator?.name ?? null,
   256→      creator_avatar_url: creator?.avatar_url ?? null,
   257→      cached_generation_data: generationData,
   258→      cached_task_data: sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(augmentedTaskData),
   259→      shot_id: shotId || null,
   260→    };
   261→
   262→    const { data: newShare, error: insertError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   263→      .insert(sharedGenerationInsert)
   264→      .select('share_slug')
   265→      .single();

   267→    if (!insertError && newShare) {
   268→      return newShare.share_slug;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    if (isUniqueViolationError(insertError)) {
   272→      attempts++;
   273→      continue;
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    if (insertError) {
   277→      throw insertError;
   278→    }
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  return null;
   282→}

   292→
   293→async function copyShareLinkAndNotify({

   296→  successDescription,

   311→/**
   312→ * Hook to handle sharing of generations via unique slug
   313→ *
   314→ * @param generationId - The generation to share
   315→ * @param taskId - The task associated with the generation
   316→ * @param shotId - Optional shot ID for final videos (to fetch input images and settings)

   318→export function useShareGeneration(
   319→  generationId: string | undefined,
   320→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   321→  shotId?: string | null,
   322→  options?: UseShareGenerationOptions
   323→): UseShareGenerationResult {

   333→
   334→  // Generate a short, URL-friendly random string
   335→  const generateShareSlug = (length: number = 10): string => {
   336→    const chars = [REDACTED];
   337→    let result = '';
   338→    const randomValues = new Uint8Array(length);
   339→    crypto.getRandomValues(randomValues);
   340→    
   341→    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
   342→      result += chars[randomValues[i] % chars.length];
   343→    }
   344→    
   345→    return result;
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  const handleShare = useCallback(async (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
   349→    e.stopPropagation();
   350→    e.preventDefault();
   351→
   352→    if (!generationId) {
   353→      toast({
   354→        title: 'Cannot create share',
   355→        description: 'Generation information not available',
   356→        variant: 'destructive',
   357→      });
   358→      return;
   359→    }
   360→
   361→    if (shareSlug) {
   362→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   363→        slug: shareSlug,
   364→        successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   365→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   366→        fallbackTitle: 'Share ready',
   367→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   368→        setShareCopied,
   369→      });
   370→      return;
   371→    }
   372→
   373→    setIsCreatingShare(true);
   374→    try {
   375→      const { data: sessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   376→      const [REDACTED]?.access_token;
   377→      const userId = sessionData.session?.user.id;
   378→
   379→      if (!accessToken || !userId) {
   380→        toast({
   381→          title: 'Authentication required',
   382→          description: 'Please sign in to create share links',
   383→          variant: 'destructive',
   384→        });
   385→        return;
   386→      }
   387→
   388→      const existingSlug = await fetchExistingShareSlug(generationId, userId);
   389→      if (existingSlug) {
   390→        setShareSlug(existingSlug);
   391→        await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   392→          slug: existingSlug,
   393→          successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   394→          successDescription: 'Existing share link copied to clipboard',
   395→          fallbackTitle: 'Share found',
   396→          fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   397→          setShareCopied,
   398→        });
   399→        return;
   400→      }

   402→      const { generationData, augmentedTaskData } = await fetchShareCachedData(
   403→        generationId,
   404→        taskId,
   405→        shotId,

   407→

   409→        generationId,

   411→        shotId,
   412→        userId,
   413→        generationData,
   414→        augmentedTaskData,
   415→        generateShareSlug,
   416→      });
   417→
   418→      if (!newSlug) {
   419→        toast({
   420→          title: 'Share failed',
   421→          description: 'Failed to generate unique link. Please try again.',
   422→          variant: 'destructive',
   423→        });
   424→        return;
   425→      }
   426→
   427→      setShareSlug(newSlug);
   428→      onShareCreated?.(generationId, newSlug);
   429→
   430→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   431→        slug: newSlug,
   432→        successTitle: 'Share created!',
   433→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   434→        fallbackTitle: 'Share created',
   435→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   436→        setShareCopied,
   437→      });
   438→    } catch (error) {
   439→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   440→        context: 'useShareGeneration',
   441→        toastTitle: 'Share failed',
   442→        logData: { message: 'Please try again' },
   443→      });
   444→    } finally {
   445→      setIsCreatingShare(false);
   446→    }
   447→  }, [generationId, onShareCreated, shareSlug, shotId, taskId]);
   448→
   449→  return {
   450→    handleShare,
   451→    isCreatingShare,
   452→    shareCopied,
   453→    shareSlug
   454→  };
   455→}

    47→        if (/(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|service_role|authorization|stripe)/i.test(k)) {
    48→          continue;
    49→        }
    50→        out[k] = redactDeep(v, depth + 1);
    51→      }
    52→      return out;
    53→    }
    54→    return value;
    55→  };
    56→
    57→  // Remove or sanitize sensitive fields from params
    58→  if (sanitized.params) {
    59→    sanitized.params = redactDeep(sanitized.params);
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  // Remove fields that shouldn't be exposed
    63→  delete sanitized.error_message; // Could contain internal details
    64→
    65→  return sanitized;
    66→}

    81→async function copyToClipboardWithFallback(value: string): Promise<boolean> {
    82→  try {
    83→    if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    84→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    85→      return true;
    86→    }
    87→  } catch {
    88→    // Fall back to textarea copy path below.
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  try {
    92→    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    93→    textarea.value = value;
    94→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    95→    textarea.style.opacity = '0';
    96→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    97→    textarea.focus();
    98→    textarea.select();
    99→    const copied = document.execCommand('copy');
   100→    document.body.removeChild(textarea);
   101→    return copied;
   102→  } catch {
   103→    return false;
   104→  }
   105→}

   124→interface ShareCachedDataResult {
