   128→
   129→async function fetchShareCachedData(
   130→  generationId: string,
   131→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   132→  shotId?: string | null,
   133→): Promise<ShareCachedDataResult> {
   134→  const generationResult = await supabase().from('generations')
   135→    .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, type, params, created_at, name')
   136→    .eq('id', generationId)
   137→    .single();
   138→
   139→  if (generationResult.error || !generationResult.data) {
   140→    throw generationResult.error ?? new Error('Failed to load generation data');
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  let taskResultData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null = null;
   144→  if (taskId) {
   145→    const { data } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   146→      .select('id, task_type, params, status, created_at')
   147→      .eq('id', taskId)
   148→      .single();
   149→    taskResultData = data;
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  let augmentedTaskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null = taskResultData;
   153→
   154→  if (shotId) {
   155→    try {
   156→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase().from('shots')
   157→        .select('id, name, settings')
   158→        .eq('id', shotId)
   159→        .single();
   160→
   161→      const { data: shotGenerations, error: genError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   162→        .select(`
   163→          timeline_frame,
   164→          generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(
   165→            id,
   166→            location,
   167→            thumbnail_url,
   168→            type
   169→          )
   170→        `)
   171→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   172→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   173→
   174→      if (!shotError && !genError && shotData && shotGenerations) {
   175→        const settingsRecord = asJsonRecord(shotData.settings);
   176→        const travelSettings = asJsonRecord(settingsRecord?.travel_between_images) ?? {};
   177→        const generationMode = travelSettings.generationMode || 'batch';
   178→
   179→        const images = shotGenerations
   180→          .filter((sg) => sg.generation?.type === 'image' && sg.generation?.location)
   181→          .map((sg) => ({
   182→            url: sg.generation.location,
   183→            thumbnail_url: sg.generation.thumbnail_url,
   184→            timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   185→          }));
   186→
   187→        augmentedTaskData = {
   188→          ...taskResultData,
   189→          cached_shot_data: {
   190→            shot_id: shotId,
   191→            shot_name: shotData.name,
   192→            generation_mode: generationMode,
   193→            images,
   194→            settings: {
   195→              prompt: travelSettings.batchVideoPrompt || '',
   196→              negative_prompt: travelSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   197→              frames: travelSettings.batchVideoFrames || 38,
   198→              steps: travelSettings.batchVideoSteps || 6,
   199→              motion: travelSettings.amountOfMotion || 50,
   200→              enhance_prompt: travelSettings.enhancePrompt || false,
   201→              phase_config: travelSettings.phaseConfig || null,
   202→              context_frames: travelSettings.contextFrames || 0,
   203→            },
   204→          },
   205→        };
   206→      }
   207→    } catch {
   208→      // Keep share creation resilient when shot-cache enrichment fails.
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→
   212→  return {
   213→    generationData: generationResult.data,
   214→    augmentedTaskData,
   215→  };

   218→interface InsertShareWithRetryArgs {
   219→  generationId: string;
   220→  taskId: string | null | undefined;
   221→  shotId?: string | null;
   222→  userId: string;
   223→  generationData: Record<string, Json | undefined>;
   224→  augmentedTaskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null;
   225→  generateShareSlug: (length?: number) => string;
   226→}
   227→
   228→async function insertShareWithRetry({
   229→  generationId,
   230→  taskId,
   231→  shotId,
   232→  userId,
   233→  generationData,
   234→  augmentedTaskData,
   235→  generateShareSlug,
   236→}: InsertShareWithRetryArgs): Promise<string | null> {
   237→  const maxAttempts = 5;
   238→  let attempts = 0;
   239→
   240→  const { data: creatorRow } = await supabase().from('users')
   241→    .select('username, name, avatar_url')
   242→    .eq('id', userId)
   243→    .maybeSingle();
   244→
   245→  while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
   246→    const candidateSlug = generateShareSlug(10);
   247→    const creator = creatorRow ?? null;
   248→    const normalizedTaskId = typeof taskId === 'string' && taskId.length > 0 ? taskId : null;
   249→    const sharedGenerationInsert = {
   250→      share_slug: candidateSlug,
   251→      ...(normalizedTaskId ? { task_id: normalizedTaskId } : {}),
   252→      generation_id: generationId,
   253→      creator_id: userId,
   254→      creator_username: creator?.username ?? null,
   255→      creator_name: creator?.name ?? null,
   256→      creator_avatar_url: creator?.avatar_url ?? null,
   257→      cached_generation_data: generationData,
   258→      cached_task_data: sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(augmentedTaskData),
   259→      shot_id: shotId || null,
   260→    };
   261→
   262→    const { data: newShare, error: insertError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   263→      .insert(sharedGenerationInsert)
   264→      .select('share_slug')
   265→      .single();
   266→
   267→    if (!insertError && newShare) {
   268→      return newShare.share_slug;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    if (isUniqueViolationError(insertError)) {
   272→      attempts++;
   273→      continue;
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    if (insertError) {
   277→      throw insertError;
   278→    }
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  return null;
   282→}
   283→
   284→interface CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs {
   285→  slug: string;
   286→  successTitle: string;
   287→  successDescription: string;
   288→  fallbackTitle: string;
   289→  fallbackDescription: string;
   290→  setShareCopied: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
   291→}
   292→
   293→async function copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   294→  slug,
   295→  successTitle,
   296→  successDescription,
   297→  fallbackTitle,
   298→  fallbackDescription,
   299→  setShareCopied,
   300→}: CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs): Promise<void> {
   301→  const copied = await copyToClipboardWithFallback(buildShareUrl(slug));
   302→  if (copied) {
   303→    markShareCopied(setShareCopied);
   304→    toast({ title: successTitle, description: successDescription });
   305→    return;
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  toast({ title: fallbackTitle, description: fallbackDescription });
   309→}

   311→/**
   312→ * Hook to handle sharing of generations via unique slug
   313→ *
   314→ * @param generationId - The generation to share
   315→ * @param taskId - The task associated with the generation
   316→ * @param shotId - Optional shot ID for final videos (to fetch input images and settings)
   317→ */
   318→export function useShareGeneration(
   319→  generationId: string | undefined,
   320→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   321→  shotId?: string | null,
   322→  options?: UseShareGenerationOptions
   323→): UseShareGenerationResult {
   324→  const { initialShareSlug, onShareCreated } = options ?? {};
   325→  const [shareSlug, setShareSlug] = useState<string | null>(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   326→  const [isCreatingShare, setIsCreatingShare] = useState(false);
   327→  const [shareCopied, setShareCopied] = useState(false);
   328→  // Reset share state when shot/generation changes
   329→  useEffect(() => {
   330→    setShareSlug(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   331→    setShareCopied(false);
   332→  }, [generationId, shotId, initialShareSlug]);
   333→
   334→  // Generate a short, URL-friendly random string
   335→  const generateShareSlug = (length: number = 10): string => {
   336→    const chars = [REDACTED];
   337→    let result = '';
   338→    const randomValues = new Uint8Array(length);
   339→    crypto.getRandomValues(randomValues);
   340→    
   341→    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
   342→      result += chars[randomValues[i] % chars.length];
   343→    }
   344→    
   345→    return result;
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  const handleShare = useCallback(async (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
   349→    e.stopPropagation();
   350→    e.preventDefault();
   351→
   352→    if (!generationId) {
   353→      toast({
   354→        title: 'Cannot create share',
   355→        description: 'Generation information not available',
   356→        variant: 'destructive',
   357→      });
   358→      return;
   359→    }
   360→
   361→    if (shareSlug) {
   362→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   363→        slug: shareSlug,
   364→        successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   365→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   366→        fallbackTitle: 'Share ready',
   367→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   368→        setShareCopied,
   369→      });
   370→      return;
   371→    }
   372→
   373→    setIsCreatingShare(true);
   374→    try {
   375→      const { data: sessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   376→      const [REDACTED]?.access_token;
   377→      const userId = sessionData.session?.user.id;
   378→
   379→      if (!accessToken || !userId) {
   380→        toast({
   381→          title: 'Authentication required',
   382→          description: 'Please sign in to create share links',
   383→          variant: 'destructive',
   384→        });
   385→        return;
   386→      }
   387→
   388→      const existingSlug = await fetchExistingShareSlug(generationId, userId);
   389→      if (existingSlug) {
   390→        setShareSlug(existingSlug);
   391→        await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   392→          slug: existingSlug,
   393→          successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   394→          successDescription: 'Existing share link copied to clipboard',
   395→          fallbackTitle: 'Share found',
   396→          fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   397→          setShareCopied,
   398→        });
   399→        return;
   400→      }
   401→
   402→      const { generationData, augmentedTaskData } = await fetchShareCachedData(
   403→        generationId,
   404→        taskId,
   405→        shotId,
   406→      );
   407→
   408→      const newSlug = await insertShareWithRetry({
   409→        generationId,
   410→        taskId,
   411→        shotId,
   412→        userId,
   413→        generationData,
   414→        augmentedTaskData,
   415→        generateShareSlug,
   416→      });
   417→
   418→      if (!newSlug) {
   419→        toast({
   420→          title: 'Share failed',
   421→          description: 'Failed to generate unique link. Please try again.',
   422→          variant: 'destructive',
   423→        });
   424→        return;
   425→      }
   426→
   427→      setShareSlug(newSlug);
   428→      onShareCreated?.(generationId, newSlug);
   429→
   430→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   431→        slug: newSlug,
   432→        successTitle: 'Share created!',
   433→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   434→        fallbackTitle: 'Share created',
   435→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   436→        setShareCopied,
   437→      });
   438→    } catch (error) {
   439→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   440→        context: 'useShareGeneration',
   441→        toastTitle: 'Share failed',
   442→        logData: { message: 'Please try again' },
   443→      });
   444→    } finally {
   445→      setIsCreatingShare(false);
   446→    }
   447→  }, [generationId, onShareCreated, shareSlug, shotId, taskId]);
   448→
   449→  return {
   450→    handleShare,
   451→    isCreatingShare,
   452→    shareCopied,
   453→    shareSlug
   454→  };
   455→}

1→/**
     2→ * DataFreshnessManager - Single source of truth for data freshness and polling decisions
     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status

     9→
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
    12→
    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
    14→type RealtimeStatus = 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    15→type PollingInterval = number | false; // false = no polling
    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {
    19→  return JSON.stringify(queryKey);

    21→
    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(
    23→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }
    49→  return now - lastEvent < freshnessThreshold;
    50→}
    51→
    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(
    53→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    54→  now: number,
    55→  parseQueryKey: (rawKey: string) => unknown,
    56→): Array<{ query: unknown; ageMs: number; ageSec: number }> {
    57→  return Array.from(lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => ({
    58→    query: parseQueryKey(key),
    59→    ageMs: now - time,
    60→    ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000),
    61→  }));

    64→interface DataFreshnessState {

    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→

    93→    } catch {
    94→      return rawKey;
    95→    }
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {

   110→

   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.

   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→

   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {

   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {

   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {

   203→  /**

   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });

   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);

   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {

   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({

   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {

   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';

   335→    return {

   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**

   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();

   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {

   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→

   373→  }

   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {

   382→    });
   383→  }

   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }

   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}

    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  /**
   152→   * Pause all preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open).
   153→   */
   154→  pause(): void {
   155→    if (this.state.isPaused) return;
   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {

   211→      }

   213→  }

   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {

   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();

   292→
   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

   235→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   236→
   237→function setTextOverride(

   239→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   240→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   241→  value: string | undefined

   358→ * legacy user_overrides fields from the metadata.
   359→ */
   360→export function buildMetadataUpdate(
   361→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   362→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   363→): Record<string, unknown> {
   364→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   365→  const fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[] = [];
   366→  applyPairSettingsToOverrides(settings, overrides, fieldsToClear);
   367→
   368→  // Use writeSegmentOverrides to write to new format
   369→  const newMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(currentMetadata, overrides);
   370→
   371→  // Access segmentOverrides as a mutable record for cleanup operations
   372→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   373→
   374→  // Handle explicit clear of phaseConfig (when switching to basic mode)
   375→  if (settings.phaseConfig === null && segOverrides) {
   376→    delete segOverrides.phaseConfig;
   377→    // Note: selectedPhasePresetId is handled independently via fieldsToClear.
   378→    // Don't cascade-delete it here — basic mode presets need to persist.
   379→  }
   380→
   381→  // Handle explicitly cleared fields ('' or null means remove override, use shot default)
   382→  if (fieldsToClear.length > 0 && segOverrides) {
   383→    clearFields(segOverrides, fieldsToClear as string[]);
   384→  }
   385→
   386→  cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(newMetadata, settings);
   387→  cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(newMetadata, settings);
   388→
   389→  return newMetadata;
   390→}

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Hook to measure a container's width using ResizeObserver.
     5→ * Returns the current width and a ref to attach to the container.
     6→ *
     7→ * Uses window.innerWidth as initial estimate to avoid layout shift on first render.
     8→ * Only updates width when layout is stable (avoids intermediate states during mount).
     9→ *
    10→ * @returns [ref, width] - Attach ref to container, width updates on resize
    11→ */
    12→export function useContainerWidth(): [RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, number] {
    13→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    14→  // Start with window width as estimate to avoid 0 on first render
    15→  const initialEstimate = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    16→    ? Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.9)
    17→    : 800;
    18→  const [width, setWidth] = useState(initialEstimate);
    19→  const hasReceivedStableWidth = useRef(false);
    20→
    21→  useEffect(() => {
    22→    const element = containerRef.current;
    23→    if (!element) return;
    24→
    25→    let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    26→
    27→    // Set up ResizeObserver - this is the source of truth for width
    28→    // Debounced to avoid rapid recalculations during animated resizes (e.g. pane lock/unlock)
    29→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
    30→      for (const entry of entries) {
    31→        const newWidth = entry.contentRect.width;
    32→        if (newWidth <= 0) continue;
    33→
    34→        if (!hasReceivedStableWidth.current) {
    35→          // First measurement: apply immediately to prevent layout flash
    36→          // (e.g. gallery in a narrow panel starts with full-viewport estimate)
    37→          hasReceivedStableWidth.current = true;
    38→          setWidth(newWidth);
    39→        } else {
    40→          // Subsequent measurements: debounce for smooth animated resizes
    41→          if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    42→          debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => setWidth(newWidth), 150);
    43→        }
    44→      }
    45→    });
    46→
    47→    resizeObserver.observe(element);
    48→
    49→    // Fallback: if ResizeObserver hasn't fired after a short delay, use offsetWidth
    50→    const fallbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    51→      if (!hasReceivedStableWidth.current && element.offsetWidth > 0) {
    52→        setWidth(element.offsetWidth);
    53→      }
    54→    }, 100);
    55→
    56→    return () => {
    57→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    58→      clearTimeout(fallbackTimeout);
    59→      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    60→    };
    61→  }, [initialEstimate]);
    62→
    63→  return [containerRef, width];
    64→}
    65→
    66→interface ContainerDimensions {
    67→  width: number;
    68→  height: number;
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Hook to measure a container's width and the full viewport height.
    73→ * Returns dimensions and a ref to attach to the container.
    74→ *
    75→ * Width: measured from the container element
    76→ * Height: full viewport height (window.innerHeight) minus an offset for controls
    77→ *
    78→ * This is used for calculating how many gallery rows fit in a full viewport,
    79→ * regardless of scroll position or where the gallery is on the page.
    80→ *
    81→ * @param heightOffset - Pixels to subtract from viewport height (e.g., for header + pagination)
    82→ * @param skipHeaderDetection - Skip auto-detecting sticky/fixed headers (e.g., on mobile where there's no header)
    83→ * @returns [ref, dimensions] - Attach ref to container, dimensions update on resize
    84→ */
    85→export function useContainerDimensions(
    86→  heightOffset: number = 0,
    87→  skipHeaderDetection: boolean = false
    88→): [RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, ContainerDimensions] {
    89→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    90→
    91→  // Start with window dimensions as estimate
    92→  const initialWidthEstimate = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    93→    ? Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.9)
    94→    : 800;
    95→  const initialHeightEstimate = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    96→    ? window.innerHeight - heightOffset
    97→    : 600;
    98→
    99→  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState<ContainerDimensions>({
   100→    width: initialWidthEstimate,
   101→    height: initialHeightEstimate,
   102→  });
   103→  const hasReceivedStableDimensions = useRef(false);
   104→
   105→  useEffect(() => {
   106→    const element = containerRef.current;
   107→    if (!element) return;
   108→
   109→    const updateDimensions = () => {
   110→      const newWidth = element.getBoundingClientRect().width;
   111→
   112→      // Detect sticky/fixed header height by scanning for header-like elements
   113→      // pinned at the top of the viewport (the site header is a sibling, not ancestor)
   114→      // Skip on mobile/iPad where there's no fixed header
   115→      let fixedChromeHeight = 0;
   116→      if (!skipHeaderDetection) {
   117→        const candidates = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="sticky"], [class*="fixed"]');
   118→        for (const el of candidates) {
   119→          const style = getComputedStyle(el);
   120→          if (style.position !== 'sticky' && style.position !== 'fixed') continue;
   121→          const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
   122→          // Must be at the top (within 10px) and header-sized (under 200px)
   123→          if (rect.top <= 10 && rect.height > 0 && rect.height < 200) {
   124→            fixedChromeHeight = Math.max(fixedChromeHeight, rect.height);
   125→          }
   126→        }
   127→      }
   128→
   129→      // Available height = viewport - fixed header - caller's offset (pagination, gallery chrome, etc.)
   130→      const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - fixedChromeHeight - heightOffset;
   131→
   132→      // Only accept dimensions that are reasonable
   133→      if (newWidth > initialWidthEstimate * 0.5 && availableHeight > 200) {
   134→        hasReceivedStableDimensions.current = true;
   135→        setDimensions({
   136→          width: newWidth,
   137→          height: Math.max(200, availableHeight),
   138→        });
   139→      }
   140→    };
   141→
   142→    let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
   143→    const debouncedUpdate = () => {
   144→      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
   145→      debounceTimer = setTimeout(updateDimensions, 150);
   146→    };
   147→
   148→    // Set up ResizeObserver for container width changes
   149→    // Debounced to avoid rapid recalculations during animated resizes (e.g. pane lock/unlock)
   150→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
   151→      debouncedUpdate();
   152→    });
   153→
   154→    resizeObserver.observe(element);
   155→
   156→    // Also listen to window resize for viewport height changes
   157→    window.addEventListener('resize', debouncedUpdate);
   158→
   159→    // Initial measurement after a short delay for layout stability
   160→    const fallbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   161→      if (!hasReceivedStableDimensions.current) {
   162→        updateDimensions();
   163→      }
   164→    }, 100);
   165→
   166→    return () => {
   167→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
   168→      window.removeEventListener('resize', debouncedUpdate);
   169→      clearTimeout(fallbackTimeout);
   170→      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
   171→    };
   172→  }, [initialWidthEstimate, heightOffset, skipHeaderDetection]);
   173→
   174→  return [containerRef, dimensions];
   175→}
   176→

   108→/**
   109→ * Builds the task params for an image_edit task

   112→function buildMagicEditTaskParams(
   113→  params: MagicEditTaskParams,
   114→  finalResolution: string
   115→): Record<string, unknown> {
   116→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   117→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   118→    seed: resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: params.seed, field: 'seed' }),
   119→    image: params.image_url,
   120→    prompt: params.prompt,
   121→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
   122→    qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model ?? 'qwen-edit',
   123→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode ?? false,
   124→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,
   125→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output ?? false,
   126→  };
   127→
   128→  // Add optional parameters if provided
   129→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   130→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   134→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   138→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   139→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   140→  }
   141→
   142→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   143→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   144→
   145→  // Add loras if provided
   146→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   147→    taskParams.loras = params.loras;
   148→  }
   149→
   150→  setTaskLineageFields(taskParams, {
   151→    shotId: params.shot_id,

   153→    sourceVariantId: params.source_variant_id,
   154→    createAsGeneration: params.create_as_generation,

   156→  });

   158→  // Add hires fix / inference params if provided
   159→  Object.assign(taskParams, buildHiresFixParams(params.hires_fix));
   160→
   161→  return taskParams;
   162→}

   164→/**
   165→ * Creates a single magic edit task using the unified approach
   166→ * This replaces the direct call to the magic-edit edge function
   167→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchMagicEditTasks)
   168→ *
   169→ * @param params - Magic edit task parameters
   170→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   171→ */
   172→async function createMagicEditTask(params: MagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   173→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   174→    params,
   175→    context: 'MagicEdit',
   176→    validate: validateMagicEditParams,
   177→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   178→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   179→        requestParams.project_id,
   180→        requestParams.resolution,
   181→      );
   182→
   183→      const taskParams = buildMagicEditTaskParams(requestParams, finalResolution);
   184→
   185→      return composeTaskRequest({
   186→        source: requestParams,
   187→        taskType: "qwen_image_edit",
   188→        params: taskParams,
   189→      });
   190→    },
   191→  });
   192→}

   194→/**

   199→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   200→ */
   201→export async function createBatchMagicEditTasks(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   202→
   203→  try {
   204→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   205→      batchParams: params,
   206→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchMagicEditParams,
   207→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<MagicEditTaskParams[]> => {
   208→        const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   209→          batchParams.project_id,
   210→          batchParams.resolution,
   211→        );
   212→
   213→        return Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   214→          const seedBase = resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: batchParams.seed, field: 'seed' });
   215→          const seed = seedBase + index;
   216→
   217→          return {
   218→            project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   219→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   220→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   221→            negative_prompt: batchParams.negative_prompt,
   222→            resolution: finalResolution,
   223→            seed,
   224→            in_scene: batchParams.in_scene,
   225→            shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   226→            output_format: batchParams.output_format,
   227→            enable_sync_mode: batchParams.enable_sync_mode,
   228→            max_wait_seconds: batchParams.max_wait_seconds,
   229→            enable_base64_output: batchParams.enable_base64_output,
   230→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,
   231→            loras: batchParams.loras,
   232→            based_on: batchParams.based_on,
   233→            source_variant_id: batchParams.source_variant_id,
   234→            create_as_generation: batchParams.create_as_generation,
   235→            hires_fix: batchParams.hires_fix,
   236→            qwen_edit_model: batchParams.qwen_edit_model,

   239→      },
   240→      createSingleTask: createMagicEditTask,

   243→
   244→  } catch (error) {

   213→/**

   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {

   230→        return {

   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);

   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),

    39→function isQueryFresh(

    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,

    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(

    64→interface DataFreshnessState {
    65→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    66→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    67→  lastStatusChange: number;

    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→
    90→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    91→    try {
    92→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);

    95→    }

    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {

   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Actual status transition - update state
   112→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
   113→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
   114→
   115→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
   116→    this.notifySubscribers();
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  /**
   120→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
   121→   */
   122→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   123→    const now = Date.now();
   124→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, affectedQueries, now);
   125→
   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
   127→    this.notifySubscribers();
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */
   134→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
   142→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }
   146→
   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   173→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   174→
   175→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   176→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   177→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   178→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→
   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {

   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }

   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}

   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();

   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {

   238→  }

   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",

   248→      'mode',

   250→  }

   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'

   256→  return {
   257→    clipSequence,
   258→    clipSourceKind: clipSource.kind,

   263→
   264→/**
   265→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for join clips
   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)

   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,

   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);

   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {

   329→  }

   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {

   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→

   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;

   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;

   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),

   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {

   396→      runId,

   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}

   454→

   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {

   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,

   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,

   360→    ...composedPayload,

   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;

1→/**
     2→ * PreloadingService - Unified coordinator for all image preloading
     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:
     5→ * 1. Preload queue management (network concurrency)
     6→ * 2. Lifecycle coordination (project switch, deletions, connection changes)
     7→ *
     8→ * The tracker (tracker.ts) is the source of truth for what's been loaded.
     9→ * This service coordinates preloading and lifecycle events.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    13→import { PreloadQueue } from './queue';
    14→import { getPreloadConfig } from './config';
    15→import { preloadImages } from './preloader';

    27→  PreloadingSubscriber,

    29→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';
    30→
    31→// =============================================================================
    32→// SERVICE
    33→// =============================================================================
    34→
    35→class PreloadingService {
    36→  private state: PreloadingServiceState = {
    37→    currentProjectId: null,
    38→    isConnected: true,
    39→    isPaused: false,
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  private queue: PreloadQueue;
    43→  private config: PreloadConfig;
    44→  private subscribers = new Set<PreloadingSubscriber>();
    45→
    46→  // Singleton
    47→  private static instance: PreloadingService | null = null;
    48→
    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {
    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {
    51→      PreloadingService.instance = new PreloadingService();
    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }

   151→  /**

   154→  pause(): void {

   163→  resume(): void {

   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();
   240→
   241→// Expose for debugging in browser console (dev only)
   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   243→  (window as unknown as { __PRELOADING_SERVICE__: PreloadingService }).__PRELOADING_SERVICE__ =
   244→    preloadingService;
   245→}

    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→

    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {

    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }

   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };

   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {

   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
