   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;

   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);

   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}

   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}

     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:

     6→ * 2. Lifecycle coordination (project switch, deletions, connection changes)
     7→ *

    12→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    13→import { PreloadQueue } from './queue';
    14→import { getPreloadConfig } from './config';
    15→import { preloadImages } from './preloader';
    16→import {
    17→  clearAllLoadedImages,

    19→  getLoadTrackerStats,
    20→} from './tracker';
    21→import { PRIORITY } from './types';
    22→import type {
    23→  PreloadConfig,
    24→  PreloadableImage,
    25→  PreloadingServiceState,
    26→  PreloadingEvent,
    27→  PreloadingSubscriber,
    28→} from './types';
    29→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';
    30→
    31→// =============================================================================
    32→// SERVICE
    33→// =============================================================================
    34→
    35→class PreloadingService {
    36→  private state: PreloadingServiceState = {
    37→    currentProjectId: null,
    38→    isConnected: true,
    39→    isPaused: false,
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  private queue: PreloadQueue;
    43→  private config: PreloadConfig;
    44→  private subscribers = new Set<PreloadingSubscriber>();
    45→
    46→  // Singleton
    47→  private static instance: PreloadingService | null = null;
    48→
    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {
    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {
    51→      PreloadingService.instance = new PreloadingService();
    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  /**
   152→   * Pause all preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open).
   153→   */
   154→  pause(): void {
   155→    if (this.state.isPaused) return;
   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();
   240→
   241→// Expose for debugging in browser console (dev only)
   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   243→  (window as unknown as { __PRELOADING_SERVICE__: PreloadingService }).__PRELOADING_SERVICE__ =
   244→    preloadingService;
   245→}
   246→

    85→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    86→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {

    88→  }
    89→
    90→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    91→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {

    95→  return { id: candidate.id };

   185→/**
   186→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   187→ *
   188→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   189→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   190→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   191→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   192→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   193→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   194→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   195→ *
   196→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   197→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   198→ */
   199→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   200→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   201→  taskId: string,
   202→  taskData: unknown,
   203→  publicUrl: string,
   204→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   205→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   206→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   207→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {

   209→
   210→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   211→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   212→  if (skipReason) {
   213→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   214→  }
   215→
   216→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   217→
   218→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   219→    task_id: taskId,
   220→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   221→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   222→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   223→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   224→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   225→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   226→  });

   228→  try {
   229→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   230→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   231→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {

   233→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   234→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   235→        recoverable: false,
   236→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   237→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   238→      });
   239→    }
   240→
   241→    if (existingGeneration) {
   242→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   243→        supabase,
   244→        taskId,
   245→        normalizedTaskData,
   246→        existingGeneration,
   247→        publicUrl,
   248→        thumbnailUrl,
   249→        logger,
   250→      );
   251→      return { status: 'created', generation };
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
   255→      const success = await handleVariantCreation(
   256→        supabase,
   257→        taskId,
   258→        normalizedTaskData,
   259→        routeParams.basedOn,
   260→        publicUrl,
   261→        thumbnailUrl,
   262→      );
   263→      if (success) {
   264→        return { status: 'created', generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn } };
   265→      }
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
   269→      supabase,
   270→      taskId,
   271→      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
   272→      publicUrl,
   273→      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
   274→      logger,
   275→      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
   276→      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
   277→      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
   278→      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   279→    };

   281→    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
   282→      const generation = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);

   292→      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
   293→      metadata: {
   294→        task_id: taskId,
   295→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   296→        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
   297→      },
   298→    });
   299→
   300→  } catch (error) {
   301→    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
   302→      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
   303→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   304→      recoverable: true,
   305→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   306→      metadata: {
   307→        task_id: taskId,
   308→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   309→      },
   310→    });
   311→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   312→      task_id: taskId,
   313→      error: normalizedError.message,
   314→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   315→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   316→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   317→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   318→    });
   319→    throw normalizedError;
   320→  }
   321→}

   323→/**
   324→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   325→ */
   326→async function handleRegeneration(
   327→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   328→  taskId: string,
   329→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   330→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   331→  publicUrl: string,
   332→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   333→  logger?: CompletionLogger
   334→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   335→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   336→    task_id: taskId,
   337→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   338→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   339→  });
   340→
   341→  const variantParams = {
   342→    ...taskData.params,
   343→    source_task_id: taskId,
   344→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   345→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  await createVariant(
   349→    supabase,
   350→    existingGeneration.id,
   351→    publicUrl,
   352→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   353→    variantParams,
   354→    true,
   355→    'regenerated',
   356→    null
   357→  );
   358→
   359→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   360→  if (shotId) {
   361→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   365→    .from('tasks')
   366→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   367→    .eq('id', taskId);
   368→
   369→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   370→    throw new CompletionError({
   371→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
   372→      context: 'handleRegeneration',
   373→      recoverable: true,
   374→      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
   375→      metadata: {
   376→        task_id: taskId,
   377→        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   378→      },
   379→      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return existingGeneration;
   384→}
   385→

   105→  });
   106→}

   109→ * Builds the task params for an image_edit task
   110→ * This follows the format from the example task you provided

   112→function buildMagicEditTaskParams(
   113→  params: MagicEditTaskParams,
   114→  finalResolution: string
   115→): Record<string, unknown> {
   116→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   117→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   118→    seed: resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: params.seed, field: 'seed' }),
   119→    image: params.image_url,
   120→    prompt: params.prompt,
   121→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",

   124→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,

   126→  };

   129→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   130→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   131→  }

   133→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   134→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   138→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   139→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   140→  }
   141→
   142→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   143→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;

   145→  // Add loras if provided
   146→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   147→    taskParams.loras = params.loras;
   148→  }
   149→
   150→  setTaskLineageFields(taskParams, {
   151→    shotId: params.shot_id,
   152→    basedOn: params.based_on,
   153→    sourceVariantId: params.source_variant_id,
   154→    createAsGeneration: params.create_as_generation,
   155→    toolType: params.tool_type,
   156→  });
   157→
   158→  // Add hires fix / inference params if provided
   159→  Object.assign(taskParams, buildHiresFixParams(params.hires_fix));
   160→
   161→  return taskParams;
   162→}

   164→/**
   165→ * Creates a single magic edit task using the unified approach
   166→ * This replaces the direct call to the magic-edit edge function

   230→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,

     7→
     8→/** Narrow a Json value to a record, returning null if not an object */
     9→function asJsonRecord(value: Json | undefined | null): Record<string, Json | undefined> | null {
    10→  if (value != null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    11→    return value;
    12→  }
    13→  return null;
    14→}
    15→
    16→interface UseShareGenerationResult {
    17→  handleShare: (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => Promise<void>;
    18→  isCreatingShare: boolean;
    19→  shareCopied: boolean;
    20→  shareSlug: string | null;
    21→}
    22→
    23→interface UseShareGenerationOptions {
    24→  /** Pre-existing share slug (e.g. batch-fetched by parent) */
    25→  initialShareSlug?: string;
    26→  /** Called after a new share is successfully created */
    27→  onShareCreated?: (generationId: string, slug: string) => void;

    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Sanitize task data before caching in shared_generations
    32→ * Removes potentially sensitive fields from params
    33→ */
    34→function sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(taskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null): Record<string, Json | undefined> | null {
    35→  if (!taskData) return null;
    36→
    37→  const sanitized = { ...taskData };
    38→
    39→  const redactDeep = (value: Json | undefined, depth: number = 0): Json | undefined => {
    40→    if (depth > 6) return null;
    41→    if (value == null) return value;
    42→    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => redactDeep(v, depth + 1)) as Json[];
    43→    if (typeof value === 'object') {
    44→      const out: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {};
    45→      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    46→        // Strip any obviously sensitive keys
    47→        if (/(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|service_role|authorization|stripe)/i.test(k)) {
    48→          continue;
    49→        }
    50→        out[k] = redactDeep(v, depth + 1);
    51→      }
    52→      return out;
    53→    }
    54→    return value;
    55→  };
    56→
    57→  // Remove or sanitize sensitive fields from params
    58→  if (sanitized.params) {
    59→    sanitized.params = redactDeep(sanitized.params);
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  // Remove fields that shouldn't be exposed
    63→  delete sanitized.error_message; // Could contain internal details
    64→
    65→  return sanitized;
    66→}

    81→async function copyToClipboardWithFallback(value: string): Promise<boolean> {
    82→  try {
    83→    if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    84→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    85→      return true;
    86→    }
    87→  } catch {
    88→    // Fall back to textarea copy path below.
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  try {
    92→    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    93→    textarea.value = value;
    94→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    95→    textarea.style.opacity = '0';
    96→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    97→    textarea.focus();
    98→    textarea.select();
    99→    const copied = document.execCommand('copy');
   100→    document.body.removeChild(textarea);
   101→    return copied;
   102→  } catch {
   103→    return false;
   104→  }
   105→}

   107→async function fetchExistingShareSlug(
   108→  generationId: string,
   109→  userId: string,
   110→): Promise<string | null> {
   111→  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   112→    .select('share_slug')
   113→    .eq('generation_id', generationId)
   114→    .eq('creator_id', userId)
   115→    .maybeSingle();
   116→
   117→  if (error && !isNotFoundError(error)) {
   118→    throw error;
   119→  }
   120→
   121→  return data?.share_slug ?? null;
   122→}
   123→
   124→interface ShareCachedDataResult {
   125→  generationData: Record<string, Json | undefined>;
   126→  augmentedTaskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null;
   127→}
   128→
   129→async function fetchShareCachedData(
   130→  generationId: string,
   131→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   132→  shotId?: string | null,
   133→): Promise<ShareCachedDataResult> {
   134→  const generationResult = await supabase().from('generations')
   135→    .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, type, params, created_at, name')
   136→    .eq('id', generationId)
   137→    .single();
   138→
   139→  if (generationResult.error || !generationResult.data) {
   140→    throw generationResult.error ?? new Error('Failed to load generation data');
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  let taskResultData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null = null;
   144→  if (taskId) {
   145→    const { data } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   146→      .select('id, task_type, params, status, created_at')
   147→      .eq('id', taskId)
   148→      .single();
   149→    taskResultData = data;
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  let augmentedTaskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null = taskResultData;
   153→
   154→  if (shotId) {
   155→    try {
   156→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase().from('shots')
   157→        .select('id, name, settings')
   158→        .eq('id', shotId)
   159→        .single();
   160→
   161→      const { data: shotGenerations, error: genError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   162→        .select(`
   163→          timeline_frame,
   164→          generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(
   165→            id,
   166→            location,
   167→            thumbnail_url,
   168→            type
   169→          )
   170→        `)
   171→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   172→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   173→
   174→      if (!shotError && !genError && shotData && shotGenerations) {
   175→        const settingsRecord = asJsonRecord(shotData.settings);
   176→        const travelSettings = asJsonRecord(settingsRecord?.travel_between_images) ?? {};
   177→        const generationMode = travelSettings.generationMode || 'batch';
   178→
   179→        const images = shotGenerations
   180→          .filter((sg) => sg.generation?.type === 'image' && sg.generation?.location)
   181→          .map((sg) => ({
   182→            url: sg.generation.location,
   183→            thumbnail_url: sg.generation.thumbnail_url,
   184→            timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   185→          }));
   186→
   187→        augmentedTaskData = {
   188→          ...taskResultData,
   189→          cached_shot_data: {
   190→            shot_id: shotId,
   191→            shot_name: shotData.name,
   192→            generation_mode: generationMode,
   193→            images,
   194→            settings: {
   195→              prompt: travelSettings.batchVideoPrompt || '',
   196→              negative_prompt: travelSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   197→              frames: travelSettings.batchVideoFrames || 38,
   198→              steps: travelSettings.batchVideoSteps || 6,
   199→              motion: travelSettings.amountOfMotion || 50,
   200→              enhance_prompt: travelSettings.enhancePrompt || false,
   201→              phase_config: travelSettings.phaseConfig || null,
   202→              context_frames: travelSettings.contextFrames || 0,
   203→            },
   204→          },
   205→        };
   206→      }
   207→    } catch {
   208→      // Keep share creation resilient when shot-cache enrichment fails.
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→
   212→  return {
   213→    generationData: generationResult.data,
   214→    augmentedTaskData,
   215→  };
   216→}

   218→interface InsertShareWithRetryArgs {
   219→  generationId: string;
   220→  taskId: string | null | undefined;
   221→  shotId?: string | null;
   222→  userId: string;
   223→  generationData: Record<string, Json | undefined>;
   224→  augmentedTaskData: Record<string, Json | undefined> | null;
   225→  generateShareSlug: (length?: number) => string;
   226→}
   227→
   228→async function insertShareWithRetry({
   229→  generationId,
   230→  taskId,
   231→  shotId,
   232→  userId,
   233→  generationData,
   234→  augmentedTaskData,
   235→  generateShareSlug,
   236→}: InsertShareWithRetryArgs): Promise<string | null> {
   237→  const maxAttempts = 5;
   238→  let attempts = 0;
   239→
   240→  const { data: creatorRow } = await supabase().from('users')
   241→    .select('username, name, avatar_url')
   242→    .eq('id', userId)
   243→    .maybeSingle();
   244→
   245→  while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
   246→    const candidateSlug = generateShareSlug(10);
   247→    const creator = creatorRow ?? null;
   248→    const normalizedTaskId = typeof taskId === 'string' && taskId.length > 0 ? taskId : null;
   249→    const sharedGenerationInsert = {
   250→      share_slug: candidateSlug,
   251→      ...(normalizedTaskId ? { task_id: normalizedTaskId } : {}),
   252→      generation_id: generationId,
   253→      creator_id: userId,
   254→      creator_username: creator?.username ?? null,
   255→      creator_name: creator?.name ?? null,
   256→      creator_avatar_url: creator?.avatar_url ?? null,
   257→      cached_generation_data: generationData,
   258→      cached_task_data: sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(augmentedTaskData),
   259→      shot_id: shotId || null,
   260→    };
   261→
   262→    const { data: newShare, error: insertError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   263→      .insert(sharedGenerationInsert)
   264→      .select('share_slug')
   265→      .single();
   266→
   267→    if (!insertError && newShare) {
   268→      return newShare.share_slug;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    if (isUniqueViolationError(insertError)) {
   272→      attempts++;
   273→      continue;
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    if (insertError) {
   277→      throw insertError;
   278→    }
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  return null;
   282→}
   283→
   284→interface CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs {
   285→  slug: string;
   286→  successTitle: string;
   287→  successDescription: string;
   288→  fallbackTitle: string;
   289→  fallbackDescription: string;
   290→  setShareCopied: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
   291→}
   292→
   293→async function copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   294→  slug,
   295→  successTitle,
   296→  successDescription,
   297→  fallbackTitle,
   298→  fallbackDescription,
   299→  setShareCopied,
   300→}: CopyShareLinkAndNotifyArgs): Promise<void> {
   301→  const copied = await copyToClipboardWithFallback(buildShareUrl(slug));
   302→  if (copied) {
   303→    markShareCopied(setShareCopied);
   304→    toast({ title: successTitle, description: successDescription });
   305→    return;
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  toast({ title: fallbackTitle, description: fallbackDescription });
   309→}

   311→/**
   312→ * Hook to handle sharing of generations via unique slug
   313→ *
   314→ * @param generationId - The generation to share
   315→ * @param taskId - The task associated with the generation
   316→ * @param shotId - Optional shot ID for final videos (to fetch input images and settings)
   317→ */
   318→export function useShareGeneration(
   319→  generationId: string | undefined,
   320→  taskId: string | null | undefined,
   321→  shotId?: string | null,
   322→  options?: UseShareGenerationOptions
   323→): UseShareGenerationResult {
   324→  const { initialShareSlug, onShareCreated } = options ?? {};
   325→  const [shareSlug, setShareSlug] = useState<string | null>(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   326→  const [isCreatingShare, setIsCreatingShare] = useState(false);
   327→  const [shareCopied, setShareCopied] = useState(false);
   328→  // Reset share state when shot/generation changes
   329→  useEffect(() => {
   330→    setShareSlug(initialShareSlug ?? null);
   331→    setShareCopied(false);
   332→  }, [generationId, shotId, initialShareSlug]);
   333→
   334→  // Generate a short, URL-friendly random string
   335→  const generateShareSlug = (length: number = 10): string => {
   336→    const chars = [REDACTED];
   337→    let result = '';
   338→    const randomValues = new Uint8Array(length);
   339→    crypto.getRandomValues(randomValues);
   340→    
   341→    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
   342→      result += chars[randomValues[i] % chars.length];
   343→    }
   344→    
   345→    return result;
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  const handleShare = useCallback(async (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
   349→    e.stopPropagation();
   350→    e.preventDefault();
   351→
   352→    if (!generationId) {
   353→      toast({
   354→        title: 'Cannot create share',
   355→        description: 'Generation information not available',
   356→        variant: 'destructive',
   357→      });
   358→      return;
   359→    }
   360→
   361→    if (shareSlug) {
   362→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   363→        slug: shareSlug,
   364→        successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   365→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   366→        fallbackTitle: 'Share ready',
   367→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   368→        setShareCopied,
   369→      });
   370→      return;
   371→    }
   372→
   373→    setIsCreatingShare(true);
   374→    try {
   375→      const { data: sessionData } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   376→      const [REDACTED]?.access_token;
   377→      const userId = sessionData.session?.user.id;
   378→
   379→      if (!accessToken || !userId) {
   380→        toast({
   381→          title: 'Authentication required',
   382→          description: 'Please sign in to create share links',
   383→          variant: 'destructive',
   384→        });
   385→        return;
   386→      }
   387→
   388→      const existingSlug = await fetchExistingShareSlug(generationId, userId);
   389→      if (existingSlug) {
   390→        setShareSlug(existingSlug);
   391→        await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   392→          slug: existingSlug,
   393→          successTitle: 'Link copied!',
   394→          successDescription: 'Existing share link copied to clipboard',
   395→          fallbackTitle: 'Share found',
   396→          fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   397→          setShareCopied,
   398→        });
   399→        return;
   400→      }
   401→
   402→      const { generationData, augmentedTaskData } = await fetchShareCachedData(
   403→        generationId,
   404→        taskId,
   405→        shotId,
   406→      );
   407→
   408→      const newSlug = await insertShareWithRetry({
   409→        generationId,
   410→        taskId,
   411→        shotId,
   412→        userId,
   413→        generationData,
   414→        augmentedTaskData,
   415→        generateShareSlug,
   416→      });
   417→
   418→      if (!newSlug) {
   419→        toast({
   420→          title: 'Share failed',
   421→          description: 'Failed to generate unique link. Please try again.',
   422→          variant: 'destructive',
   423→        });
   424→        return;
   425→      }
   426→
   427→      setShareSlug(newSlug);
   428→      onShareCreated?.(generationId, newSlug);
   429→
   430→      await copyShareLinkAndNotify({
   431→        slug: newSlug,
   432→        successTitle: 'Share created!',
   433→        successDescription: 'Share link copied to clipboard',
   434→        fallbackTitle: 'Share created',
   435→        fallbackDescription: 'Click the copy button to copy the link',
   436→        setShareCopied,
   437→      });
   438→    } catch (error) {
   439→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   440→        context: 'useShareGeneration',
   441→        toastTitle: 'Share failed',
   442→        logData: { message: 'Please try again' },
   443→      });
   444→    } finally {
   445→      setIsCreatingShare(false);
   446→    }
   447→  }, [generationId, onShareCreated, shareSlug, shotId, taskId]);
   448→
   449→  return {
   450→    handleShare,
   451→    isCreatingShare,
   452→    shareCopied,
   453→    shareSlug
   454→  };
   455→}

   167→    }
   168→
   169→    // No persisted settings yet.
   170→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   171→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   172→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   173→    if (!isReady) {
   174→      return {

   187→        createAsGeneration: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.createAsGeneration,
   188→      };

   191→    // Initialized: use the live per-generation state BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)

   193→      ...generationSettings.settings,
   194→      editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   195→    };
   196→  }, [

     5→
     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→import { asRecord, asString, firstString } from '@/shared/lib/jsonNarrowing';
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}
   125→
   126→/**
   127→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   128→ */
   129→export interface RawVariant {
   130→  id: string;
   131→  generation_id: string;
   132→  location: string;
   133→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   134→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   135→  variant_type?: string | null;
   136→  name?: string | null;
   137→  created_at: string;
   138→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   139→  is_primary?: boolean;
   140→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   145→ */
   146→export interface RawGeneration {
   147→  id: string;
   148→  location: string;
   149→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   150→  type?: string | null;
   151→  created_at: string;
   152→  updated_at?: string | null;
   153→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   154→  starred?: boolean | null;
   155→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   156→  based_on?: string | null;
   157→  name?: string | null;
   158→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   159→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   160→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   161→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   162→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   163→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   164→  child_order?: number | null;
   165→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   166→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   167→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   168→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   173→ */
   174→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   175→  id: string;
   176→  shot_id: string;
   177→  generation_id: string;
   178→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   179→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   180→  created_at?: string;
   181→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Options for transformation customization
   187→ */
   188→interface TransformOptions {
   189→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   191→  /** Timeline frame position */
   192→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   193→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   194→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   195→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   196→  shotId?: string;
   197→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   198→  verbose?: boolean;
   199→}
   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}

    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(

   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   191→  /** Timeline frame position */
   192→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   193→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   194→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   195→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   196→  shotId?: string;
   197→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   198→  verbose?: boolean;
   199→}
   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→
