   257→        isFinalStep: false,
   258→        supabaseUrl,
   259→        serviceKey,
   260→        logger,
   261→      },
   262→    );
   263→  } catch (error) {
   264→    throw toCompletionError(error, {
   265→      code: 'orchestrator_completion_failed',
   266→      context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   267→      recoverable: true,
   268→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Completion flow failed for task ${taskIdString}`,
   269→      metadata: {
   270→        task_id: taskIdString,
   271→        task_type: completedTask.task_type,
   272→        project_id: completedTask.project_id,
   273→      },
   274→    });
   275→  }
   276→}
   277→/**
   278→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   279→ */
   280→async function findSiblingSegments(
   281→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   282→  segmentType: string,
   283→  projectId: string,
   284→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   285→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   286→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   287→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   288→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   289→      supabase,
   290→      taskType: segmentType,
   291→      projectId,
   292→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   293→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   294→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   295→    });
   296→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   297→      return runIdRows;
   298→    }
   299→  }
   300→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   301→    supabase,
   302→    taskType: segmentType,
   303→    projectId,
   304→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   305→    orchestratorTaskId,
   306→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   307→  });
   308→  return orchestratorRows;
   309→}
   310→/**
   311→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   312→ */
   313→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   314→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   315→  finalStepType: string,
   316→  projectId: string,
   317→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   318→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   319→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   320→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   321→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   322→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   323→      supabase,
   324→      taskType: finalStepType,
   325→      projectId,
   326→      select: "id, status",
   327→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   328→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   329→    });
   330→  }
   331→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   332→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   333→      supabase,
   334→      taskType: finalStepType,
   335→      projectId,
   336→      select: "id, status",
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   342→    return 'not_found';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   345→    return 'failed';
   346→  }
   347→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
   348→    return 'complete';
   349→  }
   350→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
   351→    return 'pending';
   352→  }
   353→  return 'unknown';
   354→}
   355→/**
   356→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   357→ */
   358→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   359→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   360→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   361→  failedSegments: number,
   362→  totalSegments: number,
   363→  errorMessage?: string,
   364→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   365→): Promise<void> {
   366→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   367→    .from("tasks")
   368→    .update({
   369→      status: TASK_STATUS.FAILED,
   370→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   371→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   372→    })
   373→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   374→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   375→    .select('id');
   376→  if (updateOrchError) {
   377→    throw new CompletionError({
   378→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   379→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   380→      recoverable: true,
   381→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   382→      metadata: {
   383→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   384→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   385→          ? updateOrchError.message
   386→          : String(updateOrchError),
   387→      },
   388→      cause: updateOrchError,
   389→    });
   390→  }
   391→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   392→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   393→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   394→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   395→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   396→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   397→    });
   398→  }
   399→}
   400→/**
   401→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   402→ */
   403→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   404→  params: {
   405→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   406→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   407→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   408→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   409→    publicUrl: string;
   410→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   411→    supabaseUrl: string;
   412→    serviceKey: string;
   413→    logger?: CompletionLogger;
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status

    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];

    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {

    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(

    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {

   292→
   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}
   365→

     4→declare const Deno: { env: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined } };
     5→
     6→/**
     7→ * Fallback user ID used when task ownership cannot be resolved
     8→ * (e.g., project lookup fails). Used for storage path construction
     9→ * so files land in a known "system" folder instead of failing entirely.
    10→ */
    11→export const SYSTEM_USER_ID = 'system' as const;
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Authentication result for edge functions
    15→ */
    16→export interface AuthResult {
    17→  isServiceRole: boolean;
    18→  userId: string | null; // Set if user token (PAT or JWT)
    19→  success: boolean;
    20→  error?: string;
    21→  statusCode?: number;
    22→  isJwtAuth?: boolean; // True if authenticated via JWT (as opposed to PAT)
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Options for authenticateRequest
    27→ */
    28→export interface AuthOptions {
    29→  /** If true, also accept Supabase JWTs and extract user ID from payload.sub */
    30→  allowJwtUserAuth?: boolean;
    31→}
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Authenticates a request using Bearer token (Service Role Key, JWT, or PAT)
    35→ *
    36→ * This function handles authentication methods:
    37→ * 1. Service Role Key - Direct match with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    38→ * 2. Personal Access Token (PAT) - Looked up in user_api_tokens table
    39→ * 3. JWT User Auth (optional) - Extract user ID from JWT payload.sub
    40→ *
    41→ * NOTE: We intentionally do NOT accept JWTs with service_role claims.
    42→ * Only the actual service key can be used for service role access.
    43→ * This prevents unsigned/forged JWTs from gaining elevated privileges.
    44→ *
    45→ * @param req - The incoming HTTP request
    46→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client for database queries
    47→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages (e.g., "[FUNCTION-NAME]")
    48→ * @param options - Optional settings for auth behavior
    49→ * @returns AuthResult with authentication details
    50→ */
    51→export async function authenticateRequest(
    52→  req: Request,
    53→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
    54→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]",
    55→  options: AuthOptions = {}
    56→): Promise<AuthResult> {
    57→  // Extract authorization header
    58→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    59→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    60→    return {
    61→      isServiceRole: false,
    62→      userId: null,
    63→      success: false,
    64→      error: "Missing or invalid Authorization header",
    65→      statusCode: 401
    66→    };
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const [REDACTED](7); // Remove "Bearer " prefix
    70→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    71→
    72→  if (!serviceKey) {
    73→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable`);
    74→    return {
    75→      isServiceRole: false,
    76→      userId: null,
    77→      success: false,
    78→      error: "Server configuration error",
    79→      statusCode: 500
    80→    };
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // 1) Check if token matches service-role key directly (SECURE)
    84→  if (token === serviceKey) {
    85→    return {
    86→      isServiceRole: true,
    87→      userId: null,
    88→      success: true
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  // 2) If JWT user auth is enabled, verify JWT and extract user ID
    93→  if (options.allowJwtUserAuth) {
    94→    try {
    95→      const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);
    96→      const user = data?.user;
    97→      if (!error && user) {
    98→        const roleCandidate = typeof user.role === "string"
    99→          ? user.role
   100→          : typeof user.app_metadata?.role === "string"
   101→            ? user.app_metadata.role
   102→            : null;
   103→
   104→        // Reject service/admin-role JWTs from user-auth path.
   105→        if (!["service_role", "supabase_admin"].includes(roleCandidate ?? "") && user.id) {
   106→          return {
   107→            isServiceRole: false,
   108→            userId: user.id,
   109→            success: true,
   110→            isJwtAuth: true
   111→          };
   112→        }
   113→      }
   114→    } catch {
   115→      // Invalid or unverifiable JWT - continue to PAT lookup
   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  // 3) Personal Access Token (PAT) - look up in user_api_tokens table (SECURE)
   120→
   121→  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
   122→    .from("user_api_tokens")
   123→    .select("user_id")
   124→    .eq("token", token)
   125→    .single();
   126→
   127→  if (error || !data) {
   128→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Credential lookup failed`);
   129→    return {
   130→      isServiceRole: false,
   131→      userId: null,
   132→      success: false,
   133→      error: "Invalid or expired token",
   134→      statusCode: 403
   135→    };
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const userId = data.user_id;
   139→  return {
   140→    isServiceRole: false,
   141→    userId,
   142→    success: true
   143→  };
   144→}
   145→
   146→/**
   147→ * Verifies that a user owns a specific task
   148→ * 
   149→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client
   150→ * @param taskId - Task ID to verify
   151→ * @param userId - User ID to check ownership
   152→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages
   153→ * @returns Object with success status and optional error details
   154→ */
   155→export async function verifyTaskOwnership(
   156→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
   157→  taskId: string,
   158→  userId: string,
   159→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]"
   160→): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; statusCode?: number; projectId?: string }> {
   161→
   162→  // Get task and its project
   163→  const { data: taskData, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
   164→    .from("tasks")
   165→    .select("project_id")
   166→    .eq("id", taskId)
   167→    .single();
   168→
   169→  if (taskError || !taskData) {
   170→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Task lookup error:`, taskError);
   171→    return {
   172→      success: false,
   173→      error: "Task not found",
   174→      statusCode: 404
   175→    };
   176→  }
   177→
   178→  // Check if user owns the project that this task belongs to
   179→  const { data: projectData, error: projectError } = await supabaseAdmin
   180→    .from("projects")
   181→    .select("user_id")
   182→    .eq("id", taskData.project_id)
   183→    .single();
   184→
   185→  if (projectError || !projectData) {
   186→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Project lookup error:`, projectError);
   187→    return {
   188→      success: false,
   189→      error: "Project not found",
   190→      statusCode: 404
   191→    };
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  if (projectData.user_id !== userId) {
   195→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Task ${taskId} belongs to project ${taskData.project_id} owned by ${projectData.user_id}, not user ${userId}`);
   196→    return {
   197→      success: false,
   198→      error: "Forbidden: Task does not belong to user",
   199→      statusCode: 403
   200→    };
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return {
   204→    success: true,
   205→    projectId: taskData.project_id
   206→  };
   207→}
   208→
   209→/**
   210→ * Verifies that a user owns a specific shot (via its project)
   211→ * 
   212→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client

   214→ * @param userId - User ID to check ownership
   215→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages

   217→ */
   218→export async function verifyShotOwnership(
   219→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,

   221→  userId: string,
   222→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]"
   223→): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; statusCode?: number; projectId?: string }> {
   224→
   225→  // Get shot and its project
   226→  const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabaseAdmin
   227→    .from("shots")
   228→    .select("project_id")
   229→    .eq("id", shotId)
   230→    .single();
   231→
   232→  if (shotError || !shotData) {
   233→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Shot lookup error:`, shotError);
   234→    return {
   235→      success: false,
   236→      error: "Shot not found",
   237→      statusCode: 404
   238→    };
   239→  }
   240→
   241→  // Check if user owns the project that this shot belongs to
   242→  const { data: projectData, error: projectError } = await supabaseAdmin
   243→    .from("projects")
   244→    .select("user_id")
   245→    .eq("id", shotData.project_id)
   246→    .single();
   247→
   248→  if (projectError || !projectData) {
   249→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Project lookup error:`, projectError);
   250→    return {
   251→      success: false,
   252→      error: "Project not found",
   253→      statusCode: 404
   254→    };
   255→  }
   256→
   257→  if (projectData.user_id !== userId) {
   258→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Shot ${shotId} belongs to project ${shotData.project_id} owned by ${projectData.user_id}, not user ${userId}`);
   259→    return {
   260→      success: false,
   261→      error: "Forbidden: Shot does not belong to user",
   262→      statusCode: 403
   263→    };
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return {
   267→    success: true,
   268→    projectId: shotData.project_id
   269→  };
   270→}
   271→
   272→/**
   273→ * Gets the user ID for a task (for service role requests)
   274→ * 
   275→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client
   276→ * @param taskId - Task ID
   277→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages
   278→ * @returns Object with userId or error
   279→ */
   280→export async function getTaskUserId(
   281→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
   282→  taskId: string,
   283→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]"
   284→): Promise<{ userId: string | null; error?: string; statusCode?: number }> {
   285→
   286→  const { data: taskData, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
   287→    .from("tasks")
   288→    .select("project_id")
   289→    .eq("id", taskId)
   290→    .single();
   291→
   292→  if (taskError || !taskData) {
   293→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Task lookup error:`, taskError);
   294→    return {
   295→      userId: null,
   296→      error: "Task not found",
   297→      statusCode: 404
   298→    };
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  const { data: projectData, error: projectError } = await supabaseAdmin
   302→    .from("projects")
   303→    .select("user_id")
   304→    .eq("id", taskData.project_id)
   305→    .single();
   306→
   307→  if (projectError || !projectData) {
   308→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Project lookup error:`, projectError);
   309→    // Fallback to system folder — files are stored under SYSTEM_USER_ID
   310→    // so the task can still complete even if the project was deleted
   311→    return {

   313→    };
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  return {

1→/**
     2→ * usePanelModeRestore Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles automatic restoration of edit/info panel mode when media changes.
     5→ * If the user was last in edit mode, automatically re-enters edit mode.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     9→
    10→interface UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    11→  /** Current media ID for tracking changes */
    12→  mediaId: string;
    13→  /** Persisted panel mode from last used settings */
    14→  persistedPanelMode: 'edit' | 'info' | null | undefined;
    15→  /** Whether currently in special edit mode (image) */
    16→  isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
    17→  /** Whether currently in video edit mode */
    18→  isInVideoEditMode: boolean;
    19→  /** Whether initial video trim mode was requested */
    20→  initialVideoTrimMode?: boolean;
    21→  /** Whether initial edit active was requested (explicit mode set, skip restore) */
    22→  initialEditActive?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    26→  isVideo: true;
    27→  /** Handler to enter video edit mode */
    28→  handleEnterVideoEditMode: () => void;
    29→}
    30→
    31→interface UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    32→  isVideo: false;
    33→  /** Handler to enter magic edit mode (image) */
    34→  handleEnterMagicEditMode: () => void;
    35→}
    36→
    37→interface UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    38→  /** Whether panel mode has been restored for current media */
    39→  hasRestoredPanelMode: boolean;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Automatically restores the last used panel mode (edit/info) when opening a media item.
    44→ * Prevents loops by tracking restoration per-media and respecting explicit modes.
    45→ */
    46→export function usePanelModeRestore({
    47→  mediaId,
    48→  persistedPanelMode,
    49→  isVideo,
    50→  isSpecialEditMode,
    51→  isInVideoEditMode,
    52→  initialVideoTrimMode,
    53→  initialEditActive,
    54→  ...modeHandlers
    55→}: UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps | UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps): UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    56→  const hasRestoredPanelModeRef = useRef(false);
    57→  const enterEditMode = isVideo
    58→    ? modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEditMode
    59→    : modeHandlers.handleEnterMagicEditMode;
    60→
    61→  // Main restoration effect
    62→  useEffect(() => {
    63→
    64→    // Only restore once per media (prevent loops)
    65→    if (hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current) {
    66→      return;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    // Don't restore if initialVideoTrimMode or initialEditActive is set (explicit modes take precedence)
    70→    if (initialVideoTrimMode || initialEditActive) {
    71→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    72→      return;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    // Don't restore if already in edit mode
    76→    if (isSpecialEditMode || isInVideoEditMode) {
    77→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    78→      return;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (persistedPanelMode === 'edit') {
    82→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    83→      setTimeout(() => enterEditMode(), 0);
    84→    } else {
    85→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    86→    }
    87→  }, [
    88→    persistedPanelMode,
    89→    enterEditMode,
    90→    initialVideoTrimMode,
    91→    initialEditActive,
    92→    isSpecialEditMode,
    93→    isInVideoEditMode,
    94→  ]);
    95→
    96→  // Reset restore flag when media changes
    97→  useEffect(() => {
    98→    hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = false;
    99→  }, [mediaId]);
   100→
   101→  return {
   102→    hasRestoredPanelMode: hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→

    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({

    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,

    66→function deriveErrorCode(message: string, status: number): string {

    68→  if (normalized === 'method not allowed' || status === 405) {

   140→export async function bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   141→  req: Request,

   153→  }

   155→  const runtimeResult = initEdgeRuntime(
   156→    options.functionName,
   157→    options.logPrefix,
   158→    options.runtimeOptions,

   160→  if (!runtimeResult.ok) {

   162→      ok: false,

   168→

   170→    logger.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
   171→    await logger.flush();
   172→    return {

   179→
   180→  if (parseMode(options) === 'strict') {
   181→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBodyStrict(req, logger, {
   182→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   183→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   184→    });
   185→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   186→      return {
   187→        ok: false,
   188→        response: format === 'text'
   189→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   190→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   191→      };
   192→    }
   193→    body = parsedBody.value;
   194→  } else if (parseMode(options) === 'loose') {
   195→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   196→      mode: 'loose',
   197→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   198→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   199→    });
   200→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   201→      return {
   202→        ok: false,
   203→        response: format === 'text'
   204→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   205→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   206→      };
   207→    }
   208→    body = parsedBody.value;
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  let auth: AuthResult | null = null;
   212→  if (authIsRequired(options)) {
   213→    auth = await authenticateRequest(
   214→      req,
   215→      supabaseAdmin,
   216→      options.logPrefix,
   217→      options.auth?.options ?? {},
   218→    );
   219→    if (!auth.success) {
   220→      return {
   221→        ok: false,
   222→        response: buildErrorResponse(
   223→          auth.error || 'Authentication failed',
   224→          auth.statusCode || 401,
   225→          format,
   226→        ),
   227→      };
   228→    }
   229→
   230→    if (options.auth?.requireServiceRole && !auth.isServiceRole) {
   231→      return {
   232→        ok: false,
   233→        response: buildErrorResponse('Unauthorized - service role required', 403, format),
   234→      };
   235→    }
   236→  }
   237→
   238→  return {
   239→    ok: true,
   240→    value: {
   241→      req,
   242→      body: body as TBody,
   243→      supabaseAdmin,
   244→      logger,
   245→      auth,
   246→    },
   247→  };
   248→}
   249→
   250→/**
   251→ * High-level request wrapper that standardizes edge endpoint choreography:
   252→ * bootstrap -> handler -> unified unexpected-error response -> guaranteed flush.
   253→ */
   254→export async function withEdgeRequest<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   255→  req: Request,
   256→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   257→  handler: (context: EdgeRequestContext<TBody>) => Promise<Response>,
   258→): Promise<Response> {
   259→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody>(req, options);
   260→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
   261→    return bootstrap.response;
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  const context = bootstrap.value;
   265→  try {
   266→    return await handler(context);
   267→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   268→    context.logger.critical('Unexpected error', {
   269→      error: toErrorMessage(error),
   270→    });
   271→    return buildErrorResponse('Internal server error', 500, errorFormat(options));
   272→  } finally {
   273→    await context.logger.flush();
   274→  }
   275→}

    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }
    49→  return now - lastEvent < freshnessThreshold;
    50→}
    51→
    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(
    53→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    54→  now: number,
    55→  parseQueryKey: (rawKey: string) => unknown,
    56→): Array<{ query: unknown; ageMs: number; ageSec: number }> {
    57→  return Array.from(lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => ({
    58→    query: parseQueryKey(key),
    59→    ageMs: now - time,
    60→    ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000),
    61→  }));
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface DataFreshnessState {
    65→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    66→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    67→  lastStatusChange: number;
    68→  /** Track consecutive fetch failures per query for circuit breaker */
    69→  fetchFailures: Map<string, { count: number; lastFailure: number }>;
    70→}
    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→
    90→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    91→    try {
    92→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);
    93→    } catch {
    94→      return rawKey;
    95→    }
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {
   108→      return; // Don't update state or notify subscribers for duplicates
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Actual status transition - update state
   112→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
   113→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
   114→
   115→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
   116→    this.notifySubscribers();
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  /**
   120→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
   121→   */
   122→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   123→    const now = Date.now();
   124→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, affectedQueries, now);
   125→
   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
   127→    this.notifySubscribers();
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */
   134→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
   142→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }
   146→
   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   173→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   174→
   175→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   176→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   177→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   178→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→
   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→

   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {

    95→        const newPrompts = toPromptEntries(rawResults);
    96→        setPrompts(newPrompts);
    97→
    98→        const taskParams = getTaskParams(newPrompts, { imagesPerPromptOverride: promptMultiplier });
    99→        if (!taskParams) {
   100→          return;
   101→        }
   102→
   103→        const result = await onGenerate(taskParams);
   104→        return result || undefined;
   105→      },
   106→    });
   107→  }, [
   108→    aiGeneratePrompts,
   109→    generationSourceRef,
   110→    getTaskParams,
   111→    imagesPerPrompt,
   112→    onGenerate,
   113→    promptMultiplier,
   114→    prompts,
   115→    queueIncomingTask,
   116→    setPrompts,
   117→    styleReferenceImageGeneration,
   118→  ]);
   119→
   120→  return {
   121→    queueExisting,
   122→    queueLikeExisting,
   123→  };

    67→| `/src/features` | Feature slices (tasks, shots, gallery, settings, etc.) | UI + hooks organized by product feature |
    68→| `/src/integrations` | Third-party integrations | Supabase client, auth, realtime, instrumentation |
    69→| `/src/types` | Shared TypeScript types | `database.ts`, `tasks.ts`, `ai.ts`, `env.ts` |
    70→| `/src/shared` | Shared code | `components/ui/` (shadcn), `hooks/`, `contexts/`, `lib/` |
    71→| `/supabase/functions` | Edge Functions | Task processing, payments, AI integration |
    72→| `/supabase/migrations` | DB migrations | Schema changes (use `db push --linked`) |
    73→| Root | Build configs | `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `railway.toml` |

1→/**
     2→ * Generation routing for complete_task
     3→ *
     4→ * This file contains the main routing logic. Handlers are in generation-handlers.ts.
     5→ * File structure:
     6→ * - generation.ts: Routing (this file)
     7→ * - generation-handlers.ts: All handlers
     8→ * - generation-child.ts: Child generation + segment helpers
     9→ * - generation-core.ts: CRUD primitives
    10→ * - generation-parent.ts: Parent relationship helpers
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import type { SupabaseClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7';
    14→import { extractShotAndPosition, extractBasedOn } from './params.ts';
    15→import { findExistingGeneration, createVariant, linkGenerationToShot } from './generation-core.ts';
    16→import {
    17→  handleVariantCreation,
    18→  handleVariantOnParent,
    19→  handleVariantOnChild,
    20→  handleChildGeneration,
    21→  handleStandaloneGeneration,
    22→} from './generation-handlers.ts';
    23→import { TASK_TYPES } from './constants.ts';
    24→import { assertCompletionAuthContext, type CompletionAuthContext } from './authContext.ts';
    25→import {
    26→  buildTaskPayloadSnapshot,
    27→  resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId,
    28→  resolveSnapshotChildOrder,
    29→  resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem,
    30→  resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId,
    31→} from '../_shared/taskPayloadSnapshot.ts';
    32→import { asObjectOrEmpty } from '../_shared/payloadNormalization.ts';
    33→import { CompletionError, toCompletionError } from './errors.ts';
    34→import type { CompletionLogger } from './types.ts';
    35→
    36→type GenerationSkipReason =
    37→  | 'orchestration_task'
    38→  | 'skip_generation_flag';
    39→
    40→interface GenerationRef {
    41→  id: string;
    42→}
    43→
    44→export type GenerationCreationOutcome =
    45→  | { status: 'skipped'; reason: GenerationSkipReason }
    46→  | { status: 'created'; generation: GenerationRef };
    47→
    48→interface CompletedTaskData {
    49→  category?: string;
    50→  task_type?: string;
    51→  tool_type?: string;
    52→  project_id?: string;
    53→  params: Record<string, unknown>;
    54→}
    55→
    56→interface GenerationRouteParams {
    57→  basedOn: string | null;
    58→  createAsGeneration: boolean;
    59→  childGenerationId: string | null;
    60→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
    61→  childOrder: number | null;
    62→  isSingleItem: boolean;
    63→  isStitchTask: boolean;
    64→}
    65→
    66→interface GenerationHandlerContext {
    67→  supabase: SupabaseClient;
    68→  taskId: string;
    69→  taskData: CompletedTaskData;
    70→  publicUrl: string;
    71→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    72→  logger?: CompletionLogger;
    73→  childGenerationId?: string;
    74→  parentGenerationId?: string;
    75→  childOrder?: number | null;
    76→  isSingleItem?: boolean;
    77→}
    78→
    79→type GenerationRouteAttempt =
    80→  | 'variant_on_child'
    81→  | 'variant_on_parent'
    82→  | 'child_generation'
    83→  | 'standalone';
    84→
    85→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    86→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    87→    return null;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    91→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {
    92→    return null;
    93→  }
    94→
    95→  return { id: candidate.id };
    96→}
    97→
    98→function normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData: unknown): CompletedTaskData {
    99→  const record = asObjectOrEmpty(taskData);
   100→  return {
   101→    category: typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category : undefined,
   102→    task_type: typeof record.task_type === 'string' ? record.task_type : undefined,
   103→    tool_type: typeof record.tool_type === 'string' ? record.tool_type : undefined,
   104→    project_id: typeof record.project_id === 'string' ? record.project_id : undefined,
   105→    params: asObjectOrEmpty(record.params),
   106→  };
   107→}
   108→
   109→function getGenerationSkipReason(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationSkipReason | null {
   110→  if (taskData.category === 'orchestration') {
   111→    return 'orchestration_task';
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  if (taskData.params.skip_generation === true) {
   115→    return 'skip_generation_flag';
   116→  }
   117→
   118→  return null;
   119→}
   120→
   121→function resolveGenerationRouteParams(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationRouteParams {
   122→  const params = taskData.params;
   123→  const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   124→
   125→  const basedOn = extractBasedOn(params);
   126→  const createAsGeneration = (
   127→    params.create_as_generation === true
   128→    || payloadSnapshot.orchestrationContract.create_as_generation === true
   129→  );
   130→
   131→  const childGenerationId = resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   132→  const parentGenerationId = resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   133→  const childOrder = resolveSnapshotChildOrder(payloadSnapshot);
   134→  const isSingleItem = resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(payloadSnapshot);
   135→
   136→  const isStitchTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_STITCH
   137→    || taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_FINAL_STITCH;
   138→
   139→  return {
   140→    basedOn,
   141→    createAsGeneration,
   142→    childGenerationId,
   143→    parentGenerationId,
   144→    childOrder,
   145→    isSingleItem,
   146→    isStitchTask,
   147→  };
   148→}
   149→
   150→function classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams: GenerationRouteParams): GenerationRouteAttempt[] {
   151→  const attempts: GenerationRouteAttempt[] = [];
   152→
   153→  if (routeParams.childGenerationId) {
   154→    attempts.push('variant_on_child');
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  if (routeParams.isStitchTask && routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   158→    attempts.push('variant_on_parent');
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  if (routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   162→    attempts.push('child_generation');
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  attempts.push('standalone');
   166→  return attempts;
   167→}
   168→
   169→async function executeGenerationRouteAttempt(
   170→  attempt: GenerationRouteAttempt,
   171→  ctx: GenerationHandlerContext,
   172→): Promise<GenerationRef | null> {
   173→  switch (attempt) {
   174→    case 'variant_on_child':
   175→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnChild(ctx));
   176→    case 'variant_on_parent':
   177→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnParent(ctx));
   178→    case 'child_generation':
   179→      return toGenerationRef(await handleChildGeneration(ctx));
   180→    case 'standalone':
   181→      return toGenerationRef(await handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx));
   182→  }
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   187→ *
   188→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   189→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   190→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   191→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   192→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   193→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   194→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   195→ *
   196→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   197→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   198→ */
   199→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   200→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   201→  taskId: string,
   202→  taskData: unknown,
   203→  publicUrl: string,
   204→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   205→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   206→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   207→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
   208→  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
   209→
   210→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   211→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   212→  if (skipReason) {
   213→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   214→  }
   215→
   216→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   217→
   218→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   219→    task_id: taskId,
   220→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   221→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   222→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   223→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   224→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   225→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   226→  });
   227→
   228→  try {
   229→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   230→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   231→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
   232→      throw new CompletionError({
   233→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   234→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   235→        recoverable: false,
   236→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   237→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   238→      });
   239→    }
   240→
   241→    if (existingGeneration) {
   242→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   243→        supabase,
   244→        taskId,
   245→        normalizedTaskData,
   246→        existingGeneration,
   247→        publicUrl,
   248→        thumbnailUrl,
   249→        logger,
   250→      );
   251→      return { status: 'created', generation };
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
   255→      const success = await handleVariantCreation(
   256→        supabase,
   257→        taskId,
   258→        normalizedTaskData,
   259→        routeParams.basedOn,
   260→        publicUrl,
   261→        thumbnailUrl,
   262→      );
   263→      if (success) {
   264→        return { status: 'created', generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn } };
   265→      }
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
   269→      supabase,
   270→      taskId,
   271→      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
   272→      publicUrl,
   273→      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
   274→      logger,
   275→      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
   276→      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
   277→      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
   278→      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   279→    };
   280→
   281→    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
   282→      const generation = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);
   283→      if (generation) {
   284→        return { status: 'created', generation };
   285→      }
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    throw new CompletionError({
   289→      code: 'generation_route_no_result',
   290→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   291→      recoverable: false,
   292→      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
   293→      metadata: {
   294→        task_id: taskId,
   295→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   296→        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
   297→      },
   298→    });
   299→
   300→  } catch (error) {
   301→    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
   302→      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
   303→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   304→      recoverable: true,
   305→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   306→      metadata: {
   307→        task_id: taskId,
   308→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   309→      },
   310→    });
   311→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   312→      task_id: taskId,
   313→      error: normalizedError.message,
   314→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   315→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   316→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   317→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   318→    });
   319→    throw normalizedError;
   320→  }
   321→}
   322→
   323→/**
   324→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   325→ */
   326→async function handleRegeneration(
   327→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   328→  taskId: string,
   329→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   330→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   331→  publicUrl: string,
   332→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   333→  logger?: CompletionLogger
   334→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   335→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   336→    task_id: taskId,
   337→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   338→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   339→  });
   340→
   341→  const variantParams = {
   342→    ...taskData.params,
   343→    source_task_id: taskId,
   344→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   345→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  await createVariant(
   349→    supabase,
   350→    existingGeneration.id,
   351→    publicUrl,
   352→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   353→    variantParams,
   354→    true,
   355→    'regenerated',
   356→    null
   357→  );
   358→
   359→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   360→  if (shotId) {
   361→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   365→    .from('tasks')
   366→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   367→    .eq('id', taskId);
   368→
   369→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   370→    throw new CompletionError({
   371→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
   372→      context: 'handleRegeneration',
   373→      recoverable: true,
   374→      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
   375→      metadata: {
   376→        task_id: taskId,
   377→        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   378→      },
   379→      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return existingGeneration;
   384→}
   385→

   277→/**
   278→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   279→ */
   280→async function findSiblingSegments(
   281→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   282→  segmentType: string,
   283→  projectId: string,
   284→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   285→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   286→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   287→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   288→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   289→      supabase,
   290→      taskType: segmentType,
   291→      projectId,
   292→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   293→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   294→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   295→    });
   296→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   297→      return runIdRows;
   298→    }
   299→  }
   300→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   301→    supabase,
   302→    taskType: segmentType,
   303→    projectId,
   304→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   305→    orchestratorTaskId,
   306→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   307→  });
   308→  return orchestratorRows;
   309→}
   310→/**
   311→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   312→ */
   313→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   314→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   315→  finalStepType: string,
   316→  projectId: string,
   317→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   318→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   319→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   320→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   321→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   322→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   323→      supabase,
   324→      taskType: finalStepType,
   325→      projectId,
   326→      select: "id, status",
   327→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   328→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   329→    });
   330→  }
   331→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   332→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   333→      supabase,
   334→      taskType: finalStepType,
   335→      projectId,
   336→      select: "id, status",
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   342→    return 'not_found';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   345→    return 'failed';
   346→  }
   347→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
   348→    return 'complete';
   349→  }
   350→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
   351→    return 'pending';
   352→  }
   353→  return 'unknown';
   354→}
   355→/**
   356→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   357→ */
   358→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   359→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   360→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   361→  failedSegments: number,
   362→  totalSegments: number,
   363→  errorMessage?: string,
   364→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   365→): Promise<void> {
   366→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   367→    .from("tasks")
   368→    .update({
   369→      status: TASK_STATUS.FAILED,
   370→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   371→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   372→    })
   373→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   374→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   375→    .select('id');
   376→  if (updateOrchError) {
   377→    throw new CompletionError({
   378→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   379→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   380→      recoverable: true,
   381→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   382→      metadata: {
   383→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   384→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   385→          ? updateOrchError.message
   386→          : String(updateOrchError),
   387→      },
   388→      cause: updateOrchError,
   389→    });
   390→  }
   391→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   392→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   393→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   394→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   395→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   396→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   397→    });
   398→  }
   399→}
   400→/**
   401→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   402→ */
   403→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   404→  params: {
   405→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   406→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   407→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   408→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   409→    publicUrl: string;
   410→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   411→    supabaseUrl: string;
   412→    serviceKey: string;
   413→    logger?: CompletionLogger;
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}
   365→

   212→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   213→      },
   214→    ]),
   215→  );
   216→
   217→  taskParams.make_primary_variant = params.make_primary_variant ?? true;
   218→  return taskParams;
   219→}
   220→
   221→function buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(
   222→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   223→  state: SegmentBuildState,
   224→): UnknownRecord {
   225→  const segmentPostProcess = resolveSegmentPostProcessValues(params, state);
   226→
   227→  const individualSegmentParams: UnknownRecord = {
   228→    input_image_paths_resolved: state.inputImages,
   229→    start_image_url: params.start_image_url,
   230→    base_prompt: state.basePrompt,
   231→    negative_prompt: state.negativePrompt,
   232→    num_frames: state.numFrames,

   236→    motion_mode: segmentPostProcess.motionMode,
   237→    advanced_mode: state.advancedMode,
