   239→    after_first_post_generation_saturation: segmentPostProcess.afterFirstPostGenerationSaturation,
   240→    after_first_post_generation_brightness: segmentPostProcess.afterFirstPostGenerationBrightness,
   241→    phase_config: state.phaseConfig,
   242→  };
   243→
   244→  Object.assign(
   245→    individualSegmentParams,
   246→    composeOptionalFields([
   247→      {
   248→        key: 'end_image_url',
   249→        value: params.end_image_url,
   250→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   251→      },
   252→      {
   253→        [REDACTED],
   254→        value: params.start_image_generation_id,
   255→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   256→      },
   257→      {
   258→        [REDACTED],
   259→        value: params.end_image_generation_id,
   260→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   261→      },
   262→      {
   263→        [REDACTED],
   264→        value: params.pair_shot_generation_id,
   265→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   266→      },
   267→      {
   268→        [REDACTED],
   269→        value: params.start_image_variant_id,
   270→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   271→      },
   272→      {
   273→        [REDACTED],
   274→        value: params.end_image_variant_id,
   275→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   276→      },
   277→      {
   278→        key: 'enhanced_prompt',
   279→        value: state.enhancedPrompt,
   280→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   281→      },
   282→      {
   283→        [REDACTED],
   284→        value: params.selected_phase_preset_id,
   285→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   286→      },
   287→    ]),
   288→  );
   289→
   290→  return individualSegmentParams;
   291→}
   292→
   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

    12→type TaskActorPolicyFailure = {
    13→  ok: false;

    17→
    18→type TaskActorPolicySuccess<T> = {

    23→type TaskActorPolicyResult<T> = TaskActorPolicySuccess<T> | TaskActorPolicyFailure;

    31→export async function authorizeTaskActor(

    35→  if (auth.isServiceRole) {
    36→    return {
    37→      ok: true,
    38→      value: {
    39→        isServiceRole: true,
    40→        callerId: null,
    41→        taskOwnerVerified: false,

    76→}

    78→export interface ResolvedTaskStorageActor extends AuthorizedTaskActor {
    79→  taskUserId: string;
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function resolveTaskStorageActor(
    83→  input: TaskActorBaseInput,
    84→): Promise<TaskActorPolicyResult<ResolvedTaskStorageActor>> {
    85→  const authorized = await authorizeTaskActor(input);
    86→  if (!authorized.ok) {
    87→    return authorized;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  if (!authorized.value.isServiceRole) {
    91→    return {
    92→      ok: true,
    93→      value: {
    94→        ...authorized.value,
    95→        taskUserId: authorized.value.callerId!,
    96→      },
    97→    };
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  const taskUserResult = await getTaskUserId(
   101→    input.supabaseAdmin,
   102→    input.taskId,
   103→    input.logPrefix,
   104→  );
   105→  if (taskUserResult.error || !taskUserResult.userId) {
   106→    return {
   107→      ok: false,
   108→      error: taskUserResult.error || 'Task user resolution failed',
   109→      statusCode: taskUserResult.statusCode || 404,
   110→    };
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    ok: true,
   115→    value: {
   116→      ...authorized.value,
   117→      taskUserId: taskUserResult.userId,
   118→    },
   119→  };
   120→}

1→import { isPastRemovalTarget, type DeprecationPolicy } from '@/shared/lib/governance/deprecationPolicy';
     2→import {
     3→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow,
     4→  normalizeAndPresentError,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→const signaledDeprecations = new Set<string>();
     8→
     9→interface DeprecationSignalOptions {
    10→  alias: string;
    11→  policy: DeprecationPolicy;
    12→  remediation?: string;
    13→  enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
    14→}
    15→
    16→function resolveEnforcementMode(mode: DeprecationSignalOptions['enforcement']): 'warn' | 'throw' {
    17→  if (mode === 'warn' || mode === 'throw') {
    18→    return mode;
    19→  }
    20→
    21→  const metaEnv = typeof import.meta !== 'undefined'
    22→    ? (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> }).env
    23→    : undefined;
    24→  const nodeEnv = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env?.NODE_ENV : undefined;
    25→  const isTestMode = nodeEnv === 'test' || metaEnv?.MODE === 'test' || metaEnv?.VITEST === 'true';
    26→  const explicit = metaEnv?.VITE_DEPRECATION_ENFORCEMENT;
    27→
    28→  if (explicit === 'throw') {
    29→    return isTestMode ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    30→  }
    31→  if (explicit === 'warn') {
    32→    return 'warn';
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  if (isTestMode) {
    36→    return 'warn';
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  return nodeEnv === 'production' ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Emits a one-time runtime signal when a legacy alias is used past its removal target.
    44→ * Returns true when the usage is past target, false otherwise.
    45→ */
    46→export function signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
    47→  alias,
    48→  policy,
    49→  remediation,
    50→  enforcement = 'auto',
    51→}: DeprecationSignalOptions): boolean {
    52→  if (!isPastRemovalTarget(policy)) {
    53→    return false;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  const key = `${alias}:${policy.removeBy}`;
    57→  if (signaledDeprecations.has(key)) {
    58→    return true;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  signaledDeprecations.add(key);
    62→  const suffix = remediation ? ` ${remediation}` : '';
    63→  const message = `[deprecation] ${alias} is past removal target ${policy.removeBy} (owner: ${policy.owner}).${suffix}`;
    64→  const mode = resolveEnforcementMode(enforcement);
    65→  const logData = {
    66→    alias,
    67→    owner: policy.owner,
    68→    removeBy: policy.removeBy,
    69→    mode,
    70→  };
    71→
    72→  if (mode === 'throw') {
    73→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error(message), {
    74→      context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    75→      showToast: false,
    76→      logData,
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(message), {
    81→    context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    82→    showToast: false,
    83→    logData,
    84→  });
    85→  return true;
    86→}
    87→

1→/**
     2→ * Task ID resolution helpers
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes the logic for extracting task IDs from variant params,
     5→ * handling legacy field names consistently.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
     9→const CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    10→  ['source_task_id'],
    11→  ['orchestration_contract', 'orchestrator_task_id'],
    12→];
    13→const LEGACY_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    14→  ['orchestrator_task_id'],
    15→  ['task_id'],
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→function readStringPath(
    19→  value: unknown,
    20→  path: readonly string[],
    21→): string | null {
    22→  let current: unknown = value;
    23→  for (const segment of path) {
    24→    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || Array.isArray(current)) {
    25→      return null;
    26→    }
    27→    current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[segment];
    28→  }
    29→  return typeof current === 'string' && current.length > 0 ? current : null;
    30→}
    31→
    32→function resolveTaskIdFromPaths(
    33→  value: unknown,
    34→  paths: readonly (readonly string[])[],
    35→): string | null {
    36→  return paths
    37→    .map((path) => readStringPath(value, path))
    38→    .find((candidate): candidate is string => Boolean(candidate)) ?? null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→function asValidUuid(value: string | null): string | null {
    42→  if (!value) {
    43→    return null;
    44→  }
    45→  return UUID_REGEX.test(value) ? value : null;
    46→}
    47→
    48→/**
    49→ * Extract the source task ID from variant params.
    50→ *
    51→ * Variants can have their source task ID stored under different field names
    52→ * due to historical evolution of the param structure:
    53→ * - `source_task_id` - Current standard (preferred)
    54→ * - `orchestration_contract.orchestrator_task_id` - Canonical orchestrator contract
    55→ *
    56→ * @param params - Variant params object (typically from variant.params)
    57→ * @returns Valid UUID task ID, or null if not found/invalid
    58→ */
    59→export function getSourceTaskId(
    60→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
    61→): string | null {
    62→  return asValidUuid(resolveTaskIdFromPaths(params, CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS));
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Legacy-compatible source task ID extraction.
    67→ * This helper is only for migration paths that still need to read old keys.
    68→ */
    69→export function getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(
    70→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    71→): string | null {
    72→  const canonicalTaskId = getSourceTaskId(params);
    73→  if (canonicalTaskId) {
    74→    return canonicalTaskId;
    75→  }
    76→  return asValidUuid(resolveTaskIdFromPaths(params, LEGACY_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS));
    77→}
    78→
    79→/**
    80→ * Check if params contain orchestrator details.
    81→ * Used to determine if variant already has full task context.
    82→ */
    83→export function hasOrchestratorDetails(
    84→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
    85→): boolean {
    86→  return !!params?.orchestrator_details;
    87→}
    88→

   128→    const orchestratorRunId = extractOrchestratorRunId(completedTask.params, 'OrchestratorComplete');

   138→      orchPromise,
   139→      findSiblingSegments(supabase, segmentTypeToQuery, completedTask.project_id, orchestratorTaskId, orchestratorRunId),
   140→    ]);

   142→    if (orchError) {

   145→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   146→        recoverable: true,
   147→        message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Error fetching orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   148→        metadata: {
   149→          orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   150→          fetch_error: toErrorMessage(orchError),
   151→        },
   152→        cause: orchError,
   153→      });
   154→    }
   155→    if (!orchestratorTask) {
   156→      return;
   157→    }
   158→    if (orchestratorTask.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE) {
   159→      return;

   161→    if (config.isFinalStep) {
   162→      await markOrchestratorComplete(

   165→          orchestratorTask,
   166→          orchestratorTaskId,
   167→          allSegments,

   172→        },
   173→      );
   174→      return;

   197→      segmentStats,

   273→      },
   274→    });
   275→  }
   276→}
   277→/**
   278→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   279→ */
   280→async function findSiblingSegments(
   281→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   282→  segmentType: string,
   283→  projectId: string,
   284→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   285→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   286→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   287→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   288→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   289→      supabase,
   290→      taskType: segmentType,
   291→      projectId,
   292→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   293→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   294→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   295→    });
   296→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   297→      return runIdRows;
   298→    }
   299→  }
   300→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   301→    supabase,
   302→    taskType: segmentType,
   303→    projectId,
   304→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   305→    orchestratorTaskId,
   306→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   307→  });
   308→  return orchestratorRows;
   309→}
   310→/**
   311→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   312→ */
   313→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   314→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   315→  finalStepType: string,
   316→  projectId: string,
   317→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   318→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   319→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   320→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   321→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   322→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   323→      supabase,
   324→      taskType: finalStepType,
   325→      projectId,
   326→      select: "id, status",
   327→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   328→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   329→    });
   330→  }
   331→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   332→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   333→      supabase,
   334→      taskType: finalStepType,
   335→      projectId,
   336→      select: "id, status",
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   342→    return 'not_found';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   345→    return 'failed';
   346→  }
   347→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
   348→    return 'complete';
   349→  }
   350→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
   351→    return 'pending';
   352→  }
   353→  return 'unknown';
   354→}
   355→/**
   356→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   357→ */
   358→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   359→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   360→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   361→  failedSegments: number,
   362→  totalSegments: number,
   363→  errorMessage?: string,
   364→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   365→): Promise<void> {
   366→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   367→    .from("tasks")
   368→    .update({
   369→      status: TASK_STATUS.FAILED,
   370→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   371→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   372→    })
   373→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   374→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   375→    .select('id');
   376→  if (updateOrchError) {
   377→    throw new CompletionError({
   378→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   379→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   380→      recoverable: true,
   381→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   382→      metadata: {
   383→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   384→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   385→          ? updateOrchError.message
   386→          : String(updateOrchError),
   387→      },
   388→      cause: updateOrchError,
   389→    });
   390→  }
   391→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   392→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   393→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   394→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   395→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   396→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   397→    });
   398→  }
   399→}
   400→/**
   401→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   402→ */
   403→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   404→  params: {
   405→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   406→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   407→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   408→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   409→    publicUrl: string;
   410→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   411→    supabaseUrl: string;
   412→    serviceKey: string;
   413→    logger?: CompletionLogger;
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,

   278→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)

   280→async function findSiblingSegments(
   281→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   282→  segmentType: string,
   283→  projectId: string,
   284→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   285→  orchestratorRunId: string | null

   293→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   294→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   295→    });
   296→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   297→      return runIdRows;
   298→    }
   299→  }
   300→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   301→    supabase,
   302→    taskType: segmentType,
   303→    projectId,
   304→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",

   308→  return orchestratorRows;

   310→/**
   311→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   312→ */
   313→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   314→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   315→  finalStepType: string,
   316→  projectId: string,
   317→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   318→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   319→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   320→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   321→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   322→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   323→      supabase,
   324→      taskType: finalStepType,
   325→      projectId,
   326→      select: "id, status",
   327→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   328→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   329→    });
   330→  }
   331→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   332→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   333→      supabase,
   334→      taskType: finalStepType,
   335→      projectId,
   336→      select: "id, status",
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   342→    return 'not_found';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   345→    return 'failed';
   346→  }
   347→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE)) {
   348→    return 'complete';
   349→  }
   350→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === TASK_STATUS.QUEUED || task.status === TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS)) {
   351→    return 'pending';
   352→  }
   353→  return 'unknown';
   354→}

   363→  errorMessage?: string,

   371→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()

   385→          ? updateOrchError.message
   386→          : String(updateOrchError),
   387→      },
   388→      cause: updateOrchError,
   389→    });
   390→  }
   391→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   392→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {

   400→/**
   401→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   402→ */
   403→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   404→  params: {
   405→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   406→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   407→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   408→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   409→    publicUrl: string;
   410→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   411→    supabaseUrl: string;
   412→    serviceKey: string;

   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {

   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: TASK_STATUS.COMPLETE,
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),

   439→  };

   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", [...TASK_PROCESSING_STATUSES])

   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,

   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,

   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}

    50→  task_type?: string;
    51→  tool_type?: string;
    52→  project_id?: string;
    53→  params: Record<string, unknown>;
    54→}
    55→
    56→interface GenerationRouteParams {
    57→  basedOn: string | null;
    58→  createAsGeneration: boolean;
    59→  childGenerationId: string | null;
    60→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
    61→  childOrder: number | null;
    62→  isSingleItem: boolean;
    63→  isStitchTask: boolean;
    64→}
    65→
    66→interface GenerationHandlerContext {
    67→  supabase: SupabaseClient;
    68→  taskId: string;
    69→  taskData: CompletedTaskData;
    70→  publicUrl: string;
    71→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    72→  logger?: CompletionLogger;
    73→  childGenerationId?: string;
    74→  parentGenerationId?: string;
    75→  childOrder?: number | null;
    76→  isSingleItem?: boolean;
    77→}
    78→
    79→type GenerationRouteAttempt =
    80→  | 'variant_on_child'
    81→  | 'variant_on_parent'
    82→  | 'child_generation'
    83→  | 'standalone';
    84→
    85→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    86→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    87→    return null;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    91→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {
    92→    return null;
    93→  }
    94→
    95→  return { id: candidate.id };
    96→}
    97→
    98→function normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData: unknown): CompletedTaskData {
    99→  const record = asObjectOrEmpty(taskData);
   100→  return {
   101→    category: typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category : undefined,
   102→    task_type: typeof record.task_type === 'string' ? record.task_type : undefined,
   103→    tool_type: typeof record.tool_type === 'string' ? record.tool_type : undefined,
   104→    project_id: typeof record.project_id === 'string' ? record.project_id : undefined,
   105→    params: asObjectOrEmpty(record.params),
   106→  };
   107→}
   108→
   109→function getGenerationSkipReason(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationSkipReason | null {
   110→  if (taskData.category === 'orchestration') {
   111→    return 'orchestration_task';
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  if (taskData.params.skip_generation === true) {
   115→    return 'skip_generation_flag';
   116→  }
   117→
   118→  return null;
   119→}
   120→
   121→function resolveGenerationRouteParams(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationRouteParams {
   122→  const params = taskData.params;
   123→  const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   124→
   125→  const basedOn = extractBasedOn(params);
   126→  const createAsGeneration = (
   127→    params.create_as_generation === true
   128→    || payloadSnapshot.orchestrationContract.create_as_generation === true
   129→  );
   130→
   131→  const childGenerationId = resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   132→  const parentGenerationId = resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   133→  const childOrder = resolveSnapshotChildOrder(payloadSnapshot);
   134→  const isSingleItem = resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(payloadSnapshot);
   135→
   136→  const isStitchTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_STITCH
   137→    || taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_FINAL_STITCH;
   138→
   139→  return {
   140→    basedOn,
   141→    createAsGeneration,
   142→    childGenerationId,
   143→    parentGenerationId,
   144→    childOrder,
   145→    isSingleItem,
   146→    isStitchTask,
   147→  };
   148→}
   149→
   150→function classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams: GenerationRouteParams): GenerationRouteAttempt[] {
   151→  const attempts: GenerationRouteAttempt[] = [];
   152→
   153→  if (routeParams.childGenerationId) {
   154→    attempts.push('variant_on_child');
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  if (routeParams.isStitchTask && routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   158→    attempts.push('variant_on_parent');
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  if (routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   162→    attempts.push('child_generation');
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  attempts.push('standalone');
   166→  return attempts;
   167→}
   168→
   169→async function executeGenerationRouteAttempt(
   170→  attempt: GenerationRouteAttempt,
   171→  ctx: GenerationHandlerContext,
   172→): Promise<GenerationRef | null> {
   173→  switch (attempt) {
   174→    case 'variant_on_child':
   175→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnChild(ctx));
   176→    case 'variant_on_parent':
   177→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnParent(ctx));
   178→    case 'child_generation':
   179→      return toGenerationRef(await handleChildGeneration(ctx));
   180→    case 'standalone':
   181→      return toGenerationRef(await handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx));
   182→  }
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   187→ *
   188→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   189→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   190→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   191→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   192→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   193→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   194→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   195→ *
   196→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   197→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   198→ */
   199→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   200→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   201→  taskId: string,
   202→  taskData: unknown,
   203→  publicUrl: string,
   204→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   205→  logger?: CompletionLogger,
   206→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   207→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
   208→  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
   209→
   210→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   211→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   212→  if (skipReason) {
   213→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   214→  }
   215→
   216→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   217→
   218→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   219→    task_id: taskId,
   220→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   221→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   222→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   223→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   224→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   225→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   226→  });
   227→
   228→  try {
   229→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   230→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   231→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
   232→      throw new CompletionError({
   233→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   234→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   235→        recoverable: false,
   236→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   237→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   238→      });
   239→    }
   240→
   241→    if (existingGeneration) {
   242→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   243→        supabase,
   244→        taskId,
   245→        normalizedTaskData,
   246→        existingGeneration,
   247→        publicUrl,
   248→        thumbnailUrl,
   249→        logger,
   250→      );
   251→      return { status: 'created', generation };
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
   255→      const success = await handleVariantCreation(
   256→        supabase,
   257→        taskId,
   258→        normalizedTaskData,
   259→        routeParams.basedOn,
   260→        publicUrl,
   261→        thumbnailUrl,
   262→      );
   263→      if (success) {
   264→        return { status: 'created', generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn } };
   265→      }
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
   269→      supabase,
   270→      taskId,
   271→      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
   272→      publicUrl,
   273→      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
   274→      logger,
   275→      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
   276→      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
   277→      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
   278→      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   279→    };
   280→
   281→    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
   282→      const generation = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);
   283→      if (generation) {
   284→        return { status: 'created', generation };
   285→      }
   286→    }
   287→
   288→    throw new CompletionError({
   289→      code: 'generation_route_no_result',
   290→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   291→      recoverable: false,
   292→      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
   293→      metadata: {
   294→        task_id: taskId,
   295→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   296→        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
   297→      },
   298→    });
   299→
   300→  } catch (error) {
   301→    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
   302→      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
   303→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   304→      recoverable: true,
   305→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   306→      metadata: {
   307→        task_id: taskId,
   308→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   309→      },
   310→    });
   311→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   312→      task_id: taskId,
   313→      error: normalizedError.message,
   314→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   315→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   316→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   317→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   318→    });
   319→    throw normalizedError;
   320→  }
   321→}
   322→
   323→/**
   324→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   325→ */
   326→async function handleRegeneration(
   327→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   328→  taskId: string,
   329→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   330→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   331→  publicUrl: string,
   332→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   333→  logger?: CompletionLogger
   334→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   335→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   336→    task_id: taskId,
   337→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   338→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   339→  });
   340→
   341→  const variantParams = {
   342→    ...taskData.params,
   343→    source_task_id: taskId,
   344→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   345→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  await createVariant(
   349→    supabase,
   350→    existingGeneration.id,
   351→    publicUrl,
   352→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   353→    variantParams,
   354→    true,
   355→    'regenerated',
   356→    null
   357→  );
   358→
   359→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   360→  if (shotId) {
   361→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   365→    .from('tasks')
   366→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   367→    .eq('id', taskId);
   368→
   369→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   370→    throw new CompletionError({
   371→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
   372→      context: 'handleRegeneration',
   373→      recoverable: true,
   374→      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
   375→      metadata: {
   376→        task_id: taskId,
   377→        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   378→      },
   379→      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return existingGeneration;
   384→}

   304→      recoverable: true,
   305→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   306→      metadata: {
   307→        task_id: taskId,
   308→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   309→      },
   310→    });
   311→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   312→      task_id: taskId,
   313→      error: normalizedError.message,
   314→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   315→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   316→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   317→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   318→    });
   319→    throw normalizedError;
   320→  }
   321→}
   322→
   323→/**
   324→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   325→ */
   326→async function handleRegeneration(
   327→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   328→  taskId: string,
   329→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   330→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   331→  publicUrl: string,
   332→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   333→  logger?: CompletionLogger
   334→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   335→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   336→    task_id: taskId,
   337→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   338→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   339→  });
   340→
   341→  const variantParams = {
   342→    ...taskData.params,
   343→    source_task_id: taskId,
   344→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   345→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   346→  };
   347→
   348→  await createVariant(
   349→    supabase,
   350→    existingGeneration.id,
   351→    publicUrl,
   352→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   353→    variantParams,
   354→    true,
   355→    'regenerated',
   356→    null
   357→  );
   358→
   359→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   360→  if (shotId) {
   361→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   365→    .from('tasks')
   366→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   367→    .eq('id', taskId);
   368→
   369→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   370→    throw new CompletionError({
   371→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
   372→      context: 'handleRegeneration',
   373→      recoverable: true,
   374→      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
   375→      metadata: {
   376→        task_id: taskId,
   377→        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   378→      },
   379→      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return existingGeneration;
   384→}
   385→

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

   120→      if (context?.previousShots && context.project_id) {
   121→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.project_id, context.previousShots);
   122→      }
   123→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shot_id) {
   124→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shot_id, context.previousFastGens);
   125→      }
   126→      if (context?.project_id) {
   127→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({

   129→        });
   130→      }
   131→
   132→      toast.error(`Failed to add image to shot: ${toAddImageErrorMessage(error)}`);
   133→    },

   135→    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
   136→      const { project_id, shot_id } = variables;

   138→      // Replace temp ID with real ID in cache

   141→        replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache(queryClient, project_id, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   142→      }

   144→      // Invalidate related queries

   146→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });

   191→export const useRemoveImageFromShot = () => {

   216→      if (error) {

   227→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'remove-shift' },

   229→          operationLabel: 'remove-image-shift',
   230→          timeoutOperationName: 'remove-image-shift-rpc',

   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   247→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)

   251→      const shiftMap = new Map(shiftItems?.map(s => [s.id, s.newFrame]) ?? []);
   252→
   253→      // Optimistically: set timeline_frame = null on deleted item + shift remaining
   254→      if (previousFastGens) {
   255→        queryClient.setQueryData(
   256→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   257→          previousFastGens.map(g => {

   259→            const shifted = shiftMap.get(g.id);
   260→            if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...g, timeline_frame: shifted };
   261→            return g;
   262→          })
   263→        );
   264→      }

   266→      if (previousShots) {
   267→        updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, (shots = []) =>
   268→          shots.map(shot => {
   269→            if (shot.id === shotId) {
   270→              return {
   271→                ...shot,
   272→                images: (shot.images ?? []).map(img => {
   273→                  if (img.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...img, timeline_frame: null };
   274→                  const shifted = shiftMap.get(img.id);
   275→                  if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...img, timeline_frame: shifted };
   276→                  return img;
   277→                }),
   278→              };
   279→            }
   280→            return shot;
   281→          })
   282→        );
   283→      }
   284→
   285→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, projectId, shotId };
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    onError: (err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   289→      if (context?.previousShots && context.projectId) {

   291→      }
   292→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   293→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   294→      }

   308→
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}

   162→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   163→    params,
   164→    context: 'createZImageTurboImageToImageTask',

   166→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({

   174→/**
   175→ * Creates multiple Z Image Turbo image-to-image tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   176→ */
   177→export async function createBatchZImageTurboImageToImageTasks(
   178→  params: BatchZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams

   180→
   181→  try {

   184→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchParams,
   185→      buildSingleTaskParams: (batchParams): ZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams[] => (
   186→        Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   187→          const seed = batchParams.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   188→
   189→          return {
   190→            project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   191→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   192→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   193→            strength: batchParams.strength,
   194→            enable_prompt_expansion: batchParams.enable_prompt_expansion,

   202→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,
   203→          } as ZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams;

   205→      ),
   206→      createSingleTask: createZImageTurboImageToImageTask,

   208→    });
   209→
   210→  } catch (error) {

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */

    58→/**
