    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}
   125→
   126→/**
   127→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   128→ */
   129→export interface RawVariant {
   130→  id: string;
   131→  generation_id: string;
   132→  location: string;
   133→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   134→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   135→  variant_type?: string | null;
   136→  name?: string | null;
   137→  created_at: string;
   138→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   139→  is_primary?: boolean;
   140→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   145→ */
   146→export interface RawGeneration {
   147→  id: string;
   148→  location: string;
   149→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   150→  type?: string | null;
   151→  created_at: string;
   152→  updated_at?: string | null;
   153→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   154→  starred?: boolean | null;
   155→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   156→  based_on?: string | null;
   157→  name?: string | null;
   158→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   159→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   160→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   161→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   162→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   163→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   164→  child_order?: number | null;
   165→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   166→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   167→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   168→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   173→ */
   174→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   175→  id: string;
   176→  shot_id: string;
   177→  generation_id: string;
   178→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   179→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   180→  created_at?: string;
   181→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Options for transformation customization
   187→ */
   188→interface TransformOptions {
   189→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   191→  /** Timeline frame position */
   192→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   193→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   194→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   195→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   196→  shotId?: string;
   197→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   198→  verbose?: boolean;
   199→}
   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→

     4→  key: string;
     5→  value: unknown;
     6→  include?: (value: unknown) => boolean;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export function composeOptionalFields(
    10→  entries: readonly ComposeOptionalFieldsEntry[],
    11→): Record<string, unknown> {
    12→  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    13→  for (const entry of entries) {
    14→    if (entry.value === undefined) {
    15→      continue;
    16→    }
    17→    if (entry.include && !entry.include(entry.value)) {
    18→      continue;
    19→    }
    20→    payload[entry.key] = entry.value;
    21→  }
    22→  return payload;
    23→}

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();
   240→
   241→// Expose for debugging in browser console (dev only)
   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   243→  (window as unknown as { __PRELOADING_SERVICE__: PreloadingService }).__PRELOADING_SERVICE__ =
   244→    preloadingService;

    56→    `${label} must contain ${expectedText} item(s) to match ${pairCount} image pair(s)`,
    57→    field,
    58→  );
    59→}
    60→
    61→function validateImageScopedArray(
    62→  field: keyof TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput,
    63→  value: unknown,
    64→  imageCount: number,
    65→  label: string,
    66→): void {
    67→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    68→    return;
    69→  }
    70→  if (value.length === imageCount) {
    71→    return;
    72→  }
    73→  throw new TaskValidationError(
    74→    `${label} must contain ${imageCount} item(s) to match image_urls`,
    75→    field,
    76→  );
    77→}
    78→
    79→function assertNoImplicitLegacyStructureFields(params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput): void {
    80→  const legacyUsage = collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(params);
    81→  enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(legacyUsage, {
    82→    context: 'buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload',
    83→    enforcement: 'warn',
    84→  });
    85→
    86→  const topLevelLegacyFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter((field) => params[field] !== undefined);
    87→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(params.structure_videos) ? params.structure_videos : [];
    88→  const structureVideoLegacyFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
    89→    structureVideos.some((entry) =>
    90→      Boolean(
    91→        entry
    92→        && typeof entry === 'object'
    93→        && !Array.isArray(entry)
    94→        && (entry as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined,
    95→      )),
    96→  );
    97→  const usedLegacyFields: Array<LegacyTopLevelField | LegacyStructureVideoField> = [
    98→    ...topLevelLegacyFields,
    99→    ...structureVideoLegacyFields,
   100→  ];
   101→  if (usedLegacyFields.length === 0) {
   102→    return;
   103→  }
   104→  throw new TaskValidationError(
   105→    `Legacy structure-video fields are not accepted in canonical mode (${usedLegacyFields.join(', ')}). ` +
   106→      'Use structure_guidance + structure_videos, or pass explicit legacyStructureCompatibility for temporary migration paths.',
   107→    usedLegacyFields[0],
   108→  );
   109→}
   110→
   111→function buildAdditionalLorasRecord(params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput): Record<string, number> | undefined {
   112→  if (!params.loras || params.loras.length === 0) {
   113→    return undefined;
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  return params.loras.reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, lora) => {
   117→    acc[lora.path] = lora.strength;
   118→    return acc;
   119→  }, {});
   120→}
   121→
   122→/**
   123→ * Validates travel between images task parameters
   124→ *
   125→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   126→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   127→ */
   128→export function validateTravelBetweenImagesParams(params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput): void {
   129→  validateRequiredFields({ ...params }, [
   130→    'project_id',
   131→    'image_urls',
   132→    'base_prompts',
   133→    'segment_frames',
   134→    'frame_overlap'
   135→  ]);
   136→
   137→  // Additional steerable motion specific validations
   138→  if (params.image_urls.length === 0) {
   139→    throw new TaskValidationError("At least one image_url is required", 'image_urls');
   140→  }
   141→
   142→  if (params.base_prompts.length === 0) {
   143→    throw new TaskValidationError("base_prompts is required (at least one prompt)", 'base_prompts');
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  if (params.segment_frames.length === 0) {
   147→    throw new TaskValidationError("segment_frames is required", 'segment_frames');
   148→  }
   149→
   150→  if (params.frame_overlap.length === 0) {
   151→    throw new TaskValidationError("frame_overlap is required", 'frame_overlap');
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  const imageCount = params.image_urls.length;
   155→  const pairCount = Math.max(1, imageCount - 1);
   156→
   157→  validatePairScopedArray('base_prompts', params.base_prompts, pairCount, 'base_prompts');
   158→  validatePairScopedArray('segment_frames', params.segment_frames, pairCount, 'segment_frames');
   159→  validatePairScopedArray('frame_overlap', params.frame_overlap, pairCount, 'frame_overlap');
   160→  validatePairScopedArray('negative_prompts', params.negative_prompts, pairCount, 'negative_prompts');
   161→  validatePairScopedArray('enhanced_prompts', params.enhanced_prompts, pairCount, 'enhanced_prompts');
   162→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_phase_configs', params.pair_phase_configs, pairCount, 'pair_phase_configs', false);
   163→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_loras', params.pair_loras, pairCount, 'pair_loras', false);
   164→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_motion_settings', params.pair_motion_settings, pairCount, 'pair_motion_settings', false);
   165→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_shot_generation_ids', params.pair_shot_generation_ids, pairCount, 'pair_shot_generation_ids', false);
   166→
   167→  validateImageScopedArray('image_generation_ids', params.image_generation_ids, imageCount, 'image_generation_ids');
   168→  validateImageScopedArray('image_variant_ids', params.image_variant_ids, imageCount, 'image_variant_ids');
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Processes travel between images parameters and builds the orchestrator payload.
   173→ * This replicates the logic from the original steerable-motion edge function.
   174→ *
   175→ * @param params - Raw travel between images parameters
   176→ * @param finalResolution - Resolved resolution string (e.g. "1280x720")
   177→ * @param taskId - Orchestrator task ID for the payload
   178→ * @param runId - Run ID for grouping related tasks
   179→ * @param parentGenerationId - Parent generation ID to include in payload
   180→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   181→ */
   182→export function buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload(
   183→  params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput,
   184→  finalResolution: string,
   185→  taskId: string,
   186→  runId: string,
   187→  parentGenerationId?: string,
   188→): Record<string, unknown> {
   189→  assertNoImplicitLegacyStructureFields(params);
   190→
   191→  // Calculate number of segments (matching original logic)
   192→  const numSegments = Math.max(1, params.image_urls.length - 1);
   193→
   194→  // Expand arrays if they have a single element and numSegments > 1
   195→  const basePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.base_prompts, numSegments);
   196→  const negativePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.negative_prompts, numSegments) || Array(numSegments).fill("");
   197→
   198→  // CRITICAL FIX: Only expand enhanced_prompts if they were actually provided OR if enhance_prompt is requested
   199→  // If enhance_prompt is true, we must provide an array (even if empty strings) for the backend to populate
   200→  const enhancedPromptsExpanded = params.enhanced_prompts
   201→    ? expandArrayToCount(params.enhanced_prompts, numSegments)
   202→    : (params.enhance_prompt ? Array(numSegments).fill("") : undefined);
   203→
   204→  const segmentFramesExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.segment_frames, numSegments);
   205→  const frameOverlapExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.frame_overlap, numSegments);
   206→
   207→  // Extract steps parameter - only needed if NOT in Advanced Mode
   208→  // In Advanced Mode, steps come from steps_per_phase in phase_config
   209→  let stepsValue = params.steps;
   210→  if (!params.advanced_mode) {
   211→    if (stepsValue === undefined && params.params_json_str) {
   212→      const parsedParams = toRecordOrEmpty(safeParseJson(params.params_json_str, {}));
   213→      const parsedSteps = asNumber(parsedParams.steps);
   214→      if (parsedSteps !== undefined) {
   215→        stepsValue = parsedSteps;
   216→      }
   217→    }
   218→    if (stepsValue === undefined) {
   219→      stepsValue = DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.steps;
   220→    }
   221→  }
   222→
   223→  // Handle random seed generation - if random_seed is true, generate a new random seed
   224→  // Otherwise use the provided seed or default
   225→  const finalSeed = resolveSeed32Bit({
   226→    seed: params.seed,
   227→    randomize: params.random_seed === true,
   228→    fallbackSeed: DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.seed,
   229→    field: 'seed',
   230→  });
   231→
   232→  // Build orchestrator payload matching the original edge function structure
   233→  const orchestratorPayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
   234→    // Common identifier for comparing batch vs individual segment generation
   235→    generation_source: 'batch',
   236→    orchestrator_task_id: taskId,
   237→    run_id: runId,
   238→    input_image_paths_resolved: params.image_urls,
   239→    // Include generation IDs for clickable images in SegmentCard
   240→    ...(params.image_generation_ids && params.image_generation_ids.length > 0
   241→      ? { input_image_generation_ids: params.image_generation_ids }
   242→      : {}),
   243→    // Include pair shot generation IDs for stable segment tethering
   244→    ...(params.pair_shot_generation_ids && params.pair_shot_generation_ids.length > 0
   245→      ? { pair_shot_generation_ids: params.pair_shot_generation_ids }
   246→      : {}),
   247→    num_new_segments_to_generate: numSegments,
   248→    base_prompts_expanded: basePromptsExpanded,
   249→    base_prompt: params.base_prompt, // Singular - the default/base prompt
   250→    negative_prompts_expanded: negativePromptsExpanded,
   251→    // CRITICAL FIX: Only include enhanced_prompts_expanded if actually provided
   252→    // This prevents the backend from misinterpreting empty arrays
   253→    ...(enhancedPromptsExpanded !== undefined ? { enhanced_prompts_expanded: enhancedPromptsExpanded } : {}),
   254→    // NEW: Per-pair parameter overrides (only include if there are actual overrides)
   255→    // Names must match backend expectations: phase_configs_expanded, loras_per_segment_expanded
   256→    // IMPORTANT: Truncate to numSegments to handle deleted images with stale arrays
   257→    ...(params.pair_phase_configs?.some(x => x !== null) ? { phase_configs_expanded: params.pair_phase_configs.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   258→    ...(params.pair_loras?.some(x => x !== null) ? { loras_per_segment_expanded: params.pair_loras.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   259→    ...(params.pair_motion_settings?.some(x => x !== null) ? { motion_settings_expanded: params.pair_motion_settings.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   260→    segment_frames_expanded: segmentFramesExpanded,
   261→    frame_overlap_expanded: frameOverlapExpanded,
   262→    parsed_resolution_wh: finalResolution,
   263→    model_name: params.model_name ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.model_name,
   264→    model_type: params.model_type,
   265→    seed_base: finalSeed,
   266→    // Only include steps if NOT in Advanced Mode (Advanced Mode uses steps_per_phase)
   267→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? {} : { steps: stepsValue }),
   268→    after_first_post_generation_saturation: params.after_first_post_generation_saturation ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.after_first_post_generation_saturation,
   269→    after_first_post_generation_brightness: params.after_first_post_generation_brightness ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.after_first_post_generation_brightness,
   270→    debug_mode_enabled: params.debug ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.debug,
   271→    shot_id: params.shot_id,
   272→    // Include parent_generation_id so complete_task uses it instead of creating a new one
   273→    ...(parentGenerationId ? { parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId } : {}),
   274→    ...(params.main_output_dir_for_run
   275→      ? { main_output_dir_for_run: params.main_output_dir_for_run }
   276→      : {}),
   277→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.enhance_prompt,
   278→    show_input_images: params.show_input_images ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.show_input_images,
   279→    generation_mode: params.generation_mode ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.generation_mode,
   280→    dimension_source: params.dimension_source ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.dimension_source,
   281→    // Only include amount_of_motion if NOT in Advanced Mode
   282→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? {} : { amount_of_motion: params.amount_of_motion ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.amount_of_motion }),
   283→    advanced_mode: params.advanced_mode ?? false,
   284→    // Always set regenerate_anchors to false in Advanced Mode
   285→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? { regenerate_anchors: false } : {}),
   286→    // Include generation_name in orchestrator payload so it flows to child tasks
   287→    generation_name: params.generation_name,
   288→    independent_segments: params.independent_segments ?? true,
   289→    // Text before/after prompts
   290→    ...(params.text_before_prompts ? { text_before_prompts: params.text_before_prompts } : {}),
   291→    ...(params.text_after_prompts ? { text_after_prompts: params.text_after_prompts } : {}),
   292→    // Motion control mode
   293→    ...(params.motion_mode ? { motion_mode: params.motion_mode } : {}),
   294→  };
   295→
   296→  const normalizedStructureGuidance = normalizeStructureGuidance({
   297→    structureGuidance: params.structure_guidance,
   298→    structureVideos: params.structure_videos,
   299→    defaultVideoTreatment: DEFAULT_VIDEO_STRUCTURE_PARAMS.structure_video_treatment,
   300→    defaultUni3cEndPercent: 0.1,
   301→  });
   302→  if (normalizedStructureGuidance) {
   303→    orchestratorPayload.structure_guidance = normalizedStructureGuidance;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const additionalLoras = buildAdditionalLorasRecord(params);
   307→  if (additionalLoras) {
   308→    orchestratorPayload.additional_loras = additionalLoras;
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  // Add phase_config if provided (for advanced mode)
   312→  if (params.phase_config) {
   313→    orchestratorPayload.phase_config = params.phase_config;
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  // Add selected_phase_preset_id if provided (for UI state restoration)
   317→  if (params.selected_phase_preset_id) {
   318→    orchestratorPayload.selected_phase_preset_id = params.selected_phase_preset_id;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  const hasPairIds = Boolean(params.pair_shot_generation_ids?.length);
   322→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairIds
   323→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   324→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   325→
   326→  const travelReadContract: TravelBetweenImagesReadContract = {
   327→    contract_version: TASK_FAMILY_CONTRACT_VERSION,
   328→    prompt: params.base_prompt ?? params.base_prompts[0],
   329→    enhanced_prompt: enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[0],
   330→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompts?.[0],
   331→    model_name: params.model_name ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.model_name,
   332→    resolution: finalResolution,
   333→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.enhance_prompt,
   334→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? 'basic',
   335→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? null,
   336→    advanced_mode: params.advanced_mode ?? false,
   337→    amount_of_motion: params.amount_of_motion ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.amount_of_motion,
   338→    phase_config: params.phase_config,
   339→    additional_loras: additionalLoras,
   340→    segment_frames_expanded: segmentFramesExpanded,
   341→    frame_overlap_expanded: frameOverlapExpanded,
   342→    structure_guidance: normalizedStructureGuidance,
   343→  };
   344→
   345→  const familyContract = buildTravelBetweenImagesFamilyContract({
   346→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   347→    imageCount: params.image_urls.length,
   348→    segmentCount: numSegments,
   349→    hasPairIds,
   350→    readContract: travelReadContract,
   351→  });
   352→
   353→  return composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   354→    taskFamily: 'travel_between_images',
   355→    orchestratorDetails: orchestratorPayload,
   356→    orchestrationInput: {
   357→      taskFamily: 'travel_between_images',
   358→      orchestratorTaskId: taskId,
   359→      runId,
   360→      parentGenerationId,
   361→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   362→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   363→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   364→    },
   365→    taskViewInput: {
   366→      inputImages: params.image_urls,
   367→      prompt: params.base_prompt ?? params.base_prompts[0],
   368→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompts?.[0],
   369→      modelName: params.model_name,
   370→      resolution: finalResolution,
   371→    },
   372→    familyContract,
   373→  });
   374→}

     2→ * ModeSelector Component
     3→ *
     4→ * A responsive mode selector that automatically switches to icon-only mode
     5→ * when there isn't enough space to display text labels without truncation.

     7→
     8→import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { cn } from '@/shared/components/ui/contracts/cn';
    10→import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/shared/components/ui/tooltip';

    12→interface ModeSelectorItem {

    14→  label: string;

    17→}

    19→interface ModeSelectorProps {

    22→  className?: string;
    23→}
    24→
    25→export const ModeSelector: React.FC<ModeSelectorProps> = ({
    26→  items,
    27→  activeId,
    28→  className,
    29→}) => {
    30→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    31→  const measureRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    32→  const [showIconsOnly, setShowIconsOnly] = useState(false);
    33→
    34→  // Calculate minimum width needed for text mode
    35→  // Each button needs: icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width + padding (24px horizontal)
    36→  // Plus gaps between buttons
    37→  const checkIfTextFits = useCallback(() => {
    38→    const container = containerRef.current;
    39→    const measureDiv = measureRef.current;
    40→    if (!container || !measureDiv) return;
    41→
    42→    // Get the available width (container width minus padding and gaps)
    43→    const containerWidth = container.clientWidth;
    44→    const padding = 8; // p-1 = 4px each side
    45→    const gaps = (items.length - 1) * 4; // gap-1 = 4px between items
    46→    const availableWidth = containerWidth - padding - gaps;
    47→
    48→    // Measure the hidden text spans to get required width
    49→    const spans = measureDiv.querySelectorAll('span');
    50→    let totalRequiredWidth = 0;
    51→
    52→    spans.forEach((span) => {
    53→      // Each button needs: padding (24px) + icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width
    54→      const textWidth = span.scrollWidth;
    55→      const buttonWidth = 24 + 14 + 6 + textWidth;
    56→      totalRequiredWidth += buttonWidth;
    57→    });
    58→
    59→    // If we need more width than available, show icons only
    60→    const needsIconsOnly = totalRequiredWidth > availableWidth;
    61→    setShowIconsOnly(needsIconsOnly);
    62→  }, [items]);
    63→
    64→  useEffect(() => {
    65→    const container = containerRef.current;
    66→    if (!container) return;
    67→
    68→    // Initial check
    69→    checkIfTextFits();
    70→
    71→    // Set up ResizeObserver
    72→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    73→      checkIfTextFits();
    74→    });
    75→
    76→    resizeObserver.observe(container);
    77→
    78→    return () => {
    79→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    80→    };
    81→  }, [checkIfTextFits]);
    82→
    83→  return (

    85→      {/* Hidden measurement div - always renders text to measure */}
    86→      <div

    94→          </span>
    95→        ))}
    96→      </div>
    97→
    98→      {/* Visible selector */}
    99→      <div
   100→        ref={containerRef}
   101→        className={cn(

   120→                {item.icon}
   121→              </span>
   122→              {!showIconsOnly && (

   125→                </span>
   126→              )}
   127→            </button>
   128→          );
   129→
   130→          // Wrap in tooltip when showing icons only

   134→                <TooltipTrigger asChild>

   136→                </TooltipTrigger>
   137→                <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="text-xs">

   139→                </TooltipContent>
   140→              </Tooltip>
   141→            );
   142→          }
   143→
   144→          return button;
   145→        })}
   146→      </div>
   147→    </>

   149→};

   171→export function useTimelineOrchestrator({

   173→  images,

   175→  setFramePositions,
   176→  onImageReorder,
   177→  onFileDrop,
   178→  onGenerationDrop,
   179→  setIsDragInProgress,
   180→  onImageDuplicate,
   181→  readOnly = false,
   182→  isUploadingImage = false,
   183→  maxFrameLimit = 81,
   184→  structureVideo,
   185→  hasExistingTrailingVideo = false,
   186→}: UseTimelineOrchestratorProps): UseTimelineOrchestratorReturn {
   187→  const {
   188→    structureVideos,
   189→    primaryStructureVideo,
   190→    onAddStructureVideo,
   191→    onUpdateStructureVideo,
   192→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   193→  } = structureVideo ?? {};
   194→
   195→  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   196→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   197→  const isEndpointDraggingRef = useRef(false);
   198→
   199→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   200→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
   201→  const enableTapToMove = isTablet && !readOnly;
   202→  const prefetchTaskData = usePrefetchTaskData();
   203→
   204→  const uiState = useTimelineUiState();
   205→  const {
   206→    pendingDropFrame,
   207→    setPendingDropFrame,
   208→    pendingDuplicateFrame,
   209→    setPendingDuplicateFrame,
   210→    pendingExternalAddFrame,
   211→    isInternalDropProcessing,
   212→    setIsInternalDropProcessing,
   213→    activePendingFrame,
   214→  } = usePendingFrames({ shotId, images, isUploadingImage });
   215→
   216→  const {
   217→    selectedIds,
   218→    showSelectionBar,
   219→    isSelected,
   220→    toggleSelection,
   221→    clearSelection,
   222→    lockSelection,
   223→    unlockSelection,
   224→  } = useTimelineSelection({ isEnabled: !readOnly });
   225→
   226→  const trailingEffectiveEnd = getTrailingEffectiveEnd({
   227→    framePositions,
   228→    imagesCount: images.length,
   229→    hasExistingTrailingVideo,
   230→  });
   231→  const rawDimensions = getTimelineDimensions(
   232→    framePositions,
   233→    [pendingDropFrame, pendingDuplicateFrame, pendingExternalAddFrame, trailingEffectiveEnd],
   234→  );
   235→  const containerRect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() || null;
   236→
   237→  const {
   238→    dragState,
   239→    dragOffset,
   240→    currentDragFrame,
   241→    swapTargetId,
   242→    pushMode,
   243→    dynamicPositions,
   244→    handleMouseDown,
   245→    handleMouseMove,
   246→    handleMouseUp,
   247→  } = useTimelineDrag({
   248→    framePositions,
   249→    setFramePositions,
   250→    images,
   251→    onImageReorder,
   252→    fullMin: rawDimensions.fullMin,
   253→    fullMax: rawDimensions.fullMax,
   254→    fullRange: rawDimensions.fullRange,
   255→    containerRect,
   256→    setIsDragInProgress,
   257→    selectedIds,
   258→    onDragStart: lockSelection,
   259→    onDragEnd: unlockSelection,
   260→  });
   261→
   262→  const viewport = useTimelineViewportController({
   263→    framePositions,
   264→    pendingDropFrame,
   265→    pendingDuplicateFrame,
   266→    pendingExternalAddFrame,
   267→    imagesCount: images.length,
   268→    hasExistingTrailingVideo,
   269→    timelineRef,
   270→    containerRef,
   271→    isEndpointDraggingRef,
   272→    dragState,
   273→    shotId,
   274→    handleMouseMove,
   275→    handleMouseUp,
   276→  });
   277→
   278→  useEffect(() => {
   279→    if (uiState.resetGap > uiState.maxGap) {
   280→      uiState.setResetGap(uiState.maxGap);
   281→    }
   282→  }, [uiState]);
   283→
   284→  const handleImageDropInterceptor = useCallback(async (files: File[], targetFrame?: number) => {
   285→    if (targetFrame !== undefined) {
   286→      setPendingDropFrame(targetFrame);
   287→    }
   288→    if (onFileDrop) {
   289→      await onFileDrop(files, targetFrame);
   290→    }
   291→  }, [onFileDrop, setPendingDropFrame]);
   292→
   293→  const handleGenerationDropInterceptor = useCallback(async (
   294→    generationId: string,
   295→    imageUrl: string,
   296→    thumbUrl: string | undefined,
   297→    targetFrame?: number,
   298→  ) => {
   299→    if (targetFrame !== undefined) {
   300→      setPendingDropFrame(targetFrame);
   301→      setIsInternalDropProcessing(true);
   302→    }
   303→    try {
   304→      if (onGenerationDrop) {
   305→        await onGenerationDrop(generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl, targetFrame);
   306→      }
   307→    } finally {
   308→      setIsInternalDropProcessing(false);
   309→      setPendingDropFrame(null);
   310→    }
   311→  }, [onGenerationDrop, setIsInternalDropProcessing, setPendingDropFrame]);
   312→
   313→  const drop = useUnifiedDrop({
   314→    onFileDrop: handleImageDropInterceptor,
   315→    onGenerationDrop: handleGenerationDropInterceptor,
   316→    fullMin: viewport.fullMin,
   317→    fullRange: viewport.fullRange,
   318→  });
   319→
   320→  const handleDuplicateInterceptor = useCallback((imageId: string, timelineFrame: number) => {
   321→    const sortedImages = [...images]
   322→      .filter((img) => img.timeline_frame !== undefined && img.timeline_frame !== null)
   323→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
   324→
   325→    const currentIndex = sortedImages.findIndex((img) => img.timeline_frame === timelineFrame);
   326→    const nextImage = currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < sortedImages.length - 1
   327→      ? sortedImages[currentIndex + 1]
   328→      : null;
   329→
   330→    const existingFrames = images
   331→      .map((img) => img.timeline_frame)
   332→      .filter((frame): frame is number => frame !== null && frame !== undefined);
   333→    const nextFrame = nextImage?.timeline_frame;
   334→    const finalFrame = calculateDuplicateFrame({
   335→      currentFrame: timelineFrame,
   336→      nextFrame: nextFrame ?? null,
   337→      existingFrames,
   338→      singleItemTrailingFrame: framePositions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY) ?? null,
   339→      isSingleItem: images.length === 1,
   340→    });
   341→
   342→    setPendingDuplicateFrame(finalFrame);
   343→    onImageDuplicate(imageId, finalFrame);
   344→  }, [framePositions, images, onImageDuplicate, setPendingDuplicateFrame]);
   345→
   346→  const {
   347→    handleTapToMoveAction,
   348→    handleTapToMoveMultiAction,
   349→    handleTimelineTapToMove,
   350→  } = useTapToMove({
   351→    enableTapToMove,
   352→    framePositions,
   353→    setFramePositions,
   354→    fullMin: viewport.fullMin,
   355→    fullMax: viewport.fullMax,
   356→    fullRange: viewport.fullRange,
   357→    containerWidth: viewport.containerWidth,
   358→    selectedIds,
   359→    clearSelection,
   360→    containerRef,
   361→  });
   362→
   363→  const handleVideoBrowserSelect = useCallback((resource: Resource) => {
   364→    const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   365→    if (onAddStructureVideo && metadata.videoMetadata) {
   366→      const placement = calculateNewVideoPlacement(
   367→        metadata.videoMetadata.total_frames,
   368→        structureVideos,
   369→        viewport.fullMax,
   370→      );
   371→
   372→      if (placement.lastVideoUpdate && onUpdateStructureVideo) {
   373→        onUpdateStructureVideo(placement.lastVideoUpdate.index, {
   374→          end_frame: placement.lastVideoUpdate.newEndFrame,
   375→        });
   376→      }
   377→
   378→      onAddStructureVideo({
   379→        path: metadata.videoUrl,
   380→        start_frame: placement.start_frame,
   381→        end_frame: placement.end_frame,
   382→        treatment: 'adjust',
   383→        motion_strength: 1.0,
   384→        structure_type: primaryStructureVideo?.structureType ?? 'flow',
   385→        metadata: metadata.videoMetadata,
   386→        resource_id: resource.id,
   387→      });
   388→    } else if (onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange) {
   389→      onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(
   390→        metadata.videoUrl,
   391→        metadata.videoMetadata,
   392→        primaryStructureVideo?.treatment ?? 'adjust',
   393→        primaryStructureVideo?.motionStrength ?? 1.0,
   394→        primaryStructureVideo?.structureType ?? 'flow',
   395→      );
   396→    }
   397→    uiState.setShowVideoBrowser(false);
   398→  }, [
   399→    onAddStructureVideo,
   400→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   401→    onUpdateStructureVideo,
   402→    primaryStructureVideo,
   403→    structureVideos,
   404→    uiState,
   405→    viewport.fullMax,
   406→  ]);
   407→
   408→  const {
   409→    endpointDragFrame,
   410→    isEndpointDragging,
   411→    handleEndpointMouseDown,
   412→  } = useEndpointDrag({
   413→    readOnly,
   414→    fullMin: viewport.fullMin,
   415→    fullMax: viewport.fullMax,
   416→    fullRange: viewport.fullRange,
   417→    containerWidth: viewport.containerWidth,
   418→    maxFrameLimit,
   419→    dynamicPositions,
   420→    framePositions,
   421→    setFramePositions,
   422→    containerRef,
   423→    dragStartDimensionsRef: viewport.dragStartDimensionsRef,
   424→    isEndpointDraggingRef,
   425→  });
   426→
   427→  const currentPositions = dynamicPositions();
   428→  const {
   429→    pairInfo,
   430→    pairDataByIndex,
   431→    localShotGenPositions,
   432→    showPairLabels,
   433→  } = useComputedTimelineData({
   434→    currentPositions,
   435→    images,
   436→    containerWidth: viewport.containerWidth,
   437→    fullRange: viewport.fullRange,
   438→    zoomLevel: viewport.zoomLevel,
   439→  });
   440→
   441→  return {

   444→      containerRef,
   445→    },

   449→      fullRange: viewport.fullRange,
   450→      containerWidth: viewport.containerWidth,
   451→      zoomLevel: viewport.zoomLevel,
   452→      handleZoomInToCenter: viewport.handleZoomInToCenter,
   453→      handleZoomOutFromCenter: viewport.handleZoomOutFromCenter,

   457→    },
   458→    drag: {
   459→      state: dragState,

   139→    extension = extension.split(';')[0].trim();
   140→  }
   141→  if (!extension || extension === 'octet-stream') {
   142→    const urlWithoutParams = accessibleUrl.split('?')[0];
   143→    const urlParts = urlWithoutParams.split('.');
   144→    extension = urlParts.length > 1 ? urlParts.pop()! : (isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png');
   145→  }
   146→  return extension;
   147→}
   148→
   149→export async function downloadSingleMedia(
   150→  params: DownloadSingleMediaParams,
   151→): Promise<DownloadedMediaResult> {
   152→  const accessibleUrl = getDisplayUrl(params.rawUrl);
   153→  const { blob: rawBlob, responseContentType } = await downloadBlobWithXHR(accessibleUrl);
   154→  const blobContentType = params.originalContentType
   155→    || responseContentType
   156→    || (params.isVideo ? 'video/mp4' : 'image/png');
   157→  const blob = rawBlob.type === blobContentType
   158→    ? rawBlob
   159→    : new Blob([rawBlob], { type: blobContentType });
   160→
   161→  const extension = inferFileExtension(blobContentType, accessibleUrl, params.isVideo === true);
   162→  const downloadFilename = params.filename.includes('.')
   163→    ? params.filename
   164→    : `${params.filename}.${extension}`;
   165→  downloadBlobAsFile(blob, downloadFilename);
   166→  return { filename: downloadFilename };
   167→}
   168→
   169→interface DownloadStarredArchiveOptions {
   170→  images: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   171→  onProgress?: (processedCount: number, totalCount: number) => void;
   172→}
   173→
   174→function inferMediaExtension(image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata, blob: Blob): string {
   175→  const contentType = blob.type || image.metadata?.content_type;
   176→  if (contentType) {
   177→    if (contentType.includes('jpeg') || contentType.includes('jpg')) return 'jpg';
   178→    if (contentType.includes('png')) return 'png';
   179→    if (contentType.includes('webp')) return 'webp';
   180→    if (contentType.includes('gif')) return 'gif';
   181→    if (image.isVideo) {
   182→      if (contentType.includes('webm')) return 'webm';
   183→      return 'mp4';
   184→    }
   185→  }
   186→  return image.isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png';
   187→}
   188→
   189→function buildArchiveFileName(): string {
   190→  const now = new Date();
   191→  const dateStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '');
   192→  return `starred-images-${dateStr}.zip`;
   193→}
   194→
   195→export async function downloadStarredMediaArchive(
   196→  options: DownloadStarredArchiveOptions,
   197→): Promise<{ count: number; archiveFilename: string }> {
   198→  const context = 'MediaGallery.downloadStarredMediaArchive';
   199→  const JSZipModule = await import('jszip');
   200→  const zip = new JSZipModule.default();
   201→
   202→  const sortedImages = [...options.images].sort((a, b) => {
   203→    const dateA = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   204→    const dateB = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   205→    if (dateA !== dateB) {
   206→      return dateA - dateB;
   207→    }
   208→    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
   209→  });
   210→
   211→  for (let i = 0; i < sortedImages.length; i += 1) {
   212→    const image = sortedImages[i];
   213→    const accessibleImageUrl = getDisplayUrl(image.url);
   214→    let response: Response;
   215→    try {
   216→      response = await fetch(accessibleImageUrl);
   217→    } catch (error) {
   218→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   219→        error,
   220→        context,
   221→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   222→        fallbackMessage: 'Network request failed',
   223→      });
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    if (!response.ok) {
   227→      throw new DownloadServiceError({
   228→        code: 'http_error',
   229→        context,
   230→        message: `Failed to fetch media: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`,
   231→        status: response.status,
   232→        statusText: response.statusText,
   233→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   234→      });
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    let blob: Blob;
   238→    try {
   239→      blob = await response.blob();
   240→    } catch (error) {
   241→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   242→        error,
   243→        context,
   244→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   245→        fallbackMessage: 'Failed to read download payload',
   246→      });
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };
   259→}
   260→

   241→/**
   242→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   243→ */
   244→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   245→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   246→
   247→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   248→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   249→    // Get Monday of this week
   250→    const day = date.getUTCDay();
   251→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   252→    const monday = new Date(date);
   253→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   254→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);
   255→
   256→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {
   257→      weekMap.set(weekKey, { date: weekKey, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   258→    }
   259→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   260→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   261→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   262→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   266→}

1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}

   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };
   259→}

     3→import type { PromptEntry } from '../../types';
     4→import type { PromptRoutingResult } from './types';
     5→
     6→interface PromptIdDedupInput {

     8→  setPrompts: PromptRoutingResult['setPrompts'];
     9→  promptIdCounter: MutableRefObject<number>;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function usePromptIdDedupEffect(input: PromptIdDedupInput): void {
    13→  const { prompts, setPrompts, promptIdCounter } = input;
    14→
    15→  useEffect(() => {
    16→    let nextId = prompts.reduce((max, prompt) => {
    17→      const match = /^prompt-(\d+)$/.exec(prompt.id || '');
    18→      if (!match) {
    19→        return max;
    20→      }
    21→
    22→      const numericId = parseInt(match[1], 10) + 1;
    23→      return numericId > max ? numericId : max;
    24→    }, 1);
    25→
    26→    const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    27→    let hadDuplicates = false;
    28→
    29→    const dedupedPrompts = prompts.map((prompt) => {
    30→      if (!seenIds.has(prompt.id)) {
    31→        seenIds.add(prompt.id);
    32→        return prompt;
    33→      }
    34→
    35→      hadDuplicates = true;
    36→      const newId = `prompt-${nextId++}`;
    37→      seenIds.add(newId);
    38→      return { ...prompt, id: newId };
    39→    });
    40→
    41→    if (hadDuplicates) {
    42→      setPrompts(dedupedPrompts);
    43→    }
    44→
    45→    if (nextId > promptIdCounter.current) {
    46→      promptIdCounter.current = nextId;
    47→    }
    48→  }, [prompts, setPrompts, promptIdCounter]);
    49→}

   178→        const { data: taskTypes } = await supabaseAdmin
   179→          .from('task_types')
   180→          .select('name, run_type')
   181→          .eq('is_active', true);
   182→
   183→        if (taskTypes) {
   184→          taskTypeRunTypeMap = new Map(taskTypes.map(tt => [tt.name, tt.run_type]));
   185→        }
   186→      }
   187→
   188→      // Build map of user in-progress counts for capacity filtering
   189→      const userInProgressMap = new Map<string, number>();
   190→      if (Array.isArray(userStatsResult.data)) {
   191→        for (const u of userStatsResult.data) {
   192→          userInProgressMap.set(u.user_id, u.in_progress_tasks ?? 0);
   193→        }
   194→      }
   195→
   196→      // Fetch detailed task lists (parallel, with limits for performance)
   197→      const [queuedResult, activeResult] = await Promise.all([
   198→        supabaseAdmin
   199→          .from('tasks')
   200→          .select(`
   201→            id,
   202→            task_type,
   203→            created_at,
   204→            dependant_on,
   205→            projects!inner(user_id, users!inner(credits, settings))
   206→          `)
   207→          .eq('status', 'Queued')
   208→          .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
   209→          .limit(100),
   210→        supabaseAdmin
   211→          .from('tasks')
   212→          .select(`
   213→            id,
   214→            task_type,
   215→            worker_id,
   216→            updated_at,
   217→            projects!inner(user_id, users!inner(credits, settings))
   218→          `)
   219→          .eq('status', 'In Progress')
   220→          .not('worker_id', 'is', null)
   221→          .order('updated_at', { ascending: true })
   222→          .limit(100)
   223→      ]);
   224→
   225→      // Collect all dependency task IDs to check their completion status
   226→      const allDepIds = new Set<string>();
   227→      for (const task of queuedResult.data || []) {
   228→        if (Array.isArray(task.dependant_on)) {
   229→          for (const depId of task.dependant_on) {
   230→            allDepIds.add(depId);
   231→          }
   232→        }
   233→      }
   234→
   235→      // Fetch dependency task statuses if any
   236→      const completedDepIds = new Set<string>();
   237→      if (allDepIds.size > 0) {
   238→        const { data: depTasks } = await supabaseAdmin
   239→          .from('tasks')
   240→          .select('id, status')
   241→          .in('id', Array.from(allDepIds));
   242→
   243→        if (depTasks) {
   244→          for (const dep of depTasks) {
   245→            if (dep.status === 'Complete') {
   246→              completedDepIds.add(dep.id);
   247→            }
   248→          }
   249→        }
   250→      }
   251→
   252→      // Helper to check if all dependencies are complete
   253→      const allDepsComplete = (dependant_on: string[] | null): boolean => {
   254→        if (!dependant_on || dependant_on.length === 0) return true;
   255→        return dependant_on.every(depId => completedDepIds.has(depId));
   256→      };
   257→
   258→      // Filter queued tasks to match RPC criteria (only claimable tasks)
   259→      // Criteria: not orchestrator, credits > 0, allows_cloud, deps complete, user not at capacity
   260→      const queued_tasks = (queuedResult.data || [])
   261→        .filter(task => {
   262→          // Exclude orchestrator tasks
   263→          if (task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator')) return false;
   264→          // Exclude no-credits users
   265→          if (task.projects.users.credits <= 0) return false;
   266→          // Exclude users with cloud disabled
   267→          const allowsCloud = task.projects.users.settings?.ui?.generationMethods?.inCloud ?? true;
   268→          if (!allowsCloud) return false;
   269→          // Exclude tasks with incomplete dependencies
   270→          if (!allDepsComplete(task.dependant_on)) return false;
   271→          // Exclude users at capacity (5+ in progress)
   272→          const userInProgress = userInProgressMap.get(task.projects.user_id) ?? 0;
   273→          if (userInProgress >= 5) return false;
   274→          // Apply run_type filter if specified
   275→          if (appliedRunType && taskTypeRunTypeMap) {
   276→            const taskRunType = taskTypeRunTypeMap.get(task.task_type);
   277→            if (!taskRunType || taskRunType !== appliedRunType) return false;
   278→          }
   279→          return true;
   280→        })
   281→        .map(task => ({
   282→          task_id: task.id,
   283→          task_type: task.task_type,
   284→          user_id: task.projects.user_id,
   285→          created_at: task.created_at
   286→        }));
   287→
   288→      // Filter active tasks (orchestrator, credits, run_type, api-worker exclusion)
   289→      const active_tasks = (activeResult.data || [])
   290→        .filter(task => {
   291→          if (task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator')) return false;
   292→          if (task.projects.users.credits <= 0) return false;
   293→          if (appliedRunType === 'gpu' && task.worker_id === 'api-worker-main') return false;
   294→          if (appliedRunType && taskTypeRunTypeMap) {
   295→            const taskRunType = taskTypeRunTypeMap.get(task.task_type);
   296→            if (!taskRunType || taskRunType !== appliedRunType) return false;
   297→          }
   298→          return true;
   299→        })
   300→        .map(task => ({
   301→          task_id: task.id,
   302→          task_type: task.task_type,
   303→          worker_id: task.worker_id,
   304→          user_id: task.projects.user_id,
   305→          started_at: task.updated_at
   306→        }));
   307→
   308→      // Debug logging (only when debug=true)
   309→      if (debug) {
   310→        logger.debug('Service role counts', {
   311→          runType: appliedRunType || 'ALL',
   312→          queued_only, blocked_by_capacity, blocked_by_deps, blocked_by_settings,
   313→          potentially_claimable, active_only,
   314→          queued_tasks_count: queued_tasks.length,
   315→          active_tasks_count: active_tasks.length,
   316→          users_with_tasks: user_stats.filter(u => u.in_progress_tasks > 0 || u.queued_tasks > 0).length,
   317→        });
   318→
   319→        // Validation warnings (array may differ due to 100-task limit or race conditions)
   320→        if (active_tasks.length !== active_only) {
   321→          logger.warn('active_tasks array mismatch', { array: active_tasks.length, count: active_only });
   322→        }
   323→      }
   324→
   325→      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
   326→      if (debug) {
   327→        logger.debug('Completed', { elapsed_ms: elapsed });
   328→      }
   329→
   330→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   331→        mode: 'count',
   332→        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   333→        run_type_filter_requested: requestedRunType,
   334→        run_type_filter: appliedRunType,
   335→        totals: {
   336→          // Core counts (capacity-limited, for claim logic)
   337→          queued_only,              // Immediately claimable (capacity-limited)
   338→          active_only,              // Currently being processed
   339→          queued_plus_active,       // Total workload
   340→          // Breakdown for smarter scaling decisions
   341→          blocked_by_capacity,      // Will free up as tasks complete
   342→          blocked_by_deps,          // Waiting on dependencies (uncertain)
   343→          blocked_by_settings,      // User has cloud disabled (won't become claimable)
   344→          potentially_claimable     // queued_only + blocked_by_capacity (for scaling)
   345→        },
   346→        queued_tasks,
   347→        active_tasks,
   348→        users: user_stats,
   349→        elapsed_ms: debug ? elapsed : undefined
   350→      }), {
   351→        status: 200,
   352→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   353→      });
   354→    } else {
   355→      // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   356→      // USER TOKEN PATH: Task statistics for specific user
   357→      // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   358→
   359→      // ESSENTIAL: Get counts, user info, and project IDs (4 parallel calls)
   360→      const [countQueuedOnly, countQueuedPlusActive, analysisResult, projectsResult] = await Promise.all([
   361→        supabaseAdmin.rpc('count_eligible_tasks_user_pat', { p_user_id: callerId, p_include_active: false }),
   362→        supabaseAdmin.rpc('count_eligible_tasks_user_pat', { p_user_id: callerId, p_include_active: true }),
   363→        supabaseAdmin.rpc('analyze_task_availability_user_pat', { p_user_id: callerId, p_include_active: true }),
   364→        supabaseAdmin.from('projects').select('id').eq('user_id', callerId)
   365→      ]);
   366→
   367→      if (countQueuedOnly.error) {
   368→        logger.error("User count (queued only) error", { error: countQueuedOnly.error.message, user_id: callerId });
   369→        throw countQueuedOnly.error;
   370→      }
   371→      if (countQueuedPlusActive.error) {
   372→        logger.error("User count (queued+active) error", { error: countQueuedPlusActive.error.message, user_id: callerId });
   373→        throw countQueuedPlusActive.error;
   374→      }
   375→
   376→      const queued_only = countQueuedOnly.data ?? 0;
   377→      const queued_plus_active = countQueuedPlusActive.data ?? 0;
   378→      const active_only = Math.max(0, queued_plus_active - queued_only);
   379→
   380→      const analysis = analysisResult.data || {};
   381→      const eligible_queued = analysis.eligible_count ?? 0;
   382→      const user_info = analysis.user_info ?? {};
   383→
   384→      const projectIds = projectsResult.data?.map(p => p.id) || [];
   385→
   386→      let queued_tasks: unknown[] = [];
   387→      let active_tasks: unknown[] = [];
   388→
   389→      if (projectIds.length > 0) {
   390→        // Fetch task details (parallel)
   391→        const [queuedResult, activeResult] = await Promise.all([
   392→          supabaseAdmin
   393→            .from('tasks')
   394→            .select('id, task_type, created_at, project_id')
   395→            .eq('status', 'Queued')
   396→            .in('project_id', projectIds)
   397→            .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
   398→            .limit(50),
   399→          supabaseAdmin
   400→            .from('tasks')
   401→            .select('id, task_type, worker_id, updated_at, project_id')
   402→            .eq('status', 'In Progress')
   403→            .in('project_id', projectIds)
   404→            .not('worker_id', 'is', null)
   405→            .order('updated_at', { ascending: true })
   406→            .limit(50)
   407→        ]);
   408→
   409→        // Filter and format queued tasks
   410→        queued_tasks = (queuedResult.data || [])
   411→          .filter(task => !task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator'))
   412→          .map(task => ({
   413→            task_id: task.id,
   414→            task_type: task.task_type,
   415→            user_id: callerId,
   416→            created_at: task.created_at
   417→          }));
   418→
   419→        // Filter and format active tasks
   420→        active_tasks = (activeResult.data || [])
   421→          .filter(task => !task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator'))
   422→          .map(task => ({
   423→            task_id: task.id,
   424→            task_type: task.task_type,
   425→            worker_id: task.worker_id,
   426→            user_id: callerId,
   427→            started_at: task.updated_at
   428→          }));
   429→      }
   430→
   431→      if (debug) {
   432→        logger.debug('User counts', { user_id: callerId, queued_only, active_only, eligible_queued });
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
   436→
   437→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   438→        mode: 'count',
   439→        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   440→        user_id: callerId,
   441→        run_type_filter_requested: requestedRunType,
   442→        run_type_filter: appliedRunType,
   443→        totals: {
   444→          queued_only,
   445→          active_only,
   446→          queued_plus_active,
   447→          eligible_queued
   448→        },
   449→        queued_tasks,
   450→        active_tasks,
   451→        user_info,
   452→        debug_summary: {
   453→          at_capacity: active_only >= 5,
   454→          capacity_used_pct: Math.round((active_only / 5) * 100),
   455→          can_claim_more: active_only < 5 && eligible_queued > 0
   456→        },
   457→        elapsed_ms: debug ? elapsed : undefined
   458→      }), {
   459→        status: 200,
   460→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   461→      });
   462→    }
   463→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   464→    const message = toErrorMessage(error);
   465→    logger.error("Unexpected error", { error: message });
   466→    await logger.flush();
   467→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${message}`, { status: 500 });
   468→  }
   469→});
   470→
