```
     3→import { parseRatio } from '@/shared/lib/media/aspectRatios';
     4→
     5→interface SkeletonGalleryProps {
     6→  /** Number of skeleton items to show */
     7→  count?: number;
     8→  /** Number of columns for the grid (responsive breakpoints) */
     9→  columns?: {
    10→    base?: number;
    11→    sm?: number;
    12→    md?: number;
    13→    lg?: number;
    14→    xl?: number;
    15→    '2xl'?: number;
    16→  };
    17→  /** Fixed column count - overrides responsive columns when provided */
    18→  fixedColumns?: number;
    19→  /** Custom gap classes (e.g. "gap-2 sm:gap-3 md:gap-4") - defaults to "gap-4" */
    20→  gapClasses?: string;
    21→  /** Whether to use white text/styling (for dark panes) */
    22→  darkSurface?: boolean;
    23→  /** Custom className for the container */
    24→  className?: string;
    25→  /** Whether to show skeleton controls at the top (pagination, filters, search) */
    26→  showControls?: boolean;
    27→  /** Project aspect ratio (e.g. "16:9", "4:3", "1:1") to match project dimensions */
    28→  projectAspectRatio?: string;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * A reusable skeleton loading component for gallery layouts.
    33→ * Provides consistent skeleton styling across different tools and pages.
    34→ */
    35→function SkeletonGalleryComponent({
    36→  count = 20,
    37→  columns = { base: 2, sm: 3, md: 4, lg: 5, xl: 6 },
    38→  fixedColumns,
    39→  gapClasses = 'gap-4',
    40→  darkSurface = false,
    41→  className,
    42→  showControls = false,
    43→  projectAspectRatio
    44→}: SkeletonGalleryProps) {
    45→  
    46→  const colsLookup: Record<number, string> = { 1: 'grid-cols-1', 2: 'grid-cols-2', 3: 'grid-cols-3', 4: 'grid-cols-4', 5: 'grid-cols-5', 6: 'grid-cols-6' };
    47→  const prefixedCols = (prefix: string, n?: number) => n ? `${prefix}${colsLookup[n] ?? ''}` : undefined;
    48→
    49→  const gridCols = cn(
    50→    'grid',
    51→    gapClasses,
    52→    columns.base && colsLookup[columns.base],
    53→    prefixedCols('sm:', columns.sm),
    54→    prefixedCols('md:', columns.md),
    55→    prefixedCols('lg:', columns.lg),
    56→    prefixedCols('xl:', columns.xl),
    57→    prefixedCols('2xl:', columns['2xl']),
    58→  );
    59→
    60→  const skeletonBg = darkSurface ? 'bg-zinc-700/60' : 'bg-muted';
    61→
    62→  // Calculate aspect ratio for skeleton items
    63→  let aspectRatioPadding = '100%'; // Default to square (1:1)
    64→  
    65→  if (projectAspectRatio) {
    66→    const ratio = parseRatio(projectAspectRatio);
    67→    if (!isNaN(ratio)) {
    68→      const calculatedPadding = (1 / ratio) * 100; // height/width * 100
    69→      // Ensure reasonable aspect ratio bounds
    70→      const minPadding = 60; // Minimum 60% height (for very wide images)
    71→      const maxPadding = 200; // Maximum 200% height (for very tall images)
    72→      aspectRatioPadding = `${Math.min(Math.max(calculatedPadding, minPadding), maxPadding)}%`;
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return (
    77→    <div className={cn('space-y-6 pb-8', className)}>
    78→      {showControls && (
    79→        <div className="mt-0 space-y-3">
    80→          {/* Pagination row - matches MediaGallery pagination section */}
    81→          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
    82→            {/* Left side - Pagination controls skeleton */}
    83→            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
    84→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-16 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
    85→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-40 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
    86→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-16 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
    87→            </div>
    88→
    89→            {/* Right side - Starred filter skeleton */}
    90→            <div className="flex items-center gap-x-2">
    91→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-4 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
    92→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-12 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
    93→            </div>
    94→          </div>
    95→
    96→          {/* Filters row - matches MediaGallery filters section */}
    97→          <div className="flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-y-2">
    98→            {/* Left side - Filters skeleton */}
    99→            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
   100→              {/* Shot Filter skeleton */}
   101→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-[140px] rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   102→              
   103→              {/* Search skeleton */}
   104→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-8 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   105→            </div>
   106→            
   107→            {/* Right side - Media Type Filter skeleton */}
   108→            <div className="flex items-center gap-x-1.5">
   109→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-8 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   110→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-[100px] rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   111→            </div>
   112→          </div>
   113→        </div>
   114→      )}
   115→      
   116→      {/* Gallery grid skeleton */}
   117→      <div
   118→        className={fixedColumns ? cn('grid', gapClasses) : gridCols}
   119→        style={fixedColumns ? { gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${fixedColumns}, minmax(0, 1fr))` } : undefined}
   120→      >
   121→        {Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, idx) => (
   122→          <div
   123→            key={idx}
   124→            className={cn(
   125→              'animate-pulse rounded-lg relative',
   126→              skeletonBg
   127→            )}
   128→            style={{ paddingBottom: aspectRatioPadding }}
   129→          />
   130→        ))}
   131→      </div>
   132→    </div>
   133→  );
   134→}
   135→
   136→export const SkeletonGallery = React.memo(SkeletonGalleryComponent);
   137→
```

```
    40→    if (depth > 6) return null;
    41→    if (value == null) return value;
    42→    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => redactDeep(v, depth + 1)) as Json[];

   218→interface InsertShareWithRetryArgs {

   220→  taskId: string | null | undefined;

   227→
   228→async function insertShareWithRetry({
   229→  generationId,
   230→  taskId,
   231→  shotId,
   232→  userId,
   233→  generationData,
   234→  augmentedTaskData,
   235→  generateShareSlug,
   236→}: InsertShareWithRetryArgs): Promise<string | null> {
   237→  const maxAttempts = 5;
   238→  let attempts = 0;
   239→
   240→  const { data: creatorRow } = await supabase().from('users')
   241→    .select('username, name, avatar_url')
   242→    .eq('id', userId)
   243→    .maybeSingle();
   244→
   245→  while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
   246→    const candidateSlug = generateShareSlug(10);
   247→    const creator = creatorRow ?? null;
   248→    const normalizedTaskId = typeof taskId === 'string' && taskId.length > 0 ? taskId : null;
   249→    const sharedGenerationInsert = {
   250→      share_slug: candidateSlug,
   251→      ...(normalizedTaskId ? { task_id: normalizedTaskId } : {}),
   252→      generation_id: generationId,
   253→      creator_id: userId,
   254→      creator_username: creator?.username ?? null,
   255→      creator_name: creator?.name ?? null,
   256→      creator_avatar_url: creator?.avatar_url ?? null,
   257→      cached_generation_data: generationData,
   258→      cached_task_data: sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(augmentedTaskData),
   259→      shot_id: shotId || null,
   260→    };
   261→
   262→    const { data: newShare, error: insertError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   263→      .insert(sharedGenerationInsert)
   264→      .select('share_slug')
   265→      .single();
   266→
   267→    if (!insertError && newShare) {
   268→      return newShare.share_slug;
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    if (isUniqueViolationError(insertError)) {
   272→      attempts++;
   273→      continue;
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    if (insertError) {
   277→      throw insertError;
   278→    }
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  return null;
   282→}
```

```
     2→
     3→interface UseLayoutModeParams {
     4→  isMobile: boolean;
     5→  showTaskDetails: boolean;
     6→  isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
     7→  isVideo: boolean;
     8→  isInpaintMode: boolean;
     9→  isMagicEditMode: boolean;
    10→}
    11→
    12→interface UseLayoutModeReturn {
    13→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
    14→  isTouchLikeDevice: boolean;
    15→  shouldShowSidePanel: boolean;
    16→  isUnifiedEditMode: boolean;
    17→  isPortraitMode: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→/**
    21→ * Hook to detect layout mode and device capabilities
    22→ * Determines which layout variant to use (desktop/mobile/tablet)
    23→ */
    24→export const useLayoutMode = ({
    25→  showTaskDetails,
    26→  isSpecialEditMode,
    27→  isVideo,
    28→  isInpaintMode,
    29→  isMagicEditMode
    30→}: UseLayoutModeParams): UseLayoutModeReturn => {
    31→  // Use shared device detection hook for all device/orientation detection
    32→  const { isTabletOrLarger, isPortraitMode: isPortrait, isTouchDevice: isTouchLikeDevice } = useDeviceInfo();
    33→
    34→  // Unified special mode check - both inpaint and magic edit use the same layout
    35→  const isUnifiedEditMode = isInpaintMode || isMagicEditMode;
    36→
    37→  // Show sidebar on tablet/larger for: task details (even if loading), special edit modes, OR videos (always on iPad)
    38→  // Note: We show sidebar immediately for showTaskDetails to prevent layout jump while task loads
    39→  // Exception: On portrait tablets (like vertical iPad), use mobile layout for better UX
    40→  const shouldShowSidePanel = !isPortrait && ((showTaskDetails && isTabletOrLarger) || (isSpecialEditMode && isTabletOrLarger) || (isVideo && isTabletOrLarger));
    41→
    42→  return {
    43→    isTabletOrLarger,
    44→    isTouchLikeDevice,
    45→    shouldShowSidePanel,
    46→    isUnifiedEditMode,
    47→    isPortraitMode: isPortrait
    48→  };
    49→};
```

```
     3→import { bootstrapEdgeHandler, NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS } from "../_shared/edgeHandler.ts";
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Edge function: grant-credits
     7→ *
     8→ * Grants credits to a user (admin only, or welcome bonus)
     9→ *
    10→ * POST /functions/v1/grant-credits
    11→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>
    12→ * Body: {
    13→ *   userId: string,
    14→ *   amount: number,
    15→ *   description?: string,
    16→ *   isWelcomeBonus?: boolean

    18→ *
    19→ * Returns:
    20→ * - 200 OK with transaction details
    21→ * - 400 Bad Request if invalid input or welcome bonus already given
    22→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    23→ * - 403 Forbidden if not admin (for non-welcome bonus)
    24→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    25→ */
    26→const corsHeaders = {

    28→  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',

    30→
    31→serve(async (req) => {
    32→  // Handle CORS preflight requests
    33→  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    34→    return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders });
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler(req, {
    38→    functionName: "grant-credits",
    39→    logPrefix: "[GRANT-CREDITS]",
    40→    method: "POST",
    41→    parseBody: "strict",
    42→    corsPreflight: false,
    43→    auth: {
    44→      required: true,
    45→      options: { allowJwtUserAuth: true },
    46→    },
    47→    ...NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS,
    48→  });
    49→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
    50→    return bootstrap.response;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const { supabaseAdmin: adminClient, logger, auth, body } = bootstrap.value;
    54→
    55→  const { userId, amount, description, isWelcomeBonus = false } = body;
    56→  if (!userId || !amount || typeof amount !== 'number' || amount <= 0) {
    57→    return new Response("userId and positive amount are required", {
    58→      status: 400,
    59→      headers: corsHeaders,
    60→    });
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const isServiceRole = auth?.isServiceRole === true;
    64→  const currentUserId = auth?.userId;
    65→
    66→  // For welcome bonus, allow authenticated users; for admin grants, require service role
    67→  if (!isWelcomeBonus && !isServiceRole) {
    68→    return new Response("Service role access required for admin grants", {

    72→  }
    73→
    74→  try {
    75→    // ─── 3. Check and handle welcome bonus ──────────────────────────
    76→    if (isWelcomeBonus) {

    85→      // Ensure the user row exists before attempting atomic claim

    94→
    95→        const { error: insertError } = await adminClient
    96→          .from('users')

   107→          return new Response(`Could not create user record: ${insertError.message}`, {

   111→        }

   153→        .select()
   154→        .single();
   155→
   156→      if (ledgerError) {

   162→          status: 500,

   167→      logger.info('Welcome bonus granted', { amount, user_id: userId });

   182→    }

   184→    // ─── 6. Handle regular admin credit grant ───────────────────────
```

```
    45→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    46→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    47→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    48→    : null;
    49→}
    50→
    51→function resolvePathValue(params: unknown, path: TaskParamPath): unknown {
    52→  let value: unknown = params;
    53→  for (const segment of path) {
    54→    const record = asRecord(value);
    55→    if (!record || !(segment in record)) {
    56→      return undefined;
    57→    }
    58→    value = record[segment];
    59→  }
    60→  return value;
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function resolveByPrecedence<T>(...candidates: Array<T | null | undefined>): T | undefined {
    64→  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    65→    if (candidate !== undefined && candidate !== null) {
    66→      return candidate;
    67→    }
    68→  }
    69→  return undefined;
    70→}
    71→
    72→function extractTaskParamValue(
    73→  params: unknown,
    74→  paths: readonly TaskParamPath[],
    75→): unknown {
    76→  for (const path of paths) {
    77→    const value = resolvePathValue(params, path);
    78→    if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
    79→      return value;
    80→    }
    81→  }
    82→  return undefined;
    83→}
    84→
    85→function extractTaskParamString(
    86→  params: unknown,
    87→  paths: readonly TaskParamPath[],
    88→): string | null {
    89→  const value = extractTaskParamValue(params, paths);
    90→  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    91→    return null;
    92→  }
    93→  const normalized = value.trim();
    94→  return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : null;
    95→}
    96→
    97→function parseTaskParamBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | null {
    98→  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    99→    return value;
   100→  }
   101→  if (typeof value === 'number') {
   102→    if (value === 1) return true;
   103→    if (value === 0) return false;
   104→    return null;
   105→  }
   106→  if (typeof value === 'string') {
   107→    const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   108→    if (normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1') return true;
   109→    if (normalized === 'false' || normalized === '0') return false;
   110→  }
   111→  return null;
   112→}
   113→
   114→function summarizeTaskParamValue(value: unknown): string | number | boolean | null {
   115→  if (value === null) {
   116→    return null;
   117→  }
   118→  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') {
   119→    return value;
   120→  }
   121→  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   122→    return '[array]';
   123→  }
   124→  if (typeof value === 'object') {
   125→    return '[object]';
   126→  }
   127→  return String(value);
   128→}
```

```
    11→function needsSceneMigration(reference: ReferenceImage): boolean {

    16→  );

    18→
    19→function migrateSceneReference(reference: ReferenceImage): ReferenceImage {
    20→  const updates: Partial<ReferenceImage> = { ...reference };
    21→
    22→  if (
    23→    (reference.referenceMode as string) === 'scene-imprecise' ||
    24→    (reference.referenceMode as string) === 'scene-precise'
    25→  ) {
    26→    updates.referenceMode = 'scene';
    27→    updates.inThisSceneStrength = reference.inThisSceneStrength ?? 1.0;
    28→  } else if (reference.inThisSceneStrength === undefined) {
    29→    updates.inThisSceneStrength = reference.inThisScene ? 1.0 : 0;
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  return updates as ReferenceImage;
    33→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Autoplay Monitor - Tracks autoplay state changes over time
     3→ * 
     4→ * This utility periodically monitors video autoplay states to help
     5→ * identify when and why autoplay permissions change.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→let monitoringActive = false;
     9→
    10→interface VideoState {
    11→  element: HTMLVideoElement;
    12→  src: string;
    13→  paused: boolean;
    14→  currentTime: number;
    15→  readyState: number;
    16→  isGallery: boolean;
    17→  isLightbox: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→let previousVideoStates: VideoState[] = [];
    21→
    22→const captureVideoStates = (): VideoState[] => {
    23→  const videos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
    24→  return Array.from(videos).map(video => ({
    25→    element: video,
    26→    src: video.src?.substring(video.src.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) || 'no-src',
    27→    paused: video.paused,
    28→    currentTime: video.currentTime,
    29→    readyState: video.readyState,
    30→    isGallery: !!video.getAttribute('data-video-id'),
    31→    isLightbox: !!video.getAttribute('data-lightbox-video')
    32→  }));
    33→};
    34→
    35→const compareVideoStates = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]): boolean => {
    36→  if (current.length !== previous.length) return true;
    37→  
    38→  return current.some((curr, index) => {
    39→    const prev = previous[index];
    40→    if (!prev) return true;
    41→    
    42→    return curr.paused !== prev.paused || 
    43→           Math.abs(curr.currentTime - prev.currentTime) > 0.1 ||
    44→           curr.readyState !== prev.readyState;
    45→  });
    46→};
    47→
    48→interface VideoStateChange {
    49→  type: string;
    50→  video?: string;
    51→  isLightbox?: boolean;
    52→  isGallery?: boolean;
    53→  from: number | string;
    54→  to: number | string;
    55→}
    56→
    57→const logVideoStateChanges = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]) => {
    58→  const changes: VideoStateChange[] = [];
    59→  
    60→  // Check for new/removed videos
    61→  if (current.length !== previous.length) {
    62→    changes.push({
    63→      type: 'count_change',
    64→      from: previous.length,
    65→      to: current.length
    66→    });
    67→  }
    68→  
    69→  // Check for state changes in existing videos
    70→  current.forEach((curr, index) => {
    71→    const prev = previous[index];
    72→    if (!prev) return;
    73→    
    74→    if (curr.paused !== prev.paused) {
    75→      changes.push({
    76→        type: 'play_state_change',
    77→        video: curr.src,
    78→        isLightbox: curr.isLightbox,
    79→        isGallery: curr.isGallery,
    80→        from: prev.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing',
    81→        to: curr.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing'
    82→      });
    83→    }
    84→    
    85→    if (curr.readyState !== prev.readyState) {
    86→      changes.push({
    87→        type: 'ready_state_change',
    88→        video: curr.src,
    89→        from: prev.readyState,
    90→        to: curr.readyState
    91→      });
    92→    }
    93→  });
    94→  
    95→};
    96→
    97→const startAutoplayMonitoring = () => {
    98→  if (monitoringActive || !import.meta.env.DEV) return;
    99→  
   100→  monitoringActive = true;
   101→  previousVideoStates = captureVideoStates();
   102→
   103→  setInterval(() => {
   104→    const currentStates = captureVideoStates();
   105→    
   106→    if (compareVideoStates(currentStates, previousVideoStates)) {
   107→      logVideoStateChanges(currentStates, previousVideoStates);
   108→      previousVideoStates = currentStates;
   109→    }
   110→  }, 1000); // Check every second
   111→};
   112→
   113→startAutoplayMonitoring();
   114→
```

```
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

    19→
    20→/** Enriched generation data with shot associations */
    21→interface SourceGenerationWithAssociations extends GenerationRow {
    22→  all_shot_associations: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseSourceGenerationReturn {
    26→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null;
    27→  sourcePrimaryVariant: SourceVariantData | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Hook to fetch and manage source generation (based_on) data
    32→ * Fetches the generation that this media was derived from, plus its primary variant
    33→ */
    34→export const useSourceGeneration = ({
    35→  media
    36→}: UseSourceGenerationParams): UseSourceGenerationReturn => {
    37→  const [sourceGenerationData, setSourceGenerationData] = useState<SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null>(null);
    38→  const [sourcePrimaryVariant, setSourcePrimaryVariant] = useState<SourceVariantData | null>(null);
    39→  const metadataBasedOnId = (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.based_on as string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  useEffect(() => {
    42→    const basedOnId = media.based_on;
    43→    const basedOnFromMetadata = metadataBasedOnId;
    44→
    45→    // Check both direct field and metadata
    46→    const effectiveBasedOnId = basedOnId || basedOnFromMetadata;
    47→    
    48→    if (!effectiveBasedOnId) {
    49→      setSourceGenerationData(null);
    50→      setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    51→      return;
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const fetchSourceGeneration = async () => {
    55→      try {
    56→        // Fetch source generation with shot associations and primary variant
    57→        // Use left join (no !inner) so we get the generation even if it's not in any shot
    58→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    59→          .select(`
    60→            *,
    61→            generation_variants!generation_variants_generation_id_fkey(
    62→              id,
    63→              location,
    64→              thumbnail_url,
    65→              variant_type,
    66→              is_primary
    67→            )
    68→          `)
    69→          .eq('id', effectiveBasedOnId)
    70→          .maybeSingle();
    71→
    72→        if (error) throw error;
    73→
    74→        if (data) {
    75→          // Extract shot associations from joined data
    76→          const joinedData = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    77→          const shotAssociations = expandShotData(
    78→            joinedData.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    79→          );
    80→          const variants = (joinedData.generation_variants || []) as SourceVariantData[];
    81→          
    82→          // Find primary variant
    83→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
    84→          
    85→          // Add shot associations to the data for easy access
    86→          const enrichedData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations = {
    87→            ...data as unknown as GenerationRow,
    88→            all_shot_associations: shotAssociations,
    89→          };
    90→
    91→          setSourceGenerationData(enrichedData);
    92→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(primaryVariant);
    93→        } else {
    94→          setSourceGenerationData(null);
    95→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    96→        }
    97→      } catch (error) {
    98→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useSourceGeneration', showToast: false });
    99→        // Don't show toast - this is a non-critical feature
   100→        setSourceGenerationData(null);
   101→        setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
   102→      }
   103→    };
   104→    
   105→    void fetchSourceGeneration();
   106→  }, [media.based_on, metadataBasedOnId]);
   107→
   108→  return {
   109→    sourceGenerationData,
   110→    sourcePrimaryVariant
   111→  };
   112→};
   113→
```

```
1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}
```

```
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import type { LoraCategory } from '../../types';
     4→import { getLoraCategoryForModel } from '../../types';

     6→import type { LegacyMigrationsInput } from './types';
     7→
     8→type LoraCategoryMigrationInput = Pick<
     9→  LegacyMigrationsInput,
    10→  'projectImageSettings' | 'selectedProjectId' | 'updateProjectImageSettings'
    11→>;
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Migrates `selectedLorasByTextModel` (per-model LoRA selections) to
    15→ * `selectedLorasByCategory` (per-category: 'qwen' | 'z-image').
    16→ *
    17→ * All qwen-family models share the 'qwen' category, so the migration
    18→ * merges their LoRAs (deduped by id) into a single list.
    19→ */
    20→// SUNSET: 2026-09-01 — remove once all active projects have selectedLorasByCategory persisted.
    21→export function useLoraCategoryMigration(input: LoraCategoryMigrationInput): void {
    22→  const {
    23→    projectImageSettings,
    24→    selectedProjectId,
    25→    updateProjectImageSettings,
    26→  } = input;
    27→
    28→  const migrationAttemptedRef = useRef<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    29→
    30→  useEffect(() => {
    31→    const migrate = async () => {
    32→      if (!projectImageSettings || !selectedProjectId) {
    33→        return;
    34→      }
    35→
    36→      if (migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId]) {
    37→        return;
    38→      }
    39→
    40→      // Only migrate if old format exists and new format doesn't
    41→      if (!projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByTextModel || projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByCategory) {
    42→        migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
    43→        return;
    44→      }
    45→
    46→      migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
    47→
    48→      // Convert per-text-model selections to per-category
    49→      const byCategory: Record<LoraCategory, ActiveLora[]> = {
    50→        'qwen': [],
    51→        'z-image': [],
    52→      };
    53→
    54→      const seenIds: Record<LoraCategory, Set<string>> = {
    55→        'qwen': new Set(),
    56→        'z-image': new Set(),
    57→      };
    58→
    59→      for (const [model, loras] of Object.entries(projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByTextModel)) {
    60→        const category = getLoraCategoryForModel(model as Parameters<typeof getLoraCategoryForModel>[0]);
    61→        for (const lora of loras) {
    62→          if (!seenIds[category].has(lora.id)) {
    63→            seenIds[category].add(lora.id);
    64→            byCategory[category].push(lora);
    65→          }
    66→        }
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      try {
    70→        await updateProjectImageSettings('project', {
    71→          selectedLorasByCategory: byCategory,
    72→          selectedLorasByTextModel: undefined,
    73→        });
    74→      } catch (error) {
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    76→          context: 'ImageGenerationForm.migrateLoraCategoryFormat',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→        migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = false;
    80→      }
    81→    };
    82→
    83→    void migrate();
    84→  }, [projectImageSettings, selectedProjectId, updateProjectImageSettings]);
    85→}
```

```
   356→export function useLoraSubmission(args: UseLoraSubmissionArgs) {
   357→  const handleAddLoraFromForm = async () => {
   358→    const mode = getSubmissionMode(args.uploadMode, args.isMultiStageModel, args.isEditMode);
   359→    const validationError = getValidationError(args.addForm, args.loraFiles, mode);
   360→    if (validationError) {
   361→      toast.error(validationError);
   362→      return;
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    args.setIsSubmitting(true);
   366→
   367→    try {
   368→      const initialUrls: SubmissionUrls = {
   369→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: args.addForm.huggingface_url,
   370→        finalHighNoiseUrl: args.addForm.high_noise_url,
   371→        finalLowNoiseUrl: args.addForm.low_noise_url,
   372→      };
   373→
   374→      const resolvedUrls = await uploadToHuggingFaceIfNeeded(mode, {
   375→        addForm: args.addForm,
   376→        userName: args.userName,
   377→        loraFiles: args.loraFiles,
   378→        sampleFiles: args.sampleFiles,
   379→        uploadToHuggingFace: args.uploadToHuggingFace,
   380→        urls: initialUrls,
   381→      });
   382→
   383→      const uploadedSamples = await uploadSampleFiles(args.sampleFiles);
   384→      const { finalSamples, finalImages } = buildFinalSamplesAndImages({
   385→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   386→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   387→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   388→        uploadedSamples,
   389→      });
   390→
   391→      const mainGeneration = resolveMainGeneration({
   392→        uploadedSamples,
   393→        mainGenerationIndex: args.mainGenerationIndex,
   394→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   395→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   396→        deletedExistingSampleUrls: args.deletedExistingSampleUrls,
   397→        finalSamples,
   398→      });
   399→
   400→      const uniqueFilename = resolveUniqueFilename({
   401→        isEditMode: args.isEditMode,
   402→        editingLora: args.editingLora,
   403→        addForm: args.addForm,
   404→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   405→        existingFilenames: args.getExistingFilenames(),
   406→      });
   407→
   408→      const loraMetadata = buildLoraMetadata({
   409→        addForm: args.addForm,
   410→        userName: args.userName,
   411→        uniqueFilename,
   412→        isMultiStageModel: args.isMultiStageModel,
   413→        finalHuggingfaceUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHuggingfaceUrl,
   414→        finalHighNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalHighNoiseUrl,
   415→        finalLowNoiseUrl: resolvedUrls.finalLowNoiseUrl,
   416→        finalSamples,
   417→        finalImages,
   418→        mainGeneration,
   419→      });
   420→
   421→      if (args.isEditMode && args.editingLora) {
   422→        await args.updateResource.mutateAsync({
   423→          id: args.editingLora.id,
   424→          type: 'lora',
   425→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   426→        });
   427→        args.onClearEdit();
   428→      } else {
   429→        await args.createResource.mutateAsync({
   430→          type: 'lora',
   431→          metadata: loraMetadata,
   432→        });
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      args.resetForm();
   436→      args.onSwitchToBrowse();
   437→    } catch (error) {
   438→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   439→        context: 'MyLorasTab',
   440→        toastTitle: `Failed to ${args.isEditMode ? 'update' : 'add'} LoRA`,
   441→      });
   442→    } finally {
   443→      args.setIsSubmitting(false);
   444→    }
   445→  };
   446→
   447→  return {
   448→    handleAddLoraFromForm,
   449→    isButtonDisabled: () => isButtonDisabled(args),
   450→  };
   451→}
```

```
   202→      const { data: updatedProject, error } = await supabase().from('projects')
   203→        .update(dbUpdates)
   204→        .eq('id', projectId)
   205→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   206→        .select()
   207→        .single();
   208→
   209→      if (error) throw error;
   210→
   211→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(updatedProject);
   212→
   213→      setProjects(prevProjects =>
   214→        sortProjectsByCreatedAt(
   215→          prevProjects.map(p => p.id === projectId ? mappedProject : p)
   216→        )
   217→      );
   218→      return true;
   219→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   220→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to update project' });
   221→      return false;
   222→    } finally {
   223→      setIsUpdatingProject(false);
   224→    }
   225→  }, [userId]);
   226→
   227→  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   228→    setIsDeletingProject(true);
   229→    try {
   230→      if (!userId) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   231→
   232→      const { data, error } = await supabase().functions.invoke('delete-project', {
   233→        body: { projectId },
   234→      });
   235→
   236→      if (error) throw error;
   237→      if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
   238→
   239→      // Filter outside updater so we can call the side-effect callback separately
   240→      // (React state updaters must be pure — no side effects)
   241→      const updated = projects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
   242→      setProjects(updated);
   243→      onProjectDeleted(updated);
   244→
   245→      return true;
   246→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   247→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete project' });
   248→      return false;
   249→    } finally {
   250→      setIsDeletingProject(false);
   251→    }
   252→  }, [onProjectDeleted, projects, userId]);
   253→
   254→  return {
   255→    projects,
   256→    isLoadingProjects,
   257→    fetchProjects,
   258→    addNewProject,
   259→    isCreatingProject,
   260→    updateProject,
   261→    isUpdatingProject,
   262→    deleteProject,
   263→    isDeletingProject,
   264→  };
   265→}
```

```
1→import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Horizontal pointer-swipe navigation with edge resistance and scroll-safe gesture locking.
     5→ */
     6→
     7→interface UseSwipeNavigationProps {
     8→  /** Called when user swipes left (navigate to next) */
     9→  onSwipeLeft?: () => void;
    10→  /** Called when user swipes right (navigate to previous) */
    11→  onSwipeRight?: () => void;
    12→  /** Disable swipe gestures entirely */
    13→  disabled?: boolean;
    14→  /** Minimum distance in pixels to trigger navigation (default: 50) */
    15→  threshold?: number;
    16→  /** Minimum velocity (px/ms) for quick flick gestures (default: 0.3) */
    17→  velocityThreshold?: number;
    18→  /** Whether there's a next item (affects elastic resistance) */
    19→  hasNext?: boolean;
    20→  /** Whether there's a previous item (affects elastic resistance) */
    21→  hasPrevious?: boolean;
    22→  /** Maximum offset for elastic resistance when at edge (default: 80) */
    23→  maxElasticOffset?: number;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
    27→  /** Handlers to spread on the swipeable element */
    28→  swipeHandlers: {
    29→    onPointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    30→    onPointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    31→    onPointerUp: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    32→    onPointerCancel: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    33→  };
    34→  /** Current horizontal offset for visual feedback (in pixels) */
    35→  swipeOffset: number;
    36→  /** Whether the user is actively swiping */
    37→  isSwiping: boolean;
    38→}
    39→
    40→interface SwipeState {
    41→  startX: number;
    42→  startY: number;
    43→  startTime: number;
    44→  currentX: number;
    45→  pointerId: number;
    46→  isLocked: boolean; // Once we determine direction, lock it
    47→  isHorizontal: boolean | null; // null = undetermined, true = horizontal, false = vertical
    48→}
    49→
    50→function isInteractiveElement(el: HTMLElement | null): boolean {
    51→  const interactiveTags = ['BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'A', 'VIDEO', 'CANVAS'];
    52→  const interactiveRoles = ['button', 'slider', 'textbox', 'link', 'scrollbar'];
    53→  
    54→  let current: HTMLElement | null = el;
    55→  while (current) {
    56→    if (interactiveTags.includes(current.tagName)) {
    57→      return true;
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    const role = current.getAttribute('role');
    61→    if (role && interactiveRoles.includes(role)) {
    62→      return true;
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    if (current.getAttribute('data-no-swipe') === 'true') {
    66→      return true;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scrollable') === 'true') {
    70→      return true;
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    const style = window.getComputedStyle(current);
    74→    if (
    75→      (style.overflowY === 'scroll' || style.overflowY === 'auto') &&
    76→      current.scrollHeight > current.clientHeight
    77→    ) {
    78→      return true;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (current.tagName === 'CANVAS') {
    82→      return true;
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scroll-area-viewport')) {
    86→      return true;
    87→    }
    88→
    89→    current = current.parentElement;
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  return false;
    93→}
    94→
    95→export function useSwipeNavigation({
    96→  onSwipeLeft,
    97→  onSwipeRight,
    98→  disabled = false,
    99→  threshold = 50,
   100→  velocityThreshold = 0.3,
   101→  hasNext = true,
   102→  hasPrevious = true,
   103→  maxElasticOffset = 80,
   104→}: UseSwipeNavigationProps): UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
   105→  const [swipeOffset, setSwipeOffset] = useState(0);
   106→  const [isSwiping, setIsSwiping] = useState(false);
   107→  const swipeStateRef = useRef<SwipeState | null>(null);
   108→
   109→  const applyElasticResistance = useCallback((deltaX: number): number => {
   110→    if (deltaX > 0 && !hasPrevious) {
   111→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    if (deltaX < 0 && !hasNext) {
   115→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    const maxNormalOffset = 150;
   119→    if (Math.abs(deltaX) > maxNormalOffset) {
   120→      const excess = Math.abs(deltaX) - maxNormalOffset;
   121→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * (maxNormalOffset + excess * 0.2);
   122→    }
   123→    
   124→    return deltaX;
   125→  }, [hasNext, hasPrevious, maxElasticOffset]);
   126→  
   127→  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   128→    if (disabled) return;
   129→    if (!e.isPrimary) return;
   130→
   131→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   132→    if (isInteractiveElement(target)) {
   133→      return;
   134→    }
   135→    
   136→    swipeStateRef.current = {
   137→      startX: e.clientX,
   138→      startY: e.clientY,
   139→      startTime: Date.now(),
   140→      currentX: e.clientX,
   141→      pointerId: e.pointerId,
   142→      isLocked: false,
   143→      isHorizontal: null,
   144→    };
   145→
   146→    try {
   147→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   148→    } catch {
   149→    }
   150→  }, [disabled]);
   151→  
   152→  const handlePointerMove = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   153→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   154→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   155→    
   156→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   157→    const deltaY = e.clientY - state.startY;
   158→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   159→    const absDeltaY = Math.abs(deltaY);
   160→
   161→    if (!state.isLocked && (absDeltaX > 10 || absDeltaY > 10)) {
   162→      state.isHorizontal = absDeltaX > absDeltaY * 0.8;
   163→      state.isLocked = true;
   164→
   165→      if (!state.isHorizontal) {
   166→        swipeStateRef.current = null;
   167→        setSwipeOffset(0);
   168→        setIsSwiping(false);
   169→        try {
   170→          (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   171→        } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   172→        return;
   173→      }
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   177→      e.preventDefault();
   178→      state.currentX = e.clientX;
   179→      const resistedOffset = applyElasticResistance(deltaX);
   180→      setSwipeOffset(resistedOffset);
   181→      setIsSwiping(true);
   182→    }
   183→  }, [applyElasticResistance]);
   184→  
   185→  const handlePointerUp = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   186→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   187→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   188→    
   189→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   190→    const duration = Math.max(Date.now() - state.startTime, 1);
   191→    const velocity = Math.abs(deltaX) / duration;
   192→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   193→
   194→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   195→      const metDistanceThreshold = absDeltaX >= threshold;
   196→      const metVelocityThreshold = velocity >= velocityThreshold && absDeltaX > 20;

   198→      if (metDistanceThreshold || metVelocityThreshold) {

   200→          onSwipeLeft?.();
   201→        } else if (deltaX > 0 && hasPrevious) {
   202→          onSwipeRight?.();
   203→        }
   204→      }
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    try {
   208→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   209→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   210→
   211→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   212→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   213→    setIsSwiping(false);
   214→  }, [threshold, velocityThreshold, hasNext, hasPrevious, onSwipeLeft, onSwipeRight]);
   215→  
   216→  const handlePointerCancel = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   217→    try {
   218→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   219→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   220→
   221→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   222→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   223→    setIsSwiping(false);
   224→  }, []);
   225→  
   226→  return {
   227→    swipeHandlers: {
   228→      onPointerDown: handlePointerDown,
   229→      onPointerMove: handlePointerMove,
   230→      onPointerUp: handlePointerUp,
   231→      onPointerCancel: handlePointerCancel,
   232→    },
   233→    swipeOffset,
   234→    isSwiping,
   235→  };
   236→}
```

```
    86→/**
    87→ * Unified edit settings persistence hook
    88→ *
    89→ * Coordinates:
    90→ * 1. Per-generation settings (generations.params.ui.editSettings)
    91→ * 2. "Last used" settings (useToolSettings + localStorage)
    92→ *
    93→ * Loading behavior:
    94→ * - If generation has persisted settings → use those (including prompt)
    95→ * - If no persisted settings → use "last used" (prompt = '')
    96→ *
    97→ * Saving behavior:
    98→ * - All changes save to generation
    99→ * - Non-prompt changes also update "last used"
   100→ */
   101→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   102→  generationId,
   103→  projectId,
   104→  enabled = true,
   105→}: UseEditSettingsPersistenceProps): UseEditSettingsPersistenceReturn {
   106→  // Per-generation settings
   107→  const generationSettings = useGenerationEditSettings({
   108→    generationId,
   109→    enabled,
   110→  });
   111→
   112→  // "Last used" settings
   113→  const lastUsedSettings = useLastUsedEditSettings({
   114→    projectId,
   115→    enabled,
   116→  });
   117→
   118→  // Track initialization state
   119→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
   120→  const lastGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   121→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
   122→
   123→  // Reset initialization on generation change
   124→  useEffect(() => {
   125→    if (generationId !== lastGenerationIdRef.current) {
   126→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
   127→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;
   128→      setIsReady(false);
   129→    }
   130→  }, [generationId]);
   131→
   132→  // Extract stable references for the initialization effect
   133→  const { isLoading: genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed } = generationSettings;
   134→  const { lastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   135→
   136→  // Initialize from "last used" when generation loads without persisted settings
   137→  useEffect(() => {
   138→    if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && !hasPersistedSettings && generationId) {
   139→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   140→      // Apply "last used" settings (without prompt)
   141→      initializeFromLastUsed(lastUsed);
   142→      setIsReady(true);
   143→    } else if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && hasPersistedSettings) {
   144→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   145→      setIsReady(true);
   146→    }
   147→  }, [generationId, genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed, lastUsed]);
   148→
   149→  // Compute effective values
   150→  // editMode is ALWAYS from lastUsed (user-level, not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   151→  // Other settings like prompt, loraMode are per-generation
   152→  const effectiveSettings = useMemo(() => {
   153→    if (generationSettings.isLoading) {
   154→      // Still loading, use defaults but editMode from lastUsed
   155→      return {
   156→        ...DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS,
   157→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   158→      };
   159→    }
   160→
   161→    if (generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings) {
   162→      // Has persisted settings, use them BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   163→      return {
   164→        ...generationSettings.settings,
   165→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   166→      };
   167→    }
   168→
   169→    // No persisted settings yet.
   170→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   171→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   172→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   173→    if (!isReady) {
   174→      return {
   175→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   176→        loraMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.loraMode,
   177→        customLoraUrl: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.customLoraUrl,
   178→        numGenerations: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.numGenerations,
   179→        prompt: generationSettings.settings.prompt || '',
   180→        img2imgPrompt: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPrompt || '',
   181→        img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet || false,
   182→        img2imgStrength: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgStrength,
   183→        img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   184→        advancedSettings: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   185→        enhanceSettings: generationSettings.settings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   186→        qwenEditModel: generationSettings.settings.qwenEditModel ?? DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS.qwenEditModel,
   187→        createAsGeneration: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.createAsGeneration,
   188→      };
   189→    }
   190→
   191→    // Initialized: use the live per-generation state BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   192→    return {
   193→      ...generationSettings.settings,
   194→      editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   195→    };
   196→  }, [
   197→    isReady,
   198→    generationSettings.isLoading,
   199→    generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   200→    generationSettings.settings,
   201→    lastUsedSettings.lastUsed,
   202→  ]);
   203→
   204→  // Extract stable function references to avoid recreating callbacks on every render
   205→  // (the parent objects are recreated each render, but these functions are stable)
   206→  const { updateLastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   207→  const {
   208→    setLoraMode: genSetLoraMode,
   209→    setCustomLoraUrl: genSetCustomLoraUrl,
   210→    setNumGenerations: genSetNumGenerations,
   211→    setPrompt: genSetPrompt,
   212→    setQwenEditModel: genSetQwenEditModel,
   213→    setImg2imgPrompt: genSetImg2imgPrompt,
   214→    setImg2imgStrength: genSetImg2imgStrength,
   215→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   216→    setAdvancedSettings: genSetAdvancedSettings,
   217→    setEnhanceSettings: genSetEnhanceSettings,
   218→    setCreateAsGeneration: genSetCreateAsGeneration,
   219→  } = generationSettings;
   220→
   221→  // Wrapper setters that also update "last used" (except prompt)
   222→  // editMode is user-level only (not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   223→  const setEditMode = useCallback((mode: EditMode) => {
   224→    updateLastUsed({ editMode: mode });
   225→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   226→
   227→  const setLoraMode = useCallback((mode: LoraMode) => {
   228→    genSetLoraMode(mode);
   229→    updateLastUsed({ loraMode: mode });
   230→  }, [genSetLoraMode, updateLastUsed]);
   231→
   232→  const setCustomLoraUrl = useCallback((url: string) => {
   233→    genSetCustomLoraUrl(url);
   234→    updateLastUsed({ customLoraUrl: url });
   235→  }, [genSetCustomLoraUrl, updateLastUsed]);
   236→
   237→  const setNumGenerations = useCallback((num: number) => {
   238→    genSetNumGenerations(num);
   239→    updateLastUsed({ numGenerations: num });
   240→  }, [genSetNumGenerations, updateLastUsed]);
   241→
   242→  // Prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   243→  const setPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   244→    genSetPrompt(prompt);
   245→  }, [genSetPrompt]);
   246→
   247→  // Model selection (saves to generation, cloud mode only)
   248→  const setQwenEditModel = useCallback((model: QwenEditModel) => {
   249→    genSetQwenEditModel(model);
   250→  }, [genSetQwenEditModel]);
   251→
   252→  // Img2Img prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   253→  const setImg2imgPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   254→    genSetImg2imgPrompt(prompt);
   255→  }, [genSetImg2imgPrompt]);
   256→
   257→  // Img2Img setters (save to both generation and "last used")
   258→  const setImg2imgStrength = useCallback((strength: number) => {
   259→    genSetImg2imgStrength(strength);
   260→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgStrength: strength });
   261→  }, [genSetImg2imgStrength, updateLastUsed]);
   262→
   263→  const setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
   264→    genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion(enabled);
   265→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: enabled });
   266→  }, [genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion, updateLastUsed]);
   267→
   268→  // Advanced settings setter (merges with existing, saves to both generation and "last used")
   269→  const setAdvancedSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<EditAdvancedSettings>) => {
   270→    genSetAdvancedSettings(updates);
   271→    // Merge updates with current advancedSettings for lastUsed
   272→    const currentAdvanced = effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS;
   273→    updateLastUsed({ advancedSettings: { ...currentAdvanced, ...updates } });
   274→  }, [genSetAdvancedSettings, updateLastUsed, effectiveSettings.advancedSettings]);
   275→
   276→  // Video enhance settings setter (per-generation only, not "last used")
   277→  const setEnhanceSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => {
   278→    genSetEnhanceSettings(updates);
   279→  }, [genSetEnhanceSettings]);
   280→
   281→  // Generation options setter (saves to both generation and "last used")
   282→  const setCreateAsGeneration = useCallback((value: boolean) => {
   283→    genSetCreateAsGeneration(value);
   284→    updateLastUsed({ createAsGeneration: value });
   285→  }, [genSetCreateAsGeneration, updateLastUsed]);
   286→
   287→  // Video/Panel mode setters (only save to "last used", not per-generation)
   288→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: VideoEditSubMode) => {
   289→    updateLastUsed({ videoEditSubMode: mode });
   290→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   291→
   292→  const setPanelMode = useCallback((mode: PanelMode) => {

   294→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   295→
   296→  // Computed LoRAs based on mode (replaces useEditModeLoras logic)
   297→  const loraMode = effectiveSettings.loraMode;

   299→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {

   301→    switch (loraMode) {

   304→      case 'next-scene':

   306→      case 'custom':

   327→    numGenerations: effectiveSettings.numGenerations,
   328→    prompt: effectiveSettings.prompt,
```

```
1→/**
```

```
     4→ *
     5→ * This module provides hooks for querying generations at the PROJECT level.
     6→ * Mutations live in `useGenerationMutations.ts` (re-exported here for compatibility).
     7→ *
     8→ * ## When to Use
     9→ * - Displaying a gallery of generations across the project (GenerationsPane, MediaGallery)
    10→ * - Filtering by tool type, media type, starred, search term
    11→ * - Fetching derived items (edits based on a generation)
    12→ *
    13→ * ## When NOT to Use
    14→ * - Querying images within a specific shot → use `useShotImages.ts` instead
    15→ * - Timeline-specific data (frame positions, pair prompts) → use `useShotImages.ts`
    16→ * - Page-level state management (filters, pagination) → use `useGalleryPageState.ts`
    17→ * - Mutations (create, delete, star) → import from `useGenerationMutations.ts` directly
    18→ *
    19→ * ## Key Exports
    20→ * - `useProjectGenerations(projectId, page, limit, filters)` - Paginated gallery data
    21→ * - `fetchGenerations(projectId, limit, offset, filters)` - Direct fetch function
    22→ * - `GenerationsPaginatedResponse` - Response type
    23→ *

    31→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    32→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

    37→import { SHOT_FILTER } from '@/shared/constants/filterConstants';
    38→import { TOOL_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    39→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
    40→
    41→/** Cache garbage collection time for paginated generation queries */
    42→const GENERATIONS_GC_TIME_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 minutes
    43→
    44→type AnyPostgrestFilterBuilder = PostgrestFilterBuilder<unknown, unknown, unknown, unknown, unknown>;
    45→
    46→/** Common filter options for generation queries */
    47→interface GenerationBaseFilters {
    48→  toolType?: string;
    49→  mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
    50→  shotId?: string;
    51→  excludePositioned?: boolean;
    52→  starredOnly?: boolean;
    53→  searchTerm?: string;
    54→  editsOnly?: boolean;
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Apply common filters to a generations query.
    59→ * Used by both count and data queries to ensure consistency.
    60→ */
    61→// TODO: type properly - PostgrestFilterBuilder generics are complex Supabase internals
    62→function applyGenerationFilters<T extends AnyPostgrestFilterBuilder>(
    63→  query: T,
    64→  filters: GenerationBaseFilters | undefined
    65→): T {
    66→  if (!filters) return query;
    67→
    68→  // Tool type filter (skip when shot filter is active - shot filter takes precedence)
    69→  if (filters.toolType && !filters.shotId) {
    70→    if (filters.toolType === TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) {
    71→      query = query.eq('params->>tool_type', TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) as T;
    72→    } else {
    73→      query = query.or(`params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType},params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType}-reconstructed-client`) as T;
    74→    }
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  // Media type filter
    78→  if (filters.mediaType && filters.mediaType !== 'all') {
    79→    if (filters.mediaType === 'video') {
    80→      query = query.like('type', '%video%') as T;
    81→    } else if (filters.mediaType === 'image') {
    82→      query = query.not('type', 'like', '%video%') as T;
    83→    }
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  // Starred filter
    87→  if (filters.starredOnly) {
    88→    query = query.eq('starred', true) as T;
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  // Edits only filter (generations derived from another)
    92→  if (filters.editsOnly) {
    93→    query = query.not('based_on', 'is', null) as T;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  // Search filter
    97→  if (filters.searchTerm?.trim()) {
    98→    const searchPattern = `%${filters.searchTerm.trim()}%`;
    99→    query = query.ilike('params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>prompt', searchPattern) as T;
   100→  }
   101→
   102→  // Shot filter
   103→  if (filters.shotId === SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT) {
   104→    query = query.or('shot_data.is.null,shot_data.eq.{}') as T;
   105→  } else if (filters.shotId) {
   106→    query = query.not(`shot_data->${filters.shotId}`, 'is', null) as T;
   107→    if (filters.excludePositioned) {
   108→      query = query.or(`shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.null,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.-1,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[null],shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[-1]`) as T;
   109→    }

   112→  return query;

   115→/**
   116→ * Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table for a project
   117→ * Filters by tool_type in params (set by complete_task)
   118→ * 
   119→ * NOTE: Requires the project_id column on generation_variants (added via migration)
   120→ * The column is auto-populated by a trigger from the parent generation
   121→ */
   122→async function fetchEditVariants(
   123→  projectId: string,
   124→  limit: number,
   125→  offset: number,
   126→  filters?: {
   127→    toolType?: string;
   128→    mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
   129→    sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   130→    parentsOnly?: boolean; // Exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id in params)
   131→  }
   132→): Promise<{
   133→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   134→  total: number;
   135→  hasMore: boolean;
   136→}> {
   137→  const toolType = filters?.toolType;
   138→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   139→  const mediaType = filters?.mediaType || 'all';
   140→  const parentsOnly = filters?.parentsOnly ?? true;
   141→
   142→  // Build count query
   143→  let countQuery = supabase().from('generation_variants')
   144→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   145→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   146→  
   147→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   148→  if (toolType) {
   149→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   150→  }
   151→  
   152→  // Filter by media type - variants don't have a type column, so filter by URL extension
   153→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   154→    countQuery = countQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   155→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   156→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   157→  }
   158→  
   159→  // Exclude child variants (those created from another variant)
   160→  if (parentsOnly) {
   161→    countQuery = countQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   162→  }
   163→
   164→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   165→
   166→  if (countError) {
   167→    throw countError;
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   171→
   172→  if (totalCount === 0) {
   173→    return { items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false };
   174→  }
   175→
   176→  // Data query with pagination
   177→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   178→  let dataQuery = supabase().from('generation_variants')
   179→    .select(`
   180→      id,
   181→      generation_id,
   182→      location,
   183→      thumbnail_url,
   184→      params,
   185→      variant_type,
   186→      name,
   187→      created_at
   188→    `)
   189→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   190→  
   191→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   192→  if (toolType) {
   193→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   194→  }
   195→  
   196→  // Filter by media type in data query too
   197→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   198→    dataQuery = dataQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   199→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   200→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   201→  }
   202→  
   203→  // Exclude child variants in data query too
   204→  if (parentsOnly) {
   205→    dataQuery = dataQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   206→  }
   207→  
   208→  dataQuery = dataQuery
   209→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   210→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   211→
   212→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery;
   213→
   214→  if (error) {
   215→    throw error;
   216→  }
   217→
   218→  // Transform variants using shared transformer
   219→  const items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[] = (data || []).map((variant) =>
   220→    transformVariant(variant as unknown as RawVariant, { toolType })
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  return {
   224→    items,
   225→    total: totalCount,
   226→    hasMore: offset + items.length < totalCount,
   227→  };
   228→}
   229→
   230→export type GenerationFilters = GenerationBaseFilters & {
   231→  includeChildren?: boolean;
   232→  parentGenerationId?: string;
   233→  sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   234→  editsOnly?: boolean; // Filter for images with based_on set (derived/edited images)
   235→  parentsOnly?: boolean; // For variants: exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id)
   236→  variantsOnly?: boolean; // Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table
   237→};
   238→
   239→async function fetchGenerationsForProject(
   240→  projectId: string,
   241→  limit: number = 100,
   242→  offset: number = 0,
   243→  filters?: GenerationFilters
   244→): Promise<{
   245→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   246→  total: number;
   247→  hasMore: boolean;
   248→}> {
   249→  // Special path for variantsOnly - fetch from generation_variants table
   250→  if (filters?.variantsOnly) {
   251→    return fetchEditVariants(projectId, limit, offset, {
   252→      toolType: filters.toolType,
   253→      mediaType: filters.mediaType,
   254→      sort: filters.sort,
   255→      parentsOnly: filters.parentsOnly ?? true, // Default to parents only
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  // Build count query
   260→  let countQuery = supabase().from('generations')
   261→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   262→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   263→  
   264→  // Only include generations with valid output URLs - UNLESS fetching children of a specific parent
   265→  // (children may still be processing and need to show as placeholders)
   266→  if (!filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   267→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  // Parent/Child filtering (count query specific)
   271→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   272→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   273→  } else if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   274→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   275→  }
   276→
   277→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   278→  countQuery = applyGenerationFilters(countQuery, filters);
   279→
   280→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   281→  if (countError) {
   282→    throw countError;
   283→  }
   284→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   285→
   286→  // Select only the fields needed for the gallery view
   287→  let dataQuery = supabase().from('generations')
   288→    .select(`
   289→      id,
   290→      location,
   291→      thumbnail_url,
   292→      type,
   293→      created_at,
   294→      updated_at,
   295→      params,
   296→      starred,
   297→      tasks,
   298→      based_on,
   299→      shot_data,
   300→      name,
   301→      is_child,
   302→      parent_generation_id,
   303→      child_order
   304→    `)
   305→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   306→
   307→  // Parent/Child filtering - apply BEFORE location filter since parentGenerationId affects whether we filter by location
   308→  // Parent/Child filtering (data query specific - has ordering)
   309→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   310→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   311→    dataQuery = dataQuery.order('child_order', { ascending: true });
   312→  } else {
   313→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   314→    if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   315→      dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   320→  dataQuery = applyGenerationFilters(dataQuery, filters);
   321→
   322→
   323→  // Determine sort order
   324→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   325→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   326→
   327→  // Execute query with standard server-side pagination
   328→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery
   329→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   330→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   331→
   332→  if (error) {
   333→    throw error;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  if (!data) {
   337→    return { items: [], total: totalCount, hasMore: false };
   338→  }
   339→
   340→
   341→  const finalData = data || [];
   342→  const hasMore = (offset + limit) < totalCount;
   343→
   344→  // Badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount) is now loaded
   345→  // lazily via useVariantBadges hook to avoid blocking gallery display
   346→
   347→  // Use shared transformer instead of inline transformation logic
   348→  const items = finalData?.map((item) => {
   349→    // Transform using shared function - handles all the complex logic
   350→    return transformGeneration(item as unknown as RawGeneration, {
   351→      shotId: filters?.shotId,
   352→    });
   353→  }) || [];
   354→
   355→  return { items, total: totalCount, hasMore };
   356→}
   357→
   358→export function fetchGenerations(
   359→  projectId: string | null,
   360→  limit: number = 100,
   361→  offset: number = 0,
   362→  filters?: GenerationFilters
   363→): Promise<{
   364→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   365→  total: number;
   366→  hasMore: boolean;
   367→}> {
   368→  if (!projectId) {
   369→    return Promise.resolve({ items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false });
   370→  }
   371→  return fetchGenerationsForProject(projectId, limit, offset, filters);
   372→}
   373→
   374→
   375→export type GenerationsPaginatedResponse = {
   376→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   377→  total: number;
   378→  hasMore: boolean;
   379→};
   380→
   381→export function useProjectGenerations(
   382→  projectId: string | null,
   383→  page: number = 1,
   384→  limit: number = 100,
   385→  enabled: boolean = true,
   386→  filters?: GenerationFilters,
   387→  options?: {
   388→    disablePolling?: boolean; // Disable smart polling (useful for long-running tasks)
   389→  }
   390→) {
   391→  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
   392→  const effectiveProjectId = projectId ?? getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
   393→  const filtersKey = filters ? JSON.stringify(filters) : null;
   394→  const [REDACTED](
   395→    effectiveProjectId ?? '__no-project__',
   396→    page,
   397→    limit,
   398→    filtersKey
   399→  );
   400→
   401→
   402→  // Use DataFreshnessManager for intelligent polling decisions.
   403→  // Can be disabled for tools with long-running tasks to prevent gallery flicker.
   404→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(['generations', effectiveProjectId ?? '__no-project__']);
   405→  const pollingDisabled = Boolean(options?.disablePolling);
   406→  const pollingConfig: { refetchInterval: number | false; staleTime: number } = pollingDisabled
   407→    ? { refetchInterval: false, staleTime: Infinity }
   408→    : smartPollingConfig;
   409→
   410→  const result = useQuery<GenerationsPaginatedResponse, Error>({
   411→    queryKey: queryKey,
   412→    queryFn: () => fetchGenerationsForProject(effectiveProjectId!, limit, offset, filters),
   413→    enabled: !!effectiveProjectId && enabled,
   414→    // Use `placeholderData` with `keepPreviousData` to prevent UI flashes on pagination/filter changes
   415→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   416→    // Cache management to prevent memory leaks as pagination grows
   417→    gcTime: GENERATIONS_GC_TIME_MS,
   418→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   419→
   420→    // Intelligent polling based on realtime health (or disabled)
   421→    ...pollingConfig,
   422→    refetchIntervalInBackground: !pollingDisabled, // Only poll in background if polling is enabled
   423→    refetchOnReconnect: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   424→  });
   425→
   426→  return result;
   427→}
   428→
   429→// ===== MUTATIONS =====
   430→// These hooks live in useGenerationMutations.ts — import directly from there.
   431→
```

```
1→import { useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { debugChannelEnabled, debugLog, debugWarn } from './debugConsole';
     3→
     4→const LOOP_DETECT_THRESHOLD = 15;
     5→const LOOP_DETECT_WINDOW_MS = 1000;
     6→
     7→// Dev-only render-rate tracker and loop detector.
     8→export function useRenderLogger(label: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
     9→  const countRef = useRef(0);
    10→  const windowTimestampsRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
    11→
    12→  if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
    13→    countRef.current++;
    14→    const now = Date.now();
    15→    windowTimestampsRef.current.push(now);
    16→
    17→    const cutoff = now - LOOP_DETECT_WINDOW_MS;
    18→    let i = 0;
    19→    while (i < windowTimestampsRef.current.length && windowTimestampsRef.current[i] < cutoff) {
    20→      i++;
    21→    }
    22→    if (i > 0) windowTimestampsRef.current.splice(0, i);
    23→
    24→    const recentCount = windowTimestampsRef.current.length;
    25→    const total = countRef.current;
    26→
    27→    if (recentCount >= LOOP_DETECT_THRESHOLD) {
    28→      debugWarn(
    29→        'render',
    30→        `[RenderLoop] ${label} — ${recentCount} renders in ${LOOP_DETECT_WINDOW_MS}ms (total: ${total})`,
    31→        data,
    32→      );
    33→    }
    34→  }
    35→}
    36→
    37→// Dev-only dep-change tracker.
    38→export function useChangedDepsLogger(
    39→  label: string,
    40→  deps: Record<string, unknown>,
    41→  force = false,
    42→): void {
    43→  const prevRef = useRef<Record<string, unknown>>({});
    44→
    45→  if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
    46→    if (force || debugChannelEnabled('render')) {
    47→      const changed: Record<string, { from: unknown; to: unknown }> = {};
    48→      for (const key of Object.keys(deps)) {
    49→        if (!Object.is(deps[key], prevRef.current[key])) {
    50→          changed[key] = { from: prevRef.current[key], to: deps[key] };
    51→        }
    52→      }
    53→      if (Object.keys(changed).length > 0) {
    54→        debugLog('render', `[DepsChanged] ${label}`, changed, force);
    55→      }
    56→    }
    57→    prevRef.current = deps;
    58→  }
    59→}
    60→
```
