```
1→/**
     2→ * NetworkStatusManager - Centralized network status management
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides a single source of truth for online/offline status and connection type.
     5→ * Integrates with reconnect and polling flows for network-aware behavior.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     9→import type { NavigatorWithDeviceInfo } from '@/types/browser-extensions';
    10→
    11→interface NetworkStatus {
    12→  isOnline: boolean;
    13→  effectiveType?: '2g' | '3g' | '4g' | 'slow-2g';
    14→  lastTransitionAt: number;
    15→  previousOnlineStatus: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→type NetworkEventType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'connection-change';
    19→
    20→interface NetworkStatusSubscriber {
    21→  (status: NetworkStatus, eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export class NetworkStatusManager {
    25→  private status: NetworkStatus;
    26→  private subscribers: Set<NetworkStatusSubscriber> = new Set();
    27→  private initialized = false;
    28→
    29→  constructor() {
    30→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    31→    this.status = {
    32→      isOnline: navigator.onLine,
    33→      effectiveType: nav.connection?.effectiveType,
    34→      lastTransitionAt: Date.now(),
    35→      previousOnlineStatus: navigator.onLine,
    36→    };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  initialize(): void {
    40→    if (this.initialized) return;
    41→
    42→    const handleOnline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('online', event);
    43→    const handleOffline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('offline', event);
    44→    const handleConnectionChange = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('connection-change', event);
    45→
    46→    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    47→    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    48→
    49→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    50→    if (nav.connection) {
    51→      nav.connection.addEventListener('change', handleConnectionChange);
    52→    }
    53→
    54→    this.initialized = true;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  getStatus(): NetworkStatus {
    58→    return { ...this.status };
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  subscribe(callback: NetworkStatusSubscriber): () => void {
    62→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
    63→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  isSlowConnection(): boolean {
    67→    return this.status.effectiveType === '2g' || this.status.effectiveType === 'slow-2g';
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  getRecommendedIntervals(): { fast: number; normal: number; slow: number } {
    71→    if (!this.status.isOnline) {
    72→      return { fast: 60000, normal: 120000, slow: 300000 };
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (this.isSlowConnection()) {
    76→      return { fast: 30000, normal: 60000, slow: 180000 };
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    return { fast: 10000, normal: 30000, slow: 60000 };
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  private handleNetworkChange(eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void {
    83→    const now = Date.now();
    84→    const newIsOnline = navigator.onLine;
    85→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    86→    const newEffectiveType = nav.connection?.effectiveType;
    87→
    88→    const onlineStatusChanged = newIsOnline !== this.status.isOnline;
    89→    const connectionChanged = newEffectiveType !== this.status.effectiveType;
    90→
    91→    if (!onlineStatusChanged && !connectionChanged) {
    92→      return;
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    const previousStatus = { ...this.status };
    96→    this.status = {
    97→      isOnline: newIsOnline,
    98→      effectiveType: newEffectiveType,
    99→      lastTransitionAt: now,
   100→      previousOnlineStatus: previousStatus.isOnline,
   101→    };
   102→
   103→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   104→      try {
   105→        callback(this.status, eventType, event);
   106→      } catch (error) {
   107→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'NetworkStatusManager', showToast: false });
   108→      }
   109→    });
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→let networkStatusManager: NetworkStatusManager;
   114→
   115→export function getNetworkStatusManager(): NetworkStatusManager {
   116→  if (!networkStatusManager) {
   117→    networkStatusManager = new NetworkStatusManager();
   118→    networkStatusManager.initialize();
   119→
   120→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   121→      void import('@/shared/services/network/networkStatusDebug').then(({ installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers }) => {
   122→        installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers(networkStatusManager);
   123→      });
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  return networkStatusManager;
   128→}
```

```
1→import { debugConfig } from '@/shared/lib/debug/debugConfig';
     2→import type { TrackableImage, TrackerLimits } from './types';
     3→
     4→const getTrackerConfig = (): TrackerLimits => {
     5→  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
     6→  const hasLowMemory =
     7→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
     8→    'deviceMemory' in navigator &&
     9→    (navigator as { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory !== undefined &&
    10→    (navigator as { deviceMemory: number }).deviceMemory <= 4;
    11→
    12→  if (isMobile || hasLowMemory) {
    13→    return { maxImages: 100, maxUrls: 150 };
    14→  }
    15→  return { maxImages: 300, maxUrls: 500 };
    16→};
    17→
    18→const loadedImagesById = new Map<string, boolean>();
    19→
    20→const loadedImagesByUrl = new Map<
    21→  string,
    22→  { loadedAt: number; width?: number; height?: number; element?: HTMLImageElement }
    23→>();
    24→
    25→const shouldLogTrackerDebug = (): boolean =>
    26→  import.meta.env.DEV && debugConfig.isEnabled('imageLoading');
    27→
    28→/**
    29→ * Evict oldest entries from a Map until it's under the limit.
    30→ * Maps maintain insertion order, so we delete from the beginning.
    31→ */
    32→const evictOldestEntries = <K, V>(
    33→  map: Map<K, V>,
    34→  maxSize: number,
    35→  name: string
    36→): number => {
    37→  if (map.size <= maxSize) return 0;
    38→
    39→  const toEvict = map.size - maxSize;
    40→  const keys = Array.from(map.keys()).slice(0, toEvict);
    41→
    42→  keys.forEach((key) => map.delete(key));
    43→
    44→  if (shouldLogTrackerDebug()) {
    45→    console.log(
    46→      `[ImageLoadTracker] Evicted ${toEvict} oldest entries from ${name}, new size: ${map.size}`
    47→    );
    48→  }
    49→  return toEvict;
    50→};
    51→
    52→const enforceLoadTrackerLimits = (): void => {
    53→  const config = getTrackerConfig();
    54→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesById, config.maxImages, 'loadedImagesById');
    55→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesByUrl, config.maxUrls, 'loadedImagesByUrl');
    56→};
    57→
    58→export const setImageLoadStatus = (
    59→  image: TrackableImage,
    60→  isLoaded: boolean = true
    61→): void => {
    62→  const imageId = image.id;
    63→  if (!imageId) {
    64→    return;
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  // Update tracker
    68→  loadedImagesById.set(imageId, isLoaded);
    69→
    70→  // Keep legacy field in sync while older call sites are still present.
    71→  image.__memoryCached = isLoaded;
    72→
    73→  // Enforce limits in coarse batches to avoid per-write overhead.
    74→  if (isLoaded && loadedImagesById.size % 50 === 0) {
    75→    enforceLoadTrackerLimits();
    76→  }
    77→};
    78→
    79→const removeLoadedImages = (imageIds: string[]): number => {
    80→  let removedCount = 0;
    81→
    82→  imageIds.forEach((imageId) => {
    83→    if (loadedImagesById.has(imageId)) {
    84→      loadedImagesById.delete(imageId);
    85→      removedCount++;
    86→    }
    87→  });
    88→
    89→  return removedCount;
    90→};
    91→
    92→export const clearLoadedImages = (images: Array<{ id: string }>): number => {
    93→  const imageIds = images.map((img) => img.id).filter((id) => id);
    94→
    95→  return removeLoadedImages(imageIds);
    96→};
    97→
    98→export const clearAllLoadedImages = (
    99→  reason: string = 'project switch'
   100→): number => {

   102→  loadedImagesById.clear();

   104→
   105→  if (shouldLogTrackerDebug()) {

   112→

   114→  if (typeof urlOrImage === 'string') {

   117→
   118→  const imageId = urlOrImage?.id;
   119→  if (!imageId) {
```

```
    26→    // Auth operations (supabase.auth.*) are unaffected.

    52→    const dataFetch = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
```

```
    23→    },
    24→  }, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth }) => {
    25→    if (!auth || (!auth.userId && !auth.isServiceRole)) {
    26→      logger.error("Authentication failed");
    27→      return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
    28→    }

    30→    const taskId = typeof body.task_id === 'string' || typeof body.task_id === 'number'

    32→      : '';

    34→      logger.error("Missing task_id");
    35→      return jsonResponse({ error: "task_id is required" }, 400);
    36→    }
    37→
    38→    logger.setDefaultTaskId(taskId);
    39→
    40→    const actor = await authorizeTaskActor({
    41→      supabaseAdmin,
    42→      taskId,
    43→      auth: auth!,
    44→      logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-STATUS]",
    45→    });
    46→    if (!actor.ok) {
    47→      logger.error("Task access denied", {
    48→        task_id: taskId,
    49→        error: actor.error,
    50→        status_code: actor.statusCode,
    51→      });
    52→      return jsonResponse({ error: actor.error }, actor.statusCode);
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    const { data: task, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
    56→      .from("tasks")
    57→      .select("id, status")
    58→      .eq("id", taskId)

    64→    }
    65→
```

```
1→import { __WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__, __CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__ } from '@/integrations/supabase/config/env';
     2→import { captureRealtimeSnapshot } from '@/integrations/supabase/utils/snapshot';
     3→import { __CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__, addCorruptionEvent } from '@/integrations/supabase/utils/timeline';
     4→import { normalizeAndLogError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorReporting';
     5→import {
     6→  collectUnhandledRejectionInfo,
     7→  collectWindowErrorInfo,
     8→  isKnownSupabaseSourceLine,
     9→  isSupabaseRealtimeRelated,
    10→  parsePhoenixMessage,
    11→} from './eventCollectors';
    12→import {
    13→  installGlobalErrorPatchers,
    14→  installWebSocketProbe,
    15→  type InstrumentedWindow,
    16→} from './globalPatchers';
    17→
    18→function installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    19→  installGlobalErrorPatchers({
    20→    instrumentedWindow,
    21→    onWindowError: (message, source, lineno, colno, error) => {
    22→      const errorInfo = collectWindowErrorInfo({
    23→        message,
    24→        source,
    25→        lineno,
    26→        colno,
    27→        error: error ?? null,
    28→      });
    29→
    30→      if (isKnownSupabaseSourceLine(source, lineno)) {
    31→        normalizeAndLogError(new Error('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] Supabase error captured'), {
    32→          context: 'WindowInstrumentation',
    33→                    logData: {
    34→            ...errorInfo,
    35→            realtimeSnapshot: captureRealtimeSnapshot(),
    36→            corruptionTimeline: [...__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__],
    37→          },
    38→        });
    39→        addCorruptionEvent('SUPABASE_ERROR_2372', errorInfo);
    40→      } else if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(message)) {
    41→        addCorruptionEvent('RELATED_ERROR', errorInfo);
    42→      }
    43→    },
    44→    onUnhandledRejection: (event) => {
    45→      const rejectionInfo = collectUnhandledRejectionInfo(event);
    46→      if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(event.reason)) {
    47→        addCorruptionEvent('UNHANDLED_REJECTION', rejectionInfo);
    48→      }
    49→    },
    50→  });
    51→}
    52→
    53→function installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    54→  installWebSocketProbe({
    55→    instrumentedWindow,
    56→    onTrackedSocketMessage: ({ event }) => {
    57→      try {
    58→        const parsed = parsePhoenixMessage(event.data);
    59→        if (parsed) {
    60→          addCorruptionEvent('PHOENIX_MESSAGE', parsed);
    61→        }
    62→
    63→        const snapshot = instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ || {};
    64→        instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ = {
    65→          ...snapshot,
    66→          lastPhoenixMsgAt: Date.now(),
    67→        };
    68→      } catch {
    69→        // Ignore instrumentation parse failures so realtime flow remains unaffected.
    70→      }
    71→    },
    72→  });
    73→}
    74→
    75→export function installWindowOnlyInstrumentation() {
    76→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    77→    return;
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  const instrumentedWindow = window as InstrumentedWindow;
    81→
    82→  if (__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__) {
    83→    installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow);
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  if (__WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__) {
    87→    installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow);
    88→  }
    89→}
    90→
```

```
    24→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {

    26→    preferences: autoTopupPreferences,

    29→  } = useAutoTopup();
    30→
    31→  const [purchaseAmount, setPurchaseAmount] = useState(initialPurchaseAmount);
    32→  const [localAutoTopupEnabled, setLocalAutoTopupEnabled] = useState(true);
    33→  const [localAutoTopupThreshold, setLocalAutoTopupThreshold] = useState(10);
    34→  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);
    35→
    36→  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
    37→  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    38→
    39→  // Initialize from server preferences
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
    42→      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
    43→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);
    44→
    45→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
    46→        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
    47→      }
    48→
    49→      setHasInitialized(true);
    50→    }
    51→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);
    52→
    53→  // Auto-update threshold for new users when purchase amount changes
    54→  useEffect(() => {
    55→    if (hasInitialized && autoTopupPreferences && autoTopupPreferences.threshold === 10 && purchaseAmount !== 50) {
    56→      const defaultThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(purchaseAmount / 5));
    57→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(defaultThreshold);
    58→    }
    59→  }, [purchaseAmount, hasInitialized, autoTopupPreferences]);
    60→
    61→  // Cleanup debounce timer on unmount
    62→  useEffect(() => {
    63→    return () => {
    64→      if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
    65→        clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
    66→      }

    68→  }, []);
    69→
    70→  // Computed auto-top-up state

    72→    if (!autoTopupPreferences) return 'loading';

    74→    const { setupCompleted } = autoTopupPreferences;
    75→    const enabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
```

```
   143→    await logger.flush();
   144→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({

   151→      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   152→    });
   153→  } catch (error: unknown) {
```

```
   228→        upsert: false,
   229→      });

   231→    if (error) {

   235→    return filePath;

   265→        uploadToTempStorage,
   266→      });
   267→
   268→      if (!storagePaths) {
   269→        return operationFailure(new Error('No LoRA file provided'), {
```

```
    44→

    49→    .from('projects')

    53→  if (projectsError) {
    54→    return { data: null, error: { message: projectsError.message, code: projectsError.code } };

    62→    .map((project) => project.id)

    65→  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin

    75→  }
    76→

    78→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<void>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function useReplaceInShot({
    34→  onClose,
    35→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    36→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    37→    parentGenerationId: string,
    38→    currentMediaId: string,
    39→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    40→    shotIdParam: string
    41→  ) => {
    42→
    43→    try {
    44→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    45→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    46→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    47→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    48→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    49→
    50→      if (removeError) throw removeError;
    51→
    52→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    53→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    54→      const { data: existingAssoc } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    55→        .select('id')
    56→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    57→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    58→        .single();
    59→
    60→      if (existingAssoc) {
    61→        // Update existing
    62→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    63→          .update({
    64→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    65→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    66→          })
    67→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
    68→
    69→        if (updateError) throw updateError;
    70→      } else {
    71→        // Create new
    72→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    73→          .insert({
    74→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
    75→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
    76→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    77→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    78→          });
    79→
    80→        if (createError) throw createError;
    81→      }
    82→
    83→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
    84→      onClose();
    85→    } catch (error) {
    86→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReplaceInShot', showToast: false });
    87→      return;
    88→    }
    89→  }, [onClose]);
    90→
    91→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
    92→}
    93→
```

```
     8→/**
     9→ * Edge function: update-shot-pair-prompts
    10→ * 
    11→ * Updates the shot_generations.metadata.enhanced_prompt field for all positioned
    12→ * images in a shot with the provided enhanced prompts array.
    13→ * 
    14→ * POST /functions/v1/update-shot-pair-prompts
    15→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <Service Role Key or PAT>
    16→ * Body: {
    17→ *   "shot_id": "uuid-string",           // Shot ID to update
    18→ *   "task_id": "uuid-string",           // Optional: Task ID for log association
    19→ *   "enhanced_prompts": [               // Array of enhanced prompts (one per image)

    22→ *     "Another description..."
    23→ *   ]

    25→ * 
    26→ * Returns:
    27→ * - 200 OK with updated shot_generations count
    28→ * - 400 Bad Request if missing required fields

    35→serve((req) => {

    43→}, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body: requestBody, auth }) => {
    44→  const isServiceRole = auth!.isServiceRole;
    45→  const callerId = auth!.userId;
    46→
    47→  // Validate required fields
    48→  const shot_id = typeof requestBody.shot_id === "string" ? requestBody.shot_id : null;
    49→  const task_id = typeof requestBody.task_id === "string" ? requestBody.task_id : null;
    50→  const enhancedPrompts = Array.isArray(requestBody.enhanced_prompts)
    51→    ? requestBody.enhanced_prompts.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string")
    52→    : null;
    53→  
    54→  // Set task_id for all subsequent logs if provided

    58→  }

    60→  if (!shot_id) {
    61→    logger.error("Missing required field: shot_id");
    62→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Missing required field: shot_id" }, 400);
    63→  }
    64→  if (!enhancedPrompts) {
    65→    logger.error("Missing or invalid required field: enhanced_prompts", {

   104→      generation_id,
   105→      timeline_frame,

   110→        location
   111→      )
   112→    `)
   113→    .eq("shot_id", shot_id)
   114→    .not("timeline_frame", "is", null)
   115→    // Deterministic ordering: Timeline sorts by timeline_frame; add a stable tie-breaker.
   116→    .order("timeline_frame", { ascending: true })
   117→    .order("id", { ascending: true });
   118→
   119→  if (sgError) {

   123→    });

   125→  }
   126→
   127→  if (!shotGenerations || shotGenerations.length === 0) {
   128→    logger.warn("No shot_generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   129→    return jsonResponse({
   130→      success: true,
   131→      message: "No positioned images found for this shot",
   132→      updated_count: 0,
   133→    }, 200);
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  // Use shared timeline eligibility contract to keep edge behavior aligned with Timeline UI.
   137→  const imageGenerations = shotGenerations.filter((sg) => {
   138→    const generation = sg.generation as { type?: string | null; location?: string | null } | null;
   139→    return isTimelineEligiblePositionedImage({
   140→      timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   141→      type: generation?.type ?? null,
   142→      location: generation?.location ?? null,
   143→    });
   144→  });
   145→
   146→  logger.info("Found shot_generations", {
   147→    shot_id,
   148→    totalCount: shotGenerations.length,
   149→    imageCount: imageGenerations.length,
   150→    firstFewIds: imageGenerations.slice(0, 3).map((sg) => sg.id.substring(0, 8)),
   151→    firstFewFrames: imageGenerations.slice(0, 3).map((sg) => sg.timeline_frame),
   152→  });
   153→
   154→  // Verify enhanced_prompts count matches expected (N-1 for N images, since prompts describe transitions)
   155→  const expectedPromptCount = Math.max(0, imageGenerations.length - 1);
   156→  if (enhancedPrompts.length !== expectedPromptCount) {
   157→    logger.warn("Enhanced prompts count differs from expected", {
   158→      shot_id,
   159→      imageCount: imageGenerations.length,
   160→      expectedPromptCount,
   161→      actualPromptCount: enhancedPrompts.length,
   162→      note: 'Enhanced prompts describe transitions between images (N-1 prompts for N images)',
   163→    });
   164→  }
   165→
   166→  if (imageGenerations.length === 0) {
   167→    logger.info("No image generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   168→    return jsonResponse({
   169→      success: true,
   170→      message: "No image generations found for this shot",
   171→      updated_count: 0,
   172→    }, 200);
   173→  }
   174→
   175→  // Update each shot_generation's metadata with the corresponding enhanced_prompt
   176→  // Image at index i gets enhanced_prompts[i] (describes transition FROM this image TO the next)
   177→  const updatePromises = imageGenerations.map(async (sg, index) => {
   178→    const existingMetadata = sg.metadata || {};
   179→    const enhancedPrompt = index < enhancedPrompts.length ? enhancedPrompts[index] : undefined;
   180→
   181→    // Skip if enhanced_prompt is empty/falsy (expected for last image)
   182→    if (!enhancedPrompt) {
   183→      logger.debug("Skipping shot_generation (no prompt for this index)", {
   184→        shot_id,
   185→        shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   186→        index,
   187→        timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   188→        reason: index >= enhancedPrompts.length ? 'last_image_no_transition' : 'empty_prompt',
   189→      });
   190→      return { id: sg.id, success: true, skipped: true };
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    const updatedMetadata = {
   194→      ...existingMetadata,
   195→      enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   196→    };
   197→
   198→    logger.debug("Updating shot_generation with enhanced_prompt", {
   199→      shot_id,
   200→      shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   201→      index,
   202→      timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   203→      promptPreview: enhancedPrompt.substring(0, 80) + (enhancedPrompt.length > 80 ? '...' : ''),
   204→    });
   205→
   206→    const { error: updateError } = await supabaseAdmin
   207→      .from("shot_generations")
   208→      .update({ metadata: updatedMetadata })
   209→      .eq("id", sg.id);
   210→
   211→    if (updateError) {
   212→      logger.error("Error updating shot_generation", {
   213→        shot_id,
   214→        shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   215→        error: updateError.message,
   216→      });
   217→      return { id: sg.id, success: false, error: updateError.message };
   218→    }
   219→
   220→    return { id: sg.id, success: true };
   221→  });
   222→
   223→  const results = await Promise.all(updatePromises);
   224→  const successCount = results.filter((r) => r.success).length;
   225→  const failedCount = results.filter((r) => !r.success).length;
   226→  const skippedCount = results.filter((r) => (r as { skipped?: boolean }).skipped).length;
   227→
   228→  logger.info("Update complete", {
   229→    shot_id,
   230→    total: results.length,
   231→    success: successCount,
   232→    failed: failedCount,
   233→    skipped: skippedCount,
   234→  });

   239→    updated_count: successCount - skippedCount,
   240→    skipped_count: skippedCount,
   241→    failed_count: failedCount,

   244→});
   245→});
```

`currentEnv` is a module-level env read - but in a Vite context `import.meta.env` values are statically replaced at build time, so this is fine. Let me check the `__IS_DEV_ENV__` more carefully since it also reads `window.location`.

Looking at line 37-39 of env.ts:
```ts
export const __IS_DEV_ENV__ =
  import.meta.env.VITE_APP_ENV === 'dev' ||
  (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.hostname === 'localhost');
```

This reads `window.location.hostname` at import time. While it has the `typeof window` guard, it's still computing a constant at module scope that could differ from what a dynamic getter returns if the module is imported in different environments.

```
    17→/**
    18→ * In-memory queue for add-to-join intents.
    19→ * This decouples handoff from localStorage read timing.

    21→export function enqueueJoinClipsIntent(
    22→  entry: PendingJoinClipEntry,
    23→  scope: JoinClipsIntentScope,
    24→): void {

    27→  if (existing.some((pending) => pending.generationId === entry.generationId)) {
    28→    return;
    29→  }
    30→
    31→  intentsByScopeKey.set(key, [...existing, entry]);
    32→  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    33→    try {
    34→      listener(scope);
    35→    } catch {
    36→      // Intentionally swallow listener errors to keep queue dispatch robust.
    37→    }
    38→  });

    41→/**
    42→ * Consume and acknowledge pending intents for the given scope.
    43→ */
    44→export function consumeJoinClipsIntents(scope: JoinClipsIntentScope): PendingJoinClipEntry[] {
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useVariantPromotion - Handles promoting variants to standalone generations
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages variant promotion (creating standalone generation from a variant)
     5→ * and adding variants as new generations to shots with timeline positioning.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { usePromoteVariantToGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/variants/usePromoteVariantToGeneration';
    13→import { useAddImageToShot } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
    14→
    15→interface UseVariantPromotionProps {
    16→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    20→  promoteSuccess: boolean;
    21→  isPromoting: boolean;
    22→  handlePromoteToGeneration: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    23→  handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot: (
    24→    shotId: string,
    25→    variantId: string,
    26→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    27→  ) => Promise<boolean>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function useVariantPromotion({
    31→  selectedProjectId,
    32→}: UseVariantPromotionProps): UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    33→  const promoteVariantMutation = usePromoteVariantToGeneration();
    34→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
    35→  const [promoteSuccess, setPromoteSuccess] = useState(false);
    36→
    37→  // Handler for "Make new image" button in VariantSelector
    38→  const handlePromoteToGeneration = useCallback(async (variantId: string) => {
    39→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    40→      toast.error('No project selected');
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    setPromoteSuccess(false);
    45→
    46→    try {
    47→      await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    48→        variantId,
    49→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    50→      });
    51→
    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  if (!writeFunction) {
   169→    throw new Error(
   170→      '[SettingsWriteQueue] enqueueSettingsWrite called before setSettingsWriteFunction. ' +
   171→      'Ensure app initialization calls setSettingsWriteFunction first.'
   172→    );
   173→  }
   174→
   175→  const key = targetKey(write);
   176→
   177→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   178→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   179→      reject(createAbortError());
   180→      return;
   181→    }
   182→
   183→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   184→
   185→    if (existing) {
   186→      // Merge with existing pending write
   187→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   188→      if (write.signal) {
   189→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   190→      }
   191→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   192→
   193→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   194→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   195→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   196→      }
   197→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   198→      
   199→    } else {
   200→      // Create new pending write
   201→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   202→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   203→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   204→        timerId: null,
   205→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   206→      };
   207→
   208→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   209→
   210→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   211→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   212→      } else {
   213→        // Set debounce timer
   214→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   215→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   216→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   217→      }
   218→    }
   219→  });
   220→}
   221→
   222→
   223→/**
   224→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   225→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   226→ */
   227→function flushAll(): void {
   228→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   229→    if (pending.timerId) {
   230→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   231→      pending.timerId = null;
   232→    }
   233→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   234→  }
   235→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   236→  processQueue();
   237→}
   238→
   239→
```

**Score: 72/100 for mid_level_elegance**

**Summary of findings (9 defects):**

1. **asRecord/asString duplication** (high) - The same narrowing helpers are redefined in ~10 files instead of importing from the canonical `jsonNarrowing.ts` or `taskParamParsers.ts`.

2. **Dual param extraction paths** (high) - `taskParamsUtils.ts` has legacy inline extraction alongside the newer `TaskPayloadSnapshot`/`TravelPayloadReader` system, but only travel tasks use the new system.

3. **Lightbox return surface area** (medium) - `UseSharedLightboxStateReturn` has 60+ fields across 13 sub-objects, with substantial field-by-field rewrapping of sub-hook returns.

4. **Inline Supabase query in cache** (high) - `generationTaskCache.ts` contains a raw task fetch query that duplicates repository-level data access patterns.

5. **useAdjustedTaskDetails boundary complexity** (medium) - Constructs synthetic `Task` objects from 3 sources with multi-way fallback chains and unclear heuristics.

6. **className string inspection** (high) - `AIInputButton` checks `className?.includes('flex-1')` to determine sizing behavior instead of using an explicit prop.

7. **normalizeTaskDetailsPayload re-extracts** (high) - Manually re-extracts orchestrator fields that `buildTaskPayloadSnapshot` already provides canonically.

8. **SegmentSlotModeData wide interface** (medium) - 30+ field interface crossing tool/lightbox boundary with 15+ optional fields mixing unrelated concerns.

9. **Hidden global state in projectId resolution** (medium) - `resolveTaskScopeProjectId` silently reads from a global store, making data flow invisible to callers.

```
    27→serve((req) => {
```

```
     6→
     7→const AUTH_HEAL_DEBOUNCE_MS = 5000;
     8→
     9→export class AuthStateManager {
    10→  private listeners: Array<{id: string, callback: AuthCallback}> = [];
    11→  private isInitialized = false;
    12→  private __LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = 0;
    13→
    14→  constructor(private supabase: SupabaseClient) {}
    15→
    16→  subscribe(id: string, callback: AuthCallback) {
    17→    this.listeners.push({ id, callback });
    18→    return () => {
    19→      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter(listener => listener.id !== id);
    20→    };
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  private notifyListeners(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    24→    this.listeners.forEach(({ callback }) => {
    25→      try {
    26→        callback(event, session);
    27→      } catch (error) {
    28→        normalizeAndLogError(error, { context: 'AuthStateManager' });
    29→      }
    30→    });
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  private handleCoreAuth(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    34→    try {
    35→      this.supabase?.realtime?.setAuth?.(session?.access_token ?? null);
    36→      
    37→      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    38→        setTimeout(async () => {
    39→          try {
    40→            const now = Date.now();
    41→            if (now - this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ > AUTH_HEAL_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
    42→              this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = now;
    43→              
    44→              // Use ReconnectScheduler instead of direct event dispatch
    45→              const scheduler = getReconnectScheduler();
    46→              scheduler.requestReconnect({
    47→                source: 'AuthManager',
    48→                reason: `SIGNED_IN event (${event})`,
    49→                priority: 'high'
    50→              });
    51→            }
    52→          } catch (healError) {
    53→            normalizeAndLogError(healError, { context: 'AuthStateManager' });
    54→          }
    55→        }, 1000);
    56→      }
    57→    } catch (setAuthError) {
    58→      normalizeAndLogError(setAuthError, { context: 'AuthStateManager' });
    59→    }
    60→  }
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useVariantPromotion - Handles promoting variants to standalone generations
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages variant promotion (creating standalone generation from a variant)
     5→ * and adding variants as new generations to shots with timeline positioning.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { usePromoteVariantToGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/variants/usePromoteVariantToGeneration';
    13→import { useAddImageToShot } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
    14→
    15→interface UseVariantPromotionProps {
    16→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    20→  promoteSuccess: boolean;
    21→  isPromoting: boolean;
    22→  handlePromoteToGeneration: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    23→  handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot: (
    24→    shotId: string,
    25→    variantId: string,
    26→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    27→  ) => Promise<boolean>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function useVariantPromotion({
    31→  selectedProjectId,
    32→}: UseVariantPromotionProps): UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    33→  const promoteVariantMutation = usePromoteVariantToGeneration();
    34→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
    35→  const [promoteSuccess, setPromoteSuccess] = useState(false);
    36→
    37→  // Handler for "Make new image" button in VariantSelector
    38→  const handlePromoteToGeneration = useCallback(async (variantId: string) => {
    39→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    40→      toast.error('No project selected');
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    setPromoteSuccess(false);
    45→
    46→    try {
    47→      await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    48→        variantId,
    49→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    50→      });
    51→
    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→
```

```
   380→      const analysis = analysisResult.data || {};
   381→      const eligible_queued = analysis.eligible_count ?? 0;
   382→      const user_info = analysis.user_info ?? {};
   383→
   384→      const projectIds = projectsResult.data?.map(p => p.id) || [];
   385→
   386→      let queued_tasks: unknown[] = [];
   387→      let active_tasks: unknown[] = [];
   388→
   389→      if (projectIds.length > 0) {
   390→        // Fetch task details (parallel)
   391→        const [queuedResult, activeResult] = await Promise.all([
   392→          supabaseAdmin
   393→            .from('tasks')
   394→            .select('id, task_type, created_at, project_id')
   395→            .eq('status', 'Queued')
   396→            .in('project_id', projectIds)
   397→            .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
   398→            .limit(50),
   399→          supabaseAdmin
   400→            .from('tasks')
   401→            .select('id, task_type, worker_id, updated_at, project_id')
   402→            .eq('status', 'In Progress')
   403→            .in('project_id', projectIds)
   404→            .not('worker_id', 'is', null)
   405→            .order('updated_at', { ascending: true })
   406→            .limit(50)
   407→        ]);
   408→
   409→        // Filter and format queued tasks
   410→        queued_tasks = (queuedResult.data || [])
   411→          .filter(task => !task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator'))
   412→          .map(task => ({
   413→            task_id: task.id,
   414→            task_type: task.task_type,
   415→            user_id: callerId,
   416→            created_at: task.created_at
   417→          }));
   418→
   419→        // Filter and format active tasks
   420→        active_tasks = (activeResult.data || [])
   421→          .filter(task => !task.task_type?.toLowerCase().includes('orchestrator'))
   422→          .map(task => ({
   423→            task_id: task.id,
   424→            task_type: task.task_type,
   425→            worker_id: task.worker_id,
   426→            user_id: callerId,
   427→            started_at: task.updated_at
   428→          }));
   429→      }
   430→
   431→      if (debug) {
   432→        logger.debug('User counts', { user_id: callerId, queued_only, active_only, eligible_queued });
   433→      }
   434→
   435→      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
   436→
   437→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   438→        mode: 'count',
   439→        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   440→        user_id: callerId,
   441→        run_type_filter_requested: requestedRunType,
   442→        run_type_filter: appliedRunType,
   443→        totals: {
   444→          queued_only,
   445→          active_only,
   446→          queued_plus_active,
   447→          eligible_queued
   448→        },
   449→        queued_tasks,
   450→        active_tasks,
   451→        user_info,
   452→        debug_summary: {
   453→          at_capacity: active_only >= 5,
   454→          capacity_used_pct: Math.round((active_only / 5) * 100),
   455→          can_claim_more: active_only < 5 && eligible_queued > 0
   456→        },
   457→        elapsed_ms: debug ? elapsed : undefined
   458→      }), {
   459→        status: 200,
   460→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   461→      });
   462→    }
   463→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   464→    const message = toErrorMessage(error);
   465→    logger.error("Unexpected error", { error: message });
   466→    await logger.flush();
   467→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${message}`, { status: 500 });
   468→  }
   469→});
   470→
```

```
     3→/**
     4→ * Hook to measure a container's width using ResizeObserver.
     5→ * Returns the current width and a ref to attach to the container.
     6→ *
     7→ * Uses window.innerWidth as initial estimate to avoid layout shift on first render.
     8→ * Only updates width when layout is stable (avoids intermediate states during mount).

    10→ * @returns [ref, width] - Attach ref to container, width updates on resize
    11→ */
    12→export function useContainerWidth(): [RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, number] {
    13→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    14→  // Start with window width as estimate to avoid 0 on first render
    15→  const initialEstimate = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    16→    ? Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.9)
    17→    : 800;
    18→  const [width, setWidth] = useState(initialEstimate);
    19→  const hasReceivedStableWidth = useRef(false);
    20→
    21→  useEffect(() => {
    22→    const element = containerRef.current;
    23→    if (!element) return;
    24→
    25→    let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    26→
    27→    // Set up ResizeObserver - this is the source of truth for width
    28→    // Debounced to avoid rapid recalculations during animated resizes (e.g. pane lock/unlock)
    29→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
    30→      for (const entry of entries) {
    31→        const newWidth = entry.contentRect.width;
    32→        if (newWidth <= 0) continue;
    33→
    34→        if (!hasReceivedStableWidth.current) {
    35→          // First measurement: apply immediately to prevent layout flash
    36→          // (e.g. gallery in a narrow panel starts with full-viewport estimate)
    37→          hasReceivedStableWidth.current = true;
    38→          setWidth(newWidth);
    39→        } else {
    40→          // Subsequent measurements: debounce for smooth animated resizes
    41→          if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    42→          debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => setWidth(newWidth), 150);
    43→        }
    44→      }
    45→    });
    46→
    47→    resizeObserver.observe(element);

    50→    const fallbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => {

    53→      }
    54→    }, 100);
    55→
    56→    return () => {
    57→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    58→      clearTimeout(fallbackTimeout);
    59→      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    60→    };
    61→  }, [initialEstimate]);
    62→
    63→  return [containerRef, width];
    64→}

    76→ * Height: full viewport height (window.innerHeight) minus an offset for controls
    77→ *
    78→ * This is used for calculating how many gallery rows fit in a full viewport,
    79→ * regardless of scroll position or where the gallery is on the page.
    80→ *
    81→ * @param heightOffset - Pixels to subtract from viewport height (e.g., for header + pagination)
    82→ * @param skipHeaderDetection - Skip auto-detecting sticky/fixed headers (e.g., on mobile where there's no header)

    85→export function useContainerDimensions(
    86→  heightOffset: number = 0,
    87→  skipHeaderDetection: boolean = false
    88→): [RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, ContainerDimensions] {
    89→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    90→

    93→    ? Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.9)

    95→  const initialHeightEstimate = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    96→    ? window.innerHeight - heightOffset

    98→
    99→  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState<ContainerDimensions>({
   100→    width: initialWidthEstimate,
   101→    height: initialHeightEstimate,
   102→  });

   112→      // Detect sticky/fixed header height by scanning for header-like elements
   113→      // pinned at the top of the viewport (the site header is a sibling, not ancestor)
   114→      // Skip on mobile/iPad where there's no fixed header
   115→      let fixedChromeHeight = 0;
   116→      if (!skipHeaderDetection) {

   138→        });

   150→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop

    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.

    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);

    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];

    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;

   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).

   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];

   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→
```

```
    45→  }
```
