1→import * as React from 'react';
     2→
     3→const Slot = React.forwardRef<HTMLElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>(
     4→  ({ children, ...props }, forwardedRef) => {
     5→    if (!React.isValidElement(children)) {
     6→      return null;
     7→    }
     8→
     9→    const child = children as React.ReactElement<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    10→      ref?: React.Ref<HTMLElement>;
    11→    };
    12→
    13→    return React.cloneElement(child, {
    14→      ...mergeProps(props, child.props),
    15→      ref: forwardedRef ? composeRefs(forwardedRef, child.ref) : child.ref,
    16→    } as Record<string, unknown>);
    17→  }
    18→);
    19→
    20→Slot.displayName = 'Slot';
    21→
    22→function mergeProps(
    23→  slotProps: Record<string, unknown>,
    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
    25→): Record<string, unknown> {
    26→  const overrideProps: Record<string, unknown> = { ...childProps };
    27→
    28→  for (const propName in childProps) {
    29→    const slotPropValue = slotProps[propName];
    30→    const childPropValue = childProps[propName];
    31→
    32→    const isHandler = /^on[A-Z]/.test(propName);
    33→    if (isHandler) {
    34→      if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function' && typeof childPropValue === 'function') {
    35→        overrideProps[propName] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    36→          (childPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    37→          (slotPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    38→        };
    39→      } else if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function') {
    40→        overrideProps[propName] = slotPropValue;
    41→      }
    42→    } else if (propName === 'style') {
    43→      const slotStyle = typeof slotPropValue === 'object' && slotPropValue ? slotPropValue : {};
    44→      const childStyle = typeof childPropValue === 'object' && childPropValue ? childPropValue : {};
    45→      overrideProps[propName] = { ...slotStyle, ...childStyle };
    46→    } else if (propName === 'className') {
    47→      overrideProps[propName] = [slotPropValue, childPropValue].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return { ...slotProps, ...overrideProps };
    52→}
    53→
    54→function composeRefs<T>(...refs: (React.Ref<T> | undefined | null)[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
    55→  return (node) => {
    56→    refs.forEach((ref) => {
    57→      if (typeof ref === 'function') {
    58→        ref(node);
    59→      } else if (ref != null) {
    60→        (ref as React.MutableRefObject<T | null>).current = node;
    61→      }
    62→    });
    63→  };
    64→}
    65→
    66→export { Slot };
    67→

   172→      disabled={disabled || voiceState === "processing"}
   173→      className={cn(
   174→        "relative rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors z-10",
   175→        !isStretching && "h-6 w-6",
   176→        getButtonStyles(visuals),
   177→        disabled && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed",
   178→        className
   179→      )}
   180→      tabIndex={-1}
   181→    >
   182→      {/* Audio level ring indicator */}
   183→      {voiceState === "recording" && (
   184→        <span 
   185→          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-md border-2 border-white/80 pointer-events-none"
   186→          style={{
   187→            transform: `scale(${1 + audioLevel * 0.5})`,
   188→            opacity: 0.3 + audioLevel * 0.7,
   189→            transition: 'transform 50ms ease-out, opacity 50ms ease-out',
   190→          }}
   191→        />
   192→      )}
   193→      {/* Secondary expanding ring */}
   194→      {voiceState === "recording" && audioLevel > 0.1 && (
   195→        <span 
   196→          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-md border border-red-300 pointer-events-none"
   197→          style={{
   198→            transform: `scale(${1.2 + audioLevel * 0.6})`,
   199→            opacity: Math.max(0, audioLevel - 0.1) * 0.5,
   200→            transition: 'transform 80ms ease-out, opacity 80ms ease-out',
   201→          }}
   202→        />
   203→      )}
   204→      
   205→      {/* Countdown timer - bottom left corner */}
   206→      {voiceState === "recording" && (
   207→        <span 
   208→          className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -left-0.5 bg-red-600 text-white text-[8px] font-bold rounded px-0.5 leading-none py-0.5 tabular-nums shadow-sm"
   209→        >
   210→          {remainingSeconds}
   211→        </span>
   212→      )}
   213→      
   214→      {/* Cancel button - top right corner */}
   215→      {voiceState === "recording" && (
   216→        <span
   217→          role="button"
   218→          onClick={handleCancel}
   219→          className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
   220→          title="Cancel"
   221→        >
   222→          <X className="h-2 w-2" />
   223→        </span>
   224→      )}
   225→
   226→      {getMainIcon(visuals)}
   227→    </button>
   228→  )
   229→
   230→  // Text mode button content (with popover)
   231→  const textButtonTrigger = (
   232→    <button
   233→      ref={ref}
   234→      type="button"
   235→      disabled={disabled || textState === "processing"}
   236→      className={cn(
   237→        "relative rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors z-10",
   238→        !isStretching && "h-6 w-6",
   239→        getButtonStyles(visuals),
   240→        disabled && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed",
   241→        className
   242→      )}
   243→      tabIndex={-1}
   244→    >
   245→      {getMainIcon(visuals)}
   246→    </button>
   247→  )
   248→
   249→  // On mobile, skip the tooltip wrapper entirely but keep Popover for text mode
   250→  if (isMobile) {
   251→    if (mode === "voice") {
   252→      return voiceButtonContent
   253→    }
   254→    // Text mode on mobile - wrap in Popover without Tooltip
   255→    return (
   256→      <Popover open={isPopoverOpen} onOpenChange={handlePopoverOpenChange}>
   257→        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
   258→          {textButtonTrigger}
   259→        </PopoverTrigger>
   260→        <PopoverContent
   261→          side="top"
   262→          align="end"

   274→        </PopoverContent>

   276→    )
   277→  }
   278→
   279→  // Voice mode: touchable tooltip with mode switch action
   280→  if (mode === "voice") {
   281→    return (
   282→      <TouchableTooltip
   283→        side="top"
   284→        contentClassName="flex flex-col gap-1"
   285→        content={
   286→          <>
   287→            <p className="text-xs">{getTooltipText(visuals)}</p>

   305→

   332→      <TooltipContent side="top" sideOffset={5} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
   333→        <p className="text-xs">{getTooltipText(visuals)}</p>
   334→        <TextAction

     2→import { Check, Loader2, Mic, Square, Wand2 } from 'lucide-react';
     3→import type { TextProcessingState } from '@/shared/components/ui/hooks/useAIInputTextPopover';
     4→
     5→type AIInputMode = 'voice' | 'text';

     7→interface VisualStateInput {

     9→  voiceState: string;
    10→  textState: TextProcessingState;
    11→  hasExistingContent: boolean;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function getMainIcon({
    15→  mode,
    16→  voiceState,
    17→  textState,
    18→}: VisualStateInput): React.ReactNode {
    19→  if (mode === 'voice') {
    20→    switch (voiceState) {
    21→      case 'recording':
    22→        return <Square className="h-3 w-3 fill-current" />;
    23→      case 'processing':
    24→        return <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />;

    33→    case 'success':
    34→      return <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />;
    35→    default:
    36→      return <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getTooltipText({
    41→  mode,
    42→  voiceState,

    51→      default:

    53→          ? 'Voice input to create/edit prompt'
    54→          : 'Voice input to create prompt';

    62→

    47→## Tech Stack
    48→
    49→| Layer | Technology | Purpose |

    51→| **Frontend** | React + Vite + TypeScript | SPA framework & build tooling |
    52→| **Styling** | TailwindCSS + shadcn-ui | Utility CSS with container queries (`@container`) |
    53→| **Backend** | Supabase (Postgres + Edge Functions) | Database, auth, storage, serverless workers |

    55→**Dev server:** `http://localhost:2222` • **Package managers:** npm (default) or bun
    56→
    57→---
    58→
    59→## Directory Structure
    60→
    61→| Path | Purpose | Key Files |
    62→|------|---------|-----------|
    63→| `/src/app` | App bootstrap & routing | `main.tsx` → `App.tsx` → `routes.tsx` → `Layout.tsx` |
    64→| `/src/pages` | Top-level pages | `HomePage`, `ShotsPage`, `ArtPage`, `SharePage`, `NotFoundPage`, payment pages |
    65→| `/src/tools` | Feature modules | Each tool: `pages/`, `components/`, `hooks/`, `settings.ts` |
    66→| `/src/domains` | Domain-specific logic (billing, lora, media-lightbox, generation) | Business logic not tied to a single tool |
    67→| `/src/features` | Feature slices (tasks, shots, gallery, settings, etc.) | UI + hooks organized by product feature |
    68→| `/src/integrations` | Third-party integrations | Supabase client, auth, realtime, instrumentation |
    69→| `/src/types` | Shared TypeScript types | `database.ts`, `tasks.ts`, `ai.ts`, `env.ts` |
    70→| `/src/shared` | Shared code | `components/ui/` (shadcn), `hooks/`, `contexts/`, `lib/` |
    71→| `/supabase/functions` | Edge Functions | Task processing, payments, AI integration |
    72→| `/supabase/migrations` | DB migrations | Schema changes (use `db push --linked`) |
    73→| Root | Build configs | `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `railway.toml` |
    74→
    75→---
    76→
    77→## Core Concepts
    78→
    79→### Tools
    80→Tools live in `/src/tools/{tool-name}/` following a consistent structure. See [adding_new_tool.md](docs/structure_detail/adding_new_tool.md).
    81→
    82→**Active tools:** Image Generation, Video Travel, Animate Characters, Edit Images, Edit Video, Join Clips, Training Data Helper
    83→
    84→### Shots & Generations
    85→- **Generations** = gallery items (images/videos produced by AI tasks)
    86→- **Shots** = containers that organize generations into a timeline
    87→- **`shot_generations`** = join table with position + metadata (pair prompts, timeline frame)
    88→- Data access: `useShotImages(shotId)` → see [data_fetching.md](docs/structure_detail/data_fetching.md)
    89→
    90→### Settings Resolution
    91→Priority: **shot → project → user → defaults**. See [settings_system.md](docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md).
    92→
    93→### Task System
    94→Async queue for AI workloads: client creates task → DB trigger → worker polls → Edge Function completes.
    95→See [task_worker_lifecycle.md](docs/structure_detail/task_worker_lifecycle.md).
    96→
    97→### Realtime
    98→Smart polling + Supabase realtime subscriptions. Connected = no polling; disconnected = 15s fallback.
    99→See [realtime_system.md](docs/structure_detail/realtime_system.md).
   100→

1→# Frontend Architecture Patterns
     2→
     3→---
     4→
     5→## State Management
     6→
     7→No Redux/Zustand. State flows through specific layers:
     8→
     9→| Layer | Tool | Purpose |
    10→|-------|------|---------|
    11→| **Server state** | React Query | Remote data (shots, generations, settings) |
    12→| **Query keys** | `queryKeys` registry (`shared/lib/queryKeys.ts`) | Single source of truth for all cache keys |
    13→| **Global UI state** | React Context | Cross-component state (selected project, current shot) |
    14→| **Persisted UI state** | `useUserUIState` | Preferences saved to user settings |
    15→| **Local state** | `useState`/`useReducer` | Component-internal state |
    16→| **URL state** | React Router | Route params, query strings |
    17→
    18→### Query Key Convention
    19→
    20→Keys use **nouns**, **kebab-case** for multi-word, scoped **broad-to-specific**:
    21→`['shots', projectId]` not `[projectId, 'shots']`.
    22→
    23→All keys live in `queryKeys` object. Invalidation goes through hooks in `shared/hooks/invalidation/`, never raw `queryClient.invalidateQueries`.
    24→
    25→---
    26→
    27→## Contexts
    28→
    29→| Context | Provider location |
    30→|---------|-------------------|
    31→| `AuthContext` | `App.tsx` (top-level) |
    32→| `ProjectContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    33→| `UserSettingsContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    34→| `ShotsContext` | Project route layout |
    35→| `CurrentShotContext` | Shot route layout |
    36→| `PanesContext` | Shot route layout |
    37→| `GenerationTaskContext` | Tool pages |
    38→| `AIInputModeContext` | Tool pages |
    39→| `IncomingTasksContext` | Project route layout |
    40→| `ToolPageHeaderContext` | Tool page layout |
    41→| `LastAffectedShotContext` | Project route layout |
    42→
    43→### Provider nesting order matters
    44→
    45→See `App.tsx` for the hierarchy. Providers that depend on others must be nested inside them (e.g., `ProjectContext` inside `AuthContext`).
    46→
    47→---
    48→
    49→## Cross-Cutting Systems (details in dedicated docs)
    50→
    51→| System | Doc |
    52→|--------|-----|
    53→| Settings (scope cascade, persistence) | [settings_system.md](settings_system.md) |
    54→| Error handling (typed errors, `handleError()`) | [error_handling.md](error_handling.md) |
    55→| Realtime (subscriptions, batching, invalidation) | [realtime_system.md](realtime_system.md) |
    56→| Performance (memoization, preloading, debouncing) | [performance_system.md](performance_system.md) |
    57→| Task creation (validate, transform, insert) | [unified_task_creation.md](unified_task_creation.md) |
    58→| Image loading (progressive, lazy, preload) | [image_loading_system.md](image_loading_system.md) |
    59→| Tool module structure | [adding_new_tool.md](../adding_new_tool.md) |
    60→| Shared utilities (ModalContainer, ConfirmDialog) | [shared_utilities.md](shared_utilities.md) |
